tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gla
bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gla

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun bcu'i cha shas las/ /brag nag bdud rdzong gter byon drag sgrub rmad/ /kī la ya'i chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni bla ma drag po'i sgrub pa ste/ zab gter bdun bcu las/ mtha' dmag zlog byed drag po'i chos bzhi'i nang tshan drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu zhes zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la/

thog mar chos sde spyi'i rgyab chos skor la/ ka) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar gyi: lo rgyus gab sbas lde mig kha) gu ru zil gnon rtsal gyi: lung bstan chos bdag nor bu'i phreng ba/ ga) kī la ya'i dbang chog: rdo rje'i phreng ba dregs pa'i srog tig nga) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i chos skor las: dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar/ ca) bla ma zil gnon rtsal las: lus med mkha' 'gro'i gsang dbang mkha' spyod myur 'grub/ ༈ sde tshan gnyis pa dang po zhi ba bla ma gu ru pad+ma snang srid zil gnon gyi skor la/ cha) bla ma snang srid zil gnon las: gsol 'debs thugs rje'i sprin phung*/ ja) o rgyan rin po che gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel/ nya) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: dkar gtor snang srid 'dod yon/ ta) gu ru pad+ma snang srid zil gnon gyi: las byang ye shes kun khyab/ tha) gu ru snang srid zil gnon rtsal gyi/ bskang ba phrin las myur 'grub/ da) gu ru snang srid zil gnon las/ sbyin sreg dug lnga rang grol/ na) gu ru snang srid zil gnon las: rab gnas sku gsum lhun grub/ pa) gcod yul snang ba lam 'khyer/ pha) bla ma snang srid zil gnon gyi: lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor las: rtsa rlung chos nyid rang byung gi las gzhung pho nya'i brgyud phreng*/ ba) bla ma snang srid zil gnon gyi lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor las: sde lnga'i sbyor thabs/ ma) bla ma snang srid zil gnon las: lus med gsang khrid 'dzin mkhas ril ba mdor bsdus/ tsa) srid pa mo khrid kyi 'khrul 'khor/ ༈ sde tshan gsum pa bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu skor las/ tsha) bdud 'dul drag po kī la ya'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig rtsal kud/ dza) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: gsol 'debs rgyas pa bdud dpung g.yul 'joms dmod pa nag po/

wa) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: las byang rdo rje thog rgod 'bring po/ zha) bdud rtsi lag mchod/ za) kī la ya'i sngags byang gud du sbas pa gab pa mngon du phyung ba/ 'a) drag po kī la ya'i: hūm̐ sgrub ye shes me 'bar/ ya) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: las byang 'bring po rdo rje thog rgod kyi rjes chog tshogs mchod 'dod rgu mchod sbyin/ ra) drag po kī la ya las srung bzlog gur gyi drwa mig gnam lcags spu gri/ la) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: lag rdeb 'dzam gling sbub bcom/ sha) thun gtor 'gugs gzhug sa) /drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: thun gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa/ ha) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las g.yul bzlog gi mdun bskyed mtshon 'khor dug gi ri bo/ a) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs kyi/ sngags byang gab sbas gsal ba/ ki) kī la ya'i mdun bskyed kyi tshogs mchod dngos grub char 'bebs/ khi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: bskang ba bsdus pa nor bus legs brgyan/ gi) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu las: gsang sgrub lus dkyil ltar sgom pa spu gri phyung rdeg /ngi) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i go cha khro bcu dang bcas pa'i spros med a nu'i lugs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ ci) drag po kī la ya'i bka' srung ma mo gtor 'bul/ chi) drag po kī la ya'i bka' srung khyab 'jug gi gtor 'bul/ ji) kī la che mchog khro rgyal las: skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul/ nyi) drag po kī la ya'i gter srung dmu bdud klu gsum gyi gtor 'bul byad ma tshar gcod/ ti) dbang drag che mchog kī la ya las: gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i gtor 'bul/ thi) dbang drag kī la ya'i srung ma nyer bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs/

di) gter srung myur mgyogs sde bzhi'i gsol mchod pho nya myur 'bod/ ni) kī la ya che mchog khro rgyal las: gnod sbyin shan pa spu gri gsum gyi gsol mchod/ ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i smad las drag po las mtha' rnam bzhi las/ dang po 'phang ba zor gyi las tshogs srung bsad bzlog 'phang gi skor las/ pi) mtshon srung rdo rje'i go khrab mi shigs pha lam/ phi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs: ngan sngags dug gi par bu'i srung bzlog gi 'khor lo/ bi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: rdzas sngags bla gnas srung bzlog mnan gsum gyi dmigs rim/ mi) ling khrus gnad gyi man ngag bsdus pa/ tsi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: g.yul bzlog dregs pa'i dmag bskul rngam ring thog mda' nag po/ tshi) bskul thung dregs pa dbang sdud/ dzi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: smad las bsad pa reg phung dug mda' nag po/ wi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: gdab las dug phreng nag po/ zhi) rgyugs byang*/ zi) sde brgyad rgyugs byang*/ 'i) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: rtsang bzlog dmod pa snying gzir nag po/ yi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: bzlog 'phyong gshin rje myos byed dug mda' nag po/ ri) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: khyung bzlog srid gsum brlag byed khro chu'i zhun khol/ li) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: than bzlog stong thun nag po ngan dgu sgyur chog /shi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: zor rdzas byin rlabs dug mtshon reg chod/ si) bla ma drag po rtsal gyi 'phen pa zor gyi lhan thabs dgra bgegs dpung 'joms/ hi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las:

srin mo za lam mkha' 'gro'i sun zlog /i) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: g.yul bzlog thog mda' reg chod kyi sgo dbye lam bstan zor gyi rim pa/ ki) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i dmod bcol gnam lcags thog mda'/ khu) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: glud rab lha mi'i yid 'phrog /ge) dbang drag che mchog kī la ya'i drag po hom gyi lhan thabs/ ngo) bsad pa dug gi ral gri'i sbyin sreg dgra bo'i srog gcod/ ci) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu+u'i skor las: drag sngags dug mda' nag po/ chu) dbang drag pad+ma drag po rtsal gyi mnan pa'i phrin las kyi bsad las thun bskul bdud dgra tshar gcod/ je) dbang drag pad+ma drag po che mchog bdud 'dul kī la ya'i mnan pa'i las mtha' chu srin kha 'tham/ nyo) thun gtor 'bul ba/ ti) drag po kī la ya'i las tshog dug gi par bu'i skor las: drag gtad sūr+ya'i tsakra'i drag sngags/ thu) bdud 'dul che mchog kī la ya'i zin bris/ de) gu ru drag po kī la ya'i gtor ma bca' thabs bcas rdzogs so/ rtsa gsu+um kun 'dus bla ma thod phreng rtsal/ /yi dam yongs 'dus gtum drag kī la ya/ /dug gi par bus dug gsum gdug pa'i dpung*/ /rtsad brlag mngon spyod phrin las 'di ko rmad/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyi skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/

// ka) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar gyi: lo rgyus gab sbas lde mig bzhugs so: bde chen rab khros yang gsang he ru kaḥ dregs 'joms drag rtsal zil gnon rnam par rgyal: ye shes cho 'phrul longs sku rig sngags rje: kun 'dus yongs rdzogs pad+ma'i sku la 'dud: e ma zab pa'i yang gsang bla med 'di: gsang sngags 'khrul med rnal 'byor snying gi chos: log lta tshar gcod smin grol dbang bzhi ldan: mtsho rgyal yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang smon lam thob: gdams ngag snying du chongs la brtson 'grus bskyed: dus mtha'i rtsod ldan lnga brgya'i yang mtha' la: sa steng log chos mu stegs dmag gis khengs: chos la 'dre zhugs ban+de glang snying gi: dam log sprul pa kha dar sa steng khengs: 'dzam gling gsal ba'i gsang sngags sgron me 'di: dam sri chos gzugs bzhi yis bsnub par 'byung : res mos dga' bde nyams mtha' rlung g.yos ltar: gsal kyang bstan pa'i 'phel sgrib dug rlangs 'phyur: stong sgra tig chom sa g.yos than ltas 'byung : che chung ma nges log chos blo thag chod: chos spyod rgyal po sdig gi dmangs su 'bebs: sa snying kha tham dam chos mi 'dod 'byung : de dus mi rnams rang phung mtshon cha spyod: nad du rmu chu zha grum khong lhog dang : gdon du rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog rgya 'dre ldang : sku gsung thugs rten mer bsreg chu la bskyur: dus ngan 'o dod gnam du 'bod pa 'byung : gnas khang rnams kyang zhig ral had por lus: mtha' mi mgo can bzhi yang dbus su 'thab: de dus 'o skol 'gro rnams snying re rje: zhes slob dpon gyis de skad gsungs pa'i mod la: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi spyan chab mang po shor te smre sngags kyis zhus pa: kye ma kyi hud rje btsun gu ru lags: sdug bsngal las ngan dus ngan de byung tshe: phan pa'i man ngag zab gnad ji ltar lags:

thugs kyi ti ka yongs rdzogs stsol bar zhu: zhes zhus pas slob dpon gyis: nyon cig bu mo skal ldan mtsho rgyal ma: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog thabs bsrung thabs dang : bskyed rdzogs rten 'brel chos bzhin skyong sgrub bstan: drag sgrub gsang ba'i sgrub thabs 'di lta bu: phyi sgrub drag po dregs pa yongs rdzogs dang : gsang sgrub kī la me yi spu gri dang : nang sgrub hūm̐ gi skor dang rnam gsum bstan: gsang ba'i zab shog thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs dus kyi 'phel 'grib shar ba'i dus: las can hūm̐ gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: rgya rgya rgya: spyir gsang sngags kyi chos mtha' dag 'o ma lta bu: gdams ngag gnad du 'gro ba mar lta bu: gsang sngags spyod nas snying po ma rtogs na: phyugs rdzi rgad po rang sdug stong 'khyams yin: man ngag shes nas nyams su ma blang na: jo chag rgad pos gser dngul gzhom dang mtshungs: rang dbang thob pa'i dbang bzhi ma blang na: zab chos 'dod kyang dug sbrul nor bu yin: bsnyen sgrub bskyed rim gnad du ma shes na: 'khrul ba'i sde brgyad rang srog gshed du 'bebs: zab gter gsang spel dus dang ma bstun na: 'gro don 'dod kyang dgrar 'dzin 'khrul ngor 'char: zab rgya re la lo re ma song bar: gdams ngag gzig thig gud du sba bar gyis: slob bu'i ngo skal thob par tshan gcig spel: dug ri nag po khro bo kun 'dus dang : pad+ma'i thugs bcud mkha' 'gro rgyan gcig dang : zab lam snyan brgyud o rgyan lam yig rnams: lo bdun bar du gsang rgya dam par gyis: bar do ngos 'dzin mtshan ma rang grol rnams: 'du ti dag bcu gsum 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // kha) gu ru zil gnon rtsal gyi: lung bstan chos bdag nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so:

kun khyab pad 'byung ma 'gag sa ler mkhyen: sku gsum sku lnga brgyud phreng rnam bzhi las: don brgyud khungs btsun 'khrul med don bkral te: mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo'i rgyud smras pa: dang po brda don rnams la phye ba ni: thog ma'i rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud tshul bstan: gdod nas rang byung kun bzang ngo bor shar: de phyir rol rtsal rdor 'chang lha tshogs la: 'khor 'das byed po dmigs rgyu bzhi sprul pa: de dag drug tu dga' rab rdo rje bzhugs: yi ge'i gzugs brnyan dbyings la legs par shar: me long nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang po'o: gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda brgyud rgyud don bkral: dga' rab rdo rje'i ye shes klong dgu ni: thugs la gsal rdzogs kṛ ya gsal brda'i don: rdzogs chen 'bum phrag sa ya grangs med mnga': khyad par dur khrod bsil ba tshal bzhugs nas: mkha' 'gro nyi ma'i 'od zer la sogs pa: grangs med 'khor bcas lo ni bdun cu bzhugs: chos skyong ma rgyud snying thig rgya mtsho phyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas brtul zhugs rab ldan ngang : dga' rab rdo rje'i drung du byon mdzad tshe: lta ba nam mkha' klong yangs la sogs pa: tshig gi yi ge'i don brgyud bka' bab gnang : pad 'byung rig 'dzin brda brgyud gnyis pa'o: gsum pa de las gang zag snyan brgyud ni: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro'i dbus 'gying skye 'chi bral: lha srin bran khol paṇ+ḍi'-i tshogs dpon tshe: 'jam dbyangs sprul pa khri srong bsam yas bzhengs: slob dpon spyan drangs bod khams 'dul zhing tshe: gtsug lag dben gnas lo brgya bcu gcig bzhugs: khyad par shel brag mchims phur bzhugs dus su: bai ro tsa na ye shes grogs gsum la: rdzogs pa chen po snying thig rgyud dgu dang : brda brgyud rnam gsum snyan brgyud rdzogs bskur nas: mi brjed gzungs thob bka' tshig snying du gnang : gang zag snyan brda brgyud pa gsum pa'o: bzhi pa lung bstan gtad brgyud gtad pa ni:

mtshon byed phyis su yi ger 'debs dus su: ma 'ongs 'dul zhing lung bstan rgyud don ni: 'khrul med slob dpon zhal nas 'di skad gsungs: bai ro tsa na ye shes grogs gsum nyon: rdzogs pa chen po'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi: don brgyud snying gi rtsa ba'i mthar thug 'di: da lta spel ba'i gnas med gter du sbos: dus ngan yang mtha' sum cu kha dar nas: sa gter mi thub gter ston mang 'byung zhing : sangs rgyas bstan pa dbus nub mtha' rtsod tshe: gnam la char med me rlung dud pa 'phyur: sa la zhag med 'jag skyas rgyang glu len: steng 'khrug 'og 'khrug rgyal khams chu bzhin 'khol: mtha' bzhi 'khrugs pas rgyal srid dmangs kyis 'phrog: yul khrims sil 'thor bod khams rgya hor rngam: chos khrims zhig pas dge bshes chang nag bsre: dam tshig nyams pas rgyal 'gong dmar khrims g.yo: gsang sngags nyams pas nad yams bu yug 'tshub: mtha' bzhi ral bas 'dre rgod yul la chags: mi rnams stod smad rgya hor dmag gis 'ded: bod khams mi rnams lho mon rong du 'bros: gos su shing shun lcags kyi slog pa gyon: khyi phag byi ba lo la mtha' bzhi 'joms: zas su sha khrag srog gcod dmar 'gyed gtong : nor la hab sha rgyud bskul dgra la 'chol: nyin re gtam 'gyur lus chas spyod pa 'gyur: sems can gar mkhan lag pa lta bu 'byung : de dus nga yi chos brgyud mtha' skyong ba: rgyal khams ma nges rngam sgra bdud kyi mtshams: bya nag gshog rdeb stong skad 'byin pa'i yul: sha za gcan gzan ngur sgra tser ba'i rong : yul ming nag po bdud rigs mun pa can: rtsi shing nag po mtshon rtse gzengs 'dra'i tshal: yab med yum bral gshed bzhi khyi yi lo: shes rab blo ldan rgya rtags ri mo ni: spyi gtsug me ri so zho tshe bum dang : snying khar sme nag chos 'byung rgyas pa'i dbyibs: tshigs su pad+ma rdo rjer hūm̐ mthing kha: mi 'gyur rtags ldan sku lnga'i chos la dbang :

ma nges spyod ldan rgyal khams rlung bzhin rgyu: rgyud kyis gling bzung rgyal khams las kyi 'brel: rig 'dzin gar dbang rdo rje zhes grags pa'i: bdud 'dul chos spyod hūm̐ dang drag rtsal ldan: phyogs med gter 'byin dgongs brda gnad du shes: zab gsang brda yi ri mo gces kyi chod: bka' gsang shog dril bdun cu don lnga 'di: dbang bzhi blangs nas nges med dben gnas su: mi mngon gsang rgya gter gtod yang gter sbos: lo bcu'i bar du gsang rgya dam par gyis: dus kyi sa rtags thams cad shar ba'i tshe: 'gro don smin pa'i 'bras bu de dus che: rdzogs mtha' chos kyi smin grol byang chub thob: de nas yang 'phos nga yi drung du 'ong : chos bdag dang po ye shes mchog la sprod: mkha' 'gro gnyis pa bya khyi lo la sprod: brda rtags bzhi pa smon lam rdo rjer sprod: bstan gnyis bzung 'dzin spre'u lo la sprod: rgyud lung bka' bab sa khams 'brug la sprod: ring lugs rgyud don mtshams bzhi lo la sprod: dbang chen rdo rje chos kyi ming la sprod: pad+ma'i srog theg pad+ma'i ming la sprod: drag po'i chos bzhi nor bus brgyan la sprod: nges med shes rab blo ldan rnams la spel: chos bdag lung bstan smon lam 'phrod pa'i tshe: nyi ma me shel zer thag 'phrod bzhin 'byung : chos bdag rnams la rten 'brel rab 'grig na: mdo sngags rgyun bsring 'dzam gling phyal gyis spyaud: 'bring po 'grig tshe mtha' bzhi rang sar lhod: chos bdag 'pho 'chug rten 'brel nyams srid na: rgyal khams rlung 'phyur 'dzam gling sil bur 'thor: de bzhin 'bras bu gsum gyi thabs lam 'grig: lung zin chos bdag nyi shu rtsa lnga 'byung : bka' bab grub thob brgya dang bco lnga 'byung : lam sna zin pa 'brel tshad don ldan 'byung : lung bstan chos dang smon lam chos bzhi 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang sprod cig rgya:

e maḥ snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa legs phye nas: rjes 'brangs rgya mtsho'i bka' yi mtha' skyong ba: snga phyi dus gsum brda don sgo 'byed pa'i: 'bral med pad 'byung dgongs pa yongs rdzogs shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas gter nas gdan drangs shing*/ rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i mgul du shog ser las phab pa'o// // ga) kī la ya'i dbang chog: rdo rje'i phreng ba dregs pa'i srog tig bzhugs so: he ru ka dpal khrag 'thung pad 'byung sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang dbang mchog rdo rje'i phreng ba drag po'i rgyud dang lo rgyus dbye bar: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas dang po mdo sngags rgyud la legs par sbyangs shing : dur khrod brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad: rim par stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub tu: khro bo 'dus pa rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes par: rgya bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can rnams kyis tho 'tshams pas: khro bo rdo rje 'bar ba stag zhon du sprul te: lha srin gdug pa can rnams dam la btags shing bran du bkol/ de'i dus su mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can gyis lung bstan pa ni: skye med kyi rang sgra 'di thos so: kye ma: ya mtshan mchog gi sku: rdzu 'phrul mnga' zhing bdag nyid mchog: ma 'ongs yang mtha' kha ral dus: ru bzhi mi bde dbus 'khrug g.yo: mdo sngags ri mo shul rjes gtong: da lta'i sde brgyad ma rungs rigs: yang mthar bdud kyi kha 'dzin pas: rgyal khams phung ba'i sna thabs 'dren: sgrub pa po la bar du gcod: gtsug lag chos 'khor rnams kyang 'joms: ma rungs de rnams dar ba'i tshe: srung zlog bsad pa'i gdams pa gces: zhes gsungs so: de nas mkha' 'gro seng gdong yang gdod ma'i dbyings su thim: slob dpon gyis khrag 'thung rngam pa'i dpa' stobs dang bcas:

drag po ki lā ya chen por sprul te bdud 'dul gyi rang sgra 'di bsgrags so: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ artsig nirtsig badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra wā ra hī kro ti kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes drag sngags me'i rang bzhin du 'bar bas 'khor rnams sngangs shing srog snying 'di phul lo: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya ṭa ṭa: oṃ kro ta kā la tsaṇ+ḍa dun 'dus ṭa 'dus ṭa mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces brjod pas dregs pa ma rungs pa'i rigs rnams shin tu brgyal bar 'gyur to: de nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'phags te: khro bo'i zhal nas bdud 'dul gyi tha tshig 'di bsgrags: hūm̐ hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog kī la rngam pa'i sgra: lha srin sde brgyad mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod rigs: bstan la sdang shing gdug pa'i g.yul bsham na: bdud 'dul ngan sngags drag pos 'joms par gyis: hūm̐ ṭa hūm̐ ṭa dun ṭa phaṭ ṭa ram̐: zhes khro bo'i drag sngags bgrangs shing rdo rje gdeng ba las me dpung rab tu mched de mu stegs phal cher brgyal thabs su rengs par gyur to: de nas drag po'i dal du zhugs nas phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang phur pa gdeng ste: 'di skad ces gsungs: e ma hoḥ nyon dang jo mo mtsho rgyal lcam: mkha' 'gro'i brda lung ci bzhin du: mu stegs 'dre rgod 'dul mdzad pa: drag sngags srid pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: de ma thag tu slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab ste rgya rim pa gsum dang bcas te rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te drag po'i chos bzhi sbas so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: che mchog khrag 'thung kī la ya'i dbang chog chen mo sgrub pa'i khrigs chags su gdab pa ni: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin legs par bsham: rdzas kyi rim pa ni: bum pa'i kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa drag po tsa ka li go cha sde brgyad bcas phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs dpal chas kyis brgyan pa:

rdo rje phur pa: rak+sha'i thod phreng: thun rwa: me tog: sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan: cod pan: so shing : dpung skud bcas gzhung ltar bkram: bhan+dha mtshan ldan chang gis bkang : sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor: shel rdo: a dār+sha: ga ṇa la: ḍa ma ru ka: rdor dril sogs tshang bar bsham zhing : slob bu rnams yol ba'i phyi nas khrus dang phyag 'tshal bya ste: sgo nas 'di ltar zhu: hūm̐: sgo ba ging chen dgongs su gsol: bdag cag skal ldan las can te: dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya ba'i phyir: khyed rnams dam tshig sgo phyes 'tshal: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ nged rnams khrag 'thung gdug pa'i rigs: 'jigs byed me yi kha rlangs can: skal med sgrol ba'i gnyen po mchog: khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: slob bus: hoḥ ye shes dbyings kyi sgo skyong ba: snying rje'i bdag nyid dregs pa'i gzugs: bar chod sgrol ba'i laṅka ging : nged rnams bka' mchis dam gnas so: de nas ging rnams kyis thun brdeg la bgegs bskrad pa ni: hoḥ de ltar yin na nang du shog: ngar 'dzin ru tra'i bdud dang phral: bar chod bdud dang dam med rigs: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i thun gyis brdeg: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ging ka ra ging ka ra gnod byed dam sri hu lu ya phaṭḥ ces slob bu rnams sgo phyi ma'i nang du zhugs: de nas las kyi slob dpon la zhu ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: khrag 'thung bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan yang dag 'jug pa'i phyir: dpa' bos bdag la gnang bar stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: bka' 'gal dam med mi 'jug phyir: khyed cag dam ldan yin lags na: khas longs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: slob mas: hoḥ kun 'dus bde gshegs dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan cis mi dad: dam tshig dbang po dwang du len: dam la mi 'da' na ra kan: de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lam la 'khrid pa ni:

rol mo dang bcas: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: yang gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam tshig ldan pa'i bu mchog khyod: 'jug phyir dkyil 'khor gral du shog: ces pas yol ba'i nang du khrid ste dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: dam bsrungs mchog thun rtsol med 'grub: nyams na snying khrag dbang po bcas: gshin rje'i sdig pas za bar 'gyur: oṃ ya mān+ta ka pā pam̐ du sa ma ya na ra kan: de nas mig phye ba ni: hūm̐: yang dag sa mkhan ye shes spyan: khyed kyis ma rig mun pa'i tshogs: shes rig rdo rje'i thur mas phye: 'od gsal mchog gi spyan ldan shog: oṃ tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭḥ de nas dkyil 'khor du me tog dor ba ni: shar lho nub byang gi sgo ma rnams la smon lam 'di ltar gdab: dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor shar sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor lho sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: bam̐ḥ nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor nub sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu mas: bde gshegs dkyil 'khor byang sgo phyes: so shing dbang po'i me tog 'bul: tshe rabs lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe in+d+ra ye swā hā: zhes dor te gang du babs pa'i gsang mtshan 'dogs pa ni: dkyil 'khor gyi shar nub gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i brda rtags shes par bya'o: de nas ku sha gtad pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe rig 'dzin 'phags mchog gis: spros bral rtswa mchog gdan byas pas: byang chub rdo rje'i go 'phang grub: rtswa stan rten 'brel rmi lam thogs: oṃ badz+ra ku sha lo ka pra ti dza hoḥ zhes rmi lam gang byung bshad par bya:

de nas gsung skud 'dogs pa ni: gzungs sngags la: hūm̐: dam tshig 'khor lo'i rgya chings la: mi shigs rdo rje'i rgyas gdab ste: drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pas: dkyil 'khor dbang mchog brtan gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra tsakra tig shu sa ma ye: de nas cod pan 'dogs pa ni: hoḥ rdzu 'phrul ye shes lnga dang ldan: dam tshig dbang gi cod pan 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor 'dogs: las rab dbang chen thob par shog: oṃ badz+ra shi ra si an+dza sa ma ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phur pa dang lnga ldan gyi me tog gtad de: pho'-i gong g.yas dang mo'i gong g.yon du 'dogs: hūm̐: dam tshig srog gi gsang phur la: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dar tshon brgyan: mi shigs rdo rje'i yi ger btab: de ring skal ldan khyod kyis 'chongs: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya an+t+ra ḍāk+ki nī maṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: de nas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyis dbang bskur zhing gnas lnga ru thig le bya: hūm̐: thabs shes dam tshig rdo rje'i dbyings: dpa' bo ḍāk+ki'i dkar dmar byang : skal ldan gnas lngar dbang mchog sbyin: byang sems gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma la hi a hūm̐: ḍāk+ki nī dza dzaḥ de nas dkyil 'khor ngo sprad pa ni: hoḥ che mchog khrag 'thung sprul pa'i gzhal yas chen po 'di mjal ba ni khyed rang rnams las dang skal bar ldan pa yin pas: legs par ltos shig: dang po dkyil 'khor 'di la sgo brgyad yod pa ni: sgo brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi brda: logs bcu drug ni 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sa mtshams 'byed pa rig pa'i lha mo bcu drug gi brda: rmang rdo rje rgya gram ni mi shigs pa'i ting 'dzin brtan pa'i brda: rtsig pa lnga ni ye shes lnga'i brda: 'dod snam dmar bar lha mos brgyan pa ni shes rab kyi bud med rnams kyis 'khor ba'i bag chags sreg pa'i brda: pha gu ser zhing drwa phyed nag pa ni: pho brang la brten nas ye shes kyi khro bo sprul pa'i brda:

mda' yab pu shu ba gam la thod pas brgyan pa ni: phyi'i log rtog ngan pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i brda: thog steng thams cad mi lpags dang rus rgyan la sogs pas brgyan pa ni nyon mongs pa ma spangs par gnas su dag nas rang byung gi ngo bor yon tan lhun grub tu rdzogs pa'i brda: chos 'khor la me dpung dang khyung chen gyis brgyan cing dur khrod kyi bkod pa rdzogs pa ni zhi ba'i rang mdangs la khro bo'i zer 'gyed pa'i brda: phyi rol tu rdo rwa dang dur khrod me ris bskor ba ni: khrag 'thung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: drwa mig dang me long rdo rje phur pa ral gri rgyal mtshan mda' dar rnams kyis brgyan pa ni: ye nas kī la ya'i srung ba'i gur khang dgu dang ldan pa'i brda: ka rgyan gnam rgyan yol bas mdzes pa ni gzhi'i dkyil 'khor lam gyi gsal mdangs du mas mtshon pa'i brda: phyi nang gi mchod gtor rgya chen por bshams pa ni skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams mchog thun smin grol gyi lam mchog zab mo la 'god pa'i brda'o: de ltar dkyil 'khor rnam bshad legs par thon pas deng phyin chad dkyil 'khor dang phyi nang bskyed rdzogs gi bya ba las su rung ba'i skal ldan du byas so: de nas dbang la 'jug pa ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ? sogs bsang sbyang bya'o: hoḥ skad cig gis slob ma mi dmigs pa'i ngang las che mchog ma hā gu ru drag tu khros pa'i ngo bo bdud 'dul kī la ya khro bo'i rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag bco brgyad zha khro bo'i zhabs brgyad kyis lha srin sde brgyad kyi snying khar brjid pa: zhal rnams shin tu khro zhing spyan rtsa drag po'i glog ltar du 'khyug pa: rngam pa'i mche ba gtsigs shing spyi bor thod skam dang dar nag 'phur ba: dbu skra dmar nag sprin ltar du gzengs pa'i gseb nas rta zhal rnam gsum gyis rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs pa:

snyan g.yas g.yon du khyung dang seṅges brgyan cing sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas dang pos gri gug: gnyis pas rdo rje: gsum pas ral gri/ bzhi pas gsal shing*/ lnga pas rgyu zhags: drug pas gsang rnga: bdun pas thong gshol: brgyad pas tshangs mgo: dgu pas me'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o: g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag: gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ: gsum pas lcags sdig: bzhi pas spu gri: lnga pas mdung thung : drug pas me zhags: bdun pas tsit+ta: brgyad pas klu mgo: dgu pas khro rgyal gyi phur bu 'gril ba: spu gri'i sgro gshog dang rdo rje'i go khrab kyis brgyan cing me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba de'i thugs kar dregs pa zil gnon kī la ya zhal gsum phyag drug pa shin tu khro ba: phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag: bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang kha ṭ+wāṃ: tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang phur 'dzin pa'i steng du lcags sdig gis brgyan pa: sku smad khro chu'i phur gsham rngam pa: yum bdud 'dul khro mo gri thod la 'khyud pa: de'i thugs kar bdud 'dul kī la ya zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang phur bu 'dril ba: dur khrod kyi chas brgyad ldan pa: dbal zur rngam pa: yum drag mo bdud 'dul mar 'khril ba'o: gtso bo'i pang du yum tsa ti dmar mo zhal gsum phyag drug pa spyi bor phag mgos brgyan pa phyag g.yas g.yon dang pos gri thod/ bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri nad rkyal/ mtha' ma gnyis kyis be con dang rgyu zhags 'dzin cing zhabs bzhis yab la 'khril ba'o: de'i spyi bor gu ru snang srid zil gnon la thod phreng rol pa'i cha lugs can gzi brjid 'phro ba: dpral bar 'jam dpal gyis ral gri dang po ti: mgrin par rta mgrin gyis dbyug pa dang lcags sgrog: snying khar phyag rdor gyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub: lte bar khro mos gri gug dang thod khrag: gsang bar yak+shas tho ba dang zhags pa 'dzin cing dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang rab tu ldan pa'o:

shar du badz+ra kī la ya: lho ru rat+na kī la ya: nub tu pad+ma kī la ya: byang du karma kī la ya te sras bzhi'ang : gtso bo rang 'dra ba'i chas la phyag rnams kyis rdo rje dang phur pa 'dzin cing me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i phyi rol tu dregs pa sde brgyad sgo ba ging dang laṅka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa til gyi gang bu 'phel ba'i grangs dang mnyam par gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas drag po 'dus pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: zhes rol mo bya zhing spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: che mchog 'dus pa khro bo rol pa'i lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: byin chen dbab cing dbang chen bskur mdzad phyir: thogs med thugs rje'i nus rtsal myur du skyed: ye shes dpa' ba'i gzi brjid bdag la stsol: skal ldan dbang bskur byin chen dbab tu gsol: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas te byin dbab cing maṇ+ḍal 'bul: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ he ru ka pa'i dkyil 'khor du: yang dag skal ldan 'jug mdzad phyir: smin grol dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a be sha ya a āḥ

de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni: hoḥ 'di ni che mchog khro rgyal gyi: dam tshig rdo rje las kyi chu: dam bsrungs dngos grub sna tshogs mnyes: dam med dbang po bsreg par 'gyur: oṃ badz+ra pā pam̐ ru lu na ra kan: de na bum pa thogs la ngo sprad cing : hūm̐: bum pa mi shigs chos sku'i gzhal yas khang : bcud ni che mchog yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: che mchog 'dus pa sku yi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags dang bcas te bskur: de nas bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: bhan+dha dri med longs sku'i rtsal snod mchog: bcud ni dam tshig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: che mchog 'dus pa gsung gi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas dkyil 'khor thogs la: hūm̐: che mchog 'dus pa bla ma drag po rtsal: yongs rdzogs ngo sprod dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i mchog: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: che mchog 'dus pa thugs kyi dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags bcas te bskur: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: ngo mtshar rmad byung dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpal: rtsa gsum kun 'dus 'dod yon lha yi gtor: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: che mchog 'dus pa yon tan dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags bcas te bskur: de nas rak+sha'i phreng ba thogs la: hūm̐: drag sngags kun 'dus khro rgyal me phreng can: phrin las dmod pa bor chog sngags phreng 'dis: de ring skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: che mchog 'dus pa phrin las dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags dang bcas nas bskur ro: de nas phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: skabs 'dir lha'i phyag mtshan rnams re re bzhin du dbang bskur: yang bsdus pa ltar na 'di ltar: hūm̐: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu dang : glang ko zhing lpags chu srin gos: sbrul chun mgo phreng rus pa'i rgyan: khrag zhag stag sham dbang bskur ro:

zhes rtsa sngags bcas te bskur: de nas kī la khro rgyal gyi sku spyi bor bzhag cing: hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog stobs 'dus pa: 'jigs byed gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: sku gsung thugs mchog 'dus pa'i dpal: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas te bskur: de nas 'jam dpal tsakli dpral bar bzhag cing: hūm̐: sku yi gzi brjid gshin rje'i gshed: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: stobs 'dus dpa' bo chen po yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas nas: rta mgrin gyi tsakli mgrin par bzhag cing: hūm̐: gsung gi dbang phyug he ru kaḥ drag sngags bdag po dbang gi sku: 'bar ba'i khro rgyal chen po yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas te bskur ro: de nas phyag rdor tsakli snying khar bzhag cing: hūm̐: thugs mchog mi g.yo gtum chen dpal: nus pa'i rtsal ldan rdo rje me: khro rgyal gsang bdag chen po yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas te bskur: de nas khro mo lte bar bzhag cing: hūm̐: srid gsum mnga' bdag khros ma'i sku: bdud 'dul chen mo 'bar ba'i gzugs: las bzhi dbang mo chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas te bskur: de nas yak+sha me dbal gyi tsakli gsang bar bskur la: hūm̐: khro rgyal kun gyi stobs 'dus pa: gzi byin mthu stobs rtsal dang ldan: dgyes pa'i dbang phyug ston mdzad pa: yak+sha khro bos dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas te bskur: khro bcu bskur: de nas yang badz+ra kī la ya thogs nas: hūm̐: che mchog badz+ra kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: nad gdon zhi ba'i dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags kyis dbang bskur: de nas rat+na kī la ya thogs nas: hūm̐: che mchog rat+na kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro:

tshe bsod rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas pad+ma kī la ya thogs nas: hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa'i sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: khams gsum dbang sdud dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas karma kī la ya thogs nas: hūm̐: che mchog karma kī la ya: yab yum sprul pa sras dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dbang thob shog: ces rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: zhe sdang gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: yum chen rat+na mkha' 'gro ma: nga rgyal gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: de nas pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: yum chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: 'dod chags gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: de nas las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: yum chen las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: phrag dog gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis dbang bskur ro: de nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: yum chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma: gti mug gzhom phyir khros ma'i sku: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes mdzad mas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: sku'i ging chen thogs la: hūm̐: me long ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: zhe sdang chu khams dag pa yi: sku yi ging chen dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis dbang bskur ro: de nas gsung gi ging chen thogs la: hūm̐: sor rtogs ye shes ngo bo nyid:

sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: 'dod chags me khams gnas dag pa'i: gsung gi ging chen dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas thugs kyi ging chen thogs la: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: gti mug ma rig gnas dag pa'i: thugs kyi ging chen dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis dbang bskur: de nas yon tan ging chen thogs la: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: nga rgyal sa khams gnas dag pa'i: yon tan ging chen dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas phrin las ging chen thogs la: hūm̐: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: sgrol ging yab yum gnyis su med: phrag dog rlung khams gnas dag pa'i: phrin las ging chen dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis dbang bskur ro: de nas khro bcu'i tsakli thogs la: hūm̐: che mchog sprul pa'i 'od zer las: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i khro bo bcu: sa bcu mnga' ba'i dbang phyug pa: yab yum gnyis med dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas zil gnon rtsal gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bdag nyid mchog: bdud 'dul dregs pa zil gnon rtsal: mkha' 'gro rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: de nas khyung chen rigs lnga thogs la: hūm̐: khro rgyal sprul pa'i ga ru ḍaḥ klu gnyan sa bdag gnyen po che: nad rims dal yams 'joms mdzad pa: bya khyung rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis dbang bskur: de nas dregs pa khrag 'thung nag po thogs la: hūm̐: ma hā gu ru zil gnon rtsal: bdud dang mu stegs 'dul mdzad pa: drag sngags mod pa he ru kas: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur ro: de nas shar gyi sgo ma thogs la: dzaḥ shar phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: byams pa'i 'od zer ston mdzad ma: 'jigs brgyad zhi mdzad chen mo yis:

skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas lho'i sgo ma thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: snying rjes thar lam ston mdzad ma: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas nub kyi sgo ma thogs la: bam̐ḥ nub phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: dga' bzhis bde stong skyed mdzad ma: mos bzhis dbang sdud chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur: de nas byang gi sgo ma thogs la: hoḥ byang phyogs skyong ba'i ma mo che: btang snyoms 'khor 'das shan 'byed ma: dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad chen mo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: zhes rtsa sngags kyis bskur ro: de nas 'brang rgyas thogs nas: hūm̐: ngo bor 'dod yon rmad du byung : bha ling gtor mchod bla na med: ga ṇa tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di: skal ldan khyod la zas su sbyin: zhes rtsa sngags kyis sbyin: de nas chang thogs nas: hūm̐: rin chen rang byung snod mchog tu: 'bras rgun bu ram sbrang gi chang: gtams pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di: skal ldan khyod la skom du sbyin: zhes rtsa sngags kyis sbyin: de nas me long dang lha sku ngos sbyor thogs nas: hūm̐: ma skyes chu zla'i stong gzugs sam me long 'gying log lta bu'am: dbyings la mkha' yi gzhu shar ba lta bur khyod kyis deng phyin chod: bskyed rim sprul sku'i lam khyer phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa: ma hā yo ga'i ngo sprod thob pa yin no: de nas rdo rje dril bu thogs nas: hoḥ dril bu 'di gnyis med longs sku grags stong gi gzugs dang ldan pa mgo bo rdo rje ni thabs la ske bum pa ni gzhal yas khang : rtsa ba sgra ldan ni shes rab yin pas: gnyis med zung 'jug gi don dang ldan pa: sgra dang bzlas sngags thams cad brag cha lta bu'am: pi waṃ gi sgra lag pa'i 'phrul 'khor ltar yin pa ngo shes nas:

gnyis med a nu yo ga'i ngo sprod thob pa yin no: zhes ngo sprad cing : de nas shel rdo thogs nas: hoḥ shel rdo 'di ni gnas lugs gshis kyi rig pa'i rtsal dang mtshungs pa: ngo bo gsal la rnam pa bkra ba gzhi dwangs gsal dang ma 'gags par snang ba'i ngogs la shar yang sgrib pa med pas: stong pa snang stong zung du 'jug pa 'di dang mtshungs pas khyod kyi rig pa smig sgyu'i drung du sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'gyu ba lta bu sa le hrig ge rjen ne ba: dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes pa gzhi'i gnas lugs: bar du gang du'ang mi gnas pa lam shar grol: tha ma gang du'ang mi 'gag pa 'bras bu'i grol tshul: mthong ba bsgoms med a ti yo ga'i ngo sprod thob pa yin no: de nas las kyi rdo rje lag g.yas la gtad de: hūm̐: rdo rje drag po dga' ba che: rdo rje hūm̐ ste sgra sgrogs pa: mi phyed rdo rje 'bar ba che: las kyi rdo rje 'chang bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra a ḍaṃ hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phur bu g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: rdo rje sgeg pa'i gtum nyid las: srid pa'i ri rab phur bu grub: 'bebs pa rdo rje kī la che'i: las kyi phur bu 'chang bar gyis: oṃ badz+ra an+ḍa kī la ya hūm̐ hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas mgo phreng gtad de: hūm̐: srin po rak+sha'i mgo bo la: drag sngags dmod pa'i phreng ba bsgrubs: ngan sngags bzlas pa 'dren par gyis: bsad pa las bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ me la ru tra mā ra ya rbad a be sha ya ā: de nas thun ru dang rdzas lag tu gtad de: hūm̐: srin glang dmar po'i lho rwa la: mi shor chu gnas srid pa'i gzugs: thun rdzas skam rlon snod mchog gtad: bstan dgra sgos dgra bsgral bar gyis: oṃ thun dza bhed ya ha la sa ma ya: de nas slob ma lhar gsal : tshogs 'bul zhing liṅga bsgral ba: hūm̐: mdun du drag po'i hom khung du: dmigs bya dgra bo myur du khug: pho nya las mkhan dus la bab: 'gugs shing bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ru tra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa kī la ya: thugs dam tha tshig gnas nas bskul: nyes can dgra bo dam nyams 'di'i: dkar nag snying la kī la ya: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ru tra shag tshal pa rbad rbad: de nas thun ru'i thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: tshe nyungs zangs lcags rdo yi thun: dug thun skam rlon nad rlung 'thibs: ldog med drag po'i thun zor ya: gtub cing dgra sri rdul du rlog: oṃ tsha thun na lo nye thun kha lo ya rbad rbad: de nas hom gzar gtad pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid gnyis kyi nyi zla'i snod: 'khor 'das gnyis kyi hom yangs 'di: de ring slob bu khyod la gtad: bsgral mchod sbyin sreg brtson par gyis: oṃ tha ru bi na dz+wa la raṃ bha ta hi hoḥ de nas gtub cing slob ma rnams la 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal phyes shig: dgra bo'i sha khrag zhal du thob: zhe sdang spyod cing sha la zo: rtag tu srog gcod byed par gyis: oṃ he ru ka hā la pañtsa māṃ sa khā hi: de nas rak+ta gtad cing : hūm̐: 'dod chags spyod pa'i bdag nyid che: skom du khrag mchod 'thung bar gyis: rtag tu dug lnga'i rak+ta 'thung : 'dod chags spyod pa ma spongs shig: rak+ta pū dza khā hi: de nas g.yang gzhi gtad cing : hūm̐: gti mug gdug pa'i g.yang gzhi'i gos: rtag tu gyon zhing 'chang bar gyis: blang dor med pa'i gti mug spyod: 'jol nyog ci ltar dgyes par gyis: oṃ saṃ bho ra tsit+ta ba ra hoḥ de nas drag por mnga' gsol ba ni: zhwa nag gos nag gis brgyan cing : hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus che mchog kī la yar: chos sku'i mnga' gsol rdor 'chang rigs kyi bdag: rdzogs chen a ti rgyas par mnga' gsol lo: longs sku'i mnga' gsol rdor sems dkyil 'khor rgyas: sems can byang chub thob par mnga' gsol lo: sprul sku'i mnga' gsol spyi bor zil gnon rtsal: yang gsang dkyil 'khor gtso bor mnga' gsol lo:

bla ma'i mnga' gsol rig 'dzin khrag 'thung rtsal: zhi ba'i tshul dgu ldan par mnga' gsol lo: yi dam mnga' gsol bdud 'dul kī la ya: khro bo'i chas dgu rdzogs par mnga' gsol lo: mkha' 'gro'i mnga' gsol drag mo pang du 'khyud: sa dgu'i rtogs pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol lo: chos skyong mnga' gsol mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen sgreng : sangs rgyas bstan dgra sgrol bar mnga' gsol lo: dam can mnga' gsol sde brgyad sha zas bskor: rbad bskul las la bsngags par mnga' gsol lo: nor bdag mnga' gsol rin chen go khrab gsol: sgrub mchog 'dod rgu 'byung bar mnga' gsol lo: gter bdag mnga' gsol sngags kyi chas dgus spras: las bzhi'i phrin las mdzad par mnga' gsol lo: yul lha'i mnga' gsol snang srid dbang du sdud: thogs med nus rtsal 'byin par mnga' gsol lo: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor khro bo'i lha tshogs mnga' gsol lo: che btsan kun gyi gtso bor mnga' gsol lo: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

de nas rak+ta bran zhing gtor ma mchod: de nas zor thogs shing bzlog pa dang sbrags te 'phang: hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs 'dus he ru kas: stong gsum dmigs pa'i zor chen bsgril: gdug pa'i dug rdzas sna dgus brgyan: dregs pa gshin rjes dmod pa bor: ldog med las kyi dbal zor gyis: bzlog go chag che nyam nga zlog: bsgyur ro rkyen ngan dgra la sgyur: rbad do pho nya las la bskul: 'phen no dgra bo'i srog la ya: hūm̐ kro ta ya: nye lo ya: te lo ya: shag dza ya: rbad bh+yo ya: ru tra ya: tra tra ya: rbad lo ya: thun thun ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces zor 'phang mgo nas bskyal te 'phang : rdo rje slob dpon la bshags pa bya: de nas liṅga cha gcig bsreg pa ni: hom khung du: hūm̐: gru gsum gshin rje'i pho brang du: dug shing sna dgu'i sbyin sreg sbar: dgra bgegs ru tra'i sha khrag 'di: 'jigs byed me lha'i zhal du thob: oṃ ag+ne ye ru tra dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐: zhes 'bul lo: phaṭḥ skad cig gis mdun du dur khrod kyi pho brang la gshin rje gdug pa'i me hom mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su ngo bo khrag 'thung la rnam pa me lha'i gtso bo ltar gsal bar gyur: hom bskyed bya: de nas dgra bo mnan pa ni: sham bu'am gang rung la tri re re bris te rnal 'byor rang rang gi 'og tu mnan: hūm̐: khro rgyal bdud 'dul bden pa'i mthus: dam sri gzugs kyi liṅgar khug: rim dgu sa 'og gshin rjer gtad: mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: hūm̐ nan: dgra sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes mnan zhing lug gu rgyud du brdung: de nas byin rlabs bka' bsgo bya ba ni: de nas gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: chos sku kun bzang rdor 'chang : longs sku rdo rje sems dpa': sprul sku che mchog zil gnon: rin 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: mkhas pa shrī singha : rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal:

sngags 'chang shākya pra bha: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du'ang che mchog kī la ya yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyis skal ldan gyi slob ma la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: ces byin rlabs bya: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni: rig ma mtshan ldan rgyan chas kyis spras shing : dam tshig gi bdud rtsi phab ste slob mar sbyin pa ni: hrīḥ che mchog dbyings kyi mkha' lam nas: legs 'byung bdud rtsi a mṛ ta: thabs shes sbyor ba'i dam tshig rdzas: sbyin pas gsang dbang thob par shog: oṃ a rak+ta a mṛ ta khā hi: slob mas: hoḥ rdo rje rgyal po dgongs su gsol: bdag cag zab lam mos pa'i bur: gsang ba'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ khyed rnams dam tshig ldan lags sam: grol lam mchog gi pho nya 'di: dam ldan lam la bsngags pa'i mchog: khas longs khyod la sbyin par bya: slob mas: hūm̐: zab mo bde ba'i lam mchog la: snod ldan rnal 'byor cis mi dad: gtso bos bdag la gnang bar stsol: dam tshig mi 'da' sa ma ya: dam chu sbyin cing : slob dpon gyis: hoḥ mtshan ldan yid 'ong dge ba'i grogs: 'di rten bde stong rgyud la skye: thig le 'bab bzung 'dren par gyis: gnyis med ye shes ngo bor ltos: sa ma ya: rā ga ya hoḥ de nas slob ma lha yab yum du bskyed de: rdo rje pad+ma mkha' gsang sbyar te: hūm̐: slob ma mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : che mchog drag po yab yum gsal: rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor spyod: sgab 'dre bzlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: ho mu ṭa rā ga ya mi: zhes bde stong spyod cing ngo bo bskyang : de nas ngo sprad pa ni: hoḥ bu khyod kyis deng phyin chad zab lam mkha' 'gro'i khrid thob pa yin pas: mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gzung thag nas bzung ste:

hūm̐: phyi nang mu mtha' khyab pa yi: pho brang drag po'i zhing khams 'dir: rten 'brel 'khor los bsgyur ba'i phyir: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra dharma tsakra tiṣ+ṭha a be sha ya a hūm̐: zhes gtad do: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi chas kyis brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: pho brang 'di ni sgrub pa'i rten: rgyal mtshan 'di ni mdzes pa'i tog: gnam rgyan yol ba bkra ba'i rdzas: sa rgyan 'di ni dbang gi gzhi: phur pa ral gri srung ba'i gur: me long mda' dar rten 'brel rdzas: drwa mig 'ja' ris longs sku'i zhing : drwa ba cod pan mdzes pa'i phyam: stag sham thod phreng drag po'i chas: sgo gzhi'i phyag mtshan srung ba'i rten: sman gtor rak+ta skong ba'i rdzas: phyi nang nyer spyod mnyes pa'i srid: bkra shis lha mo dge ba'i grogs: de ltar dkyil 'khor rten 'di dag: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin: sgrub pa mthar phyin nus par gyis: oṃ badz+ra sid+dhi raṃ shud+dhe hoḥ zhes sbyin no: de nas dregs pa'i srog dbang bskur ba ni: dmar gtor che ba gcig la 'khor brgyad kyis bskor bar shas brgyan pa dang sde brgyad kyi tsakli btsug pa bshams: de nas sde brgyad spyan drangs te gtor mar bstim: dregs pa rnams re re bzhin du tshig dang bstun te slob ma la gtad pa ni: hoḥ las can skyes bu skal ldan khyod: de ring drag po lag tu bcug: dam can dregs pa khyod la gtad: slob dpon bdag gi bka' ltar bgyid: gal te 'gal zhing nyams gyur na: khyod kyi snying khrag dregs pas phyung : tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i skal ldan la: khyod kyi grogs su bran bzhin 'gyur: 'khu ldog ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ sa ma ya dregs pa dun dun na ra kan: de nas dam chu sbyin: de nas lha'i tsakli'i dbang bskur zhing srog yig gtad: hrīḥ lha yi dmag dpon dregs pa khyod: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs:

'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ a sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gshin rje'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: gshin rje'i dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ ya sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas ma mo'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: ma mo'i dmag dpon rgyal mo ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ ma sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bdud kyi tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: bdud kyi dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ du sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rgyal po'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: rgyal po'i dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ ru sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas btsan gyi tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: btsan gyi dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ tsa sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gnod sbyin gyi tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: gnod sbyin dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ sha sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas klu'i tsakli thogs nas: hūm̐: klu yi dmag dpon dregs pa ches: slob bu 'di la dbang bskur bas: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: 'khu na dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom: oṃ na sa ma ya na ra kan: hṛ da ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas dge bsnyen bzhi thogs la: hūm̐: zab gter gnyan gyi srung ma ches: lha bdud klu btsan dge bsnyen khyod: bstsal ba'i gter kha ji bzhin du: zab chos 'di yi phyi la 'brongs: slob bu 'di yi rogs ldan sgrubs: dam nyams rnams la chad pa chod: rin chen gter gyi srung ma mdzod: sngon tshe slob dpon tha tshig bzhin: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul: dam la ma 'da' dam tshig srungs: bka' gtad gter srung dbang thob shog: oṃ a ru tsa tri hṛ da ya sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes bskur: de nas dmar gtor gnas lngar bzhag cing : hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: nga ni che mchog khrag 'thung che: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag rnams: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: khyod kyi srog snying nga la yod: de bas ci ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: khyod kyis thogs med 'grub par mdzod: dam ldan rigs kyi slob bu 'dis: zhi rgyas las bzhi gang brtsam yang : khyod rnams 'khu'am ma ldog cig: gal te bka' las 'da' srid na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin gyi dam yang bskul: dam tshig rdo rjes gzhom zhing bshig: na raka chen por ltung bar 'gyur: de bas dam tshig dran par mdzod: rtsal chen dregs pa'i sde tshogs kyis: srog gi dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ: aḥ yaḥ maḥ duḥ ruḥ tsaḥ shaḥ naḥ sa ma ya i dan+te badz+ra na ra kan hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes sde brgyad gtor ma nas dngos grub zhu: de nas sngags rnams rgyun du 'chang bar bya'o: 'khu na sngags za bar gyis: de nas bskang ba dang gtor ma sogs rgyas par bya: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p rjes su bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya zhing gtang rag gtong : slob ma rnams kyis lo mtshams re med par dbang mi sbyin: dam med rnams la dpe dang gdams pa mi bstan: snying gi dwangs ma ltar btsan par zungs shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: kho bo mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan smin slad du:

yang snying dbang mchog rdo rje'i phreng ba dang : dregs pa srog thig sde brgyad spyi dbang dang : bskrad gzer 'phen pa'i las mtha' rnam pa lnga: rgyud dang 'brel ba cha tshang khyad 'phags 'di: dbyangs can lha mo mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: legs par gdams pa ye shes grogs gsum pas: rin chen zab shog logs su bkod nas kyang : mi nub grogs kyi snying gi dkyil du sbos: gter srung shan pa bzhi la legs par bcol: ma 'ongs bskal pa nyi shu'i bar bskal dus: las kyi mkha' 'gro 'dong can rigs 'khrungs shing : pad+ma gter bdag gling pa'i ming la sprod: des kyang shes rab blo ldan rnams la spel: chos med dred po log lta skal chad mkhan: 'gong po ser skya'i lag tu ma shor rgya: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: thim rgya: mi nub rgya: spel rgya: kho bo bdag 'dra pad+ma gter bdag gling pas rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa phag lo'i zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin/ o rgyan gyi lung bstan bzhin khrom pa nyi shu tsam dang bcas nas/ gegs med du gdan drangs shing pad+ma sbas pa'i tshal du shing 'brug gi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin shog ser zheng sor bzhi dkyus mtho gang ngos sor bzhi pa nas mkha' 'gro sha za'i yi ger 'dug pa bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o// // nga) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i chos skor las: dbang 'bring rdo rje rab 'bar bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: yang gsang pad+ma he ru ka la bstod: pad+ma nga ni 'khrul med chos sku'i thugs: ma yengs jo mo mtsho rgyal legs par nyon: mi nub gsang ba'i dbang mchog smin grol bstan: da lta'i bskal par smon lam bzang lags kyang : nam zhig snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mgo tshugs tshe: dbul phongs nad mug 'khrug pa'i bskal pa dar: de dus zab gter 'di dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngon 'gro bkra shis byin chags sa phyogs su: dkyil 'khor maṇ+ḍal mkho ba'i yo byad sogs: las byang gzhung bsrang slob dpon bskyed rdzogs dang : gsol 'debs bsnyen la rang dbang lung bstan pas: slob bur khrus byas mig dar dang bcas te: me tog thogs nas phyi nas 'di skad zhu: e ma: che mchog dbang gi bdag: dregs 'joms khro bo he ru kaḥ yang gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: 'jug cing dbang mchog bskur du gsol: lan gsum zhu: bla mas: hoḥ skal ldan bu khyod tshur nyon dang : dkyil 'khor sgom sgrub byed nus sam: de ltar yin na dbang mchog sbyin: sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: de nas slob ma gral du 'khod: bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom zhing gsol ba gdab: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: slob mas: kyai: skye med bla ma drag po rtsal: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i yang snying gi: smin grol dbang mchog bskur du gsol: lha tshogs rnams gsal la: bla mas: kyai: gling mchog rnga yab pad+ma 'od: tsit+ta bam ro'i gnas mchog nas: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bde chen gsang ba mtsho rgyal mar: gdung ba drag pos gsol 'debs kyis: gnas 'dir byin chen dbab tu gsol: dbang chen drag po'i dbang bskur la: dkyil 'khor dbyer med thim par mdzod: om̐ gu ru kī la ya a be sha ya a ā: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐: de nas ye shes kyis byin phebs shing rtags 'phar 'dar 'khrab par 'byung : de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul: bum pa thogs nas: hūm̐: drag po 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang : skye med snang stong dkyil 'khor lha: bdud 'dul kī la'i dbang bskur bas: 'gyur med sku yi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bhan+dha thogs la: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor 'byung 'jug bdud rtsi'i dbang : gnyis med rol rtsal drag po'i sngags: zung 'jug rang bzhin dbang bskur bas: thabs shes rang bzhin dbang thob shog:

om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: me long thogs la: hūm̐: chos sku skye med rig rtsal dbang : rang byung rang grol ngo bos stong : yang dag don dam dbang bskur bas: chos nyid bde chen dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: sku bzhi mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje rab 'bar khro bo yis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zil gnon dbang sdud dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phur bu thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan spros pa'i sku: drag rtsal badz+ra kī la ya'i: sprul pa'i las mkhan dbang bskur bas: log lta tshar gcod dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dur khrod chas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad 'khrul ba'i bdud bcom pa: ye shes cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i sku: dpa' chas brgyad kyis dbang bskur bas: dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: rig stong grags stong hūm̐ gi sgra'i: thabs kyis skye med don rtogs phyir: drag po'i phrin las dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs dbang bskur thob par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: ngo mtshar 'dod yon rmad du byung : kun 'dus dngos grub mchod mchog 'dis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yongs rdzogs gsang 'dus dbang thob shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī la ya ḍāk+ki mu ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes rtsa sngags rgyas par 'don te dbang bskur: maṇ+ḍal 'bul: dkyil 'khor slob ma snod ldan la bstim: mi ldan na rang la bsdu: slob mas: gtso bos sogs brjod: slob bur snying rus sgrub tshugs ldan na po ti dang bka' srung gtad pa ni: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bka' srung gsum gyi gtor ma dang : gter bdag dge bsnyen gyi gtor ma mgor bzhag la bka' bsgo'o: hūm̐: lha bdud btsan klu drag po'i tshogs: sngon tshe spa gro mchims phu sogs: dben gnas gter gyi srung ma rgyud: ci ltar bka' bsgos dam bcas bzhin: deng nas slob bu sngags 'chang 'dir: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: rig 'dzin bka' yi srung ma mdzod: chos 'di sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: log lta bdud rigs tshar gcod mdzod: oṃ a du tsa na badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta i dan+te na ra kan: bka' srung gi bla rdo bla 'khor 'chang: e ma: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: dgongs pa gnyis med don mthong bstan: ma 'ongs rtsod ldan dus snyigs su: bstan pa gnyis pa'i snyigs ma la: dam tshig chung bas dkar phyogs 'bros: lha rnams ri rab logs la gzigs: de phyir rten 'brel nyams stobs kyis: nag po bdud rigs bar chad sdang : bdud rigs 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni: nga nyid khros pa'i khro bo ste: drag po kī la'i zab chos 'di: pad+ma bdag gis legs par bshad: mtsho rgyal khyod kyis yi ger thob:

rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: dge bsnyen bzhi la bcol dam gyis: yul dang sa phyogs gud du sbos: gsang rgya spu gri me 'bar 'di: hūm̐ nag drag rtsal khyod nyid la: ma 'ongs dus su 'phrod par shog: ces gsungs so: sprel zla'i dus chen du: slob dpon gyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba las: skyems 'dren rnams 'du zhing yod pa'i dus gcig tu: 'ur sgra shin tu che ba zhig byung bas: bdag gis ji ltar lags zhus pas: 'o skol bod 'bangs rnams las khyod kyi bod la dus 'khrug 'byung gsungs: da gdod gi dus su sprel min pas: rang lo de yin snyam: slar gter 'byin gyi rang lo 'dug ste: de ni lo gzhug skabs su dus 'khrug gi rten 'brel cung gnod gsungs: de nas rgya gar nas yin zer ba'i bu mo mo lo nyi shu'i skor yin 'dra ba sngo ris gcig 'dug ste: slob dpon la a ru ra sder ma gang phul te 'ja' lus kyi chos skor gnongs zhus song: slob dpon gyis 'di mkha' 'gro ma yin gsungs: 'o na mkha' 'gro la slar 'ja' lus 'grub pa ci lags zhus pas: 'di sha khrag la brten pas dka' ba spyod dgos gsungs: 'di'i ming ci lags zhus pas: ḍāk+ki dhe wa dha ra yin gsungs: mkha' 'gro ma des bdag la dgyes tshul mdzad nas a ru ra rdog po gcig byin: nam zhig gi dus su khyod kyi chos kyi grogs mo mdzad gsungs: had de langs nas phyag phul bas: kho mo la phyag 'tshal mi dgos gsungs: rig 'dzin gyi gral du 'khod zin gsungs: slob dpon gyis bdag la rten 'brel bsgrigs: rig ma khyad du 'phags ma drag mos phrin las bsgrub gsungs: dpal gyi ye shes khyod rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes pa'i smon pa che gsungs: dgu rlung bsgrub na lam myur te 'phral du gegs sel la brtson dgos gsungs: mkha' 'gro ma de dang bdag gnyis sku bzhi lhun grub tu byin gyis brlabs so:

slob dpon gyi gsungs par: bud med kyis thugs zag bsog na 'gro don rgyun chad nyen che gsungs: 'o na bud med sngags kyi grogs mo lags sam: zhus pas: gsang sngags bzla ba'i grogs yin kyang ston pa'i dgra yin gsungs: 'o na mkha' 'gro ma bud med du mi gtogs sam zhus pas: mkha' 'gro bud med yin kyang skyon gyis gos ma myong : de'i phyir mkha' 'gro ma la skyon du blta mi rung gsungs: 'o na gsang sngags kyi dbang khrid zhu ba'i dus su tshogs rdzogs gang lags zhus pas: bar chad sel ba'i ting 'dzin skyong ba legs: 'phral gyi rkyen ngan gtor ma dag gis sel: dngos grub thams cad tshogs las 'byung ba yin: bsod nams tshogs rdzogs maṇ+ḍal dal gyi don: byin rlabs 'jug par mos gus gsol 'debs gyis: sgrib gnyis sbyong bar bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis yin: dam tshig chag nyams skong bshags sgrib sbyang 'bungs: kha chos lo ma can du ma song na: nga yi zab chos legs bkod bris pa 'di: da lta'i gter ston smon lam 'dzoms pa yi: chos bdag rnams dang dam chos 'di 'phrad shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs pa'o/ shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // dbang 'di'i mjug gi yig chung gi ma dpe gsal po mi 'dug kyang bskyur yang ma rung tshod dpag byas nas bris pas yid ches pher ba ma byung bas blo ma bde mchan// // ca) bla ma zil gnon rtsal las: lus med mkha' 'gro'i gsang dbang mkha' spyod myur 'grub bzhugs so: gsang dbang mchog la ye shes gang sprugs pa: lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor zab lam nas: gsang dbang mkha' spyod myur 'grub gdams pa ni: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po bkra shis byin chags dben gnas yid du 'ong ba'i sar dkyil 'khor gzhi bslangs te th-ig gdab mchod pa tshogs gtor rgyas pa btang zhing cha rkyen bsag pa ni: gzungs ma mtshan ldan bcu drug nyer lnga'i bar:

lus mtshams dang che chung ran pa dam tshig gtsang ma gsang thub cing lus rgyas shing bde drod dang ldan pa: dang po dbang gis rgyud smin par byin gyis brlabs: rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad cing rten 'brel brtag: bar du khrus bya gos dkar gyon zhing bgegs bskrad te: bla ma la maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu 'bul: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma la: nyams tshad gsum btab pa'i dam ldan min na bskur du mi rung : dam ldan la zab lam bstan pa ni: dang po bum dbang bhan+dha me long rdo rje gsang sngags rdzogs rjes: gzungs ma de slob bu rnams kyis bla ma la 'bul zhing : kye: gzhi lam gsang sngags dkyil 'khor 'dir: mtshan tshang shes rab rgyas shing mdzes: 'bul bzhes bdag la gnang bar stsol: de nas byin gyis brlabs nas: gnas gsum du yig 'bru dgod: longs sku'i rgyan spras te: dkyil 'khor nub nas shar du gyu zhing : thabs shes kyi dbang rtags phyag tu bzung ste: ngo sprod dkar dmar gyi bdud rtsis gnas lnga ru thig le bya: bde spyod gsal bshad dal bsdu bkra shis brjod: dam srung gsang la sgrub ces pa: dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings dpal ri sprul pa'i zhing : pad 'byung rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gnas 'dir gshegs shing byin chen myur phob la: gzungs ma ye shes mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi lnga ldan dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas: ye shes ḍāk+ki'i sprul pa bye ba 'bum: gnas 'dir gshegs shing byin chen myur phob la: gzungs ma ye shes ḍāk+kir byin gyis rlobs: rten 'brel dbang gi rtsa rlung byin gyis rlobs: om̐ badz+ra a be sha ya ḍāk+ki nī mu ṭa rā ga ya pha la dza dzaḥ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang gi chu bo bzhin phab cing bhan+dha'i nang du bskyil: de nas slob bu rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul zhing : rdo rje slob dpon gyis gzungs ma'i phyag g.yon nas bzung ste bstod pa:

hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba nam mkha'i mdzod: lam bsgyur rdo rje sgeg pa mo: yid chags mdzes 'dzum gar rtsed can: gsang ba bde stong rig mar bstod: de nas slob bus yis: bum chus byin gyis brlab: kye: rdo rje dpa' bo thabs bskul phyir: gsang ba dbyings nyid rig ma'i mchog: rdo rje gsang ba'i grol lam 'di: skal ldan bdag la gnang bar stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni pho nya bde stong lam: zung 'jug ye shes lnga dang ldan: rtag tu mkha' 'gro mchod nus sam: de ltar khas longs dbang mchog stsal: slob mas: kye: shes rab bden nam grub pa yi: thabs ldan bdag la gnang bar stsol: rtag tu mkha' 'gror bkur zhing mchod: dam bsrung badz+ra sa ma ya: de nas slob dpon gyis mna' chu sbyin cing sku'i dbang bskur ba ni: gzungs ma'i zhabs slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la: hūm̐: gzugs sku snang stong bskyed rim lam: sprul pa'i 'gro don yid snang ngor: rdo rje thugs kyi yid dga' mos: dbang bskur rtsa khams lha ru bsgom: om̐ badz+ra pad+ma rā ga gnosh+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rgya rtags bstan te: hoḥ thabs shes gsang sngags gnyis med lam: rtag tu brda skad sgra bsgyur sam: de ltar khas longs dbang mchog sbyin: dam med rnams la bstan mi bya: slob mas: kye: grol lam zung gi brda 'di la: gsang sngags rnal 'byor cis mi dad: bzlas sgrub skong bshags dam mi 'gal: bde ba'i dam tshig sa ma ya: zhes mna' chu sbyin cing rig mas phyag mtshan: slob ma'i gnas lngar bzhag ste: hūm̐: rdo rje pad+ma rtags kyi rgya: āḥdam tshig rdzas mchog rab bskul phyir: khyod kyi gnas lngar bzhag pa yis: rten 'brel 'khor los dbang bsgyur shog: rtsa sngags bzlas la: de nas rig mas: slob bu'i gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing dbang bskur: hoḥ gsang sngags pho nya myur lam gyis: bha ga kun bzang dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam srung rtag tu mchod nus sam:

de ltar khas longs dkyil 'khor bstan: slob mas: kye: sku yi yon tan rabs rdzogs pa'i: bde chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: snod ldan rjes su 'jug phyir du: skal ldan yid spro rtag tu mchod: mna' chu sbyin: bha ga phye zhing ngo sprod ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bdag mo'i bha ga 'di: sngon tshe sangs rgyas byon pa'i shul: kun ldan skyon bral pad+ma'i mkha': rang byung bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i gnas: rtsa rlung ye shes rtsal rdzogs shog: de nas slob bu pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru bdud rtsir bsams shing : bha ga la 'o bya: de nas slob dpon gyis rig ma'i phyag slob bu la gtad cing ngo sprad pa ni: hūm̐: ka dag rang byung rig pa me: bcu drug yon tan mdzes ldan 'di: khyod kyis 'di rol tshul bzhin spyod: kun 'byung ye shes lhag ge bar: bde ba ngos zungs dbyings la zhog: ces rol zhing bde bzhi ngos bzung : thig le rnams mchod pa'i tshul gyis 'bul: de nas slob dpon gyis: hoḥ zab lam gsang rgyud la zhugs nas: mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dam tshig tu: bud med smad pas 'dzin mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dam tshig tu: bud med smad pa bshad mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig tu: bud med log lta bzung mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i yon tan dam tshig tu: bud med thabs kyis smad mi bya: mkha' 'gro'i phrin las dam tshig tu: bud med shes rab spang mi bya: dbyings phyug skong bshags tshogs gtor brtson: zung 'jug grol lam brtson pa dang : nam yang mkha' 'gro brten par bya: lus med ye shes mkha' 'gro yi: zab lam bu yis mchog thob shog: rtsa sngags brjod cing : rdo rje pad+ma rgyas btab ste: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p maṇ+ḍal gser sogs rin chen 'bul: bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab: me tog 'thor: e ma lus med chos skor 'di: gzugs sku mi mo mtsho rgyal ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug gsang sngags kyi: zab lam mkha' 'gro'i brda bsgyur 'di:

nyon mongs ye shes bskyed pa yi: bden gnyis thugs phrad byang chub kyi: snying khrag mkha' spyod myur 'grub bzhag: ma 'ongs sum cu'i yang mtha' la: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gnubs lo'i thugs sprul khyi lo bas: dam chos spel ba'i lam 'byung ngo : karma las 'brel hūm̐ gis gser gling nas gdan drangs shing jo bo rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i 'od gsal rdo rje'i phug tu shog ser nas phab pa'o// // cha) ༈ bla ma snang srid zil gnon las: gsol 'debs thugs rje'i sprin phung bzhugs so: e ma hoḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: ka dag gnas lugs rtogs par shog: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: snang stong 'od skur grol bar shog: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: gzugs skus 'gro don nus par shog: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: shes rab rang rtsal mngon par shog: gu ru shrī singha la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par shog: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: 'chi med 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: rlung sems rang dbang thob par shog: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par shog: chos rgyal rtsa gsum gling pa la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: 'khor 'das rang dbang 'dus par shog: yang sprul brgyud 'dzin skyes chen la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: smin grol 'gro don nus par shog: drin chen bla ma kun 'dus la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par shog: brgyud pa'i byin rlabs thugs rje can:

'od gsal a ti rdzogs chen la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: stong nyid chos sku'i don rtogs shog: rgyal ba kun dang mi 'bral zhing : rtag tu chos la spyod par shog: sku gsum rdo rje'i don rtogs nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: dge 'dis ma gyur 'gro ba kun: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu smin gyur cig: ces bla ma snang srid zil gnon kyi lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor gcod yul snang ba lam 'khyer gyi cha rkyen du dad ldan pad+ma badz+ra dang dbang 'dzoms kyis bskul ngor/ kho bo gnam lcags rdo rjes shog ser las bshus so// // ja) ༈ o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so: om̐ āḥhūm̐: spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: 'ja' 'od mkha' dbyings rnam dag grub pa'i dbus: gtan gyi skyabs mgon rje btsun o rgyan la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: dus ngan skye 'chi'i drag gcod sdug bsngal la: sman pa'i rgyal po mdzod cig o rgyan rje: las dbang sngon gyi rkyen gyur sdug bsngal na: skyob pa'i ded dpon mdzod cig o rgyan rje: bsod nams las 'bras chung ba'i skal med la: longs spyod dpal 'byor rgyas shig o rgyan rje: ya nga skyi g.ya' bar do'i lam 'phrang las: sgrol ba'i ded dpon mdzod cig o rgyan rje: thar med las kyi dmyal ba'i btson dong las: 'dren pa'i ded dpon mdzod cig o rgyan rje: tshe la long med skye 'chir dgra sdang na: log lta rkyen dbang ma gtong o rgyan rje: yams nad 'go ba'i sdug bsngal dar ba'i tshe: srung skyob nad yams zlog cig o rgyan rje: skal med bod kyi rje 'bangs sdug bsngal na: mtha' dmag g.yul 'khrug zlog cig o rgyan rje: glo bur 'khrug rtsod yul gyi 'pho 'gyur rnams: myur du zhi bar mdzod cig o rgyan rje: nam yang 'khrul zhing 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe:

byang chub lam sna ston cig o rgyan rje: bdag gis rtse gcig gsol ba drag tu 'debs: thugs rje ma chung o rgyan sprul pa'i sku: byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru rin po che: skyabs med bod kyi sems can rje 'bangs la: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid stsol shog:

ces gsungs: de dang 'brel bar 'go ba'i rims yams kyi nad srung ba'i sngags ni: om̐ na ga sha la: du sha la tri dza la kha thaṃ: 'go ba'i rgya nad gzer thung gis mi tshugs par srungs shig gi tra badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: nangs snga mor snar dud pa ma song gong du brgya rtsa re bzlas nas sna bug ru phu byas na 'go nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs so: rig 'dzin lo ha badz+ra gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs pa'o// // nya) ༈ bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: dkar gtor snang srid 'dod yon bzhugs so: dkar gtor chab kyi bran la rin chen snod du gser skyems bshams: rang nyid yi dam ting 'dzin gyis: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ: kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod rgu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa kun tu zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra hi ma ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab: hūm̐: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rkang gnyis gtso: bden gnyis dkon mchog rtsa gsum bka' la nyon: gling bzhir mi gnas rgya mtshor mi 'thung med: srog la mi 'dzem lus la mi 'phang med: khrims la mi 'jigs bden pas mi dor med: lha srin sde brgyad 'byung pos bka' la nyon: bzang ngan las byed phrin las bcol ba'i phyir: 'dod yon lnga ldan rin chen gser skyems 'bul: hūm̐: slob dpon pad 'byung bka' dang dam gnas pa'i: dpal mgon bdun cu phyi nang sde brgyad dang : sde dpon sum cu yang 'khor sprul pa 'bum: sngags bdag bco brgyad bka' yi las mkhan bcas: yul gyi zhing skyong gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dang : lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad rgyu skar brgyad:

dbang phyug brgyad dang phyogs skyong yang 'khor bcas: skyes lha yul lha dgra lha zo dor dang : khyad par bka' srung gter srung drag rtsal can: yul ṛs gzhi bdag dben gnas skyong ba'i lha: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma 'bul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las gang bcol yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: dmag jag 'khrug rtsod nad yams zhi ba dang : zab chos bstan pa rgyas pa'i mthun rkyen grogs: yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa yis: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces phyogs gtsang sar 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas lcags phag lo'i hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin phyed la mi khrom sum cu'i 'khor dang bcas te gser brag bya skyibs nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ta) ༈ gu ru pad+ma snang srid zil gnon gyi: las byang ye shes kun khyab bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: 'od gsal rdo rje ting 'dzin brda bzhi las: grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma thod phreng ngas: shes rab rje 'bangs skal ldan blo gros can: snying stobs ldan pa'i shes rab bu yi don: dgongs brda rgya mtsho gsang ba'i snying byang bstan: smon lam ldan pa'i ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: brda bzhi bsgyur la rin chen gter du sbos: dge bsnyen sde bzhi phyi yul srung mar bcol: gter bdag gnod sbyin shan pa rdo rje rgyal: bka' srung dbang gi lha mo'i tsit+ta rgya: shes rab blo ldan hūm̐ dang chos bdag la: sprod cig dregs ldan chos skyong ming sring gsum: skal med log lta bdud rigs dbang po snubs: dang po sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi: dben ri bkra shis rgyal bas byin brlabs pa'i: dgra jag chom dang rnam g.yeng med gnas su:

dkyil 'khor byin rlabs rig ma mtshan ldan gyi: sgrub pa'i grogs btsal nyams dang grib sel zhing : mchod pa phyi nang nyer rdzas tshang bar bshams: rang nyid lho nub kha bltas pad 'byung bsgom: dang po dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa la: dang po skyabs yul ni: na moḥ 'das dang ma byon dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: sgo gsum bag chags sbyang bya'i phyir: mi 'bral rtse gcig skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ srid zhi'i ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: bde dga' rgya mtsho'i mchog reg cing : nyon mongs chu srin las bsgral phyir: mtha' yas de bzhin sems bskyed do: gsum pa 'khor gsum yongs dag ni: hoḥ phyi nang dge rtsa dpag yas las byung ba'i: kun tu 'od kyi rig pa rdo rje chos: bla med byang chub ma nor ci mchis pa: 'khor 'das dam chos dge ba yongs la bsngo: bzhi pa bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran cing byin rlabs bya: hūm̐: bdag nyid bdud 'dul khro rgyal gyi: thugs las 'gugs pa'i sa bon 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bgegs rnams khug: mchod sbyin gtor mas tshim zhing dengs: gal te 'tshe zhing sdang sems na: kī la khro tshogs me 'od 'khrugs: rdor mtshon char 'bebs bgegs dpung 'joms: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ ma hā gu ru kī la ya baṃ ḍāk+ki nī gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bcu khro bo'i gur: me dpung rab 'bar bgegs mtshams chod: rdo rwa me ri phyi nang gur: mi shigs sra brtan rwa bas bskor: oṃ badz+ra tsakra raṃ khaḍ+ga rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ham̐'u phaṭḥ drug pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: snang srid pad 'byung zil gnon lha: de'i don rig pas brda sgo phyes: kun nas rang byung la phyag 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'bral srog ltar bsgrub: bh+rūm̐ pra ti dza ho badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: bdun pa byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūm̐: pad 'byung rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

dgongs pa chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: sgrub mchog gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la: dbang bskur byin phob dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru baṃ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: brgyad pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bla med kun bzang mchod pa'i rdzas: phyi nang nyer spyod sman raka dang : dkar dmar bde chen rgyu byung nas: bhan+dhar bskyil zhing byin gyis brlab: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pañtsa a haṃ pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: ye nas stong zhing spros dang bral: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rnam rol las: rtog med yi ge rang byung nyid: gsal stong blo 'das ngang la gnas: oṃ dharma dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: gnyis pa lha bskyed ni/ e las nam mkha' rgya gram rlung : me chu sa las rdo rje'i gzhi: de dbus ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pas mdzes: sna lnga mu khyud 'dod snams dang : pha gu drwa phyed rin chen spras: shar bu mda' yab chos 'khor brgyan: ka gdung dral lcam 'phan dar 'phyangs: gdugs tog rgyan dang zer thag 'tsher: phyi rol rdo rwa me ris bskor: mtshan tshang yongs rdzogs gzhal yas khang : phyi nang zang thal 'od klong bsgom: de dbus pad nyi zla ba yi: lte ba chos dbyings mthing 'od dbus: hūm̐ dmar tshwa tshwa 'phro zhing brjid: phyogs bcu rgyal sras bcud bsdus nas: dbyer med thim zhing dran rdzogs gyur: skad cig zil gnon thod phreng sku: dmar smug dbang gi phrin las rdzogs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum mdzes: pad+ma'i lhub chen lnga ldan 'phur: snyan cha mgul rgyan se mo do: phyag g.yas zil gnon rdo rje gdengs: g.yon pas bhan+dha tshe bum dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ yum brten 'gying zhing brjid: lhab lhub ber dang chos gos dmar: phod kha stod g.yogs sku reg mdzes:

zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs brjid: mu stegs sde brgyad zil gnon tshul: spyi bor badz+ra zil gnon dkar: mgrin par pad+ma zil gnon dmar: thugs kar bud+dha zil gnon mthing : lte bar rat+na zil gnon ser: gsang bar karma zil gnon ljang : sku lnga gtso bo'i cha lugs bskyed: 'khor lo'i sgo srung 'jam dpal ser: ral gri po ti 'dzin zhing rngam: g.yas su lha lcam mkha' 'gro dmar: mda' dar tshe bum rgyan chas rdzogs: g.yon du mtsho rgyal btsun mo dkar: bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi bskyil zhing mchod: gnyis ka bcu drug lang tsho ldan: bha ga nu ma 'bur zhing ldem: yab la mdangs gzigs zim chags bsgom: shar du pad+ma 'byung gnas mthing : mkha' 'gro dkar mo gnyis med 'khril: sdigs mdzub gdeng thabs mkha' la gtad: lho ru shākya seṅge ser: sprul sku rang byung tshul du bsgom: nub tu blo ldan mchog sred dkar: ḍā ru pad phor lhun mdzes bsgom: byang du seṅge sgra sgrogs mthing : rdo rje sdigs mdzub khro gtum bsgom: shar lho pad+ma sam+bha dkar: sprul sku pad phor mchog sbyin bsgom: lho nub nyi ma 'od zer ser: kha ṭ+wāṃ nyi zer rol stabs bsgom: nub byang pad+ma rgyal po dmar: ḍā ru me long ber phyam brjid: byang shar rdo rje gro lod smug: rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing brjid: mtshan brgyad gzi brjid gsal snang rdzogs: mtshams bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams: gri thod rgyan ldan gar bsgyur zhing : rang mdog gsal 'tsher cha lugs bsgom: phyogs bzhi ma mo ging bzhi ni: sgo ma phyag mtshan rang rtags rdzogs: phyi rol 'khor yug bar khyams su: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro bcas: ging dang laṅka ma sring tshogs: gnas nyul zhing skyong phra men rnams: gsal snang 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom: bdag mdun dbyer med thugs ka nas: rang rang sa bon 'od zer gyis: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs:

skad cig gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma baṃ ḍāk+ki nī sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐: rnga yab dpal ri'i gnas dang ni: sku lnga rang mtshon zhing khams nas: zil gnon thod phreng lha tshogs rnams: spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin chen phob: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki nī dzñā na sarba sid+dhi pha la badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral 'dab stong ge sar dbus: ting 'dzin rnam gsum gnyis med mnyam sbyor gang : ma 'gag zung 'jug bde chen rgyas pa'i khrir: mi g.yo gsal stong ngang la bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: kun tu yid snang spros bral chos nyid ngang : ma bcos rdo rje gnyug ma'i sku nyid la: mi phyed yid kyi rtse gcig gdung ba'i phyir: mi 'bral sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod: sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchod yon la sogs yid sprul lha mo dang : sman raka bdud rtsi dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: sbyor sgrol bla med phyi nang sprin spros pa: zil gnon thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā pañtsa pū dza hoḥ
