khā hi khā hi: ༈ bdud rtsi'i lag mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: thog ma'i sangs rgyan kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur/ khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ snang srid zil gnon rtsa gsum 'dus pa rtsal/ /thod phreng rigs lnga sprul pa mtshan brgyad la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal yum mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gsang rgyud brda bsgyur chos bdag lung zin sogs/ /mdo sngags brgyud 'dzin skyes chen thams cad la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ /bdud 'dul kī la rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /go cha lha lnga kī la sras bzhi la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lo'i ngang*/ khro bcu dregs pa sde brgyad bka' sdod la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang du dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ 'bru gsum sa bon bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid/ /gnas gsum thim pas rtsa rlung ye shes bskyed/ /sku gsum mngon gyur 'pho med rdo rje'i srog /bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ kā ya sid+dhi om̐/ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/

ma hā mu tra sarba sid+dhi ho/ drin gyis 'khor med sngags 'chang nor bu'i mtshan/ /'di ltar dgos zhes nan du bskul ba'i mthus/ /phyogs med rgyal khams pha yul byed mkhan po/ /rong smyon o rgyan rig 'dzin rtsal gyis sbyar// // bdun pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos lhun grub bde chen ngang nyid las: gang 'dul der snang longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: zung 'jug don la sku gnyis 'du 'bral med: bdud dang mu stegs gdug pa 'dul la bstod: hūm̐: zil gnon brjid ldan pad zhwa mthong grol gsol: khro 'dzum smug zhal dgyes pas bdud tshogs 'dul: yid bzhin snyan cha 'khrol zhing ma tshogs sdud: mgul rgyan mu tig chun 'phyang dpa' bar 'gro: mi g.yo sku mchog zil gnon rtsal la bstod: phyag g.yas rdo rjes pha rol g.yul ngo 'joms: phyag g.yon bhan+dha tshe bum 'chi med spel: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: phod kha chos gos theg dman zil gyis gnon: 'gag med tshangs dbyangs zil gnon gsung la bstod: snang srid ber chen khams gsum dbang du sdud: dar dmar me long mkha' 'gro'i rgya rtags 'chang : 'od gsal rnam gsum chos dbyings rten 'brel mdzad: rgyal ba kun gyi gzi brjid 'od phung 'khyil: brjod bral ka dag klong chen thugs la bstod: gsus khyim 'khyil zhing sgrub la mchog thun stsol: rgya lham swag ris rigs drug sdug bsngal gnon: mu stegs gdan la g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'gying : khro rgyal rol stabs tshul gyis zil gnon pa: snang srid zil gnon rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: zhi rgyas dbang drag rang bzhin dbyings sprul nyid: gar dbang thod phreng zil gnon sde lnga la: gang 'dul thabs kyi 'gro mgon la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: sku mchog mi g.yo 'jam dpal dpa' bo khro: gdug pa'i g.yul 'joms ral gri pu ti 'dzin:

bde stong ye shes 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ba: shes rab dpa' bo gshin rje la phyag 'tshal: hrī maḥ rang byung dbyings spros bde chen yon tan rgyas: rgyal ba'i bskyed yum gsang rgyud gdams pa'i mdzod: dga' bzhi dbang sdud mdzes ldan yid 'phrog ma: ma sring rig ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gang 'dul 'gro don yid snang sku sprul pa: zhi dang khro gar phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du: mos pa'i skal ldan rjes 'jug smin mdzad phyir: pad 'byung mtshan brgyad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyogs mthun rigs las brda dang gar bsgyur ba'i: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dbang sdud lha mo bcas: mdzes ldan 'khril 'khyug gar sgyur sgeg pa mo: rigs bzhi lha mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dur khrod gnas nyul sgrub pa'i sgo skyong mdzad: phyag mtshan bzhi ldan tshad med bzhi sprul pa: ye shes 'jig rten rgyal bstan skyong mdzad pa: sgo skyong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyi 'khor dbang phyug ging dang laṅka mo: zhing skyong phra men gter srung la sogs pa: che mchog gu ru zil gnon lha tshogs kyi: dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs la phyag 'tshal: khyod la phyag 'tshal mchod bstod gdung ba'i mthus: thugs rje'i klong nas byin rlabs char chen phob: dgongs brda brgyud dang dam tshig shog ser gyis: smon lam skad cig myur du 'grub gyur cig:

brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha: du mar snang yang ngang du gcig: dkyil 'khor spro bsdu bcos mi bya: rang nyid lha dang lha nyid rang : rang dang lhan cig skyes pa ste: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur/ ༈ bsnyen pa'i dmigs bzlas ni/ snang srid zil gnon thugs ka ru/ /pad zlar bud+dha thod phreng mthing*/ /thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ /tha mar sngags phreng rā ga'i mdog /g.yas bskor 'od kyis don gnyis byas/ /tshur 'dus snang grags rtog pa'i chos/ /pad+ma thod phreng sku gsung thugs/ /lha sngags chos nyid rol par blta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sid+dhi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes las bzhi sgrub pa'i sngags phyi nang chu bo'i rgyun ltar si li li: sgra zur ma chad bklag thabs su 'khor bar bsam zhing bzlas: dbang blang ba ni/ rang las sprul zhing rang dbang bskur: hūm̐/ rang rig rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: sa ma ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa a la la hoḥ e ma kho bo pad+ma zil gnon ngas: phyi rabs skal ldan shes rab brtson 'grus can: blo gsal sgom tshugs nges shes blo brtan bur: nga nyid snang srid zil gnon bsgrub tshul bzhag: dus ngan lam sna 'dren pa'i brda btab nas: las byang don brgyud dgongs brda rnam gsum 'di: da lta mtsho rgyal hūm̐ bdag karma rtsal: rigs ldan phyi ma mtshams bzhi lo ru skyes: de dus zab rgya'i bka' srung mchod sbyin stsol: za ba ga ṭa ṭa myur du rten 'brel 'grig par gyis: las smon grub thob skal ldan sngon sbyangs btsan: thugs kyi sras la sprod cig bka' srung rgya: chos bdag : chos bdag karma rta mgrin rig ma khyi lug sprel phag lo rig ma 'byung : sbas rnams de la dang po tshogs mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni:

hūm̐: chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur ldang : zung 'jug lugs 'byung snying po can: rtsal snang aḥs sbyangs du mar spel: spros pas gnas 'gyur rdzas su bsgom: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga na tsakra pū dza hoḥ hūm̐: pad 'byung yab yum thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir oṃ āḥhūm̐: bag chags sbyangs bkrus gtor bsregs nas: 'dod yon snang srid rgyas khengs gyur: oṃ badz+ra ga na tsakra pha la hoḥ gnyis pa tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos sku rdor 'chang kun tu bzang : longs sku rdor sems rigs kyi gtso: sprul sku zil gnon thod phreng rtsal: sde lnga mtshan brgyad mkha' 'gro ging : shugs 'gro zhing skyong gter bdag la: bka' yi srung ma 'khor gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed shigs se shig: dur khrod gnas mchog nyams re dga': 'dir tshogs pho mo dam re gtsang : tshogs dang mchod rdzas dwangs re spro: lhun grub 'od gsal tshogs khang la: dbang bskur byin phob thugs dam bskul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong gter bdag la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra oṃ aḥhūm̐: bzhi pa bskang bshags ni/ spro na bskang ba rgyas pa 'dir bya/ hoḥ tshogs kyi nyes skyon bag chags sgrib: sgyu ma rmi lam 'khrul grol nas: skye med klong du bskang zhing bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ lnga pa bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: skye med drag po khro bo'i rgyal: gtum drag badz+ra kī la yas: rdo rje phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs: byad ma'i snying la kī la ya: oṃ ma hā gu ru kī la ya bigh+nān baṃ byad ma'i srog la rbad ya bh+yo mā ra ya rbad rbad: drug pa bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: stobs ldan ma hā gu ru zil gnon rtsal:

dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus thams cad kyis: dug lnga ru tra bsgral ba'i sha khrag bzhes: chos dbyings bde stong rol pa'i klong du hoḥ dgra bo'i ma hā māṃ sa sogs? tshogs la rol/ bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ging : zhing skyong mkha' 'gro sha za las byed mas: mi sdug gzugs 'chang rngam pa'i ha sgra sgrog: gcer mo'i lus la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gyon: rgyu ma 'dren zhing sha khrag tshogs la dgyes: bhan+dha'i thod skyogs dur khrod tshogs khang nyul: ting 'dzin drod nyul rnal 'byor stangs 'byed mas: lhag ma bzhes la gsang sngags bstan grogs mdzod: ma rungs g.yul ngo gdug pa'i dgra dpung chom: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta ta khā hi: brgyad pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: gdung ba'i yus dang bcas nas ni: drag po'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bskul: dregs sde mngon spyod las su bkol: hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng skur bzhengs shig: dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: du ru ra tsa bzlog pa'i dus la bab: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mu stegs dmag g.yo bzlog pa'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal srin dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gnyan nad smyo 'bog 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sngon gyi dam bca' nyams par mi 'gyur bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dgu pa chad mdo 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: snang mtha' chos dbyings pho brang du: rig rtsal rdo rje 'chang dbang gis: skye med stong nyid sgra sgrogs tshe: dby-ings phyug mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis: rang rtags gzugs bstan dam tshig bzhin: dngos grub mchog stsol ma chad dam:

dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dam bcas phrin las mdzod: de 'og bar bskal gnyis pa la: stag tshang seṅge'i skyed tshal du: thod phreng ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: zil gnon yang gsang zhal phyes tshe: dregs chen lha srin sde brgyad kyis: rang rtags gzugs bstan dam tshig bzhin: dngos grub mchog stsol ma chad dam: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dam bcas phrin las mdzod: de 'og dus tshig gsum pa la: shel brag mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu: pad 'byung rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyis: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bka' srung gter bdag shan pa yis: rang rtags gzugs bstan dam tshig bzhin: dngos grub mchog stsol ma chad dam: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dam bcas phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma hā kro ta kro ti yo ga yo gi a du tsa sa ma ya i daṃ bha ling+ta ta kha kha khā hi: bcu pa brtan skyong ni/ hūm̐: brtan skyong ma sring ya ma bcu gnyis tshogs: 'jig rten bod skyong brtan ma ma mo sman: lhab lhub rgyan ldan dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: glu len bro rdung gsang sngags zab gter srungs: gtor ma bzhes la zab gter mtha' rgyas mdzod: oṃ ma ma ma mo hriṃ hriṃ e dza ka bhak+ṣa si khā hi khā hi: bcu gcig pa rta bro ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen badz+ra kī la ya: nyon mongs bsgral ba'i zhing chen gzhir: brtul zhugs ting 'dzin bro brdungs pas: mtshan 'dzin bsgral ba'i cho ga rdzogs: oṃ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gnyis pa dngos grub la rol ba ni/ hūm̐: bde mchog klong yangs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang gsang rgyal ba rig 'dzin thugs rje gter: tshe chos zas nor gos kyi dngos grub ni: sgrub mchog skal ldan bdag la myur du stsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu gsum pa mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: mchod yon la sogs yid sprul lha mo dang : sman raka bdud rtsi dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun:

sbyor sgrol bla med phyi nang sprin spros pa: zil gnon thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā pañtsa pū dza hoḥ khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos lhun grub bde chen ngang nyid las: gang 'dul der snang longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: zung 'jug don la sku gnyis 'du 'bral med: bdud dang mu stegs gdug pa 'dul la bstod/ bcu bzhi pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ hoḥ mkha' klong mi 'gyur shar grol rig pa'i rtsal: 'khor 'das dbyer med 'od gsal ngang nyid las: spro bsdu bcos bsgyur re dogs 'khrul pa'i tshogs: rang byung thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: skye med ye shes nam mkha'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: rang rig gdod ma'i rang sa zin gyur cig: ces yig brgya bzla: bco lnga pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings ka dag klong yangs rtsal rdzogs pa'i: shar grol snang stong sku bzhi zhing sprul lha: dkyil 'khor hūm̐ thim zhabs kyu mgo skar yal: zla tshes nā da mi dmigs stong par bzhag: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: a a āḥ de'ang mi dmigs par ngo bo gsal stong ngang la ci gnas su bzhag: bcu drug pa bsngo ba dang smon lam ni/ hoḥ ma gyur mtha' yas 'gro kun smon lam zhing : gang 'dul thugs rje'i stobs bcu'i rtsal phyung nas: sa lam go 'phang tshe 'dir mngon grub ste: 'og min zhing du sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo: bcu bdun pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: longs sku'i bkra shis rdor sems zhi khro'i lha: sprul sku'i bkra shis snang srid zil gnon rtsal: kun gzhi'i bkra shis ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: thams cad bkra shis mkha' 'gro gter gyi bdag: zung 'jug bde chen rten 'brel smon lam tshogs: yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par stsol:

e ma rgyal kun gcig 'dus zil gnon mkha' 'gro yi: yang gsang brgyud pa'i las byang don bsdus pa'i: pad+ma'i thugs bcud mkha' 'gro rgya can 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bya sprel lo bzung mkha' 'gro'i brda smon 'grub: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sngags 'chang hūm̐ ka las sa phag lor gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas gdan drangs shing rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa ru shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // tha) ༈ gu ru snang srid zil gnon rtsal gyi/ bskang ba phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// // gu ru snang srid zil gnon rtsal la 'dud/ tshogs gtor mchod pa ci 'byor bshams nas byin brlab bya/ hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas/ /kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas gshegs su gsol/ /rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /gu ru snang srid zil gnon gshegs su gsol/ /mā ra ti ka gsang ba'i pho brang nas/ /lha lcam man+da ra ba gshegs su gsol/ /zag med dga' bzhi bskyed pa'i pho brang nas/ /mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes sgo skyong 'khor lo'i pho brang nas/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo ser po gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes lnga ldan rnam dag pho brang nas/ /gu ru thod phreng sde lnga gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rang rang pho brang nas/ /sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad gshegs su gsol/ /thabs mchog bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas/ /dpa' bo rigs bzhi 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /shes rab gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas/ /dpa' mo mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol/ /phrin las sna tshogs ma nges pho brang nas/ /dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /gshegs nas dam bskang phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ /rig 'dzin bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas bskang mchod 'bul ba ni/

hūm̐/ zil gnon che mchog 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /phyi yi mchod pa tshogs drug lha mo'i gar/ /nang gi mchod pa bde chen thig le'i bcud/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i rlabs/ /sbyor ba'i mchod pa phyag rgya drug gi lam/ /sgrol ba'i mchod pa dug lnga dbyings su dag /bskang ba'i mchod pa rang byung skye ba med/ /ye nas rang byung bla med mchod mchog 'di/ /bder gshegs rig 'dzin kun 'dus rtsal la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong deng 'dir bstsal du gsol/ hūm̐/ ye nas ka dag sangs rgyas phyir/ /snang mtha' spyan gzigs thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /pad 'byung zil gnon thugs dam bskang*/ /tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i phyir/ /man+da ra ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mchog gi bde ba ster ba'i phyir/ /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang*/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i sgo skyong phyir/ /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs dam bskang*/ hūm̐/ gti mug dbyings su dag pa'i phyir/ /bud+dha thod phreng thugs dam bskang*/ /zhe sdang dbyings su dag pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje thod phreng thugs dam bskang*/ /nga rgyal dbyings su dag pa'i phyir/ /rat+na thod phreng thugs dam bskang*/ /'dod chags dbyings su dag pa'i phyir/ /pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang*/ /phrag dog dbyings su dag pa'i phyir/ /karma thod phreng thugs dam bskang*/ hūm̐/ skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i sku/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang*/ /lung rigs rgyud sde'i nyi ma shar/ /blo ldan mchog sred thugs dam bskang*/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa bas snang srid mkhyen/ /nyi ma 'od zer thugs dam bskang*/ /mu stegs bdud kyi bstan pa bsnubs/ /seṅge sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang*/ /bla med a ti'i rgyal sa thob/ /pad+ma sam+bha'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sbyor sgrol spyod pas 'gro ba sdud/

/pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /shākya seṅge'i thugs dam bskang*/ bdud btul lha srin dam la btags/ /rdo rje gro lod thugs dam bskang*/ hūm̐/ ting 'dzin rtogs pa'i dur khrod nas/ /badz+ra dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam rtog zhig pa'i dur khrod nas/ /rat+na dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'gogs lam 'thor ba'i dur khrod nas/ /pad+ma dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'khri ba chod pa'i dur khrod nas/ /karma dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /kun tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rnam par rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nges par rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod nas/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /tshogs drug mtha' bral dur khrod nas/ /lha mo bcu drug thugs dam bskang*/ /gnas yul drag rgyu'i dur khrod nas/ /dbang phyug ma mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'phro 'du sa mtshams dur khrod nas/ /zhing skyong pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dam nyams zas su za ba'i phyir/ /srin po pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mtshan mo dur khrod 'grim pa'i phyir/ /gnas nyul pho mo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /sprul pas phyogs bcur khyab pa'i phyir/ /mu ran skyong ba'i thugs dam bskang*/ /las kyi bya ra byed pa'i phyir/ /sprul 'khor nyid sprul thugs dam bskang*/ /rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas/ /bdag gi g.yar dam sor chud cing*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ hūm̐/ thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni/ /rmad byung brjid ldan gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ /'chi med bdud rtsi sman gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /ar+ghaṃ rak+ta dmar gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /ma nyams yang phud sman gyis thugs dam bskang*/ /dri med zhun mar mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang*/

/rnal 'byor longs spyod tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /bkrag gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes thugs dam bskang*/ /mtshan ldan dam rdzas mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang*/ /bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po skong gyur cig /bskang ngo rtsa gsum gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /dngos po chos nyid klong du thugs dam bskang*/ /snang ba ye shes klong du thugs dam bskang*/ /gzung 'dzin rang grol klong du thugs dam bskang*/ /sdug bsngal bde ba chen po'i klong du bskang*/ /gnyis med don rtogs spang blang med pa yi/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs chen po'i mchod pa 'bul/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /sdom pa spyi dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /bka' lung dbang dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags/ /dam tshig snod dang mi ldan mthol lo bshags/ /bskyed rim so sor ma gsal mthol lo bshags/ /rdzogs rim dgongs par mi ldan mthol lo bshags/ /bzlas brjod gzungs rtags ma thon mthol lo bshags/ /mthol lo bshags so bla ma yi dam lhar/ /gnong ngo 'gyod do mkha' 'gro dam can rnams/ /mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyis dngos grub stsol/

zhes yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang bar bya'o/ gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi phrin las kyi kha skong ba/ phrin las myur mgyogs 'di yang*/ bla sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi bskang ba rgyas pa 'dod rgu mchog sbyin la gzhi byas shing skabs su bab pa'i mos lam kha shas kyis brgyan pa 'di'ang*/ rang gnas khrom gzigs rngam pa tshal gyi gnas mdar/ rong smyon o rgyan rig 'dzin gyis sbyar ba kun tu dge bar gyur cig/ // da) ༈ gu ru snang srid zil gnon las/ sbyin sreg dug lnga rang grol bzhugs so/ ma hā gu ru'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ dang po sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ /gnas sam sgrub khang gang yin la/ /sa stegs thig sogs rgyud ltar gdab/ /rdul tshon la sogs zhib rgyas bya/ /shing yang sgo rdzogs tshul du brtsegs/ /me dar kha dog rnam pa lnga/ /sa slong mtshams gcod zhib rgyas bya/ /me snying rin chen sna lnga dang*/ /'bru sna me lha'i gtor ma bzhag /mchod gtor dbang po rnam lnga dang*/ /mchod pa rnam lnga la sogs pa/ /mchod rdzas yod tshad tshang bar bsags/ /mi gtsang 'bag bsgribs thams cad sbyangs/ /rang nyid lho nub kha bltas nas/ /bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs/ /rang nyid pad 'byung gsal btab cing*/ /sngags chas zhugs shing 'di skad do/ / om̐ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ swā hā: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs? om̐ badz+ra shud+dhe swā hā: zhes lan lnga'am gsum bzla/ de nas thabs shes kyi dgang gzar phyag tu thogs nas/ om̐ badz+ra shrī ram̐: om̐ badz+ra hrī dha ra swā hā: zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi mchod rdzas la reg tsam bya/ de nas me mgo mnan pa ni/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tram̐ gu na tiṣ+ṭha tsakra ye swā hā: zhes lan gsum du brjod cing dūrba rgya gram gyis mnan/ de nas me sbar ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor shar sgo dkar po nas: me long ye shes me sbar bas: zhe sdang mi gtsang zhi gyur cig: dkyil 'khor lho sgo ser po nas:

mnyam nyid ye shes me sbar bas: nga rgyal brag ri zhi gyur cig: dkyil 'khor nub sgo dmar po nas: sor rtogs ye shes me sbar bas: 'dod chags rgya mtsho skem gyur cig: dkyil 'khor byang sgo ljang khu nas: bya grub ye shes me sbar bas: phrag dog rlung dmar zhi gyur cig: dkyil 'khor dbus kyi phyogs rol nas: chos dbyings ye shes me sbar bas: gti mug mun pa sel gyur cig: 'khor yug khyab par me sbar bas: bdud bzhi rang sar zhi gyur cig: 'og gi phyogs nas me sbar bas: tshe srog bar chad zhi gyur cig: ye shes lnga yi me sbar bas: phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: raṃ dz+wa la raṃ ye swā hā: de nas rlung g.yab thogs la 'di skad do/ / hūm̐ hrīḥ shar phyogs dkar mo g.yo ba mos: byams pa tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: lho phyogs ser mo rgyas pa mos: dga' ba tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: nub phyogs dmar mo bde ba mos: btang snyoms tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: byang phyogs ljang mo drag rtsal mos: snying rje tshad med rlung g.yobs shig: dbus phyogs sna tshogs kun grol mos: ye shes chen po'i rlung g.yobs shig: dzeṃ haṃ yaṃ yaṃ shud+dhe ye swā hā: de nas me mtshams gcod pa ni/ dzaḥ shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu mas: lha bu'i bdud kyi me mtshams chod: dzaḥbadz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa mas: phung po'i bdud kyi me mtshams chod: hūm̐: rat+na tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: baṃ: nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog mas: nyon mongs bdud kyi me mtshams chod: baṃ: pad+ma tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: hoḥ byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu mas: 'chi bdag bdud kyi me mtshams chod: hoḥ karma tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: bh+rūm̐: sna tshogs g.yo ba gar byed dang : ging dang sgo ma tshogs bcas kyis: phyogs mtshams kun tu thub par srungs: bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ tsakra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: de nas me lha'i pho brang rten bca' ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta

sogs? swa bhā wa sa sbyang? stong pa'i ngang las ram̐ ram̐ zhes pas me lha'i pho brang yangs shing rgya che ba kha dog lnga dang ldan pa: bag chags dug lnga rnams rang grol sreg byed chen po'i dam tshig gi me rab tu 'bar ba ste dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis med kyi gzhal yas khang chen po: skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs kyi rang bzhin can du gyur nas shar lhor drang srong me lha'i tshogs skad cig gis spyan drangs te dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: badz+ra sa ma ya e ma ko3 haṃ: de nas me lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung sprul pa'i lha: skye med ngang las 'bar ba'i ye shes bskyed: dngos 'dzin 'khrul ba'i bag chags bsreg pa'i phyir: ye shes me lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: dam tshig byin za'i lha dang dbyer med du: mchod cing bstod phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye sa mā ya dza dza: de nas me lha bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ ho: snod kyis bsdus pa'i snang ba'i rol gar du: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gyur nas kyang : dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: mtshan 'dzin bud shing bsreg phyir bzhugs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas me lha la gdan 'bul ba ni/ om̐: ku sha 'di ni gtsang shing dge: tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin: dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed yin: sa la skyes pa 'dab mi snying : bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni: zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol: de nas me lha mchod pa ni/ hoḥ dbyings kyi ngo bo dpa' ba'i rdzu 'phrul can: rig pa po yi shes rab tsaṇ+ḍa lī: dug lnga zhi mdzad sku lnga'i rang mdangs bskyed: tshad med bzhi yi phrin las 'grub pa'i phyir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: bcom ldan me lha'i tshogs la 'bul lags na: bag sgrib a 'thas gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ ag+ne ye sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ri dhi dzñā na ye khā hi:

pā d+yaṃ? sbyar bas zhabs bsil 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye puṣ+pe swā hā: me tog 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye dhū pe swā hā: bdug spos 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye ā lo ke swā hā: mar me 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye gan+dhe swā hā: dri chab 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye nai wi d+ye swā hā: zhal zas 'bul/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye shab+da swā hā: rol mo bsgrag /gzugs sgra dri ro rnams phyogs gcig tu 'bul/ de nas tshogs 'bul ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ yam shing la/ om̐ bho dhi bh+rik+ṣa ye swā hā: zas mchog la/ om̐ sarba pu tsa taṃ bu la ye swā hā: de nas 'bru sna lnga la dang po nas ni/ om̐ badz+ra ni tha ta ye swā hā: 'bras la/ om̐ badz+ra tang ku la ye swā hā: gro la/ om̐ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā: so ba la/ om̐ badz+ra kir ti swā hā: sran ma la/ om̐ badz+ra so pa ra swā hā: til dkar nag la/ om̐ sarba pā paṃ da ha swā hā: 'o zho la/ om̐ sarba sa bha de wa swā hā: dar zab la/ om̐ badz+ra wasatra ye swā hā: rin chen sna lnga la/ om̐ badz+ra rat+na a yu ṣe swā hā: mngar gsum la/ om̐ dha hri āḥbhik+ṣa swā hā: shing 'bras la/ om̐ badz+ra e ma u swā hā: dūrba la/ om̐ su ki a yu ṣe swā hā: ku sha la/ om̐ pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swā hā: mar khu 'bul ba ni/ om̐ badz+ra ag+ne ye pra ha ti swā hā: zhes phul la de nas me lha'i bstod pa ni/ gtor ma phul la 'di skad do/ / hoḥ shar lho'i phyogs kyi rgyal po me lha'i tshogs: bdag gis mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor yid kyi 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod: ces mar khu dang gtor ma sman ril bcas 'bul la phyag kyang 'tshal/ de nas gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ hoḥ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐: zhes pas me lha'i lto bar ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa rmang gzhi rdo rje rgya gram las byas shing rtsig pa sna lnga dang mu khyud kyis spras te 'dod snam du mchod 'bul gyi lha mo rnams kyis gar bsgyur ba:

pha gu la nor bu dang pad+mas brgyan pa: stong ku la drwa ba dang drwa phyed gyis spras pa: shar bu dang za ra tshags: sgo bzhir 'khor lo dang ri dwags chos nyan dang rin po che'i gdugs kyis spras pa: de rnams kyi steng du chos 'khor bcu gsum la gdugs khebs dang nyi zlas brgyan cing phyi nang stong gsal 'dzin med kyi pho brang chen por gyur nas: snang srid zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkha'i dbyings la 'ja' ldang ba ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du gsal ba'o: bh+rūm̐ maṇ+ḍal gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ye swā hā: zhes cho ga'i gzhung bsrangs nas mchod pa la bskyal te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings klong du ma ro gcig ngang : 'khor 'das rang byung rig pas phyag 'tshal zhing : snang srid dag pa rab 'byams mchod pa 'bul: sku gsum lhun grub rang byung ngang du bzhes: zhes pā d+yaṃ sbyar bas mchod yon zhabs bsil 'bul/ mchod pa rnam lnga la/ hūm̐: phyi yi mchod pa dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon: gsang mchod nang gi mchod pa rnam lnga 'di: snang srid zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong nas bzhes su gsol: zhes rtsa sngags kyis 'bul/ me tog la/ om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā: bdug spos la/ om̐ badz+ra dhū pe ye swā hā: mar me la/ om̐ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā: dri chab la/ om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe ye swā hā: zhal zas la/ om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye swā hā: rol mo la/ om̐ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: de nas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: zag med dwangs ma dbyings rig thig le'i gzhir: lhun grub rdo rje'i gzugs sgra dri ro lnga: reg bya lha mos nam mkha' gang ba 'di: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho na: rnam grol ye shes bde chen rgyas mchod 'bul: chos zad 'khor ba sprug phyir bzhes su gsol: zhes rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ gzugs la/

om̐ badz+ra rū pa swā hā: sgra la/ om̐ badz+ra shab+da swā hā: dri la/ om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā: ro la/ om̐ badz+ra rā sa swā hā: reg bya la/ om̐ badz+ra spar+she swā hā: bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad la/ hoḥ tshogs drug lha mo nam mkha'i gar sgyur ma: mi khom gnas brgyad zhen pa bral ba'i phyir: bkra shis rtags brgyad 'di dag 'bul gyis bzhes: zhi dang bkra shis bde legs mdzad du gsol: zhes rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ om̐ dharma badz+ra bi shwa maṅga laṃ pū dza hoḥ rgyal srid sna bdun la/ hoḥ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo rin po che: blon po rin chen glang po rta mchog dang : g.yul las rgyal byed dmag dpon rin chen 'di: snang srid zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: zhes rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ om̐ dharma badz+ra puṣ+ṇe swa bhā hoḥ nang mchod bde chen 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bde chen gsang ba mchog gi bhan+dha ru: bla med mkha' dbyings dam tshig bdud rtsis gtams: gsang ba ye shes rgyas mchod 'di 'bul bas: bdag gi sgrib gnyis bral phyir bzhes su gsol: rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: bde chen no/ om̐ a haṃ pañtsa la khā hi: de nas rak+ta dang dbang po rnam lnga dang bha ling 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rang byung mkha' dbyings chos 'byung bhan+dha ru: zhing bcu bsgral ba'i snying khrag phyur bur gtams: sku gsum rang grol ngang du 'bul lags na: dug gsum rang grol klong du bzhes su gsol: rtsa sngags mthar/ om̐ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: rdzas dbang po rnam lnga la/ om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta khā hi: de nas sreg rdzas rnams la/ hūm̐: rang bzhin dag pa'i phyi mchod sna tshogs dang : blo yis blangs dang dngos su 'byor ba'i tshogs: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lags na: skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral ngang du bzhes: rtsa sngags mthar tshogs 'bul ba ni/ om̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: yam shing la sogs gong gi sngags dang 'dra bas 'gres shes par bya/

mar khu la/ om̐ a hu ti sarba pū dza la khā hi: zhes rdzas rnams thams cad rtsa sngags kyis phul bar shes/ de nas sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ om̐: yid 'ong rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha' klas khyab: zag bral nges legs tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang : kun nas bsdus pa'i sman mchod 'bul lags na: bdag 'gro dug lnga'i nad rnams sel bar mdzod: rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ kar ti ki ma ṇa waṃ shu pu ka dzeṃ haṃ ṇi pa la swā hā: de rjes mar khu tshar gcig phul la/ hoḥ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo snang srid zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di phul bas: dgyes par bzhes la bdag cag gis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan pa'i sdig sgrib dang rkyen ngan pa'i bar chod: gzhan yang dug lnga dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i sgrib pa dang : yul brgyad mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad kyi gnas ngan len pa'i rigs drug las bsgral nas/ rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga sogs rten 'brel phyogs med du 'char ba dang : gzhan yang bdud bzhi'i bar chod dang 'jigs pa brgyad sogs rang sar zhi nas tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas shing : khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum 'dod rgu'i longs spyod thams cad dbang du bsdus nas dam sri dgra bgegs thams cad dang : bdud dang 'byung po rnams kyi rno ba'i dbal sbyor ba'i dug thams cad tshar gcod par gyur cig: rtsa sngags kyi mthar: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ma ma wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes mar khu dam rdzas dri bzang spos gos dang tam bu bcas mchod/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rol pa'i gzhal yas chen po nas: dran rig ye nas stong gsal mdun gyi cha: gsal stong dbyer med stong gsal 'od lnga'i klong : rigs bdag kun bzang rdor 'chang la sogs dang : gang 'dul sprul mdzad snang srid zil gnon sku:

ma bcos gsang yum lha lcam ye shes mtsho: thod phreng sde lnga gu ru mtshan brgyad dang : lha mo bcu drug dbang phyug laṅka ging : sgo skyong dang bcas dkyil 'khor ma lus la: snang srid ye grol chen por phyag 'tshal nas: spyi ti 'khor 'das rdzogs dbyings chen por bskang : a ti bla med ye grol klong du bshags: yang ti rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du sbyor: yo ga gsum gyis dug gsum dbyings su sgrol: chos longs sprul gsum ngo bo nyid gsum gyi: rtsal snang rol pa sgyu 'phrul snang ba'i rgyan: sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi thig le dang : phyi dang nang dang gsang ba de kho na: dbyings dang rig pa gsang gsum bde stong bcu: dga' ba bzhi rdzogs snang bzhi'i 'ja' gur klong : snang ba thams cad rgyud sde bzhi yi yab: stong pa thams cad ka dag dbyings kyi yum: gnyis med 'di ni he ru ka pa'i lam: rtsa rlung thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing : thig le thams cad bde chen 'od kyi sku: lhun grub gyur dkar 'od kyi klong rum nas: tshad med bzhi yis bdag 'gro yongs la skyong : gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ngo bo mi zad pa: bde gsal mi rtog ting 'dzin yi rangs nas: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjes dor med kyis: skye 'gag gnas gsum mtha' bral gsol ba 'debs: sku gsum bla ma'i tshogs la mchod cing bstod: gzung 'dzin ye shes 'od lnga'i klong du bshags: rtag par chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol: chos zad 'khor ba dong sprugs chen por bsngo: gsal stong rnam dag ye shes thig le'i gzhir: ngo mtshar snang ba'i tshom bu mi zad spras: thams cad chos sku thig le nyag gcig ngang : sku gsum lhun grub ngang du yi rang ngo : snang ba thams cad sprul sku'i gzugs snang las: sgra grags thams cad grags stong chos kyi gsung : dran rtog thams cad chos sku'i dgongs pa dang : mtha' med bdag 'gro 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzod:

ces bsdu chog sogs gzhung nas bya/ me ro thal ba rdul tshon sogs rlung la spur ba'am chur bying du chug /phun tshogs legs bshad rnam bkra lhun po'i rtser/ /sngags dang phyi nang zung 'jug bla med rgyan/ /sku gsum lhun grub rol pa ci bzhin tshig /'bras bu dgongs rgyan don la 'gal dang 'khrul/ /yod med don la mkhas pas rtog cing dpyod/ /nongs pa'i dri ma ci mchis bcos su 'tshal/ /'gro blo'i snang byed gling bzhi'i sgron me mchog /srid 'dir dregs ldan gtsug na mdzes gyur cig /zab don rgyu 'bras rnam rgyal khang bzang rtser/ /gdod ma'i sems nyid 'od gsal nor bu'i tog /mi g.yo rdo rje'i snying po'i rgyal srid bstan/ /srid gsum lha yul dga' bde'i rgyan gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang rang don du cung dgos pa dang snang srid zil gnon gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong du/ rong smyon o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis gang shar du spel ba'o// // na) ༈ gu ru snang srid zil gnon las: rab gnas sku gsum lhun grub bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs// hrīḥ khyab bdag 'gro ba'i mgon gyur snang mtha' yas/ /'gro kun 'dren pa'i mchog gyur rdo rje sems/ /'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma 'byung*/ /sku gsum lhun grub bla ma der phyag 'tshal/ de'ang rab gnas bya ba'i rim pa ni/ /bkra shis byin chags rgyal bas me tog 'thor/ /smon lam mchog ldan dben ri yid 'ong der/ /slar yang stegs bu bcag der dbus mtho ba/ /gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang rtse'i dbyibs dag la/ /thig gdab tshon spel bkod legs mdzes par bya/ /mkho ba'i yo byad sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bsags/ /phyi nang mchod tshogs rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ /glu gar rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*/ /gzhan yang longs spyod dkor cha'i rigs rnams dgod/ /tshangs pa'i khyim ltar dwangs pa'i mdangs phyungs la/ /bde chen thugs rje'i byin 'bebs brtan bzhugs gsol/

/rab gnas ye shes byin 'bebs las/ /sngon byon rgyal bas bzhengs pa'i rten/ /de ltar la ni lta ci smos/ /de bzhin bzos pa'i rigs rnams la/ /rab tu gnas par ma byas na/ /byin rlabs mi 'jug skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya zhing ting 'dzin gsal/ nyon mongs bdud rnams ma lus bskrad par bya/ hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /'dir tshogs khro bo khro mo ste/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rgyal 'gong dang*/ /the'u rang dam sri 'byung po dang*/ /bstan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rigs/ /'di ru 'dug pa'i gnas med pas/ /so so rang rang gnas su dengs/ /ci ste gdu+ug pa'i sems 'chang na/ /rig sngags 'bar bas gzhom par byed/ /gzungs sngags snying rjes lus sems phral/ /ral gri 'bar bas mgo lus gtub/ /rgya gram rdo rjes phye mar brdung*/ /rim dgu gshin rje'i grong du gtad/ /bskal par bgrod 'gyu med par bya/ /de bas rang rang phyir dengs shig om̐ mañdzu shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza hūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ thun brdeg pa ni/ hūm̐: bskul lo ging chen pho mo rnams: mdzod cig nyon mongs bdud bzhi thul: rbad do rnal 'byor nyams grib sol: brten no nyon mongs zug rngu sregs: 'bod do dkyil 'khor mu ran skyongs: bskul ba yin no mthu ma chung : hūm̐: ging chen dmag tshogs dus la bab: nyon mongs dug gsum dgra dar na: ging chen thugs dam dus la bab: dam tshig gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: ging phos rdo thun sha ra ra: ging mos me zor wa la la: dmar nag ral pa sa la zhol: mi lpags g.yang gzhi shams se sham: rgyu ma'i zhags pa na ra ra: stag lpags sham thabs khrigs se khrig: rngam rgyug gar stabs lings se ling : rkang gling phaṭ sgra 'u ru ru: bshugs sgra rgyang glu kyu ru ru: bgegs bskrad gad mo lhangs se lhang : phyi yi rnam rtog bdud dgra chom: nang gi nyon mongs bdud bzhi thul:

gsang ba'i na tsha rkyen ngan phrol: dug lnga'i 'khrul ba da shigs la: nga bdag 'gong po dbyings su sgrol: dam sri gnod byed rmang nas phyungs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i bar chod thal bar rlog: om̐ kro ta ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐: gnod byed dam sri nyon mongs bdud bzhi thams cad ghardza ghardza phaṭḥ kro ti shwa ri gh+ri na bh+yo bh+yoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel ngan pa thams cad da ha da ha dz+wa la raṃ: dug lnga nyon mongs mtshams gcod 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung : dri za 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: shar phyogs gdon bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: lho phyogs gdon bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : dbang ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: nub phyogs gdon bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis: byang phyogs gdon bgegs mtshams chod cig: hūm̐: gzhan yang mtshams dang steng 'og rnams: phyogs skyong rgyal po thams cad kyis: nam yang 'byung po ma gtong zhig: om̐ ma hā dhe wa ga ru na tsakra hūm̐: de nas bdag 'jug bya ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pas pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis dam tshig pa gu ru snang srid zil gnon rtsal sku mdog dmar smug: g.yas pas rdo rje dang g.yon pas phur bu gdeng thabs su 'dzin pa: spyan gsum dang ldan pa: sku la mthing nag gi phod kha dang dbu la bdud dpung zil gnon gyi sngags zhu gsol ba: dar dmar gyi sku reg dang rgya lham gsol zhing rol stabs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas: lho nub rnga yab laṅka'i yul: dbang drag gsang chen rol ba'i gnas: zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi lha tshogs nam mkha'i dbyings la 'ja' ldang ba ltar lam gyis byon nas bdag dang rten rnams la byin gyis brlab phyir skad cig gis spyan drangs sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

rang rtsal ma 'gag rol par spyan 'dren no/ hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab gling : dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: phyogs dus rgyal ba'i rgyud kun ma lus dang : rje btsun ma hā gu ru gshegs su gsol: sku lnga lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas: gu ru thod phreng sde lnga gshegs su gsol: phyogs mtshams dur khrod rang rang gnas mchog nas: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang lha mo dbang phyug laṅka ging : sgo skyong gnas nyul ma mo thams cad dang : zil gnon thod phreng lha tshogs ma lus pa: ye shes rol pa chen pos spyan 'dren no: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dam chos nyi ma rgyas pa'i 'od klong nas: gsang gsum zil gnon thod phreng dkyil 'khor gyis: mtshan mo'i 'khri ba ma lus bsal ba'i phyir: rdo rje rta ring len tshe brda gar 'cham: ka dag ye shes snying rje'i byin 'bebs so: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub ka dag pho brang nas: chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum la: skye med chos dbyings dag par mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: rnam dag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs sku yab yum la: dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: mtshungs bral snang srid zil gnon yab yum la: gangs can bstan pa'i sgron mer mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: sku lnga rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang nas: rje btsun gu ru thod phreng sde lnga la: gnyis med rol pa chen por mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: za hor laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog nas: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum la: rdzu 'phrul mngon du phyung bar mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: siṅga sku la rdzogs pa'i gnas mchog tu:

rig 'dzin gu ru pad+ma sam bha la: klong yangs rgyud sde bzhi yis mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: bal yul lhun grub brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po blo ldan mchog sred la: yon tan mngon du phyung bar mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: thor cog can gyi pho brang dgu ldan nas: rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma rgyal po la: 'dod rgu lhun gyis grub par mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: rgya gar bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po shākya seṅge la: sde snod gsum gyi bdag por mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: kha che he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po nyi ma 'od zer la: rdzogs chen lta ba klong yangs mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po seṅge sgra sgrogs la: mu stegs g.yul las rgyal bar mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje gro lod la: lha srin sde brgyad dbang sdud mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: gangs can bod yul gling dgu'i gnas mchog tu: thugs kyi sras mchog rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: gsang mdzod rin chen gter gyi mnga' gsol bas: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la byin chen phob: dkyil 'khor thams cad bum pa gcig tu bsdus: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mas byin phob cig: byin chen dbab cing rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rtsa gsum lha tshogs gzi brjid spungs se spung : zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'od dpung kyi li li: khro bo'i lha tshogs me ri ya la la: dpa' bo 'bum gyis gar byed shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis brda skad lhangs se lhang :

ging pho rnams kyis rngam stabs khyugs se khyug: ging mo rnams kyis bshugs sgra tse re re: rnga gl̥ng sgra ldan rol mo 'u ru ru: zhub can stong gis sgra skad si li li: g.yas na pho rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: g.yon na mo rgyud thams cad sha ra ra: chos skyong srung ma'i las byed khyugs se khyug: bar snang thams cad dar gdugs lhabs se lhab: hūm̐ gi snang glu mang po di ri ri: phaṭ kyis brda skad drag po sangs se sang : dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs me re re: rten mchog rnams la byin 'bebs thibs se thib: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir: thugs rje'i byin rlabs sprin phung ltar du gtibs: rgyal ba ye shes lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor rnams la byin chen phob: 'dir 'tshogs skal ldan rnams la dbang mchog bskur: nyams rtogs rig pa mi rtog rdo rje'i gshis: gang yang ma 'gag cir yang lam 'khyer ba'i: kun bzang ye grol gdod ma'i dgongs pa dang : rtsa gsum zil gnon thod phreng dkyil 'khor rnams: rten mchog 'di la byin chen dbab tu gsol: om̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal ma ma kun+ta sha ra ṇa a we sha ya hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ dza rten mchog 'di la brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor rgyal ba ye shes kyi lha tshogs kun gyi ngo bo rje btsun ma hā gu rus rten mchog rnams la byin dbab nas: bde gshegs kyi rgyal ba sku dngos su gyur te nam yang bgegs dang 'byung pos mi 'tshe bar gyur bar bsams la: ye dharmā sa brlab par bya: ā li kā li dang rten 'brel snying po sogs kyis rin chen sna lnga dang 'bru sna la sngags nas rab gnas kyang 'thor: sa ma ya: sku gsum lhun grub mchod pa 'di ltar 'bul: rdo rje lta bu'i rten bzhugs nar mar spyod: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams rten du 'bul:

phyi nang mnyam rjes dag pa'i ngang nyid du: rten 'brel mtshon pa'i dbyangs dang bcas nas ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal tshab sku yi dngos: gdung mchog ma lus rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i chos: dge 'dun 'dus sde ma lus kun gyi rten: 'di la brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: bder gshegs kun gyi thugs mnyes phyag rgya ma: mchod 'dzin lha mo me tog bdug spos ma: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i tshogs: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lags na: sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog 'di rnams la: mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: lhun grub rdo rje'i gzugs lnga sgra dri ro: reg bya lha mo nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs: zil gnon thod phreng lha la 'bul lags na: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la brtan par bzhugs: hūm̐: nye ba'i sras mchog brgyad kyi rol pa'i yum: sgeg phreng la sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad: sku la gdugs mchog snyan la gser gyi nya: ljags la pad+ma spyan la dpal be'u: gsung la dung dkar thugs la rgyal mtshan mchog: phyag la nor bu zhabs la 'khor lo dang : bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'di dag 'bul lags na: g.yo med rdo rje lta bu'i rten bzhugs mdzod: hūm̐: rgyal srid gser gyi 'khor lo rin po che: 'dod rgu kun 'byung nor bu rin po che: zung 'jug shes rab btsun mo rin po che: thabs mchog ldan pa blon po rin po che: stobs bcu mnga' ba glang po rin po che: myur mgyogs shugs ldan rta mchog rin po che: g.yul las rgyal byed dmag dpon rin po che: rtsa gsum thod phreng lha la 'bul gyis bzhes: rten mchog rnams la mi g.yo rtag bzhugs mdzod: hūm̐: sku yi rten du bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gzugs: gsung gi rten du dam chos glegs bam mdzes: thugs kyi rten du mtshan ldan mchod rten dang : yon tan rten du spyan gzigs dkor chas brgyan: phrin las rten du rnam rgyal khang bzang brtsegs:

don lnga ldan pa'i rten mchog dam pa 'di: bde gshegs kun 'dus zil gnon lha la 'bul: 'bral med brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣ+ṭha ldan: de nas phyag rdzas 'bul ba ni: mchod rten 'khor lo me tog bcas pa dang : hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: stobs dang ma 'dres chos dang ni: dran pa nyer bzhag rnam thar brgyad: ye shes lnga sogs thob par shog: om̐ sarba pra ta na swā hā: glegs bam cod pan rgyan can bcas pa dang : hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: bka' yi 'gyur dang rten gyi chos: 'dul ba glegs bam mdo sde brgyad: chos nyid lnga sogs thob par shog: oṃ a mu gha te swā hā: sku gsum mtshon pa'i brda sngags yi ge thogs: hūm̐: rdzogs chen 'bum phrag brgyad cu dang : lta ba klong yangs rgyud sde dgu: dgongs don lnga sogs thob par shog: om̐ hri hri ga laṃ swā hā: bzed zhal lhung bzed spyi blugs bhan+dha bcas: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: rin chen snod mchog gzhong pa dang : bzed zhal lhung bzed spyi blugs 'dis: mkho ba'i 'dod rgu'i longs spyod shog: om̐ gha ma na ri swā hā:

na bza' rgyan mchog rab byung chas gsum bcas: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: na bza' rgyan mchog dam pa dang : mdzes mchog yongs su bsdus pa 'dis: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ spar+she gha laṃ swā hā: rdo rje dril bu kha ṭ+wāṃ gyis phyag na brgyan: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug dang : phyag mtshan rgya rtags sna tshogs 'dis: bzod pa'i go cha rgyun gnas shog: om̐ purne rat+na swā hā: rin chen gzhong pa zas mchog gis bkang ba 'bul: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: snang srid yongs kyi zas mchog dang : dngos grub bcud mchog 'dod yon 'dis: bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho bar shog: om̐ dharma rā sa swā hā: rol mo bye brag sna tshogs 'bud dkrol bya: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: rnga chen dung dang ting ting shag: gling bu sgra yi rol mo 'dis: shes rab pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ gha ma shang ṣa swā hā: tshems shing rgyan gyis mdzes par thogs: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: tshems shing gtsang ma'i legs sbyar dang : rab byung rgyan mchog dam pa 'dis: tshul khrims pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ sarba pra ta swā hā: zhi ba'i rgyan bcas rin chen thogs la: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: rgyan gdub rin chen mdzes pa'i rigs: rat+na dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'dis: sngags kyi pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ marga rat+na swā hā: sman mchod bdud rtsi zhabs bsil 'bul: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: byung dang 'byung 'gyur mchog gi rdzas: sman dang bdud rtsi dam pa 'dis: ting 'dzin pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ nai ru ghan+dhe swā hā: gdan 'bol shing rta dar zab bcas: hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: dar zab gdan 'bol dam pa dang : rten bzhugs rdzas mchog dam pa 'dis: brtson 'grus pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ swa ta na dhi swā hā: rta glang rin chen ri dwags bcas:

hūm̐: 'jig rten khams kun ma lus na: rta dang glang po rin chen mi: ri dwags chos nyan gar bsgyur 'dis: snying rje'i pha rol phyin par shog: om̐ saṃ bha ra ni swā hā: zhes rdzas rnams phyag 'bul gyis tshul du 'bul zhing bstod pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams zhing khams na: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo mi zad par: rnam snang rol pa sgyu 'phrul snang bas brgyan: zil gnon dkyil 'khor bde 'dus lha la bstod: ces rol mo dal bus 'khrol zhing rten 'brel snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rab gnas bya zhing bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis ngo bo kun tu bzang : mtha' bral gnas yul dag pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rdor sems rigs kyi bdag: thugs rjes phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis snang srid zil gnon rjes: 'gro kun smin cing grol ba'i bkra shis shog: sku lnga'i bkra shis thod phreng sde lnga bcas: don lnga lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis lha lcam ye shes mtshos: snyan brgyud nam mkha' mtha' yas bkra shis shog: mtshan brgyad bkra shis gu ru pad 'byung brgyad: gang 'dul der ston mthar phyin bkra shis shog: drag sngags bkra shis sangs rgyas ye shes rtsal: man ngag lung dang ldan pa'i bkra shis shog: smon lam bkra shis hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal: lung bstan dus las mi 'da' bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis rgyud sde bzhi yi lhas: dngos grub 'dod rgu stsol ba'i bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis dpal mgon phyag bzhi pas: bar chad dgra bgegs brlag pa'i bkra shis shog: bka' srung bkra shis ma gza' rdo rje legs: mkha' ltar mtha' yas kun khyab bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i rtsal: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: nyin yang bkra shis gzi brjid spungs se spung :

mtshan yang bkra shis bkrag mdangs ya la la: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs pa: bkra shis des kyang byin chen myur 'bebs shog: mi 'gyur lhun po? sogs brjod cing me tog 'thor: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol: sa ma ya: rab tu gnas pa'i rten mchog dam pa de: gang gis mi 'jig mkha' ltar thugs rjes khyab: dbang po lkugs pa'i sems can thams cad kyang : sna tshogs phyag rgyas 'gro kun thar lam bskyal: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de bzhin rab gnas la 'bad par bya/ zhes rab gnas nyung bsdus 'di'ang rong smyon pas sbyar ba'o// // pa) ༈ gcod yul snang ba lam 'khyer bzhugs so: lus med mkha' 'gro'i sku la 'dud: gcod yul snang ba lam 'khyer ni: phaṭḥ gcod yul grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho la: gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang bzhi stsol: rkyen ngan lam du lhongs par byin gyis rlobs: lha 'dre'i re dogs chod par byin gyis rlobs: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ de nas dbang sdud zil gnon ni: na moḥ srid rtse dang mnar med yan chod kyi: snang srid gyi lha srin gzhi bdag rnams: ma dbang sdud mkha' 'gros dbang du sdus: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i zil gyis gnon: rlung dmar shwa kha 'tshubs bzhin 'dus: phaṭḥphaṭḥ skyabs sems ni: phaṭḥ rang rig ngo bo mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi: de yi rang gdangs mngon gyur sems bskyed do: zhes dang : phaṭḥ de nas rnam shes spar zhing sha khrag 'gyed pa ni: phaṭḥ rang rig rnam shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar 'phros: mthing 'od gri thod 'dzin pa'i skur snang gyur: bem po sha khrag bdud rtsi'i ngo bo ni: dkar dmar mdangs ldan stong gsum kun khengs gyur: phaṭḥ de nas sha khrag bdud rtsi dkar 'gyed ni: kyeḥ 'dir tshogs dregs pa sha za dang : 'byung po bgegs rigs lan chags rnams: lus sha khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: khyed 'dir tshogs ngoms shing tshims nas kyang : rkyen sha 'khon bu lon 'khor ba dang :

bka' snang srid lha 'dre dgyes gyur cig: phaṭḥ de nas rim par sha khrag dmar 'gyed ni: hoḥ sha khrag snang srid khyon bkang ba'i: dmar 'gyed sha khrag lams se lam: drag mos gnyan 'bod si li li: snang srid dmag tshogs spungs se spung : gcan gzan sha thed rol pa bzhin: skad cig myur rol dgyes par tshim: phaṭḥ de nas lus sha khrag gi lhag ma 'gyed pa ni: ma lhag sdud ging chen pho mo rnams: sku keng rus gar stabs khro lo lo: phyag bhan+dhar lhag sdud khyugs se khyug: lus sha khrag lhag ma myur du khyer: phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas snang srid lha 'dre chos skur byin gyis brlab pa ni: maḥ snang srid chos nyid rol pa las: gzugs lha 'dre rang sems cho 'phrul 'di: rkyen re dogs chod par byin gyis rlobs: bdud 'khrul gzugs pho gdon mo gdon rnams: zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sa thob nas: don dmigs med chos sku'i ngang la thim: phaṭḥ rnam par shes pa snying gar chos 'byung gi dbus su bstim pa ni: bdag rnam shes mkha' 'gro rang sar babs: snying chos 'byung snang stong mkha' 'gror bsgom: dbang rim bskur ye shes lngar gyur nas: mchog thun mong dngos grub thob par shog: ces rnam shes snying gar phab cing byin rlabs dbang bzhi len: dmigs rim rgyud ltar gsal nas chos nyid kun gzhi'i ngang la bzang ngan rkyen rnams grogs su shes shing rtog med du nyal: e maḥ gcod yul yang zab las: 'di phyi'i tshogs rdzogs bar chad zhi: lha 'dre dbang 'dus bran bzhin 'byung : lus med mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig rgya: rgya rgya: sngags 'chang karma hūm̐ nag gis gser gling nas gdan drangs shing rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i 'od gsal rdo rje'i phug tu shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // pha) ༈ bla ma snang srid zil gnon gyi: lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor las: rtsa rlung chos nyid rang byung gi las gzhung pho nya'i brgyud phreng bzhugs so:

zung 'jug lam bzhi rang grol pho nya mos: dbang bsgyur dbang mdzad ye shes mtsho rgyal ngas: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug 'dod chags rang grol du: myur lam zab khrid mkha' 'gro'i snying thig bstan: ye shes mchog khyod ma yengs rtse gcig tu: kho mo'i brda ltar gsang ba'i yi ge 'di: mi brjed gzungs thob rin chen gsang ba'i gnas: phun tshogs dgos 'byung bswe sgrom smug po'i nang : rgya rim bdun gyis rgyas thob smon lam 'grub: gter srung bdud mo seng gdong sman mo bzhi: gter bdag snying thig lha mo rnam lngar bcol: las can chos bdag bu la smon lam thob: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ma 'ongs yang mtha' snyigs ma lnga yi dus: chos pa rnams kyang chos gzugs ri mo tsam: mdo sngags bstan pa spel dang sbyang ba nyung : tshul chos dge slong btsun chung bshang sgor 'khrig: ston pa'i 'dul khrims dang 'gal byang sems yal: so thar nyan thos khas blangs dam tshig bral: rang rgyud ma dul kha chos ri mo bshad: las rgyud ma sbyangs tshig 'chal bzang rlom bsgom: sems rgyud ma sbyangs nyon mongs mig rten tsam: bka' thub yin smra dgong lto log par bsags: grwa tshang sgrigs gtor smyo chang lkog tu 'thung : bud med mchor mthong sdom gsum g.yang du g.yug: chags zhen srid pas ngan khag skye bor 'phrod: dam sdom btsun chung g.yem pa nyid kyis brlag: ser snas bsog 'dzin phal pa bas kyang sdug: dam tshig gsum ldan chos dang grub mtha' bshad: chags sdang ru nga phrag dog sdug sems sdang : mi yong khas len mi 'grub blo rgya che: stong skad mthon pos rang rgyud dbyings la bskur: ngos lkog mi thub chos brgyad gtso bor 'don: gling dang grong sgo nyul zhing rnam shes dag: bar do'i dri za yid lus lta bur 'khyams: zas su dkor nag dug chu longs spyod 'thung : sbyin pa shi gson snying rje'i bag yal nas: tshe 'dir dmus long phyi ma ngan 'gror skye:

dam med dred po dge slong tshul 'chos mkhan: ston pa'i rkang 'dren dus ngan rtags dang mtshungs: de phyir dus ngan sa bon rang byas las: snyigs ma lnga bdor dge slong de ltar 'byung : de yang dam chos nub pa'i snga ltas yin: de la soms nas rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug bur: bslab gsum don ldan 'dul lung bslad med bzhin: srung ba'i 'bras bu nam yang chud mi za: legs par gdams so phyi rabs dge slong rnams: kho mo nga nyid 'dul khrims srung sdom bral: ci snang chos nyid lam 'khyer sdom gsum ldan: rkyen ngan ngo bo thugs phrad dam tshig gtsang : de bzhin mdzod dang mdo sngags bstan pa dar: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sdom chos bzhin: zab don snyan brgyud lam 'khyer bu slob rnams: stong lta kha pho ma che rang rgyud sbyongs: rlung sems snang tshod ma mtho nyams len 'bungs: rtsa rlung 'chal bar ma stong cig dril sgrubs: rnam rtog spang blang ma mang sor bzhag klod: dgra gnyen grogs su shes pa'i ro snyom gyis: 'khor 'das bla mar rtogs la dag snang sbyongs: mched grogs yi dam 'dzin la gdung sems skyed: mthun grogs dam tshig gtsang dgos mkha' 'gro sgoms: phyogs med gnas yin gzhi bdag chos skyong sgoms: dben gnas dgon yin yid spro btsan sa zungs: mnga' thang dgra yin gcig pur rang tshod zungs: g.yeng ba bdud yin 'du 'dzi'i sred pa chod: nor rdzas gyod yin 'khor ba'i gtod phur skyur: ngo srung bdud yin phyi sa sna thag chod: mthun 'gyur byur yin ca co'i tshig ma mang : dam med chos mched mu stegs blo ma ston: de phyir gsang sngags nyams len ma byung na: bsgom med kha mkhas rang bslu'i mgo skor yin: dam med tshig 'chal dmyal ba'i bslu khrid yin: ma mthong chos smra long ba lag sbrel yin: rtsa rlung gnad med 'khrul 'khor smyo 'khrab yin: gsang khrid gnad med sdom shor byi phrug slog: mkha' 'gro'i brda med chags lam gol ba yin:

rtsa rlung ma 'byongs gsang sngags rkang 'dren yin: mtshan ldan mi shes bdud mos bslu brid yin: brda bzhi mi shes gsang rgya ral ba yin: dam tshig ma gtsang dam med ngan song gzhi: rnam rtog ma lhongs ro snyom sdug gu yin: spros pa ma chod mtshan bcas 'dus byas yin: de ltar gsang sngags gnad gsum ma bral 'tshal: bskyed rim sprul sku snang stong zung 'jug sgoms: rdzogs rim chos sku ka dag don khrid sbyongs: gnyis med longs sku sgyu ma rmi lam sbyongs: nyams len 'chug med 'od gsal rdo rje'i lam: zab lam gnad bdun rig ma bde stong lam: chags pa rgyas 'debs ma bsgoms sangs rgyas bsgrub: dga' bzhi ngo sprod 'od gsal lhag gis 'char: gzungs ma mtshan ldan ma spangs 'ja' lus grogs: rlung sbyor 'dren khug bde chen gtum mo'i lam: yas babs mas 'dren rtsa rlung ljon shing bskyed: 'bebs ldog 'dren dgram pho nyas lam sna zin: dam tshig gnad gtsang mchog thun myur du 'grub: kho mo nga nyid 'byung bar mnga' dbang bsgyur: zab gsang brda nyid pad 'byung thugs rje'i bdag: nyams myong la sbyangs sngon gyi las sad pas: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rig sngags bsgrub: e ma nyon dang rjes 'brangs ye shes grogs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' gsang sngags bstan pa nub: chos byed rnams ni dgong mo'i dmar thag tsam: gsang sngags nyams len smyug ma'i sdong po tsam: brgyud 'dzin bu rnams tho rangs skar ma tsam: dam chos long med sprin bar nyi ma tsam: bar chad bdud mang rlung nang sgron me bzhin: zab lam gnad med rdzing bu gyen bzlog tsam: dbang med lung med lung stong ku co bzhin: dam tshig snod med sdong snod chu zin bzhin: de rnams gsang sngags bstan pa nyams rtags te: lung rgya yod kyang dbang lung ma rdzogs mang : de phyir snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag 'di: ma 'ongs smon lam ldan pa'i bu la bzhag: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbas nas kyang :

las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi rim pa ni: e ma bdag 'dra mtsho rgyal ngas: ma 'ongs yang snyigs 'dul dka'i don: yang zab thugs bcud zhun thig las: tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag 'chang bstan: ye shes mchog khyod legs nyon dang : dus mthar rgya ral yang snyigs la: dam chos gsang sngags nyams shing gud: tshe la long med skye 'chis sdang : sgrub pa'i spyod 'chol dam tshig yal: man ngag gnad med dbang po 'grib: gdams pa sna log ngan 'gror skye: de phyir khungs btsun gnad zab phyir: srog sgrub mkha' 'gro'i gdams ngag bstan: snying du chongs la yi ger thob: zab shog gsang ba'i logs su bris: zab gnad gsang ba'i snying thig rgya: phyi nang bskyed rim rlung sgrub ni: dben ri byin chags phun tshogs zhing : yid 'phrog rnam g.yeng med pa'i gnas: bag sgrib 'ching ba'i rkyen bsal ba'i: mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad bsags: khrus byas rgyan gos legs bsgyur nas: 'bebs gdan zhing dkyus tshad ldan khar: rnam snang skyil krung lus gnad bca': gsal btab rlung ro lan dgu bsal: rlung bzung 'khrul 'khor 'bebs shing brdeb: rjes su g.yang gzhi ltar sprug cing : phyag 'tshal bsngo smon sbyang bya zhing : skye med ngang la ci gnas bzhag: thun drug thun brgyad gang rung la: khams gso gnyid dang longs spyod kyi: 'tsho ba bsten pa ma gtogs pa: nam yang bar ma chod du sbyang : bum can brgya dang brgyad kyi tshad: sbyor ba bzhi ldan gnad du bsnun: 'bar 'dzags dmigs pas a haṃ bskul: dga' bzhi tshad phebs gnad 'byong na: mtshan ldan mu ṭa pho nya'i lam: rgyas 'debs rgyud sbyangs mngon sangs rgyas: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:

dang po ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ka dag rdor 'chang chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: longs sku'i rtsal snang ston pa rdo rje sems: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku 'chi med rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa gsum gar dbang mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nus rtsal brtul zhugs sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: las 'phro gter 'byin karma las 'brel gling : gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sprul sku rig 'dzin rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rten 'brel mnga' bsgyur zab rgya'i gter srung la: gsol ba 'debs so rtsa rlung bde drod skyed: gtum mo ye shes me dpung sbar du gsol: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab: gnyis pa rlung ro bsal rjes su'ang :

hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las ye shes me yi dal: gru gsum tsha ngar ldan pa'i ram̐ dbus su: ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: dkar dmar mdangs ldan 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: zhal gcig spyan gsum gcer mor lang tsho ldan: skra grol cod pan spyi bor bun bun bskyod: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas ka pā la: rus rgyan rat+na dag gi rgyan 'phyangs mdzes: nu ma bha ga rgyas zhing bde drod 'bar: mnyen lcug gar ldan 'jo sgeg pad gdan 'gying : phyi nang zang thal ma bcos dbu ma ni: 'khor lo lnga ldan chos nyid dbyings dang mnyam: lte 'og aḥshad spyi bor haṃ gyis mtshan: lugs 'byung me 'bar spyi bor haṃ yig zhu: lugs ldog kun das 'khor lo ltem gyis gang : dga' bzhi bde gsal mi rtog chos skur bsgom: rlung bzung dgang gzhil raṃ sbar 'bung cing sbyang : de nas 'khor lo rnam pa lnga ni: mgo bo dgye sgu mjing pa shad: lag pa brkyang bskum bzhag sha brdab: ro stod drag bskor g.yas g.yon bskor: sked pa g.yas g.yon 'khor lo bskor: rkang pa phra shad brkyang bskum bya: drag 'bebs ha sprugs lhab lheb bya: de nas 'byung bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor ni: mda' 'gengs lag bsnol rkang bsnol 'bebs: bzhi 'phra li khri sgril log bya: 'bebs shing rtsal sprug drag po bya: ka dag ngang la lhan ne bzhag: phyi nang snang stong dbyer med de: 'od dpung bsgom zhing sbyangs gyur na: 'ja' lus 'grub par the tshom med: mkha' 'gro'i snying thig-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngags 'chang gar dbang rdo rje hūm̐ gis gser gling nas gdan drangs te rga rgyal rdo rje'i brag phug tu shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // ba) ༈ bla ma snang srid zil gnon gyi lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor las: sde lnga'i sbyor thabs bzhugs so: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i 'khrul 'khor ni: rdo rje mkha' 'gros gri thod 'khrab: rin chen mkha' 'gros phyed skyil 'khrab:

pad+ma mkha' 'gros gling bzhi bsgrad: las kyi mkha' 'gros gdam zhing 'khrab: de rjes thog 'bebs drag tu bya: lnga pa phyed skyil sbyor thabs gdams: sprug cing drangs la khyab par bkram: dug lnga lam 'khyer 'khrul 'khor te: chags pa'i rgyas 'debs mkha' spyod bgrod: ma bsgoms thabs kyis sa lam sgrol: mkha' 'gro snying thig-i atsha rgya: zab gnad gtum mo rtsa rlung don: gsang khrid dug lnga lam 'khyer ni: rang nyid rlung 'byongs las rung pa: bde stong btsun mo pang du 'khyud: rlung sbyor 'dren khug gnad du phyin: dmigs pa yul gyi sa mtshams zin: 'khrul 'khor gnad bsnun sbyor thabs mkhas: bag chags lam 'byongs 'od gsal rtogs: pho nya g.yul 'gyed spyod lam mkhas: gsang khrid lam 'byongs rjes 'jug rnams: lam 'chug med pho nya spyod pa'i yul: ma jo mos rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams: lam 'chug med pho nya gsang sngags 'di'i: rjes sus snyeg snying la de ltar zungs: e maḥ yang gsang zab pa'i shog dril 'di: las bdag mkha' 'gro bzhi la bcol: gter srung drag mo seṅge'i gdong : thub par srungs shig a thaṃ rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: gsang sngags 'chang ba karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas yar tshes bco lnga la gdan drangs shing jo bo rga rgyal 'od gsal rdo rje'i phug par shog ser nas phab pa'o// // ma) bla ma snang srid zil gnon las: lus med gsang khrid 'dzin mkhas ril ba mdor bsdus bzhugs: de nas gsang khrid sbyor drug ni: skyil krung lus gnad gsang yum 'khyud: 'bebs ldog 'dren cing dgram par bya: gnyis pa gzhog phab gsang yum gyi: rkang pa phrag blang bsnol thabs spyod: gsum pa zur phab sbyor thabs spyod: bzhi pa rus sbal steng du bzhag: lnga pa mgo gcu rkang steng bsnol: drug pa lang bkram ha sprugs sbyor: zhes pa sbyor ba drug ldan no: 'dren pa'i thabs lam 'dren pa ni:

pus btsugs thams cad rlung bus rjes: dbu ma ka 'dzugs spyi bor gtad: pus mo lag par sbyar zhing dgram: rkang bzung rkang phyes chu bur gyen: sbrul tshang ri rab gling bzhi bsdom: seṅge rnam rol rtsal sprugs bya: g.yas 'then g.yon 'then rkang lag bcun: gyen log tshul gyis rlung bcud bcun: spyi bor bdun bdun 'bras bur gtad: res mos 'dren bkram dbab ldog bya: de dag 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor rdzogs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // tsa) ༈ srid pa mo khrid 'khrul 'khor 'dren: dpa' bo thabs ldan dag btsal zhing : 'dren zhing bkram pa rnam pa gsum: pho stod pho smad 'phongs zhing srub: gtun brdung drag tu 'bebs par bya: gru 'bebs ci mang 'deg 'jog bya: g.yas g.yon rkang mgo bzung byas nas: drag 'then drag tu 'bebs par bya: rkang mgo bzung zhing 'big 'bebs bya: pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon bsgrad cing 'bebs: ha sprugs rdo rjes drag sprug bya: zhes pa mo khrid skye rgyud nas: rtsa bcad sbyong ba'i 'khrul 'khor rdzogs: rmad du 'dren pa 'dir gab bo: pad+ma dung 'bud zhal las shes: gzhan yang ma 'ongs phan blo yis: bshal sbyong rlung rim rnam pa'o: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: dam rgya: gu h+ya: dha thim: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // tsha) ༈ bdud 'dul drag po kī la ya'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig rtsal kud bzhugs so/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes rang gsal dkyil 'khor lhun grub dbus/ /dang po'i mgon po bde chen rang gsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rlung sems 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dag pa rab 'byams klong gi gzhal yas nas/ /ma 'gag rang byung rdo rje mtha' yas la/

/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang grol mtha' bral 'od kyi zhing khams nas/ /o rgyan gu ru snang srid zil gnon la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'chi med rig 'dzin thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang grol stong gsal 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mkha' dbyings dbang phyug ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rtsa rlung dga' bzhi 'phrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rngam brjid 'jigs rung dbang drag dkyil 'khor du/ /bdud 'dul khro bo drag po kī la yar/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bdud bzhi tshar gcod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /u tsa me dpung rab 'bar gnas mchog tu/ /drag mo myur mgyogs phag mo bdud 'dul la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ma bu bzhin du lung bstan dngos grub stsol/ /ye shes 'khor lo lnga yi pho brang du/ /thod phreng srog skyob go cha rigs lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mu stegs bdud dpung tshar gcod dngos grub stsol/ /gdug pa tshar gcod bka' bzhin dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad+ma'i bka' skyong yang gsang sde tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'bral med lus grib bzhin du 'grogs par mdzod/ /snang stong 'dzin pa rang grol pho brang du/ /las 'phro'i smon lam hūm̐ nag drag rtsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /zab chos snying thig phyogs med rgyas par mdzod/ /phyogs med 'gro don gtad med zhing khams su/ /rtsa rlung dbang sdud pra bha'i yang mtha' la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bdag gzhan 'gro don 'bad med lhun 'grub shog /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/

/dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rlung sems rten 'brel 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang stong ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs/ /thabs shes zung 'brel las su rung bar shog / om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra pad+ma sarba dz+wa la hūm̐: zhes drag po las gzhung la mthun pa'i gsol 'debs hūm̐ kriṣ+ṇa artsig gis bris pa'o// // dza) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: gsol 'debs rgyas pa bdud dpung g.yul 'joms dmod pa nag po bzhugs so: e ma hoḥ chos dbyings mtha' bral yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: snang stong dbyer med kun bzang yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: 'og min bde chen klong yangs dkyil 'khor nas: rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: rtsal rdzogs ye shes lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas: sku lnga rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: snang srid dbyings su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'khor 'das yongs grol dga' rab rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: klong yangs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor nas: thogs med shugs 'chang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: 'od gsal mi shigs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen rol pa shrī singha la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: sku gsum zhing khams bye ba phrag brgya nas: snang srid zil gnon rtsa gsum 'dus pa rtsal:

gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: bde chen ye shes dbyings kyi gur khang nas: gdeng mchog mngon spyod bka' bab mtsho rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: mthu stobs drag sngags 'bar ba'i e dbyings nas: dmod las mthar phyin shākya pra bha la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: snang srid las la 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas: mthu stobs dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: mu stegs bdud 'gong mthar byed klong yangs nas: bdud 'dul dbang phyug hūm̐ nag drag rtsal la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: mngon spyod rang dbang bsgyur ba'i pho brang nas/ /grub dbang rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: phrin las gang 'dul der ston pho brang nas/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la/ gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: thugs rje'i mkha' la rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: drag rtsal che mchog khro bo 'dus pa la: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: rang lus phung khams dag pa'i pho brang nas: gdug pa kun 'joms dbang drag kī la yar: gsol ba 'debs so bden tshig 'grub pa dang : dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog par shog: dam tshig mi shigs gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor nas: bka' srung dam can dregs pa sde brgyad la: gsol ba 'debs so thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: snod bcud 'byung ba 'khrugs pa sor chud cing :

las rlung ye shes dbyings su thim pa yi: phung khams snang srid rgyal pa'i skur grol nas: rig sngags dmod pa'i bden tshig 'grub pa dang : mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal chen yongs rdzogs te: ma rungs dam sri 'byung po'i tsha ngar bcom: dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs bzlog par shog: de ltar dag snang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la: gdung shugs drag pos gsol btab bskul ba'i mthus: kun kyang thugs rje ye shes klong nyid las: rig sngags dmod pa las kyi skur bzhengs shig: snyigs mtha'i dus dang bskal bar mi bzad pa: mthu stobs 'od gsal chen po'i klong du zlog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid thams cad rigs lnga'i lha: 'byung ba thams cad dmod pa'i mtshon: sgra skad thams cad drag sngags ldir: 'od gsal thugs rje'i rang bzhin la: nga bdag gzung 'dzin dbyings su yal: dgra gdon bag chags rang sar grol: 'khor 'das chos kun rdzogs pa che: khyab brdal chen po a la la: snang stong ngang nas hūm̐ sgra sgrog: snod bcud thugs rje'i rang bzhin du: dmod pas sbyangs shing 'byung khrus kyis: gso bskyed nus sbar stobs bskyed nas: sku gsum rol pa chen por bzla: rmad byung phrin las thugs rje bskyed: rab 'byams rten 'brel sgyu 'phrul gar: thogs med gang 'dul cir snang bsgyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes bla ma drag po kī la ya'i gsol 'debs rgyas pa bdud dpung g.yul 'joms dmod pa nag po las nyung bsdus khol du phyung ba'o// //

wa) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: las byang rdo rje thog rgod 'bring po bzhugs lags so: ma hā gu ru'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku sgyu ma'i rnam rol gar mkhan gyi: ma 'gag rang byung che mchog drag po rtsal: gang 'dul dregs pa'i yang gsang he ru kaḥ yi dam che mchog pad+ma drag por 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs sems can don slad du: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan: phyi rabs sems can don slad du: bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : shākya pra bha khyod la gdams: ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar dus: mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul: sa steng mi dge'i dmag gis khengs: dam nyams khrims ral lung pa khengs: gtsug lag chos 'khor 'jig pa'-i dus: pra bha khyod kyi skyes mtha' mchog: drag sgrub 'di dang 'phrad par shog: mtha' dmag dpung bzlog tsa tri rgya: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin: me rgya rlung rgya gnyis kyis thob: gsang rgya spu gri me 'bar 'di: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: dang po sngon 'gro'i las rim la: sgrub pa las sbyor dbang la sogs: dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas tshang bar bsags: sman raka gtor ma phyi nang gsang : mchod pa la sogs ci 'byor bsham: gnyis pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na moḥ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun thod phreng rtsal: bdag blo rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'bral med rjes 'dzin dbang bzhi mchog bskur nas: 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal bral gyur cig: lan gsum: yan lag bcu pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dpal gyi rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ma lus 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren no: chags bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: chos dbyings ro gcig ngang la phyag 'tshal lo: gnyis med 'khrul snang rang grol mchod pa 'bul:

re dogs sdug bsngal skye med klong du bshags: gdod ma'i chos sku'i byin rlabs char ltar phob: 'od gsal chos kyi sku la rjes yi rang : 'khor 'das gzung 'dzin bral bar chos 'khor bskor: dmigs med khyab brdal dge ba yongs su bsngo: kun kyang kun bzang klong du grol bar shog: gsum pa dkar gtor legs par grub nas: bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis 'dod rgur brlab: thod phreng rtsal gyi ting 'dzin gyis: bar chod bgegs bkug bka' bsgo ba: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog thod phreng rtsal: mthing nag rngam brjid stobs ldan sku: chos nyid skye med tshwa tshwa 'phros: dmod pa'i rig sngags mtshon char 'byin: yang gsang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: gnyis 'dzin bar chad log lta bgegs: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dpag tshad rgyang grags ma gnas par: phyi rol lcags ri'i pha mthar dengs: 'joms byed chen po'i las byos shig: gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ yungs thun tsha ngar drag pos bskrad: bzhi pa re dogs mtshams gcod ni: 'joms byed dbyings kyi srung 'khor bsgom: hūm̐: chos sku yang gsang dkyil 'khor du: bdag gzhan gnyis 'dzin ru tra'i rgyu: ma rig log lta las kyi bdud: nyon mongs 'khor ba mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na dz+wa la tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: lnga pa phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gis bsregs gtor bkrus: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung rlung me thod sgyed steng : a dkar las byung bhan+dha'i snod: dum gcig mtshan ldan rgya che'i nang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'bru zhu ba las: sha lnga ye shes bdud rtsi lnga: sman gtor rak+ta dbang po lnga: sbyangs spel bdud rtsi'i 'phro 'du rnams: sku lnga lhun grub bdud rtsir bsgyur: rang byung lha mo dpag med 'phros: srid zhi'i byin rlabs bcud bsdus nas: ar+ghaṃ la sogs phyi mchod dang : sman raka gtor mchod dgyes pa'i phud:

gzugs sgra la sogs bskang ba'i rdzas: dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa kun: 'dod rgu lhun grub 'byung ba spel: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: de ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa la: dang po dbyings kyi ting 'dzin las: hūm̐: ye nas stong zhing spros dang bral: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rnam rol las: rtog med yi ge rang byung nyid: gsal stong blo 'das ngang la gnas: om̐ dharma dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang sgo bskyed pa ni: gnyis pa dbyings kyi rang mdangs las: longs sku'i rtsal chen thugs rje'i 'od: gang 'dul sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar: log 'dren 'dul phyir drag po'i dal: snod bcud dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsgrub: 'byung rim dur khrod gzhal yas gsal: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig 'byung rim ni: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ sa bon las: rlung me chu sa dbang chen gzhi rim brdal: khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i dug rlangs mtshon cha'i dbus: srin po pho mo'i thod pa skam rlon brtsegs: gru gsum rtsibs brgyad gshin rje'i pho brang dbus: tshangs pa lha chen pho mo'i ka ba la: ka gdan rus sbal sa bdag 'khun pa 'debs: ka zhu g.yu 'brug ngar skad sa gzhi g.yo: gza' klu gdung ma dug sbrul dral lcam gtibs: srin po'i g.yang gzhi thigs tshags thog steng khyab: rdo rje'i gdung ma gshin rje'i mdzer gyis bsdams: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad spu gri'i drwa ba'i sgo: zhing gi rgyal mtshan tsit+ta nor bu'i tog: ma mo'i ba gam mi lpags sham bu dkar: baṃ ro pho mo'i keng rus rgyal mtshan phyar: chos 'khor rta babs mgo phraing drwa bas brgyan:
