khyung chen sde lnga ri dwags rgyan gyi tshul: me dpung dgu bsgril phyogs bzhir 'od zer 'khrigs: khro chu khol ma'i rang bzhin gzhal yas khang : lcags mkhar rgyan rdzogs pho brang phyi rol du: dur khrod me ri rig 'dzin drang srong dang : bdun pa kī la sgra sgrogs gcan gzan ngar: ro langs 'byung po sha za ma lus tshang : ye nas chos dbyings skye med ngang nyid las: phyi nang zang thal ma bcos drag po'i zhing : pho brang gzhal yas chos dbyings lhun grub bsgom: bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: ru tra kro ti baṃ: hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: gsum pa drag po'i lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod dkyil 'khor rang shar dbus: ye shes chos 'byung mthing nag me dpung klong : bdud bzhi dam sri rgyal bsen srin po'i gdan: nyi zla pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan gyi steng : gnam lcags rdo rje rab 'bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: de nyid gnas 'gyur drag po kī la ya: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsang bdag khros pa'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum sdang mig spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra smin ma dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam dbu rgyan rin chen snyan cha 'khrol: rta zhal mthing nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs: g.yon pas bdud dmag sgrol 'debs phur bu bsgril: rdo rje spu gri'i sgro gshog bar snang khengs: seng glang zhing lpags khrag zhag thig les brgyan: rdo rje go khrab rus rgyan stag sham gsol: thod rlon sbrul chun dar nag cod pan 'phur: sku lus spyan stong de nang sangs rgyas stong : sku smad chu srin rngam zhal khro phur te: dam nyams byad ma'i snying khar brjid par bsgom: de yi pang du phag mo bdud 'dul ma: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis yab la 'khyud:

gri gug thod khrag zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: dbu skra kham nag thod skam lnga yis brgyan: spyi gtsug phag zhal mu stegs dmag tshogs 'dul: rin chen rus rgyan dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: sku lus spyan stong mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: gar gyi nyams ldan gzi brjid me dpung 'bar: bde stong gnyis med yab la 'khril bar bsgom: de yi spyi gtsug pad gdan ge sar dbus: rigs bdag gu ru snang srid zil gnon sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyal po rol stabs tshul: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum rgyas pa'i nyams: za ber mthing nag chos gos pa tra ris: rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ gsang yum tshul: pad zhwa sgro dar me long dar snas brgyan: snyan cha mgul chun ye shes khro chas rdzogs: gzi brjid 'od 'bar rngam brjid stobs ldan bsgom: rigs bzhir go cha phyi nang gnas su gsal: phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: shar phyogs rtsibs steng lha chen tshangs pa dkar: ral gri mdung dar 'dzin cing g.yag dkar zhon: lho phyogs rtsibs steng gshin rje ya ma nag: thod dbyug zhags pa 'dzin cing ma he zhon: nub phyogs rtsibs steng ma mo srid rgyal dkar: mda' dar me long 'dzin cing g.yu 'brug zhon: byang phyogs rtsibs steng bdud po skra dkar nag: ru mtshon bdud zhags 'dzin cing rta nag zhon: shar lho'i rtsibs steng rgyal chen dpe har dkar: 'khar bsil lhung bzed 'dzin cing seṅger zhon: lho nub rtsibs steng skyes bu btsan rje dmar: mda' gzhu ru dar 'dzin cing rta dmar zhon: nub byang rtsibs steng gnod sbyin yak+sha smug: dgra satwa zhags pa 'dzin cing phung stag chibs: byang shar rtsibs steng gnod sbyin 'chi bdag nag: nad rkyal bdud zhags thogs shing chu srin zhon: sde brgyad dmag tshogs khrag 'thung rngam pa'i tshul: gar dgu dpa' stobs hūm̐ dang phaṭ sgra sgrog: khro tshogs dkyil 'khor ma lus yongs rdzogs bsgom:

de ltar gsal ba gsum las 'od 'phros pas: rnga yab dag zhing pho brang pad+ma 'od: rang bzhin dbyings nas rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: dam can bka' sdod dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas: thog ser 'brug stong glog zhags 'khyugs pa bzhin: skad cig bsgom pa ji bzhin spyan drangs gyur: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni: spos dang rol mo'i rngam stabs kyi nga ros: hūm̐: gling mchog rnga yab pad+ma 'od: laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i yul: o rgyan rang byung zhing mchog nas: rje btsun thod phreng gshegs su gsol: dbang drag gsang chen dur khrod nas: gu ru kī la gshegs su gsol: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bar mtshams gnas mchog nas: rigs bzhi khro bcu gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rba klong nas: lha srin sde brgyad gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir phrin las sgrubs: rgyal bsen dam sri mtha' dmag dang : ru tra nag po mgo can sogs: mu stegs dmag tshogs bzlog pa'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra kī li kī la ya: badz+ra bha ra hi: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa yak+sha kā la badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes lnga rdzogs dkyil 'khor dbus: log lta ru tra'i gdan steng du: drag po bdud 'dul lha tshogs rnams: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhan: drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: ma 'gag rang rtsal drag po'i lha: rig sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha can: mos gus yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bdun pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: ar+ghaṃ la sogs phyi mchod 'bul: rang byung nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul:

rgyud drug bsgral ba'i rak+ta 'bul: bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta sarba pū dza la khā hi: brgyad pa bstod pa bdud dpung tshar gcod ni: hūm̐: drag po chos dbyings me dpung klong dkyil na: mi bzad stobs ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ 'jigs rung zil gnon chos sku'i ngang nyid las: drag tu khros pa'i bdud 'dul dpa' bo ni: sku mdog mthing nag rngam pas bstan dgra sgrol: rta skad drag pos dregs pa dbang du sdud: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril nyams pa'i snying khrag 'thung : spyan gsum dmar zlum lha srin sngangs shing brgyal: dbu skra bsigs pas stong gsum shig shig 'gul: thod skam lnga nas rig 'dzin dmag dpung 'gyed: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rjes mtha' dmag zlog: g.yon pa'i snang srid phur pas bstan dgra sgrol: rdo rje'i 'dab gshog ri rab thal bar rlog: sku lus spyan mig bdud 'dul khro tshogs 'gyed: dur khrod chas brgyad sde brgyad dbang du sdud: sku smad phur pas bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: rngam brjid stobs ldan me dpung klong na 'gyings: bdud 'dul khro bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs dam dbyings nas bskul lo sa ma ya: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog phag mo bdud 'dul ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod yab la 'khyud: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril me dpung tshwa tshwa 'phro: spyan gsum sdang mig pha rol log lta 'joms: dur khrod chas brgyad sprul pa'i khro tshogs sdud: phag mo'i ngur sgras bgegs dpung thal bar rlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgras 'brug sgra sgrog: gar dgu'i nyams ldan rnal 'byor tshe srog sring : sku lus spyan mig mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs sdud: cha lugs sna tshogs du ma'i cho 'phrul gyis: ma lus bdud dpung 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: spyi gtsug bde chen 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong :

'dab stong ge sar nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: ma bcos lhun grub gu ru pad+ma'i sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis snang srid zil gnon tshul: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: zhal 'dzum spyan gsum mkha' dbyings phyogs bcur gzigs: pad zhwa za ber chos gos dmar po la: lhun grub bde stong gser gyi pa tra ris: rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ gsang yum tshul: rin chen rus rgyan chos nyid g.yer kha'i sgra: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum rgyal po rol stabs kyis: mu stegs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs zil gyis gnon: he ru ka pa'i rang bzhin ting 'dzin la: skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i sku la rdzogs: sku lnga mtshan brgyad bla ma rje la bstod: hūm̐: rigs bzhi kī la'i gnas lngar go cha'i lha: 'jam dpal rta phyag khro mo rigs lnga dang : yak+sha kā la phyi 'khor sde brgyad sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: dzapa bskul dang gzhan yang*/ bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi tshe: sgrub pa rtsa sngags kyi gzhi tshugs: go cha zhi ba: rigs bzhi rgyas pa: khro bcu'i dbang : las sngags drag sgrub: saugs bsnyen pa gud phyung ltar bya/ dgu pa kun 'dus rtsa sngags me dpung 'khor lo ni:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti kā li badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya mañdzu shrī h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ḍāk+k-i ha ri ni sa yak+sha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ gzhan yang*/ sde brgyad byad gzhug: sde gsum mtha' sdud: sogs rim pa ltar le lo rnam g.yeng gi tshig gis bar ma chod par rtags rdzogs su bklag: 'di nyid kyi sngon du snang srid zil gnon gyi bsnyen sgrub them pa gal che'o: 'di yi chos skor las byang nges don gyi: las mtha' dug gi par bu nag po dang : spyi chings yang gsang ma bu bco lnga dang : dgos pa'i gnad sa bstan pa la sogs pa: zab pa'i yang gsang drag po'i chos bzhi'i skor: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyis brag nag bdud rdzong nas khrom gter du gdan drangs shing dus mtha'i dmag dpung bzlog pa'i lung bstan byung bas shog ser zhing mdzub gang dkyus sor bzhi pa nas dus tshod drag po dang bstun dgos yod: shog ser rnams kyang gter du sbas: zha) bdud rtsi lag mchod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur/ khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ snang srid zil gnon rtsa gsum 'dus pa rtsal/ /thod phreng rigs lnga sprul pa mtshan brgyad la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ rgyal yum mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/

/thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ gsang rgyud brda bsgyur chos bdag lung zin sogs/ /mdo sngags brgyud 'dzin skyes chen thams cad la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ /bdud 'dul kī la rdo rje phag mo dang*/ /go cha lha lnga kī la sras bzhi la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams 'khor lo'i ngang*/ khro bcu dregs pa sde brgyad bka' sdod la/ /rnam dag dam rdzas bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ 'bru gsum sa bon bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid/ /gnas gsum thim pas rtsa rlung ye shes bskyed/ /sku gsum mngon gyur 'pho med rdo rje'i srog /bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /kā ya sid+dhi om̐/ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ ma hā mu tra sarba sid+dhi ho/ drin gyis 'khor med sngags 'chang nor bu'i mtshan/ /'di ltar dgos zhes nan du bskul ba'i mthus/ /phyogs med rgyal khams pha yul byed mkhan po/ /rong smyon o rgyan rig 'dzin rtsal gyis sbyar// // za) ༈ kī la ya'i sngags byang gud du sbas pa gab pa mngon du phyung ba ni/ thog mar dzap bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha: du mar snang yang ngang du gcig: dkyil 'khor spro bsdu bcos mi bya: rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang : rang dang lhan cig skyes pa ste: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur/ /snang srid thams cad rigs lnga'i lha: 'byung ba thams cad dmod pa'i mtshon: sgra skad thams cad drag sngags ldir: 'od gsal thugs rje'i rang bzhin la:

nga bdag gzung 'dzin dbyings su yal: dgra gdon bag chags rang sar grol: 'khor 'das chos kun rdzogs pa che: khyab brdal chen po a la la: bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni: rang nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la phyag rdor mthing nag gis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag las me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba la sngags phreng mthing nag 'od zer dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar gyur/ de la gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam pas sngags phreng grangs med pa 'phros pas lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa bsregs/ sngags kyi rang sgra dang bcas pa ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ 'od zer de phog pa'i snang srid snod bcud thams cad me ri dang khro bo mtshon cha'i rang bzhin du gyur pas/ bdud dang dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad tshar bcad/ khyad par dam sri 'gong po'i rigs dang gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad kyi mthong ba'i dug: bsam pa'i dug /reg pa'i dug kha rlangs kyi dug ste bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad rang bzhin 'bar ba ye shes kyi me yis bsregs/ bskal pa'i rlung gis gtor/ kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid mthu stobs nus pa thams cad 'ub kyis tshur bsdus nas bdag dang srog yig la thim pas/ gzi brjid cher 'bar ba'i che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla bral ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur bar bsam bzhin/ snod bcud snang grags thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par 'byams klas par bya'o/ rtsa sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ bsnyen sgrub gcig chog yin no/ las sngags gcig dril ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti kā li badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya mañdzu shrī h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ḍāk+k-i ha ri ni sa yak+sha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ

a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ las sbyor phrin las bzhi sbyor ni/ dang po zhi ba go cha rigs 'dus ni: om̐ ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi sarba ḍāk+ki yak+sha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ sgrub pa po'i nad gdon bar chod 'jigs brgyad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnyis pa rgyas pa rigs bzhi ni: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma he ru ka kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po'i 'byor drug thams cad rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gsum pa dbang khro bcu la: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra bi dza ya a ya mān+ta ka h+ya gh+ri wa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li nī la daṇ+ṭa a tsa le a pa rā dzi ta trai lok+ṣa bi dza ya ma hā bā la kro ta kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bdag cag sgrub pa por brtan pa dang g.yo ba khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad mos pa bzhi'i sgo nas dbang du 'du bar gyur cig wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bzhi pa las kyi drag sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba dang gnod pa rno ba'i mtshon dang sbyor ba'i dug la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar gcad par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ khyad par gyi las sbyor srung bzlog bsad gsum 'bod rbad bsad mnan brub sogs las kyi mthar sbyar bar mos na gzhung ltar bya'o/ mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying dang bcas grub nas mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: mchod yon la sogs yid sprul lha mo dang : sman raka bdud rtsi dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: sbyor sgrol bla med phyi nang sprin spros pa: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā:

oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā pañtsa pū dza hoḥ khā hi khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: srid pa gsum du che btsan 'gran zla bral: thogs med stobs ldan drag rtsal kī la ya: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod par gsol ba ni: hoḥ mkha' klong mi 'gyur shar grol rig pa'i rtsal: 'khor 'das dbyer med 'od gsal ngang nyid las: spro bsdu bcos bsgyur re dogs 'khrul pa'i tshogs: rang byung thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: skye med ye shes nam mkha'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: rang rig gdod ma'i rang sa zin gyur cig: ces yig brgya bzla: rdzogs rim nyer bsdu ni: hūm̐: snang stong zung 'jug gnyis med dkyil 'khor gyi: rang rtsal rol gar drag po'i lha tshogs rnams: dgongs pa rang gsal mtha' bral ngang du gshegs: ma skyes mi 'gag skye med ngang la gnas: hūm̐ a āḥ mthar bsngo smon sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ zhes bsnyen sgrub nyams len pa'i dgos mkho'i cha rkyen du dmigs nas gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ji bzhin legs par bsdebs pa 'di'ang gnam lcags bstan 'dzin pas ta pe rgyal sa gnam lcags chos tshogs su shing sprel zla ba 7tshes 10la'o// // 'a) drag po kī la ya'i: hūm̐ sgrub ye shes me 'bar bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: drag rtsal khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: pad+ma thod phreng drag po bdag nyid kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug smon lam brda sbyar phyir: dregs pa'i snying 'byin spu gri'i las tshogs las: rgya 'dre 'gong po'i smyo 'bog 'dul ba yi: hūm̐ sgrub yang snying ye shes me 'bar bstan: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: hra/hra/hra/ 'di la dang po dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni: stong pa'i rang rtsal rig stong las: ye nas snang srid gzhal yas khang : blo bcos ma yin lhun gyis grub: sngags med rdzas med ting 'dzin med:

bsgom med bcos med gdod ma'i lha: bdag mdun spro bsdu bya mi dgos: 'dzin med snang stong 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐ḥ snang srid drag po e yi klong : snod bcud gzhal yas chos 'byung dbus: gzugs rnams khro bo khro mo'i sku: rtsi shing nags tshal mtshon cha'i gur: 'bab chu khrag sna dmar chen 'khyil: sgra skad hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ sgra sgrog: na bun skyi bun me rlung 'tshubs: dug gi ser ba mtshon char 'bebs: snang srid dkar dmar cha lang rdeb: gza' dang rgyu skar thog rgod 'bebs: mun pa nag po'i 'o dod 'bod: las kyi gshin rjes gad mo sgrog: srid pa'i ma mos rgyangs glu len: dur khrod sha za sprin ltar gtibs: gcan spyang ro zan ngar sgra sgrog: srid pa pho mos bsha' ra 'dzin: rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor dbus: bdag nyid drag po kī la ya: che chung nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: mthing nag me dpung tshwa tshwa 'phro: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: mu stegs dmag tshogs rdul du rlog: g.yon pas khro rgyal phur pa 'dril: rgyal 'gong rgya 'dre'i srog dbugs sdud: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i snying khrag 'thung : spyan gsum sdang mig khrag ltar g.yo: dregs pa pho mo sngangs shing 'dar: dbu skra smin ma me ltar 'bar: dug lnga'i rnam rtog rtsad nas gcod: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: sde brgyad ma mo dbang du sdud: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal bgrad: klu gnyan sa bdag gdug pa 'dul: rdzu 'phrul 'dab gshog bar snang khengs: thogs med bstan dgra rdul du rlog: sku smad srid gsum dbal zur ldan: ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyun gcod: dbyings rig gsang yum bdud 'dul ma: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par zhugs: yab yum khro chas me ltar 'bar: gnas lngar go cha'i dkyil 'khor lha: yan lag sgo ma mkha' 'gro dang : nying lag sde brgyad bswo sgra sgrog: chos sku rdo rje kī la ya:

skye mched khros pa'i ngang nyid las: drag po'i thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: bla ma rdo rje thod phreng gi: sku lnga hūm̐ gis rang sgra sgrog: 'byung 'jug hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: drag sngags stong gsum shig shig 'gul: dbang sdud zil gnon bcud bsdus nas: dgra bgegs tshar gcod las grub gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ grags stong ngang du ci nus bzla: cho 'phrul che na snang stong bsgom: bying 'thibs shes pa mi gsal na: rig pa cung zad gcun par bya: nyams gsal smra rgod shes gsal na: dga' spro bdud du shes par bya: rmi lam rtsub nyams cher byung na: grub rtags yin pas sna tshogs spang : de nas rig 'dzin dbang bzhi blang : hūm̐: gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal: spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo ru: snang stong hūm̐ gis dbang mchog bskur: dkar po hūm̐ gis byin gyis rlobs: badz+ra hūm̐ gi dbang thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: brgya phrag bgrang : spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor dkar pos ltem gyis gang bar bsgom: hūm̐: gu ru pad+ma drag po rtsal: mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru: grags stong hūm̐ gis dbang mchog bskur: dmar po hūm̐ gis byin gyis rlobs: pad+ma hūm̐ gi dbang thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: brgya phrag bgrang : mgrin pa longs spyod gyi 'khor lor dmar pos ltem gyis gang bar bsgom: hūm̐: gu ru bud+dha drag po rtsal: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ru: gsal stong hūm̐ gis dbang mchog bskur: sngon po hūm̐ gis byin gyis rlobs: bud+dha hūm̐ gi dbang thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: brgya phrag bgrang : snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor sngon pos ltem gyis gang bar bsgom: hūm̐: gu ru rat+na drag po rtsal: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru: bde stong hūm̐ gis dbang mchog bskur: ser po hūm̐ gis byin gyis rlobs: rat+na hūm̐ gi dbang thob shog:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: brgya phrag bgrang : lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor ser pos ltem gyis gang bar bsgom: hūm̐: gu ru karma drag po rtsal: gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo ru: rig stong hūm̐ gis dbang mchog bskur: ljang gsal hūm̐ gis byin gyis rlobs: karma hūm̐ gi dbang thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: brgya phrag bgrang : gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lor ljang gus ltem gyis gang bar bsgom: pad+ma'i thugs bcud yang zab hūm̐ sgrub 'di: rin chen zab shog gsang ba'i ngos su bris: bka' srung gnod sbyin bzhi dang shan pa spun: thub par srungs shig a du tsa tri rgya: las can thugs ky-i sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lha srin sde brgyad ci ltar kha dar kyang : hūm̐ sgrub drag po lan bdun bzlas srid kyis: rkyen ngan mi 'byung mchog thun dngos grub thob: byin rlabs myur ba'i zab chos a thaṃ rgya: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs te shog ser du phab pa'o// // ya) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: las byang 'bring po rdo rje thog rgod kyi rjes chog tshogs mchod 'dod rgu mchod sbyin bzhugs so:

bdud 'dul drag po rtsal la 'dud: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la: dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: māṃ sa dza gad gtsor gyur pa'i: bza' ba ldag myong longs spyod rigs: phun sum tshogs pa bshams byas nas: chu gtsang bdud rtsis bsang gtor bya: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po'i thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ las me rlung chus: bdag gzhan rtog pa'i dri ma sbyangs: tshogs kyi nyes skyon rnam rtog kun: sbyangs bkrus gtor nas bdud rtsir bsgyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: gnyis pa tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rje btsun drag po thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun: dur khrod gnas mchog tshogs khang 'dir: bsod nams ye shes las 'brel phyir: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor gnas mchog nyams re dga': 'dir tshogs pho mo dam re gtsang : tshogs gtor brjid ldan bcud re che: tshogs rdzas sna tshogs bag re dro: drag po thod phreng lha tshogs rnams: dkyil 'khor rdzas la byin phob cig: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs bcom ldan he ru ka'iḥ drag po bdud 'dul lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye med chos dbyings ngang du rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: bzhi pa tshogs kyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: yang gsang pad+ma he ru kaḥ thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: spyan gzigs phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo'i sgra: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas kyis: drag po thod phreng lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskangs la rkyen zlogs shig: ma rig bdag gzhan dgrar 'dzin rnams: gnyis med shar grol ngang du bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ

zhes dang yi ge brgya pas bshags: rgyas pa spro na zur du gsal: lnga pa tshogs kyi bsgral mchod ni: tshogs snod pho nya e las lcags khang du: tshogs rdzas dmigs byang dngos su bsam: bden stobs brjod cing 'gugs stim bya: tshe khrus dgongs pas phur bu gzir: na moḥ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum zhi khro rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du'ang bdud 'dul drag po rtsal gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden mthus/ dgra bgegs 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad tshogs tha ma 'di la khug cig nṛ tri dza dzaḥ lan gsum/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drag po thod phreng bdud 'dul rtsal: ye shes khros pa'i ngang nyid las: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: phyag g.yon gnam lcags phur bu 'dril: 'khrul snang ru tra'i gzugs phung la: btab bo badz+ra kī la ya: byad ma nṛ tri mā ra ya: rbad sod khug ril nan: nṛ tri trig nan hur thuṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces bsgral la 'bul zhing bdud rtsis bran: hūm̐: rngam brjid chos dbyings zhal phyes la: gnyis 'dzin dug lnga bsgral ba yi: rang grol ye shes mchod pa 'di: rtsa gsum drag po'i zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: drug pa 'dus pa'i tshom bu ni: longs spyod tshogs la rol bar bya: gzungs ma'am las slob kyis: tshogs rdo rje rgyal po la: hoḥ gzigs mdzes chos nyid rol pa las: rnam rtog rang grol spang blang bral: re dogs mtshan mas ma gos par: gnyis med ro gcig ngang du rol: zhes rdo rje glus bskul bas: slob dpon gyis pad kor dang bcas te: a la la pū dza hoḥ zhes blang zhing tshogs la zhim par rol: drug pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni: sme lhag phud lhag mtshams sbyar te: mkha' dbyings rgya bcas kha phru gdab: sdud pa'i sgra yis lhag sdud bsdu:

hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: dregs pa'i sde dpon ma lus pa: tshogs la mi dbang lhag sdud mas: lhag gtor bzhes la gnas su gshegs: phrin las rnam bzhi'i sdongs grogs mdzod: u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha ling+ta khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: gdung ba'i yus dang bcas nas ni: drag po'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bskul: dregs sde mngon spyod las su bskol: hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng skur bzhengs shig: dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: du ru ra tsa bzlog pa'i dus la bab: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mu stegs dmag g.yo bzlog pa'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gnyan nad smyo 'bog 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sngon gyi dam bca' nyams par mi 'gyur bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyi rol gnam lcags 'khor lo'i steng : gnas pa'i sde brgyad dmag dpung rnams: sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges te: rang rtags rgyan dang phyag mtshan rdzogs: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: rngam brjid ha ha'i gad mo sgrogs: rdzu 'phrul ri rab thal bar rlog: las la chas pa'i mthu bo che: srog la rngam pa'i 'jig rten lha: myur du rgyug pa'i drag rtsal can: bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i: sde brgyad mngon spyod las la bskul: khyed rnams gang bcol phrin las rnams: dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' bar: sangs rgyas bstan la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can las la chos: mtha' 'khob dmag tshogs bzlog pa dang : dus 'khrug nad yams bzlog pa sogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa na sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes pas phrin las bcol zhing dam la bzhag: brgyad pa chad mdo'i tha tshig ni:

dmar gtor phud bcas rngam tshig gis: hūm̐: sngon tshe ma la ya yi rtse mo dang : stag tshang shel brag mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu: dregs 'dul stobs ldan pad+ma thod phreng la: rgyal po la sogs dregs pa bco brgyad kyis: rang rtags srog phul khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor gyi: phrin las sgrubs la chad mdo'i dam ma g.yel: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: hor sog mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs bzlog pa dang : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ dharma pā la badz+ra sa dhu tsa na ma tri rā hu la ki kang ra shu tsa tri dhe wa nā ga du pra ma ti pa tsa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: gtor gzhong bshal chus brtan mar bran: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: lhab lhub sil snyan sgra dang bcas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe mdzod: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ du pra mo yak+ṣa kau rī aṇ+ṭa ting ting sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi: bcu pa rta bro bya ba ni: gtor gzhong kha sbub mgo 'dren rnams: bden pa'i stobs brjod 'gugs 'dren bya: hūm̐: ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal: chos nyid sgyu ma'i ngang nyid las: ma bsgoms ting 'dzin khros pa'i sku: skye med ye shes dpa' bo yis: ma rig dug lnga'i dgra bo 'di: blo 'das chos sku'i ngang du mnan: 'khrul ba'i rnam rtog bshig cing choms: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mtshan ma'i ru tra satwaṃ bha ya nan: las kyi ru tra mā ra ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub blang ba ni: gtor gzhong kha yar bzed la 'bru 'thor zhing : hūm̐: zab gsang bde chen mkha' spyod klong yangs nas: zab rgya'i dkyil 'khor gu ru kī la ya: zab gsang 'dzad med brda bzhi rdo rje'i chos: zab lam snyan brgyud ye shes mkha' 'gro mas:

zab gter nyi zla rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: zab yangs mnga' thang chos nor bu mchog dang : zab bzhir longs spyod khams gsum dbang bsdus nas: zab mo'i dbang bzhi mchog bskur 'chi med stsol: zab gnad dgongs pa ma lus mthar phyin nas: zab rgyas gter srung bran du khol ba dang : zab chos mthar rgyas yar zla gong 'phel nas: zab pa'i mthar thug mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: kā ya sid+dhi om̐: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: ma hā mu tra sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ gtang rag gi mchod bstod bya ba ni: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: srid pa gsum na che btsan 'gran zla bral: thogs med stobs ldan drag rtsal kī la ya: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bstod par 'os sogs: bcu gnyis pa bzod par gsol ba ni: hoḥ mkha' klong mi 'gyur shar grol rig pa'i rtsal: 'khor 'das dbyer med 'od gsal ngang nyid las: spro bsdu bcos bsgyur re dogs 'khrul pa'i tshogs: rang byung thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: skye med ye shes nam mkha'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: rang rig gdod ma'i rang sa zin gyur cig: ces yig brgya bzla: bcu gsum pa rdzogs rim nyer bsdu ni: hūm̐: snang stong zung 'jug gnyis med dkyil 'khor gyi: rang rtsal rol gar drag po'i lha tshogs rnams: dgongs pa rang gsal mtha' bral ngang du gshegs: ma skyes mi 'gag skye med ngang la gnas: hūm̐ a āḥ bcu bzhi pa bsngo ba ni: oṃ: 'khor 'das snang srid 'khrul gzhi'i 'phrang sgrol nas: gdod ma'i gnas lugs don gnyis lhun grub ste: sngon las 'phral rkyen gegs dbang mi 'gyur bar: stobs bcu rnam 'dren mchog gi sa thob shog: bdag gzhan 'gro drug ma gyur sems can rnams: ri dwags rgyar chud shing rta'i 'khor lo bzhin:

sdug bsngal bzod dka' myong bzhin 'khor ba rnams: 'khor gsum yongs dag dge bas bskul ba'i mthus: thar lam 'chug med tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: bco lnga pa bkra shis ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang rdo rje sems: phyogs bral gnas yul dag pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis dga' rab shrī sing : shar grol mtha' bral zang thal bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: gang 'dul der ston mthar phyin bkra shis shog: snyan brgyud bkra shis bde chen mtsho rgyal mas: dga' bzhi bde stong zung 'jug bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis che mchog kī la yas: bdud dpung g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis drag mo phag zhal can: mu stegs dmag tshogs tshar gcod bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar gcod bkra shis shog: dam can bkra shis skyes bu thig le rtsal: myur mgyogs bgegs dpung 'joms pa'i bkra shis shog: bka' srung bkra shis khyab 'jug rā hu las: mthu rtsal myur mgyogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: rgyud srung bkra shis sngags bdag ma mo che: dbang sdud bsod nams dpal bskyed bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis lha mo klu dang btsan: las bskul thogs med 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: sngon tshe khas blangs bka' bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i: sde brgyad gzhi bdag rnams kyis bkra shis shog: gzhi yi bkra shis rang rgyud 'byongs par shog: lam gyi bkra shis gzhan rgyud grol bar shog: 'bras bu'i bkra shis gnas lugs don rtogs shog: mchog thun 'bad med 'grub pa'i bkra shis rnams: gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas gyur cig: de ltar las rim bco lnga yi: rjes kyi cho ga bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bstan pa'i sgron me yang gsang dkyil 'khor 'di: skal ldan las 'phro can gyi chos skal mchog:

smon lam sbyangs shugs stobs kyis 'phrad nas kyang : zab gter nyi mas snyigs mtha'i rmongs mun sel: bdud sprul blo 'gel chos log 'dul slad du: pad+ma'i thugs bcud yang gsang zab pa'i chos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ra) ༈ drag po kī la ya las srung bzlog gur gyi drwa mig gnam lcags spu gri bzhugs so: shin tu zab pa'i gsang rgya: che mchog drag po thod phreng sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de'ang srung 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa ni: dgong thun bzhag pa'i tshe: srod thun nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la: ting 'dzin mi g.yo bar gsal gdab pa'i ngang las: hoḥ skad cig gis bdag mdun mi dmigs pa'i ngang las: e chos 'byung gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros: dgra bgegs dam sri gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad: 'od zer thams cad tshur 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim ste yongs su gyur pa las: bdud 'dul khro rgyal chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa dbu skra dmar ser sprin ltar gtibs pa'i gseb nas rta dbu ljang zhur gyis rta skad phyogs bcur bsgrags pas snang srid dbang du sdud pa: phyag g.yas pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar bas srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa: g.yon pas sgrol byed kyi phur pa thog ltar du 'bebs pas byad ma dam sri 'dre rgod rnams kyi srog dbugs sdud pa: de'i steng du za byed las kyi sdig pa 'gyed pas 'gong po ma rungs pa'i snying khrag 'dren pa: sku smad gnam lcags dbal ldan gyi phur pa tshwa tshwa dmar lam lam 'phro bas bstan dgra gdug pa'i tsit+tar bsnun pa:

sku la dur khrod dang dpa' chas yongs su rdzogs pas dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad pho nyar 'gyed pa: de'i pang du yum bdud 'dul ma sku mdog dmar mo me'i mdog can gyis 'khril zhing rab tu khros pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad las la bskul ba ste: yab yum bskal pa'i me ri drag tu 'khrugs pa'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i gnas lngar go cha lha lnga: chu srin gyi mche ba bzhi la kī la rigs bzhi: sku stod kyi cha la khro bo bcu: sku smad kyi khong seng du sde brgyad: dbal gyi zur gsum la spu gri mched gsum: dug sbrul gyi chun po la gter srung las mkhan rgyu ba: phyi rol tu drag po'i pho brang gnam lcags ur mo las grub pa: pho brang gi phyi rol la dang po stong nyid e'i gur khang la me'i tshwa tshwa 'khrigs pa: gnyis pa gnam lcags 'khor lo so 'thab kyi rtsibs phyi la bstan pa'i gur khang : gsum pa khro bo gdug pa 'joms byed nag po cha lugs gtso bo ltar grangs med phyi la rgyu ba ste: zlog sngags kyi dmod pa bor ba'i gur khang : bzhi pa ral gri bsam chod gyi gur khang lnga pa spu gri 'thab pa'i gur khang : drug pa chu srin rlung gri 'khor lo 'bar ba'i gur khang : bdun pa gnam lcags kyi sdig pa'i rwa gzengs pa'i gur khang : brgyad pa gser gyi rdo rje'i drwa mig tu rlung mi bgrod pa'i gur khang : dgu pa bla ma rdo rjai thod phreng sku mdog dkar po longs sku'i cha lugs can gyis rdo rje dang tshe bum bsnams pa gar gyi 'gying stabs can: de'i pang du lha lcam dmar mo mda' dar dang tshe bum bsnams pa: yab yum 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs pa: sgrub pa po la 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin stsol ba'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: sa ma ya:

de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni: de'ang rang nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba zhig bsgoms pas: phyi rol sngags phreng mthing nag 'od zer dmar po kyud pa: sngags bzla ba'i tshe: sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: de las gnyis mched kyi rnam pas lus thams cad gang : nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa bsregs: khyad par du dam sri 'gong po'i rigs dang gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad kyi gdong gi dug: bsam pa'i dug sbyor ba'i dug ste: thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'bar ba ye shes kyi mes bsregs: gtso bo'i sngags bzla ba'i tshe gnas kyi lha thams cad kyis rang sngags di ri ri sgrog par bsam: slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las mched pa'i sngags sgra dang bcas pa ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros: snang srid snod bcud thams cad me ri dang khro bo'i mtshon cha'i rang bzhin du gyur: bdud dang dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad mtshon cha me ri rig sngags kyi sgras bskul bas tshar bcad: bskal pa'i rlung gis gtor: kho'i tshe dang bsod nams bkrag dang gzi brjid mthu stobs nus pa thams cad 'ub kyis tshur bsdus: bdag dang srung ba'i gur khang la thim pas: gzi brjid cher 'bar zhing che btsan kun gyis 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: zlog sngags kyi tshe phyi rol khro bo rnams kyis bzlog pa'i las byed par bsgom: srung sngags kyi tshe: bla ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku las 'od zer dpag yas phyogs bcur 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems 'phags tshogs rnams kyi byin rlabs nus stobs bden tshig thams cad bsdus nas bdag la sku gsum gyi dbang bskur te bstim pas sku gsum he ru ka'i ngo bo gnas par bsam la: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki nī pad+ma kā ra artsig nirtsig ma hā kro ta shrī badz+ra kī li kī la ya bigh+nā nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

r+ghing wa ri nṛ hūm̐ tsakra tsakra bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: ci 'grub bzla: sa ma ya: zlog sngags dang bsad sngags sbrags pa'i tshe: mdun bskyed kyi pho brang gi 'og tu dgra bo'i bsad khang mun pa dgu rim can gyi nang du steng gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor: 'og zangs kyi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba'i bar thams cad dgra bgegs gnod byed dmigs yul du gang bkaud pa thams cad: gnam lcags kyi rtsibs nas spros pa'i spu gri'i so la bskyon te dmar nyil du gtor: bsad khang thams cad khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur: sku smad phur pa'i khong seng nas spros pa'i ye shes 'jig rten dregs pa'i las mkhan shan pa rnams kyis dpa' zas bgyis te sha zos: khrag 'thung : dbugs blangs: mdangs phrogs nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsam: slar yang mchod pa gso bran bgyis nas thun bskul tshar gcig gtong : dgra bo lan grangs gang rung zhig 'gugs: thun gyis brab: brda chog gi dmod pa bor: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis ma shor bar dam du bzung bar bsam: lcags khang yang zin nas thar pa med par 'phro 'gyu chad pa'i rang bzhin gyi sgrom bur bsam: srung 'khor sngar ltar gsal gdab: srung sngags bdun nam gang 'grub tsam bzlas la: mthar srung 'khor de ka'i ngang la nyal: ting 'dzin mi shigs pa'i ngo bo yang skyong : las mtha' ma yin pa'i dus sgrub pa'am rmi ltas log pa'i rkyen ngan sogs byung na: rang nyid sngar ltar gsal ba'i 'og tu sa rim pa dgu'i mtshams su: yang na rlung ri rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba hom yangs kyi nang du dgra bo mngon sum du dmigs pa'i snying khar sku smad gnam lcags kyi dbal btab pas: dbal zur nas las mkhan shan pa 'phros pas kho'i nus pa thams cad bcom: mya ngan gyi skad tser tser gyis kyi hud 'debs pa: de'i tshe las mkhan rnams kyis rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra 'brug ltar ldir bas sku'i cha nas khro chu'i tshwa tshwa gnam lcags kyi zi ra thog char bu yug 'tshubs te bskrad cing bcom nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsgom:

khyad par du snang srid thams cad khro bo'i me dpung : sa gzhi thams cad khro chu khol ma'i rba rlabs zi ra 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du bsgom: des snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam sri 'byung po'i bar chod ma rungs pa bdud kyi cho 'phrul: ban bon sngags pa'i byad zor rnams skad cig la brlag nus par 'gyur ro: de'ang las kyi brub khang du dmigs bya gsal gdab pa gnad ches khyad par dmigs pa dang sngags 'di nyid mu stegs stong thun byad ma 'bum thub bya ba phra men ral gri phyung rdeg gi dmigs rkang dang 'brel ba'o: rtsa sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhi tshugs shig /oṃ maṇ+ḍa pa dā sarba swā hā: go cha rigs 'dus ni: om̐ ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi sarba ḍāk+ki yak+sha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ sgrub pa po'i nad gdon bar gcod 'jigs brgyad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rigs bzhi ni: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma he ru ka kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po'i 'byor drug thams cad rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: khro bcu la: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra bi dza ya a ya mān+ta ka h+ya gh+ri wa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li nī la daṇ+ṭa a tsa le a pa rā dzi ta trai lok+ṣa bi dza ya ma hā bā la kro ta kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bdag cag sgrub pa por brtan pa dang g.yo ba khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad mos pa bzhi'i sgo nas dbang du 'du bar gyur cig wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: las kyi drag sngags ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag sgrub pa po la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba dang gnod pa rno ba'i mtshon dang sbyor ba'i dug la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig:

hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ de nas sde brgyad kyi las sngags niḥ oṃ hi tri ka la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya zlog zlog: byad ma gnod byed lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya nan nanaḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po ma rungs pa'i snying rtsa 'ur 'ur shig shig trig nan bhig nan sum bha ra ḍāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo de shaṃ de shaṃ bhur brub bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la hal ta hal ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi ka wa tsi brlag brlag mā ra ya thun bh+yoḥ ta sha ku ru ye brub nan a laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: mdun bskyed skabs lo dgra zla gshed len chog bcas thun gyis brab: shan pa sde gsum gyi rtsa sngags ni: om̐ du pra ma rā dza nā ga ti pa ra tsa ya ging ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po 'dre rgod kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbadaḥ srog rtsa la chod chod: snying rtsa la rbad rbad: dbugs la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: pags pa la rbad rbad: 'du ba bzhi la rbad rbad: dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: rnam shes drug la rbad rbad: skye mched bcu gnyis la rbad rbad: skye gnas bzhi la rbad rbad: dgra bgegs snying khrag baṃ ri kha la rag mo yag mo bh+yo bh+yo rbad rbad: ha la tsakra rbad ya tri thum rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: zhes bdag bskyed kyi skabs su lha'i rnal 'byor gsal btab nas srung bzlog bsad gsum dmigs pa gcig dril bya: sa ma ya: dang po sgrub pa rtsa sngags kyi gzhi 'dzugs: go cha'i lhas phyi nang bgegs tshogs zhi: kī la rigs bzhis khams gsum las rnam par rgyal te tshar bcad nas gzi brjid thams cad cher rgyas: khro bo bcus pha rol gyi nus pa thams cad tshur bsdus te bdag la thim pas stobs bskyed: las sngags gtso bo dregs pa zil gnon gyi nus pa cher 'phos: sku'i cha las mtshon thogs grangs med 'phros pas dgra bo rjes shul med par bya:

slar yang dgra bo phyi mtha'i sde brgyad kyis byed du bcug: bdud btsan klu gsum gyi lag tu gtad nas mnan pas mi shor bar gyis: sa ma ya: slar yang mdun bskyed bzlog pa dmigs rim gong bzhin las sngags kyi sham bur zlog sngags kyi kha bsgyur lag rdeb bya: las bzhi'i skabs su sham bu kha sgyur ni: dang po go cha la: sngags kyi sham bur dgra bo'i lo dang srog thams cad nyams par gyur cig: mā ra ya bzlog bzlog nan nan: de bzhin kun la 'gres: rig sngags bzhi la: dgra bo zla ba lus: khro bo bcur: dgra bo zhag dang dbang thang : drag sngags la: dgra bo dus tshod dang rlung rta: sde brgyad la: dgra bo za ma dang spar kha: spu gri gsum la: dgra bo chu tshod dang sme ba thams cad yang na 'di'i mtshams su sde brgyad man gyi bzlog bsad mnan gsum gyi sngags tshar gcig gam gsum btang rjes: res g.yul bzlog gi brub chog kha tshar btab cing zlog dmigs brub dmigs dang grub nas mnan dmigs bya: de nas nyal ba'i khar sngar ltar srung 'khor dgu rim bsgom zhing srung sngags bzla: nyal ba'i tshe rmi ltas la sogs pa dang cho 'phrul sogs grwa 'khor 'khrugs pa'i rigs nang dbyen mi mthun par byung na: gnyid sad pa'i skabs sham bu 'di bya: om̐ badz+ra he ru ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad gardza gardza rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed thams cad ha na ha na rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad pa tsa pa tsa rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad hu lu hu lu rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ

dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad da ha da ha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bhan+dha bhan+dha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta sarba trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bhin+dha bhin+dha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: dam sri gnod byed thams cad ma tha ma tha tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha hu lu hu lu tig+na tig+na ādzñā pa ya ti ru tra a mu ka bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta nan gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba mar wa dha ya: gnod byed dgra bgegs dam sri thams cad thum thum pur thum satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: dmigs pa gong bzhin las dgra bgegs gnod byed gang yin thams cad hom du dgug: gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong dang ldan pa bsgom: 'gugs gzhug tshar gcig dang thun phob: de nas sngags btang ting 'dzin ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug las: dug gi par bu gab yig ltos: bsrung ba ri rab gnam lcags mkhar: bzlog pa thog rgod khro chu'i zor: bsad pa spu gri gshin rje'i sgyogs: mnan pa chu srin kha thaṃ rgya: mu stegs phra men rlung zhags te: ma 'ongs bstan dgra bsgral phyir bzhag: nam zhig yang mtha' la nye zhing : bod khams mtha' bzhi'i dmag gis bskor: sa steng g.yo ba'i dur sa 'tshubs: bod mi phal cher dgra la phyogs: snying brtse'i grogs po phal cher rnams: phyi dkar nang nag gangs ri bzhin: blo sna bya rog 'ug pa 'dra: mthong snang mi mthun me ltar 'bar: de tshe dam sri spun dgu dar: sprul pas bod khams phung bar 'gyur: de dus sems can kyi re hud:

ma 'ongs de ltar ngo shar tshe: drag sngags bzlog bsad las mtha' gtso: de'ang sngon gyi bden tshig dang : rten 'brel de la rag las pas: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag dang : rtag chag mgul lha brtan ma yi: pho brang mkhar dang sde brgyad kyi: 'dus pa rnams su dmod pa gces: nges par dus las mi yol zhing : 'byung po smra man ma bcug na: bcu gsum mam ni nyi shu bzlog: rten 'brel 'bring pos lo bdun bzlog: bdud dbang 'gong pos sna drangs na: rong chen bzhi la sil bur 'thor: stod smad thams cad chu ltar khol: bod khams slang tshan yos ltar dkrug: chu me sa shing dus skag che: de tshe bzlog bskul dmod pa bor: ri rgya rlung 'khor sa gnad 'chos: bdud 'dul mchod rten mang du brtseg: gtsug lag nyams gso rab gnas bskyal: dam sri'i mnan pa gang 'grub 'bungs: de ltar gab rgya yid la gcags: sa ma ya: rgya 'di dge bsnyen sde bzhis srungs: bar chod sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: spu gri'i rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong smug po lha rtse zhes gsang bdag dregs pa'i gnas nas spyan drangs pa'o// // la) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: lag rdeb 'dzam gling sbub bcom bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: bzlog pa gnam lcags spu gri'i mtshon: thal rdeb srid gsum brlag byed ni: bdag nyid srid pa las kyi lha: bdud 'dul khro rgyal kī la ya: snang srid gang ba'i sku dbyibs klong : bsrung bya yul gling ma lus pa: thugs mchog 'od kyi gwa'u'i nang : ye shes rol pa'i tshul du gsal: 'og tu srid gsum 'brub pa'i khung : khro chu khol ma'i klong rum nang : bstan dgra bgegs dpung yul gzhis rnams: thar med skad ngan tse re re: sku las spros pa'i khro mtshon dang : bka' sdod dregs sde ma lus pas:

las la rngam zhing sha la rings: gnam sa ri rab srid pa'i khyon: thebs theb ngar ngar g.yo zhing rdeb: drag rtsub reg phung mtshon cha'i char: smyo byed rdzas rgod na bun 'khyil: bstan dgra sgos dgra zur dgra dang : byad ma lha srung bstan dang bcas: klad la g.yugs shing drag tu brdab: stobs bral 'chi dbugs tha mal tsam: brub khung nang du char ltar dbab: las byed dregs pa'i dmag tshogs kyis: mtshon cha'i char dang khro chu'i thun: gnam lcags thog dang 'byung ba'i dgra: 'ur sgra ldeg chom 'brug stong ldir: dgra sde dpung bcas rdul du brlag: sku smad phur bu'i dbal zer 'phro: dbyings nas gsor zhing brdegs pa yis: rlung dkyil ma thug gzir byas nas: rnam shes dgongs pa'i klong du bstim: bag chags phung po gzhob tu sreg: rnam smin zag bcas lnga phung bshig: sha khrag dbang po nang rol rnams: las byed pho nyas hub der zos: srid pa khro chu'i zhun khol nas: 'dre rgod bdud 'gong ma lus sreg: chag sgo rkyen ngan dbyings su gtor: snang grags rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor che: gzhom bral 'khor 'das kun bdag gi: dgongs pa'i ngang nas bzlog bsad kyi: sngags rgod dus drug bzla zhing bskul:

oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kā ra artsig nirtsig badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ging ka ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ya mān+ta ka kā la yak+sha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum rbad bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: snying rtsa la chod chod: dum bur rbud rbud: shag tshal pa shag tshal pa phye ma phye ma: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: na sha ya na sha ya: e hur thum rbad rbad: sa ga du du rbad rbad: na ga pa sha nan nan: tri tri sha du nan nan: ra tri tsit+ta nan nan: ka sham ka la ya nan nan: dza tri nye lo ya chod chod: u tri sha la ya chod chod: pha rol byad ma lha srung dang bcas par bh+yo bh+yoḥ rak+shi mā ra ya byad ma'i rnam shes la dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kī la ya byad ma rbod gtong thams cad zlog zlog: ces pa brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar rang nyid dbyings kyi he ru kar gsal ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi phyag gnyis kyis gnam sa nyi zla'i dal 'dzam gling yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor kha sbyar nas: brdabs pas byad ma'i lha srung brlags par bsgom: hūm̐: rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba yi: phyag g.yon srin mo sha zan lngar gyur pa'i: bha ga hoṃ khung dug rlangs nad yams dbus: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma lha srung khug: phyag g.yas khro rgyal gnam lcags phur gsham can: tsha zer ngar ldan rdo rjes thog ltar rgyob: pha rol byad ma lha srung bcas pa rnams: drag tu brdabs pas myos bsregs phye mar thongs: sod cig gtub cig bstan dgra mā ra ya: bzhes shig bstan dgra sgos dgra kha raṃ khā hi: sreg byed 'dre rgod dam sri dz+wa la raṃ: gtor cig mtha' dmag u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bdud dgra ldang med gnon cig satwaṃ bha ya: dmigs med dbyings su stims shig a a āḥ zhes thal mo brdab: sa ma ya: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug mchogaḥ mtshan bcas rdzas la ma ltos par: srung bzlog bsad mnan gcig dril ba:

brda chog dug mda' nag po yi: drag sgrub dug gi par bu'i skor: sngon chad bod du ma grags shing : mkha' 'gro snying gi zungs khrag phyung : rjes 'jug bu la brtse phyir bzhag: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbas: rno myur drag po'i sngags rgod 'di: mtshon char 'khrigs pas brlags par bsam: dmag dpung 'phral du bzlog par 'gyur: jag rkun bsrung na bye mar sngags: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gtor zhing bskor: bye thun dregs pa'i pho nyar 'gyedaḥ gnod byed brlag cing gtor bar bsgom: rbod gtong zor kha bcad pa la: dug shing skyer pa'i phur pa ru: sngags rgod bris shing dug khrag byug: bskyed rim sngags kyis ngar blud nas: dgos pa'i phyogs su dbal rtse gdeng : pha rol byad ma brlags par bsam: byad zor rbod gtong bzlog par 'gyur: gang zhig blo stobs ldan pa'i bus: spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du: brtson na dgra bgegs thal bar brlag: tshe dpal nyams dang rtogs pa 'bar: bdud dang log 'dren zil gyis gnon: sngon las 'phral rkyen ma lus bzlog: srid pa'i ri rab 'jigs nus na: mtha' dmag 'byung po smos ci dgos: nus stobs dpag yas brjod mi lang : bstan pa srung ba'i mtshon cha ru: spyi chings ma bu cha tshang bzhag: thugs sras dzñā na'i skyes mtha' mchog: mthu chen de dang 'di 'phrad nas: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // sha) ༈ thun gtor 'gugs gzhug bya ba ni: na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bdud 'dul che mchog drag po kī la ya'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthus/ bsam ngan sbyor log 'chang ba'i dgra bo spyi dang*/ khyad par du'ang bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'joms pa'i mtha' bzhi'i dmag 'khrug g.yo zhing mtshon rtse ston pa'i phung byed dam sri bdud rigs log par 'dren pa'i rgyab rten lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad dmar chen thun gyi gtor ma 'di la gnyis su med par khug cig

/nṛ tri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: thun gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa bzhugs so: gsang ba'i las byang phrin las rgya mtsho las: bstod bskul dug gi par bu 'bring po'i lugs: sde brgyad bcas pa'i gtor 'bul ni: drag po'i lcags snod gru gsum du: 'bru nag gam ni gang rung zan: dpal gtor zur gsum yab yum tshul: sde brgyad bshos bus bskor bar bya: 'gugs gzhug drag dmigs logs su gsal: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dur khrod chos 'byung me dpung 'bar ba'i klong : lha srin sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rtsa gsum drag po'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: dpal chen drag po stobs ldan skur bzhengs shig: bdud 'dul che mchog kī la skur bzhengs shig: khrag 'thung dregs pa dbang sdud skur bzhengs shig: ye shes khro mo dbyings phyug skur bzhengs shig: rigs bzhi go cha'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: srog gcod shan pa sde brgyad skur bzhengs shig: sprul pa dregs pa yongs rdzogs skur bzhengs shig: chos sku skye med dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: longs sku khro bos dgra 'dul ma g.yel bar: sprul sku'i phrin las nam mkha'i glog ltar 'khyugs: sngon tshe thugs dam rgyud bskul zhal bzhes bzhin: dam tshig dus las ma g.yel sa ma ya: dug gsum sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dus ngan mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs bzlog pa dang : phyi nang bstan dgra gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun: myur du khug la sha khrag tshogs su rol: rnam shes drag pos chos kyi dbyings su spor: phrin las dus la bab bo sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi:

ma hā bha su ta la khā hi: ma hā sarba pū dza la khā hi: dug gi par bu'i las byang 'bring po'i dgong thun gtor ma 'bul ba'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // ha) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las g.yul bzlog gi mdun bskyed mtshon 'khor dug gi ri bo bzhugs so: bdag 'dra pad+ma gar dbang gis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu rnams la: bar chad bzlog pa'i cha rkyen chos: dmag mtshon yams nad dar ba'i tshe: de nyid srung bzlog bsad rim gyi: gtor zlog thog mda' reg chod bstan: rgya rgya rgya: de la bzlog pa'i bca' gzhi ni: phung sa'i stegs bu gru bzhi la: ro sol dug khrag chag chag gdab: gnam lcags 'khor lo ma traṃ gyis: thig gdab rim gyis pho brang brtsig: de dbus gru gsum liṅga bzhag: rgyas pa lha grangs lta bu la: bris ling steng du zan ling bzhag: dar nag re ba nag pos bcad: de steng drag po'i gtor ma ni: lcags sam shing gi li khram steng : rab ni lcags snod drag po'i rdzas: ma rnyed gang rung snod gtsang du: ngar phye khrag chang dug gis sbrus: dregs pa rngam 'dra khro zhal bstod: dmar nag me yis zur gsum brgyan: rtse mor khyung chen 'bar ba gzugs: go cha lnga la dpal gtor re: kī la rigs bzhir dpal gtor bzhi: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad sde brgyad la: rang rang 'os pa'i bshos bu bzhag: sgo ma rnams kyang de bzhin ltar: lha grangs ltar gyi khrag kong brgyan: phyag gtsang drug cu re bzhi ni: ring thung khru re'i tshad du bya: phyi gtsang brgya dang rtsa lnga ste: ring thung mtho re'i tshad du bya: shan pa srin mo'i 'gros su btsugs: bha su ta yi zhags pas bsdam: rtse mo sha dang liṅgas brgyan: dar nag gur phub tsit+ta dang : zlog 'khor me long dar snas brgyan:

ma 'byor snal ma'i gdug rtsibs phub: sa ma ya: phyogs bzhi dur 'jim zor kong la: mda' dar dregs pa'i zor rdzas dang : dmar chen yon chab la sogs pa'i: drag po'i nyer spyod rnam lnga bzhag: lcags ri'i nang du bsgral ling ni: khrag gis sbags pa gang mang bzhag: thun mtshams 'gugs gzhug thun gyis brab: de yang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs: gnas dus rnal 'byor rig pas dpag: mda' dar rol mo rkang gling sogs: drag po'i spyan gzigs ci 'byor bsham: de ltar bca' gzhi legs grub nas: bdag bskyed gzhung bsrangs sngags bar bskyal: mdun gyi zor rdzas mchod pa'i tshogs: byin brlabs rol mo drag tu 'khrol: mdun bskyed gsal bar 'di ltar bsgom: oṃ e shud+dhe: yam̐ shud+dhe: ram̐ shud+dhe: kham̐ shud+dhe: lam̐ shud+dhe: badz+ra a mṛ ta shud+dhe āḥ zhes ma dag pa sbyang ba dang byin rlabs rgyud kyi sngags lngas lan gsum du sbyang : oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang? sogs stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las e las dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang rlung ri rgya gram gru gsum gyi rtsibs bsnol mar 'khor ba'i bar thams cad du: dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha khrag dang rnam shes kyi rten rnams khrag skyo ltar dkrugs pa'i sha khrag gi rba klong drag po mkha' la 'phyo ba de la mtshon cha dang thog ser gyi bu yug 'tshubs pa: 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du 'khrugs pa'i rngam sgra lhang lhang sgrog pa: khro chu khol ma'i me dpung dmar nag tu 'bar ba: de'i dbus su kaṃ dmar nag las grub pa'i pho brang rgyu dang mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa'i thod mkhar gru bzhi zur brgyad logs bcu drug dang ldan pa: rmang gzhi nag po gnam lcags ur mo las grub pa: bar thams cad lcags sdig nag po dang mes gtams pa: logs brgyad la dur khrod chen po brgyad dang ldan paḥ bya gcan sha za srog gcod zhing skyong rnams kyis gad mo sgrog pa: de ltar 'jigs shing yangs pa'i dal gyi nang thams cad:

mi lpags skam rlon gyi bla bre gdugs ltar bklubs pa: srin po pho mo'i ka ba la don snying lnga'i ka zhus brgyan pa: ka gdan sa bdag rus sbal nag pos 'khun pa di ri ri sgrog pa: tshangs pa lha chen gyi gdung gzhi bres pa: dug sbrul nag po'i dral lcam 'khyugs pa: ru tra nag po'i g.yang gzhis thog steng khyab pa: klu chen gyi kha bad g.yu 'brug gyen skyes dang ldan pa: keng rus kyi shar bu la mi lpags kyi sham bu lhab lhub tu bskyod pa: gshin rje nag po'i za ra tshags su gdab pa: gza' brgyad kyi rgyal mtshan glog ltar brjid cing tsit+ta sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa: me dpung dgu bsgril gyi 'phyang thag phyogs bzhir brgyangs pa: khro chu khol ma'i tshwa tshwa dmar lam 'phyo ba'i gzer gyis bsdams pa: gzhan yang dur khrod kyi chas sna tshogs pas thog steng khyab pa: phyi rol du zlog byed khro bo nag po rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i gur khang dgu dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su yi ge na nag po las nad kyi bun pa lang long du 'phro ba: gzhi thams cad gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong rno ngar dang ldan pa drag tu 'khor ba: de'i steng du ra las rak+ta'i rba klong rab tu 'khrugs pa: de'i steng du ram̐ las me dpung nyi zla'i 'khor lo: de'i steng du tri nag po las byung ba'i mu stegs bstan dgra nag po 'gyel thabs su bsgyil ba'i snying khar rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa hūm̐ drag tu 'bar bas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros: gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: 'jig rten dregs byed rnams kyi nus stobs tshur bsdus te hūm̐ la thim: de yongs su gyur pa las che mchog rdo rje drag rtsal sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rngam tshul gyis rta zhal mthing nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog pa: dbu skra dmar nag sprin ltar du gtibs par rigs lngas mtshan pa'i thod skam lnga dang sbrul nag stong gi chun pos brgyan pa:

zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba 'bar ba'i mche ba gtsigs pa: spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa glog ltar 'khyugs pa: shangs nas rdo rje'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: phyag g.yas kyis gnam lcags kyi rdo rje mu stegs kyi klad la gdengs pas dgra yul bcom par byed pa: g.yon pas gnam lcags kyi sgrol phur hūm̐ phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog pa dpa' la brjid pas log lta can sgrol ba: zhing chen gyis stod g.yogs shing glang kos brgyan pa: thod rlon gyi ga shal sbrul 'gul shig 'khyug 'khyug byed pa: stag lpags kyi sham thabs: khrag gi thig le: zhag gi zo ris: thal chen gyi tshom bu: dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang dpal gyi chas bcus brgyan pa: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad spyan stong gis spras pa las sprul pa'i khro tshogs dpag med 'gyed pas bstan dgra brlag par byed pa: rdo rje'i go khrab la me'i tshwa tshwa lam lam du 'phyo ba: spu gri dang chu gri'i sgro gshog gdengs pas snang srid thams cad shig shig 'gul ba: lte ba chu srin dmar nag khros pa'i zhal gdangs pas dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa: sku smad ye shes dang las kyi dbal phur zur gsum pa khro chu'i rang bzhin can: thog dang rdo rje'i mtshon char 'bebs pas mu stegs bstan dgra nag po'i snying dkar nag mtshams su brjid par bsnun pa zhig tu gyur: de'i pang du phag mo bdud 'dul nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum khrag ltar g.yo bas log 'dren bdud rigs thams cad tshar gcod pa: zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa ljags bskyod pa me ltar 'bar ba dbu skra dmar nag bsigs pas spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar bas skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa: g.yon pas bhan+dhar gdug pa'i snying khrag dmar la rol zhing byad ma 'joms pa: zhing chen gyi stod g.yogs glang chen gyi 'gying gos thod phreng gi ga shal rus pa'i rgyan 'phyang :

khrag zhag gi tshom bu du mas brgyan pa: sku'i cha thams cad drag po 'bar ba'i spyan stong gis spras pa las bdud 'dul khro mo'i dmag dpung 'gyed pa: rin po che dang g.yer kha'i seng sgra 'ur 'ur sgrog pa: dar nag cod pan 'phyangs pas ma tshogs dbang du sdud pa: stag gi sham thabs dang sbrul rigs kyi chun pos brgyan pa: zhabs gnyis khro bo la rol stabs kyis 'khril bas 'khor lo drag tu rgyas 'debs shing dgra bo byad ma'i bla tshe sdud pa'o: yab yum gyi spyi bor 'od lnga zer thag bsgrengs pa'i tshom bu'i dbus su thod phreng drag tu khros pa'i ngo bo dregs pa zil gnon nag po: zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum gyis sdang mig phyogs bcur g.yo ba zhal nas bdud 'dul drag sngags 'brug sgra ltar sgrog pa: gnam lcags kyi me'i le brgan lhab lhub tu bskyod pas dregs can dbang du sdud pa: dbu la dregs pa zil gnon gyi sngags zhwa nag po rdo rje'i rgyan ldan gsol ba: dar nag gi cod pan phyogs bcur bskyod pa: sku la dar nag gi ber chen lhab lhub brjid chags kyi nyams can gyi gong lag stags lpags kyis brgyan cing dar dmar gyi sku reg bcings pa: phyag g.yas pas snang srid zil gnon gyi rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa gdengs shing : g.yon pas khro rgyal bdud 'dul gyi phur pa thog rgod ltar bsgril ba: zhabs gnyis khro bo 'gying stabs su bzhugs pas mu stegs ngan pa'i dmag tshogs tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa: de'i spyi bor snang mtha' rab tu khros pa'i bdag nyid bya khyung nag po'i rwa dang mchu sder gnam lcags las grub pa: 'bar ba'i rwa bar nor bus brgyan pa: sder bzhi glog ltar 'khyugs pa: zangs mche dmar po rngam zhing gtsigs pas klu dang rgyal srin bsngangs shing 'dar ba: rdo rje'i sgro gshog brdabs pas gnam sa ri rab bsnyil ba: phyag gnyis kyis dug sbrul pho mo zhal du gsol ba:

sder bzhi bgrad pas nad rims dal yams 'joms pa: rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa me ri smug nag 'tshubs pa'i klong du gsal ba'o: gtso bo'i dpral bar 'jam dpal mthing nag gis ral gri dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa: mgrin par rta mgrin dmar nag gis rdo rje dang lcags sgrog thogs pa: snying khar phyag rdor mthing nag gis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa: lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lngas rdo rje dang gri gug bsnams pa: gsang bar yak+sha nag pos rdo rje dang tho ba gdengs pa: de thams cad khro bo'i cha lugs gtso bo'i rgyan dang ldan pa gnam lcags dbal gyi phur gsham rab tu rngam pa'o: rtsibs kyi shar du badz+ra kī la ya'i sku mdog dkar po: lhor rat+na kī la ya'i sku mdog ser po: nub tu pad+ma kī la ya'i sku mdog dmar po: byang du karma kī la ya'i sku mdog ljang nag: de thams cad kyang khro tshul rngam zhing dpa' la brjid pa hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra drag po bsgrags pas srid pa gsum po ma lus par brlag cing bcom pa: g.yas thams cad kyis gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gdengs pas byad ma gdon tshogs rnams rang gshed du 'bebs pa: g.yon thams cad khro rgyal gyi phur bu bsgril bas log 'dren tshar gcod pa: sku smad zur gsum khro chu'i phur pa byad ma'i snying khar brjid pa: de'i pang du bdud 'dul khro mo bzhis gtso ltar 'khril ba gar dgu'i dpa' chas rdzogs pa'o: hoḥ de'i shar du āḥlas srid pa lha'i gtso bo dkar pos ral gri dang dar mdung bsnams te g.yag dkar la zhon pa: lhor yaḥlas ya ma ra tsa nag pos thod dbyug dang zhags pa 'dzin cing ma he la zhon pa: nub tu maḥlas ma mo srid rgyal dkar mos mda' dar dang me long 'dzin cing g.yu 'bru+ug la zhon pa: byang du duḥlas bdud po skra dkar nag pos ru mtshon dang bdud zhags 'dzin cing rta nag la zhon pa: shar lhor ruḥlas rgyal chen pe dkar dkar pos 'khar bsil dang lhung bzed bsnams shing seṅge la zhon pa:

lho nub tu tsaḥlas skyes bu btsan rje dmar pos mda' gzhu dang ru dar 'dzin cing rta dmar la zhon pa: nub byang du shaḥlas gnod sbyin kā la yak+sha dmar nag gis dgra satwa dang zhags pa 'dzin cing phung stag ri bkra la chibs pa: byang shar du naḥlas klu bdud 'chi bdag nag pos nad rkyal dang sbrul zhags thogs shing chu srin la zhon pa: de thams cad kyang drag po'i yang 'khor sde tshan gyi tshogs dang bcas shing rngam rgyug dmag chas brtson pa dgra bo byad ma'i srog la btsan 'phrog byed pa'o: de'i phyogs bzhir shar sgor stag gdong dkar mos rdo rje dang lcags kyu: lho sgor 'ug gdong ser mos rat+na dang zhags pa: nub sgor khwa gdong dmar mos pad+ma dang lcags sgrog: byang sgor spyang gdong sngon mos rgya gram dang dril bu 'dzin cing : rang rtags dur khrod chas kyis spras shing drag la rtsub pa las la chas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can gar sgeg gi tshul du gnas pa: de'i phyi rol lha ma srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs sha la dga' ba: khrag la dgyes pa: snying rje dang bral ba: srog la rngam pa: gsod la brtson pa: gcod la rol pa: gzhan yang bya sha zan gcan gzan khrag 'thung la sogs pa las la dbang ba'i gtso 'khor rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: lte bar bh+yoḥ gsang bar dzaḥ de rnams las 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab laṅka'i yul: dbang drag gsang chen 'bar ba'i dur khrod: u tsa la'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga: lcang lo can: ha ha dgod pa'i zhing : ri bo chen po'i rtse mo: sku gsung thugs kyi rang gnas: phyi yul dur khrod nyer brgyad: phyogs bzhi srid gsum gyi gnas chen po nas skad cig gis bdud 'dul kī la ya khro bo'i lha tshogs bskal pa drag bskyod kyi las rlung drag po g.yos pa bzhin spyan drangs: badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: ye shes kyi lha tshogs thams cad dam tshig pa'i cha lugs ji bzhin rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas rnams dang : ri bo rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong nas snang srid shig shig yom yom du byon par bsams la: spos bsreg cing rol mo g.yab dar gdung dbyangs dang bcas pas: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab gling : laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i yul gling dbus: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog nas: bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru gshegs su gsol: sha khrag rlabs 'phyo 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas: che mchog bdud 'dul kī la gshegs su gsol: u tsa tshang tshing me dpung rab 'bar nas: drag mo bdud 'dul dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: ri rab brjid ldan 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: bya khyung srog gzan nag po gshegs su gsol: rtsub 'gyur 'od tshal lhun grub pho brang nas: bdud 'dul kī la rigs bzhi gshegs su gsol: gnas lnga drag rtsal e klong da la nas: drag po go cha'i lha lnga gshegs su gsol: phyogs brgyad dur khrod me rlung 'tshub 'khyil nas: sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung gshegs su gsol: mtshams bzhi shugs 'gro sha za 'tshogs gling nas: rigs bzhi gdong can sgo skyong gshegs su gsol: phyi yul dregs gnas rang rang gnas brgyad nas: bka' skyong 'khor bcas yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: gshegs nas dam tshig gnyan po bskul ba'i phyir: dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' dmag g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dus la bab: nad rims dal yams bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mtshon cha'i dal 'bab bzlog pa'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal 'gong smyo 'bog 'dul ba'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo thugs dam gnad bskul tshe: tha tshig sngon gyi smon lam ma bor bar: do nub drag po'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya mañdzu shrī h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa yak+sha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes ye shes phebs rtags ma byung bar du bskul zhing yang yang bstim mo: de nas dbyer med du bstim pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: thugs mchog mi g.yo zab mo lta ba'i klong : snang stong 'dzin med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang : dam tshig ye shes chu la chu thim ltar: dbyer med dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa ma ya: zhes drag po dpal chen sprul 'khor dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par blta'o: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: bdud bzhi mu stegs bsnol ba'i khri steng du: drag po bdud 'dul kī la'i lha tshogs rnams: khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i tshul gyi brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes srid gsum ngar 'dzin ru tra'i dpung tshogs dmigs med mtha' bral gyi klong du ma dag gi bar du: gang 'dul gyi rol gar cir yang bsgyur bzhin par gzung 'dzin zil gnon rngam brjid 'gying tshul du bzhugs par mos: de nas phyag 'tshal ba niḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: che btsan 'bar ba drag po bdud 'dul lha: rngam brjid stobs ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo che: brkyang bskum rol pa'i brjid chags dpal ldan pa: sgo gsum dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes snang srid dregs sde kun gyis dpal chen rngam zil ma bzod par sngangs 'dar yed pas srog snying phul te gus phyag byas par mos: de nas bshags pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dbang drag khros pas bdud dpung tshar gcod par: log lta rkyen gyur bag med dbang btsan pas: rang ngo ma shes 'khrul bas 'khor bar 'khyams: dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags:

sa ma ya sarba shud+dhe āḥ spro na he ru ka'i yig brgya bzla: zhes gdod nas rang rig dpal chen po'i ngo bor chas su zhugs pa la kun snang bag chags a 'thas pa'i 'khrul ba lu gu rgyud du 'khor bas: rang rig sku gsum lhun grub kyi dgongs pa gnad du mi phyin pa'i log rtog thams cad 'od gsal sgyu ma'i klong du bshags pa'o: de nas phyi'i mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gdug pa'i dmar chen mchod yon lbu ba 'khrigs: dbang po'i me tog sha chen bsregs pa'i spos: tshil chen mdangs ldan 'bru nag dpal gyi bshos: rkang gling sgra ldan rol mos thugs dam bskang : mngon spyod phrin las mdzad phyir bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas nang mchod sman raka gtor 'bul la: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sha chen klad rus khu ba las byung ba'i: gnyis med bde bas bzhus pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun: dug lnga sgrol gar sman dang sbyar ba 'di: rtsa gsum drag po'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: oṃ a haṃ pañtsa pū dza la khā hi: rgyas par spro na bdud rtsi lag mchod sbyar: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen: longs sku rdo rje sems dpa': sprul sku che mchog zil gnon: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: mkhas pa shrī singha: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal: sngags 'chang shākya pra bha: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma: gu ru che mchog drag rtsal: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs: rta mgrin gsung gi lha tshogs: phyag rdor thugs kyi lha tshogs: yon tan mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs: phrin las me dbal lha tshogs: sprul pa khyung gi lha tshogs: bdud 'dul kī la rigs lnga'i lha tshogs: ye shes khro mo lnga'i lha tshogs:

sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: phrin las sgo ma rnam bzhi: yang 'khor dregs pa'i sde tshogs: bka' srung ma mgon sde brgyad: gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs: gzhan yang snang srid thams cad che mchog kī la ya drag po'i skur gsal ba'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā bha ling+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la kha kha khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: ma hā bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: dmar chen rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: thod pa mtshan ldan zhal bu ka pā lar: rak+ta khrag gi rgya mtsho chi li li: dmar chen rba rlabs phyogs bcur lhabs se lhab: zhag g.yo bcud ldan 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma hā rak+ta pū dza khā hi: dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dpa' bo g.yul du mtshon gyis bsad pa yi: gri rgod snying bshos dmar po zur gsum 'di: bdud 'dul kī la'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta tsit+ta khā hi: de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ ham̐'u: dug khrag nyungs dkar gu gul nag po dang : pad+ma rak+ta añdza rak+ta dang : mu la rak+ta la sogs sbyar ba 'di: bdud 'dul drag po kī la'i tshogs la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rak+ta pañtsa pū dza khā hi: de nas bsgral mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: srid gsum rnam rgyal bdud 'dul kī la'i tshogs: gnyis med dbyings su dug lnga rab bsgral ba'i: 'khor 'das bcud bsdus brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta keṃ ni ri ti bha ling+ta pū dza la khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog gtum chen g.yul las rgyal:

srid pa gsum du che btsan 'gran zla bral: thogs med stobs ldan drag rtsal kī la ya: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas rtsa sngags gyi sham bur las sngags dang zlog sngags rnam spel mar bzla zhing : skabs su 'gugs gzhug dang thun gyis brab: thun gtor 'bul: gdab las reg phung dug mda' sogs kyis zhal bstab bya: de nas gtor bskul thog mda' nag po sogs bzlog pa'i gzhung la 'jug par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o// // a) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs kyi/ sngags byang gab sbas gsal ba bzhugs/ de nas sde brgyad kyi las sngags ni: oṃ hi tri ka la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya zlog zlog: byad ma gnod byed lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya nan nanaḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po ma rungs pa'i snying rtsa 'ur 'ur shig shig trig nan bhig nan sum bha ra ḍāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo de shaṃ de shaṃ bhur brub bhi sha tsakra ha la ha la hal ta hal ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed rnams kyi ka wa tsi brlag brlag mā ra ya thun bh+yoḥ ta sha ku ru ye brub nan a laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: shan pa sde gsum gyi rtsa sngags ni: om̐ du pra ma rā dza nā ga ti pa ra tsa ya ging ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po 'dre rgod kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbadaḥ srog rtsa la chod chod: snying rtsa la rbad rbad: dbugs la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: pags pa la rbad rbad: 'du ba bzhi la rbad rbad: dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: rnam shes drug la rbad rbad: skye mched bcu gnyis la rbad rbad: skye gnas bzhi la rbad rbad: dgra bgegs snying khrag baṃ ri kha la rag mo yag mo bh+yo bh+yo rbad rbad:

ha la tsakra rbad ya tri thum rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: mdun bskyed skabs su lo dgra zla gshed len chog bcas thun brab:oṃ ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi sarba ḍāk+ki yak+sha kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo'i lo dang srog nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma he ru ka kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo'i zla ba dang lus thams cad nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra bi dza ya ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li nī la dan+ḍa a tsa le a pa rā dzi ta trai lokya bi dza ya ma hā bā la kro ti hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs zhag dang dbang thang thams cad nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo'i dus tshes dang rlung rta thams cad nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: oṃ hri tri ka la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya zlog zlog: dgra bo'i za ma spar kha thams cad nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: oṃ du pra ma rā dza shu la rā dza nā ga ti pa ra tsa ya ging ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo'i chu tshod dang sme ba thams cad nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga ba te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo byad ma'i lha srung dang mgon skyabs thams cad nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog nan nan: byad ma gnod byed lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad mā ra ya nan nan: dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po ma rungs pa'i snying rtsa la 'ur 'ur shig shig trig nan bigh+nān sum bha ra ḍāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo de sha de shaṃ bhur brub bha sha tsakra ha la ha la hal ta hal ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po rnams kyi ka wa tsi brlag brlag mā ra ya thun bh+yoḥ

ta sha ku ru ye brub nas a laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bha ya nan: dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po 'dre rgod kyi srog tsa la rbad rbad: srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa la rbad rbad: dbugs la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: pags pa la rbad rbad: 'du ba bzhi la rbad rbad: dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: rnam shes drug la rbad rbad: skye mched bcu gnyis la rbad rbad: skye gnas bzhi la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i snying khrag baṃ ril kha la rak+mo yag mo bh+yo bh+yo rbad rbad: ha la tsakra rbad ya tri thum rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: zhes dang spu gri phyung rdeg gi thun gtor yang 'bul zhing bsad mnan brub gsum gyi dmigs pa gzhung bzhin byas la thal mo brdab bo/ khyad par gyi las sbyor srung bzlog bsad gsum 'bod rbad bsad pa mnan brub sogs las kyi mtha' sbyar bar mos na srung sngags kyi tshe: bla ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku las 'od zer dpag yas phyogs bcur 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs rnams kyi byin rlabs nus stobs bden tshig thams cad bsdus nas: bdag la sku gsum kyi dbang bskur te bstim sku gsum he ru ka'i ngo bor gnas par bsams la: oṃ ma hā gu ru ḍāk+ki nī pad+ma kā ra artsig nirtsig ma hā kro ta shrī badz+ra kī li kī la ya bigh+nā nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma ha ri nṛ hūm̐ tsakra tsakra bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: srung sngags bdun nam gang 'grub tsam bzlas la: zlog sngags dang bsad sngags sbrags pa'i tshe: mdun bskyed kyi pho brang gi 'og tu dgra bo'i bsad khang mun pa dgu rim can gyi nang du steng nas gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor: 'og nas zangs kyi 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba bar thams cad dgra bgegs gnod byed dmigs yul du gang bkaud pa thams cad gnam lcags kyi rtsibs las spros pa'i spu gri'i so la bskyon te dmar nyil du gtor:

bsad khang thams cad khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur: sku smad phur pa'i khong seng nas spros pa'i ye shes dang 'jig rten dregs pa'i las mkhan shan pa rnams kyis dpa' zas bgyis te sha zos: khrag 'thung : dbugs blangs: mdangs phrogs nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsam: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kā ra artsig nirtsig badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra ging ka ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ya mān+ta ka kā la yak+sha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas nṛ tri trig nan e hur thum rbad bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: snying rtsa chod chod: dum bur rbud rbud: shag tshal pa shag tshal pa phye ma phye ma: bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya: na sha ya na sha ya: e hur thum rbad: sa ga du du rbad rbad: na ga pa sha nan nan: tri tri sha du nan nan: ra tri tsit+ta nan nan: ka sham ka la ya nan nan: dza tri nye lo ya chod chod: u tri sha la ya chod chod: pha rol byad ma'i lha srung dang bcas par bh+yo bh+yoḥ rak+shi mā ra ya byad ma'i rnam shes la dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kī la ya byad ma rbod gtong thams cad zlog zlog: ces pa brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar rang nyid dbyings kyi he ru kar gsal ba'i g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis kyis gnam sa nyi zla'i dal 'dzam gling yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor kha sbyar nas: brdabs pas byad ma lha srung brlags par bsgom:
