hūm̐: rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba yi: phyag g.yon srin mo sha zan lngar gyur pa'i: bha ga hoṃ khung dug rlangs nad yams dbus: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma lha srung khug: phyag g.yas khro rgyal gnam lcags phur gsham can: tsha zer ngar ldan rdo rjes thog ltar rgyob: pha rol byad ma lha srung bcas pa rnams: drag tu brdabs pas myos bsregs phye mar thongs: sod cig gtub cig bstan dgra mā ra ya: bzhes shig bstan dgra sgos dgra kha raṃ khā hi: sreg byed 'dre rgod dam sri dz+wa la raṃ: gtor cig mtha' dmag u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bdud dgra ldang med gnon cig satwaṃ bha ya: dmigs med dbyings su stims shig a a āḥ zhes thal mo brdab: de nas nyal ba'i khar sngar ltar srung 'khor dgu rim bzhin bsgom zhing srung sngags bzla: nyal ba'i tshe rmi ltas la sogs pa dang cho 'phrul sogs grwa 'khor 'khrugs pa'i rigs nang dbyen mi mthun par byung na: ting 'dzin mi shigs pa'i ngo bo'ang skyong : las mtha' ma yin pa'i dus sgrub pa'am rmi ltas log pa rkyen ngan sogs byung na: rang nyid sngar ltar gsal ba'i 'og tu sa rim pa dgu'i mtshams su: yang na rlung ri rdo rje'i rgya gram gyi lte ba hom yangs kyi nang du dgra bo mngon sum du dmigs pa'i snying khar sku smad gnam lcags kyi dbal btab pas: dbal zur nas las mkhan shan pa 'phros pas kho'i nus pa thams cad bcom: mya ngan gyi skad tser tser gyis kyi hud 'debs pa: de'i tshe las mkhan rnams kyi rgyob rgyob sod sod kyi sgra 'brug ltar ldir bas sku'i cha nas khro chu'i tshwa tshwa gnam lcags kyi zi ra thog char bu yug tu 'tshubs te bskrad cing bcom nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsgom: khyad par du snang srid thams cad khro bo'i me dpung : sa gzhi thams cad khro chu khol ma'i rba rlabs zi ra 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can du bsgom: gnyid sad pa'i skabs su sham bu 'di bya:

om̐ badz+ra he ru ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad gardza gardza rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed thams cad ha na ha na rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad pa tsa pa tsa rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad hu lu hu lu rbad ya bzlog ya nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad tshin+dha tshin+dha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad da ha da ha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bhan+dha bhan+dha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta sarba trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bhin+dha bhin+dha rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: om̐ badz+ra kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dam sri gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa rbad ya bzlog ya nan nan: dam sri gnod byed thams cad ma tha ma tha tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha hu lu hu lu tig+na tig+na ādzñā pa ya ti ru tra a mu ka bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta nan gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba mar wa dha ya gnod byed dgra bgegs dam sri thams cad thum thum pur thum satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: dmigs pa gong bzhin las dgra bgegs gnod byed gang yin thams cad hom̐ du dgug: gnam lcags mchod rten rtsibs stong dang ldan par bsgom: 'gugs gzhug tshar gcig dang thun phob: de nas sngags btang ting 'dzin ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya:

des snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam sri 'byung po'i bar chod ma rungs bdud kyi cho 'phrul: ban bon sngags pa'i byad zor rnams skad cig la brlag nus par 'gyur ro: de'ang las kyi brub khang du dmigs bya gsal gdab pa gnad che/ khyad par dmigs pa dang sngags 'di nyid mu stegs stong thun byad ma 'bum thub bya ba phra men ral gri phyung rdeg gi dmigs rkang dang 'brel ba'o// // ki) ༈ kī la ya'i mdun bskyed kyi tshogs mchod dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs pa'i dbu'i gzigs phyogs/ de nas tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: yam̐ yam̐ yam̐: kham̐ kham̐ kham̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ: chos nyid mi 'gyur ting 'dzin las: āḥ snang srid 'dod yon tshogs su bsgyur: hūm̐: gnyis med stong par byin gyis rlobs: hrīḥ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med kyis: tram̐ḥ rang byung bhan+dha rgyas shing mchod: hoḥ zag med dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig: hūm̐: snang srid dag pa'i tshogs gzhong du: nang bcud bsdus sems can tshogs su bsgyur: des 'khor 'das tshim par 'byung gyur cig: āḥ chos dbyings khyab brdal tshogs gzhong du: don brjod bral blo 'das tshogs su bsgyur: gzhi mkha' khyab ye grol tshim gyur cig: oṃ: lnga ldan tshogs drug tshogs gzhong du: sems dran rig gnyug ma'i tshogs su bsgyur: lam cir snang chos sku tshim gyur cig: hūm̐ hrīḥ bhan+dha 'dzam gling yangs pa'i tshogs gzhong du: tram̐ḥ rin chen dgos 'dod bsod nams tshogs chen bshams: hoḥ rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: tshogs khang rang byung dur khrod 'bar ba 'dir: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin grub thob bla ma'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: yi dam kī la dpal dgu'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rngam brjid dur khrod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:

go cha zil gnon lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen gzhal yas nas: ma sring mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro zhing skyong rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan por grub pa'i dbus: mgon po dam can chos skyong gter srung rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dgos 'dod lhun grub dbang phyug dpal zhing nas: dbang bsgyur nor bdag nor lha 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang rang so so'i las dbang gnas mchog nas: yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: dbu skra thor tsugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: glu len gar byed shigs se shig: rin chen rus rgyan si li li: dpa' bos gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: rnga sgra dung sgra 'u ru ru: rkang gling smyug gling tse re re: dur khrod g.yang gzhi shigs se shig: 'dod yon tshogs 'khor spungs se spung : tshogs khang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dur khrod gzhal yas byin gyis rlobs: 'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: tshogs mchod longs spyod rgyan ldan 'di: zad med rdzas su byin gyis rlobs: mnyes mchod bdud rtsi sprin 'khrigs 'di: 'chi med rdzas su byin gyis rlobs: bam chen skye bdun sha mchod 'di: dgos 'dod 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: oṃ a la la ha ho hrīḥ hūm̐: bla ma rgya mtshos tshogs la rol: yi dam rgya mtshos tshogs la rol: mkha' 'gros rgya mtshos tshogs la rol: chos skyong rgya mtshos tshogs la rol: dam can rgya mtshos tshogs la rol: gter srung rgya mtshos tshogs la rol: gzhi srung rgya mtshos tshogs la rol:

rigs drug pha mas tshogs la rol: lan chags bgegs rigs tshogs la rol: oṃ la las phyi yi tshogs la rol: a la las nang gi tshogs la rol: hūm̐ la las gsang ba'i tshogs la rol: hrī la las bde ba'i tshogs la rol: ho la las kho na nyid la rol: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin grub thob bcas: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : nor lha gter srung gzhi bdag la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma 'bul: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: 'di ni ya mtshan legs 'ong chos: dngos grub rgyal ba dgyes mchod 'di: 'bul bzhes bdag la gnang bar mdzod: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni spang blang bral zhing rol: gdol ba khyi phag 'dzin pa bral: ting 'dzin ro mchog de myong nas: mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur: de nas lhag ma ni: hūm̐: dang po phud dgyes rig 'dzin mchog: bar du tshogs bdag yi dam che: tha ma lhag sdud dregs pa'i tshogs: 'dir gshegs lhag mi gtor ma bzhes: hūm̐: la las zhal zas tshogs kyi lhag ma sdus: tshogs len dgyes pa'i gar byed khyugs se khyug: la las bdud rtsi chang gi lhag ma sdus: tshogs la dgyes pa'i bzhad gad ya la la: la las bha ling gtor ma'i lhag ma sdus: gtor len rngam pa'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig: la las dmar chen rak+ta'i lhag ma sdus: 'dod chags khrag 'thung lce dmar yugs se yug: la las zhe sdang rus pa'i lhag ma sdus: rus 'cha' dkrig dkrig mche ba gtsigs se gtsigs: hūm̐: shar phyogs dkar mo ma bdun lhag gtor bzhes: lho phyogs ser mo ma bdun lhag gtor bzhes: nub phyogs dmar mo ma bdun lhag gtor bzhes: byang phyogs ljang mo ma bdun lhag gtor bzhes: bka' yi pha 'bab lhag ma 'di bzhes la: bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas chad mdo brtan skyong rgyas pa logs su gsal lo//

// khi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: bskang ba bsdus pa nor bus legs brgyan bzhugs so: de nas bskang ba'i rim pa bya ba ni: mchod rdzas skong rdzas la sogs pa ci 'byor bsham: las gzhung tshogs mchod bsgral bstab byas rjes su: gsur chen spos dud snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas: hūm̐: gdod nas dag pa chos sku zhi khro'i klong : rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : ma 'gag rang byung longs sku'i rtsal snang rdzogs: rig 'dzin rgyal dgongs snyan gter thugs dam bskang : sprul sku rtsol bral gnyis med dkyil 'khor rgyas: pad+ma thod phreng mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskang : don gnyis e klong chos 'byung rang byung dbus: che mchog kī la yab yum thugs dam bskang : sku lnga mtshan bzhi 'khor lo khyab brdal te: go cha kī la rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dur khrod gnas brgyad phyogs bzhi sgo skyong ste: sde brgyad gdong can bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : phyi 'khor las bskul dregs sde dmag dpon mchog: btsan bdud lha klu dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : las mdzad phrin las dbang mo drag skyong mched: ma gza' rdor legs shan pa'i thugs dam bskang : mchog sbyin dgos 'byung dbang phyug gsang ba'i mdzod: dzam lha gter bdag gzhi bdag thugs dam bskang : mchod 'os bstod nas rang gnas legs son pa'i: pha ma rigs drug lan chags thugs dam bskang : dam bskangs g.yar dam mchog gi mchod mchog ni: phyi nang mchod pa sna bdun gzugs mdzes dang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo'i bye brag dang : spyan gzigs dkor nor 'dzam gling kun bkod pa'i: sna tshogs dpag yas zhing kun khengs pa 'dis: dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bshags bskangs mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: skong sgrol sbyor mchod legs 'ong kun tshogs kyis: sa lam theg thob kun bzang la gnas pa'i: gdod ma'i rang bzhin sku gsum yongs rdzogs shog:

bshags pa ni: hoḥ mkha' klong mi 'gyur shar grol rig pa'i rtsal: 'khor 'das dbyer med rang sa zin gyur cig: spro bsdu bcos bsgyur re dogs 'khrul pa'i tshogs: rang byung thod phreng dkyil 'khor lha la 'chags: skye med ye shes nam mkha'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: rang rig gdod ma'i rang sa zin gyur cig: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang : rgyas pa khro 'dus sde rgyud phreng ba 'don: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // gi) ༈ bla ma drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu las: gsang sgrub lus dkyil ltar sgom pa spu gri phyung rdeg bzhugs so: bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: srung 'khor dang lus dkyil sbrags pa'i khro chu'i mngon rtogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra kī la ya: sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing rab tu 'jigs: zhal gsum phyag drug gnam lcags dbal gsham can: spyi bor rta dbu rigs gsum rta skad 'tsher: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rab tu khro: gri gug ral gri rdo rje g.yas su thogs: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ sdig phur g.yon du bsnams: chu srin rngam zhal drag po'i lto bar bgrad: rdo rje'i go khrab dur khrod dpa' chas rdzogs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal gsham mtshon char 'bebs: pang du 'khyud pa'i bdud 'dul khro mo dmar: gri thod 'dzin cing spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing phem sgra sgrog: yab yum ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: spyi bor hūm̐ chen kā ras mda' gzhu 'gengs: lag g.yas rnam rgyal 'khor lo tri shul bsnams: lag g.yon gshin rjes thod dbyug dgra satwa bsnams: zhal du rta mgrin spu gri zhags pa bsnams: dpung g.yas mi g.yos ral gri zhags pa bsnams:

dpung g.yon 'dod rgyal bhan+dha rnga yab thogs: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal rim pa bzhin: rna g.yas dbyug sngon me dbal dbyug to bsnams: rna g.yon gzhan gyi mi thub rdo rje zhags: sna la bdud rtsi rgya gram dril bu bsnams: dbal khong stobs chen be con zhags pa bsnams: mtha' yi phyag rnams ri rab phur pa bsgril: kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing 'jigs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal gyi tsha zer 'phro: dur khrod chas ldan me dpung rab tu 'bar: ba spu'i bu gar rang 'dra grangs med 'phros: go cha'i lha rnams ma 'dres so sor gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru badz+ra shrī tsaṇ+ḍa kro ti kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas yang dril gyi sngags rnams bzla zhing : sku smad drag po'i bskyed rim khro chu re re bzhin gsal gdab bo: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes ci 'grub bzla: de'i tshe dpal chen rdo rje kī la ya'i snang srid thams cad khyab pa'i sku las rang 'dra grangs med 'phros pas dam sri bdud dang glags lta'i 'dre rgod rnams gzugs can gzugs med thams cad bya sgro me 'od kyis gzhob pa ltar khro chus 'ub kyis tshig par bsam: yang hūm̐ de las 'od zer gnyis mched du staing du 'phros pas hūm̐ ka ras lha'i gdon tshogs 'byung po 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: shar du 'phros pas rnam par rgyal bas dri za'i gdon tshogs kyi 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: lho ru 'phros pas gshin rjes gdon tshogs kyi 'byung po dang 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: nub tu 'phros pas rta mgrin gyis ma mo'i gdon tshogs kyi 'byung po dang 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: byang du 'phros pas bdud rtsi 'khyil bas gnod byed gyi gdon tshogs kyi 'byung po dang 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: shar lhor 'phros pas dbyug sngon can gyis me lha'i gdon tshogs kyi 'byung po dang 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: lho nub tu 'phros pas mi g.yo mgon pos srin po'i gdon tshogs kyi 'byung po dang 'dre rgod brlag par bsam:

nub byang du 'phros pas 'dod pa'i rgyal pos rlung lnga'i gdon tshogs 'byung po 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: byang shar du 'phros pas gzhan gyis mi thub pas dbang ldan bgegs kyi gdon tshogs 'byung po 'dre rgod brlag par bsam: 'og tu 'phros pas stobs po ches klu dang gdon dam sri 'byung po 'dre rgod thams cad brlag par bsam: 'khor yug phyogs med du 'phros pas khro chung grangs med pas mu stegs bdud dang gzugs can gzugs med kyi tshogs thams cad tshar bcad: gzi brjid nus pa thams cad hūm̐ gi lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis bsdus nas khro bo dang go cha khro bcu la thim pas: gzi brjid nus stobs kyis stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad shig shig yom yom du 'gul bar bsam: de'i shugs kyis ngang nas khro bo rnams phyag mtshan gong ma nas gnas 'gyur te: phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros: phur pa'i stobs kyis tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang la bar du gcod pa thams cad bsgral: lcags kyus srid gsum gzugs can gzugs med kyi snying nas bzung : zhags pas bcings nas 'ub kyis bsdus: dang po dngos po 'gugs yul ni: sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs yi dam gyi dngos grub: mkha' 'gro'i rten 'brel: chos skyong gi mthu rtsal: dam can gyi nus pa: nor lha rnams kyi phywa g.yang : lha rnams kyi tshe bsod: gnod sbyin rnams kyi longs spyod: ma hā de wa'i pho nya: dregs pa sde brgyad kyi rtsal shugs: 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i mnga' thang : btsun mo'i srid: blon po'i dbang bsgyur ba'i nus pa: glang po che'i stobs: rta mchog gi bang : dmag dpon gyi dpa' rtsal: mkhas pa'i yon tan: gzhon nu ma'i bde ba: klu'i nor bu sna tshogs dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rigs: phyogs kyi rgyal po'i mnga' thang :

gser ri'i bcud: rol mtsho'i zhag: nyi zla'i mdangs: rtsi bcud 'bras bu dang 'bru sna 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma: 'dzam gling mdzod kyi rgyan gos: rkang 'gro'i g.yang gi gnas lugs la sogs pa'i'adod rgu thams cad bdag gis dbang du bsdus nas snang srid stong khams kun tu 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam: sa ma ya: yang hūm̐ gi sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpon sogs rgol ba rtsom pa'i rigs gang yin pa la khro bcu'i dmag tshogs dang : phur pa'i char babs te bred cing sngangs yed yed du gyur cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs su bsgom: slar khro bo'i thugs ka nas yi ge tha nag po ri rab dang mnyam pa grangs med pa 'phros pas kho'i bar snang du sleb pa tsam gyis gnam lcags mchod rten nag po grangs med du gyur pa sgyogs ltar phab ste: de'i 'og rim pa dgu'i nang du mnan: mchod rten de'i 'og tu rtsibs ldan 'khor lo rlung nyi zla reg chod kyis bskor bas phye mar dum bur 'thag pa'i sha khrag rnams las gshin nyi khri dgu 'bum gyis gsol: kho'i bla rten srog yig rnams gshin yul lcags mkhar nag po'i nang du khrid nas nam yang mi shor bar bsam: de ltar dgos ched shin tu mi che na bya mi rung : gar thod du mi gtub shin tu bka' gnyan: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don nam rnal 'byor pa bdag la rgol ba'i dgra khyad par du sdang ba de la gdab par bya'o: sa ma ya: 'gugs bsgral dbang sdud zil gnon gyi gdams pa zab rgya can yin no: sa ma ya: de'ang sngon tshe thog mar khro bcu'i dkyil 'khor la bstan pa'i bskyed rim 'di nyid lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe khro bcu'i las phur bsgrubs nas dmod pa'i rig sngags bgyis pas lha min rab tu pham: de 'og bar skabs su sangs rgyas mngon byung gi rgyal po'i dus su rta phag dang ru tra 'thab pa'i tshe ru tra pham nas dur khrod kyi bkod pa sogs bkram:

de 'og lnga brgya'i dus su bskal pa ston pa mngon rdzogs sprul pa gnyis ldan gyi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang bdud kyi dmag tshogs 'thab pa'i tshe khro bcu'i gtso bo gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur rgyal hūm̐ ka ras gnam lcags kyi thog mda' ting nge 'dzin gyi shugs las bdud sde thams cad rab tu pham: de 'og tu seṅge sgra sgrogs kyi skabs su'ang nang pa sangs rgyas pa dang phyi pa mu stegs pa gnyis rtsod pa hūm̐ ka ra'i ser ba drag 'bebs kyi gdam pas gnam lcags kyi char phab ste mu stegs pa rab tu pham: de 'og pad+ma thod phreng rtsal bod du phebs pa'i dus bod kyi gdug 'dre rnams kyis tho 'tsham pas khro bcu kī la ya'i las tshogs bgyis pas lha 'dre'i dmag thams cad rab tu pham ste dam la btags: bod kyi bsam yas chos 'khor gtan la phab pa'i tshe lo paṇa bka' bab rig 'dzin rnams dang : bon mu stegs kyi mthu chen mi bzhis mtshan nyid phyi nang gi chos rtsod pa'i tshe mu stegs las rgyal tshe slar rdzu 'phrul 'gran par sbran par: hūm̐ kar khro bcu'i phur pa gdeng chog gi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te las tshogs bgyis pas phyi bon mu stegs thams cad pham zhing rab tu pham: de dag rten 'brel smon lam gyi mtshams sbyar ste drag po rnam gsum gyi skur bzhengs pa ni: rdo rje gdan du mthing nag rdo rje khro bo'i skur bzhengs: spa gro stag tshang du smug nag khro bo'i skur bzhengs: mchims phur dmar nag rdo rje khro bo'i skur bzhengs: mtha' 'dul bzhi la drag po rigs bzhi'i skur bzhengs: gzho stod ti sgror drag po pad+ma rab 'bar srid gsum g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i skur bzhengs: de'ang drag po khro 'dus me'i 'khor lo srid gsum g.yul las rgyal byed ltar na: go cha khro bcu lus la bskor ba zhes pas: drag po khro bo'i spyan gnyis su ma hā gu ru yab yum:

gnas lngar go cha lha lnga: mkhrig ma brgyad la khro bo brgyad: gtsug tor dang rdo rje nor bu pad+mar khro bo gnyis: lag mgo dang rkang mgo'i mkhrig ma bzhi la kī la rigs bzhi: lag mthil dang rkang mthil bzhi la sgo ma bzhi: lag pa'i sor mo bcu la sde dpon bcu: rkang sor rnams la pho nya dang las mkhan: dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rnams su sprul pa nyid sprul grangs las 'das pa gsal ba ste go cha 'bring po'i lugs so: sa ma ya: de ltar gcig dril khro bcu'i go cha 'di bzhin nyams su myong bas pha rol gyi bdud dang dgra las rab tu rgyal bar 'gyur ro: gnam lcags ur mo'i rgya: 'di'i kha skong las phran ni: gtor ma bdud rtsi bshams la byin rlabs grub rjes:

hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog badz+ra kī la ya: bdud 'dul bla ma drag po skur bzhengs shig: ma hā kā la rta gdong skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog phag gdong nag mo skur bzhengs shig: 'jigs byed khro bcu'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: ye shes dbyings nas khro bo'i skur bzhengs shig: thugs rjes rtser dgongs bdag la dgyes pa'i phyir: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin sgrub la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: khyad par dmod pa'i las la bsngags pa'i lha: che btsan stobs ldan khyed kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi: rig sngags stobs kyis snang srid skye 'gro bkums: mthu rtsal shugs kyis khro bcu'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: yang sprul ba spu'i bu ga re re nas: khro bcu'i gnam lcags thog ser char du 'bebs: spu gri mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rlung ltar 'tshubs: byad ma 'dre rgod dam sri bdud kyi rigs: log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po thams cad la: gnam lcags ri rab phur bu'i ser ba phob: chu 'dzin nag po drag po'i rlung bskyod bzhin: gling bzhi ri rab sa yi 'og tu snyol: bskal pa'i mun nag 'khrigs pa'i lhums su skyol: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i gdan la phob: 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum dus la bab: dgra bo byad ma sdig can shor ra re: da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra kro ta shrī tsaṇ+ḍa kro ti kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta ḍā sha ya ḍāk+ki sarba bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ ru tra a mu ka badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dam sri a kriṣ+ḍa sarba tse dī ta rur+ṇa rur+ṇa byad ma sha pa tha bhan+dha gnod byed na ti pu rak+ṣa la raṃ dz+wa la tik+ṣa pra kīn+ta bhu mi gu pa ta mā ra ya bi ra ṇa bi ra ṇa ha la ha la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs te do gal med na phyogs su 'bul: do gal che na gong bzhin me thab tu 'phang ba'am:

dmag thab tu 'phang ba khro chu ri rab srid pa las phur ltar 'phen pa gnas skabs dang bstun: rjes shes hūm̐ yig la mnyam par bzhag: phyi rol srung 'khor yum la thim: yum khro bcu la thim: khro bcu yab la thim: yab hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ zhabs kyu: zhabs kyu ha khog: ha khog mgo sked: mgo sked zla tshes: zla tshes thig le: thig le nā da: nā da skye med chos sku'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag: rtag tu hūm̐ sgrub bya na rtsa sngags brgya dang brgyad bgrang : de man chad hūm̐ gang 'grub rtag tu rgyun khyer bya: hūm̐ bye ba dgu grangs kyi tshad yin: dmigs pa gong bzhin blos rgyas bsdus dpag: de ltar nyams len 'grub gyur na: lag na rdo rjes 'jigs mi 'gyur: 'jig rten rnams la lta ci smos: ban bon phur thogs 'bum 'gras kyang : rang nus kho rang steng du bzlog: khyad par mtha' bzhi dmag dpung la: dmod pa bor chog gdams pa yin: mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gtsug lag tu: drag po 'di nyid bzhengs grub cing : khro bcu'i las mtha' bgyis pa na: mu stegs dam sri dpung bskyed pa'i: ma rungs mtha' bzhi'i 'gong po yi: dmag gi ru bzhi 'khor gyur cing : myur du bzlog par the tshom med: shan pa sde gsum a thaṃ rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: spu gri rgya: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong smug po lha rtse nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus pa'o// // ngi) bla ma drag po kī la ya'i go cha khro bcu dang bcas pa'i spros med a nu'i lugs kyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ bdud 'dul bla ma drag po kī la ya la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang drag po kī la ya'i go cha khro bcu dang bcas pa'i spros med a nu'i lugs kyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la sngon 'gro tshogs zhing yid kyis gsal btab la/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa chab gcig tu bgyi ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/

dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sogs nas chen por bsngo/ tshog zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru badz+ra shrī tsaṇ+ḍa kro ti kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brjod pa'i brten dang rten pa'i dkyil 'khor wal gyis gsal gdab par bya'o/ / hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod dkyil 'khor rang shar dbus: ye shes chos 'byung mthing nag me dpung klong : bdud bzhi dam sri rgyal bsen srin po'i gdan: nyi zla pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan gyi steng : gnam lcags rdo rje rab 'bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: de nyid gnas gyur bla ma drag por gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal badz+ra kī la ya: sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing rab tu 'jigs: zhal gsum phyag drug gnam lcags dbal gsham can: spyi bor rta dbu rigs gsum rta skad 'tsher: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rab tu khro: gri gug ral gri rdo rje g.yas su thogs: bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ sdig phur g.yon du bsnams: chu srin rngam zhal drag po'i lto bar bgrad: rdo rje'i go khrab dur khrod dpa' chas rdzogs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal gsham mtshon char 'bebs: pang du 'khyud pa'i bdud 'dul khro mo dmar: gri thod 'dzin cing spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing phem sgra sgrog: yab yum ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: spyi bor hūm̐ chen kā ras mda' gzhu 'gengs: lag g.yas rnam rgyal 'khor lo tri shul bsnams: lag g.yon gshin rjes thod dbyug dgra satwa bsnams: zhal du rta mgrin spu gri zhags pa bsnams: dpung g.yas mi g.yos ral gri zhags pa bsnams: dpung g.yon 'dod rgyal bhan+dha rnga yab thogs: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal rim pa bzhin: rna g.yas dbyug sngon me dbal dbyug to bsnams: rna g.yon gzhan gyi mi thub rdo rje zhags: sna la bdud rtsis rgya gram dril bu bsnams: dbal khong stobs chen be con zhags pa bsnams:

mtha' yi phyag rnams ri rab phur pa bsgril: kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag rngam zhing 'jigs: sku smad gnam lcags dbal gyi tsha zer 'phro: dur khrod chas ldan me dpung rab tu 'bar: ba spu'i bu gar rang 'dra grangs med 'phros: go cha'i lha rnams ma 'dres so sor gsal: zhes gsal brtan dag gsum ldan par bskyed cing rim gyi rtsis thebs pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i rim pa ni/ hūm̐: de ltar bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha: du mar snang yang ngang du gcig: dkyil 'khor spro bsdu bcos mi bya: rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang : rang dang lhan cig skyes pa ste: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med gyur/ / de kho na nyid gyi ting 'dzin la ci gnas su bzhag pa dang*/ mthar bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa ni/ thugs mchog phyag rdor thugs kar hūm̐/ /tha mar sngags kyi phreng ba las/ /'od zer mthing nag me tshwa 'phros/ /srid gsum gdug pa tshar thag bcad/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs rdul du rlog /'khor ba ka dag dbyings su yal/ /snod bcud sku gsum zhing du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru badz+ra shrī tsaṇ+ḍa kro ti kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sam spros med/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes ci 'grub bzla/ de'i tshe dpal chen rdo rje kī la ya'i snang srid thams cad khyab pa'i sku las rang 'dra grangs med pa 'phros pas/ dam sri bdud dang glags lta'i 'dre rgod gzugs can gzugs med thams cad bya sgro me 'ob kyis gzhob pa ltar khro chus 'ub kyis tshig par bsam/ yang hūm̐ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ khro bo bcu bskul/ phyogs bcu'i gdon chen bcu btul/ 'byung po 'dre rgod thams cad brlag par bsam/ 'khor yug phyogs med du 'phros pas khro chung grangs med pas mu stegs bdud dang gzugs can gzugs med kyi tshogs thams cad tshar bcad/ gzi brjid nus pa thams cad hūm̐ gi lcags kyu'i bsdus nas rang la thim pa'i gzi brjid nus stobs rgyas pas/

stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dbang du bsdus nas snang srid stong khams kun tu 'gran zla dang bral bar bsam/ yang bdag gi 'od gyis phog pas phyi nang snod bcud snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi 'khor lor sad par mos la/ rig stong chos sku'i rang zhal blta zhing mnyam rjes ris med ka dag chen por la bzla bar bya'o/ /'gugs bsgral dbang sdud zil gnon gyi gdams pa zab rgya can gyi man ngag gzhung ltar spros shes par bya'o/ zhes gu h+ya'i ming gis rang la mkho phyir gter gzhung las btus pa yin no// // ci) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i bka' srung ma mo'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so// // ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i gtor ma tsit+ta zur brgyad kyi gzugs yod pa la dmar gyis brgyan te bshams la/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bskal pa me 'bar khrag mtsho'i klong : rtsub 'gyur chos nyid dkyil 'khor nas: kun bzang ma gcig khros pa las: e ka dzā ṭi dmar nag gzugs: ral gcig spyan gcig nu ma gcig: rkang gcig stobs ldan 'dzam gling nyul: phyag gnyis spu gri dgra snying rol: ral pa sprugs pas dug char 'bebs: khrag nad dmar yams dgra la gtong : 'khor ni srog gcod srin mo bzhi: sha za khrag 'thung ma mos bskor: sngags srung khro gnyer ral pa bsigs: gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma che: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngags srung khro mo dgra la bh+yo: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: sha za khrag 'thung mtshan ma gtor: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: khrag skyug nad kyis sod la shog: gsang sngags gnyan la dgra byung na: nyan thos yin kyang myur du sgrol: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' stsal pa: ji ltar khas blangs dam tshig bzhin: dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo rak+sha e ka dzā ṭi trig dgra bo mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phyogs gtsang sar ram dgra phyogs su bskyal:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs pa'o// // chi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i bka' srung khyab 'jug gi gtor ma 'bul ba ni: gtor ma bya rog gis mtshan pa bshams la: hūm̐: dug rlangs dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong : gdug pa'i bu yug thog char dbus: ki kang rngam klong nang shed nas: srog bdag khyab 'jug nag po bzhengs: dbu dgu mun rub 'khrigs pa'i gzugs: zhal nas dug rlangs chi li li: spyan dmar tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: srog gzan bya rog dbang rtags rdzogs: g.yas gnyis thog mda' spu gri bsnams: g.yon gnyis lcags gzhu rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: sku stod srin po sku smad sbrul: mgo lus khyab par mig gis gtams: de'i nang sde brgyad dmag tshogs 'gyed: lte bar khro zhal bstan dgra 'joms: g.yon du srog gcod ma mo rngam: 'khor du gza' brgyad gdong mo 'gyed: hrul du sha za khrag 'thung bskor: ki kang thog 'bebs nag po che: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sdang ba'i dgra la thog ser phob: gza' nad steng grib 'tshub tu chugs: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra dang bgegs: sgos su bdag la sdang ba rnams: srog gcod dbugs longs snying khrag 'thung : dus la bab bo sa ma ya: sngon tshe gsang bdag pad+ma yis: dam tshig ci ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis bskul: ma thogs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hrīḥ rā hu la ki kang hrī shag ru raṃ dgra bo'i srog rtsa la yaṃ kha raṃ khā hi: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs 'bul la: khyab 'jug dug mtsho nas khol du phyung ba'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gser gling nas karma las 'brel rtsal gyis gdan drangs pa'o// // ji) ༈ kī la che mchog khro rgyal las: skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul bzhugs so: gter srung skyes bu dam can gyi gtor 'bul ni: 'bru nag gam ni gang rung zan: ra mgos mtshan pa'i dpal gtor gzugs: ra yi sha khrag gsur btang zhing :

rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐ bh+yo tri: byang shar me rlung 'bar ba'i klong : skyes bu badz+ra sa dhu rtsal: dmar nag ra skyes kham pa chibs: phyag gnyis rdo rje dgra snying rol: btsan mdung ru dar lhabs se lhab: sku la dar dmar phod chen gsol: stag ral gzig shubs ral gris brgyan: btsan dmag yang 'khor sha za sde: drag bskul las la bos pa'i tshe: ma thogs gnas 'dir myur du byon: slob dpon ji ltar bka' bsgos bzhin: zab gter gnyan gyi bstan pa srungs: ra yi sha khrag gsur mchod bzhes: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du bcol: nyin mtshan srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod: gal te nyams pa'i dgra bo yi: gnod tshe gdug sems 'ching gyur tshe: skyes bu dam can las la chos: btsan rgod shan pa'i dmag sna drongs: the'u rang 'gong po'i phung shig thongs: yang 'khor sprul pa'i ru 'dren 'gyed: chos chos sdang ba'i dgra la chos: dgra bo'i mi nor phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i yul zhing ser bas khongs: shwa kha khram 'debs snying rlung gis: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: pho rgyud mo rgyud mngal nas skoms: rigs rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: dgra la dmag sna 'dren pa'i tshe: nam mkhar 'brug zhon nyi khri stong : dgra yul thog gis khongs la shog: bar snang seng zhon nyi khri stong : dgra la smyo 'bog snying gzer thongs: sa gzhi ra zhon nyi khri stong : dgra la grib rgod sna tshogs thongs: sprul pa pho nya las mkhan rnams: ka cha dkor nor phyir la rgyugs: yang 'khor gcan spyang sha za'i tshogs: dgra bo'i nor rdzas bla 'khyams sdud: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: dam can dregs pa btsan gyi tshogs: sha khrag dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: gsang bdag rdo rje khro bo dang : dregs 'dul snang srid zil gnon la: yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug tu: khyod kyis srog phul bka' bsgos bzhin: zab chos gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod:

ka cha chas ka gang zhig de: nyes can rkun 'phrog bcom srid na: myur du phyir 'brongs dgra bo sgrol: gal te nyes 'gal byung srid na: skyes bu dam can med do skad: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: rgyud srung bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra sa dhu tsa rak+sha nag po dgra bo'i don snying la khā hi khā hi: zhes gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngam gtsang sar bskyal: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma hūm̐ gis phag laur brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o// // nyi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i gter srung dmu bdud klu gsum gyi gtor 'bul byad ma tshar gcod bzhugs so: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: dmu bdud klu gsum gtor ma ni: dmu la zur gsum rtse mo nor bus mtshan pa: bdud la gtor nag zur gsum mi mgos mtshan pa: klu la gtor ma nor bu sbrul dkris pad+mas mtshan pa bya zhing chu gtsang gis bran la: dgra bgegs gzugs la byin rlabs bya: bdag nyid kī la yar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dmu bdud klu gsum gtor ma len pa'i slad du spyan drangs: om̐ gam bu ra du ra nā ga tsi dza dzaḥ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shin tu nag cing dug rlangs sprin gyi dbus: dmu bdud dmar nag btsan zer 'phro ba'i gzugs: rngam pa'i kha gdangs gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: sku la dar nag dbu la 'ob zhu gsol: phyag gnyis dar nag zhags nag glog 'khyug bsnams: chibs su dred mong kham nag smyon pa chibs: rbad pa tsam gyis 'dzam gling yud kyis bskor: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar gtor 'di bzhes la: yang zab gsang sngags bstan la sdang ba rnams: da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: mun gling nag po tsha ngar 'khrigs pa'i dbus: nag po bdud rje kha la me 'bar ni: dmar nag gdug pa'i kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs: sku la mun nag g.yung drung swag zhu gsol: phyag gnyis ru dar mi snying dmar po bsnams:

chibs su rta nag rlung gi gshog can chibs: drag tu rbad tshe dgra yul had kyis 'debs: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: zab gsang gsang sngags bstan la sdang ba rnams: da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngo nag 'tshub cing mthing brag rgyas pa'i klong : klu bdud nag po dug gi spu gri ni: dug gi rlangs 'phro dgra la kha rlangs 'debs: srin gzugs sbrul mjug rus sbal mgo dgu chibs: gcer bu 'tshubs shing dug sbrul dgu yis brgyan: phyag gnyis spu gri dug gi sbrul zhags bsnams: drag tu rbad tshe dgra la nad rlangs 'thib: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: zab gsang gsang sngags bstan la sdang ba'i dgra: da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: drag po bka' srung sde gsum dus la bab: dam nyams log par 'dren pa'i dgra dang bgegs: myur du sgrol la sha khrag dbang po rol: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' ma bcag: bar du bai ro tsa na'i dam ma bkral: da lta sngags 'chang bskul ba don ma chung : drag po bka' yi phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ gam bu ra du ra nā ga tsi i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi:

zhes 'bul lo: kī la chos kyi bka' srung mthu bo che: zab chos bstan pa rgyas pa'i mel tshe mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: gter ston karma las 'brel rtsal gyis brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ti) ༈ dbang drag che mchog kī la ya las: gter srung dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i gtor 'bul bzhugs so: bla ma drag po kī lar 'dud: gter srung bzhi yi mchod thabs ni: bswe phor zangs snod gang rung du: dpal bshos bzhi bshams dkar dmar brgyan: skyems phud mchod pa ci 'byor bsham: yi dam gsal bar bdag bskyed 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: bdag nyid khro mo dbal gsham sku: gtum rngam dpa' chas rdor phur bsnams: sku smad dbal phur bgegs la gzir: sprul 'khor ye shes dregs pa ni: mdun du khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i dbus: lha klu btsan bdud sha za rnams: mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur: hūm̐: lha btsan dmag dpon myur mgyogs pa: sku mdog dmar smug zhi ba'i chas: dar thod dkar zhing ru mtshon dkar: zhags dkar 'dzin cing rta dkar zhon: sprul pa mi dkar bye ba 'bum: yang sprul lcags spyang dkar po 'gyed: hūm̐: mi bdud 'byams pa khrag mgo nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dgra satwa dang : spu gri ru mtshon nag po g.yab: rta nag zhon cing mi nag 'gyed: yang sprul dom nag grangs med 'gyed: hūm̐: btsan rgod a bswe mi dmar gzugs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis srog bdag gzugs: btsan dmar spu gri zhags pa dang : mche gtsigs dgra bo'i glo snying rol: rta dmar zhon cing mi dmar 'gyed: yang sprul zangs 'phar lhang lhang zug: hūm̐: klu bdud nā ga kha thun ni: mthing nag mun pa'i tsha ngar can: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags sdig pa dang : chu srin rgyal mtshan dug zor 'dzin: rta sngon zhon cing mi sngon 'gyed: yang sprul dug sbrul sa gzhi khengs: shan pa gnod sbyin mched bzhi'i tshogs: sngon tshe gzho stod ti sgro ru:

ban bon rgyud srung khas blangs bzhin: dmar gyi gtor ma khrag zhag dang : mchod gtor rgya mtsho'i 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bskul rbad bka' bcol bzhin: zab gsang bstan pa rgyas pa dang : rgyu sbyor bar chod rkyen sel ba: lo nyes sad ser zhi ba dang : 'byor drug bstan pa rgyas pa yi: phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: bka' yi tha tshig gnad nas bskul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams: ma thogs myur du 'grub par mdzod: oṃ bswau a tri kha thun na tri sha du ru ru tri nā ga phur dza dzaḥ i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: rgyun mchod chos skyong sgrub thabs 'di: phrin las nam mkha'i glog las myur: ban bon gnyis kyi srung ma'i phyir: ri khrod pho brang brag la sbas: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter srung gi dngos su gzugs bstan bskul phyir/ karma las 'brel gling pas bris/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // thi) ༈ dbang drag kī la ya'i srung ma nyer bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs bzhugs so/ rang nyid dpal chen 'bar ba yi/ /gzi byin 'bar ba'i stobs shugs kyis/ /sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams dang*/ /'byung lnga snod bcud mkha' klong nas/ /bka' dang gter srung rgya mtsho rnams/ /mchod sbyin slad du spyan drangs gyur/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ dbyings las ma g.yos cho 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /snying srung mkha' 'gro sde lnga zhing skyong dbang*/ /ma gza' rdor legs lha bdud btsan klu dang*/ /dge bsnyen sde bzhi lha srin sde brgyad sogs/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la/ /rngam brjid drag po'i mthun rdzas sprin ltar gtibs/ /drag mchod sha khrag gling bzhi'i khyon ltar bdal/ /mngon spyod las byed shan pa rlung ltar 'tshubs/ /nyams dgra'i bla tshe srog dbugs bun ltar g.yo/ /sman raka gtor mchod dwangs ma'i zer ltar 'khrugs/

/'bod rdzas sgrub rdzas skong rdzas mnyes pa'i rdzas/ /stong gsum 'jig rten khams gsum srid pa'i sprin/ /thugs rjes rtsal las 'gog med shar ba'i dpyid/ /ye shes 'jig rten pho rgyud mo rgyud sogs/ /bdud 'dul dpal gyi bka' nyan rnams la 'bul/ /srid pa dregs sde'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang*/ /thogs med phrin las gnyan gyi g.yar dam stsol/ om̐ pā shaṃ de wi ha ri ni sa bh+yo ra tri e du tsa na yak+sha tsa tur a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ phrin las myur mgyogs tha tshig gnyer ba'i tshogs/ khyod la phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /chos bzhin sgrub la bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dpal ye shes snyan grags gong du 'phel/ /lha 'dre mi gsum 'dod rgu dbang du sdus/ /bstan dgra sgos dgra zur dgra thal bar rlog khyad par zab gsang theg pa'i bstan pa 'di/ /nyi ltar gsal zhing mkha' ltar khyab cing brtan/ /snod bcud bde 'byor chos bzhin spyod pa sogs/ /bdud 'dul pad+ma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las lhun 'grub mdzod/ ces pa'ang lha ri gyang rdo'i dben gnas nas dbang drag kī la ya'i bsnyen sgrub kyi tshe skyid grong smyon pas nyung bsdus 'khyer bder bkod pa'o// // di) ༈ gter srung myur mgyogs sde bzhi'i gsol mchod pho nya myur 'bod bzhugs so: gter srung 'bar ba mched bzhi'i gsol mchod ni: rang nyid dpa' bo thod phreng rtsal du bskyed cing mchod rdzas ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs nas: hūm̐: 'jigs rung rdo rje 'tshubs pa'i pho brang nas: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: rab rngam srin po khros pa'i pho brang nas: rtag rgyal 'jigs byed bdud rje gshegs su gsol: dmar nag me rlung drag 'bar pho brang nas: btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung gshegs su gsol:

zab gsang bka' gter drag po'i pho brang nas: gza' rgod shan pa dmar nag gshegs su gsol: oṃ dhe wa tsa du baṃ tri dza rā hu la hu ra ti sa mā ya dza dzaḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dregs pa'i sde dpon bka' skyong dmag tshogs la: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: dkar dmar brgyan pa'i 'dod yon bsang mchod dang : sman raka bdud rtsi gtor mas thugs dam bskang : ci bcol las sgrubs phrin las rogs ldan mdzod: oṃ dhe wa tsa du baṃ tri dza rā hu la hu ra ti pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: rga rgyal drag po gnas kyi bka' srung che: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba zhi ma khro: dung khrab rmog zhu stag ral gzig shubs bkra: phyag gnyis ral gri ru mtshon dgra la phyar: chibs su lha rta dkar po rlung gshog chibs: lha dmag dbang sdud sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: zab gter rgya mtsho'i bka' yi bstan pa srungs: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dus 'khrug nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: srog bdud nag po'i dregs byed rta nag zhon: sku mdog mun nag char sprin g.yos pa'i gzugs: lcags khrab rmog zhu dar nag ber chen g.yo: stag ral gzig shubs dar mdung lcags kyu gdengs: bdud dmag g.yul 'gyed pha rol rgol ba 'joms: zab gter rgya mtsho'i bka' yi bstan pa srungs: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dus 'khrug nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sha za zangs mdog me dpung gdong pa can: btsan rgod brda skyong mi zan dmar po che: dmar smug mdog can zangs khrab sing sing khrol: rmog phod dar dmar ru mtshon lhab lhub bskyod: stag ral gzig shubs btsan mdung zhags pa 'khyug: zangs rta mdur ldang sa gzhi 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: mthu stobs dbang phyug sangs rgyas bstan bshig sgrol: zab gter rgya mtsho'i bka' yi bstan pa srungs: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dus 'khrug nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐: shan pa dmar nag rol pa skya bdun ni: tshwa tshwa skar ltar las mkhan pho nya 'khyug: srin po khros 'dra'i drag shul dmar nag zhal: khrab rmog phub la don snying tsit+tas brgyan: dmar nag ru mtshon phyar zhing dgra yul 'joms: stag ral gzig shubs brgyan cing zab gter srungs: bdud chas rta rgyug drag byed shigs se shig: 'khor ni skyes bu srog bdag stong gis bskor: lcags spyang gcan gzan srog len zhums se zhum: bka' bzhin sgrub tshe las kyi bya ra mdzad: zab gter rgya mtsho'i bka' yi bstan pa srungs: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dus 'khrug nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ki kang dmar nag srin po rā hu la: gza' rgod rgyu skar pho nya sde brgyad rnams: sha za khrag 'thung sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: mkha' la drag rgyu gnam lcags thog mda' 'phen: dam las 'gal ba'i dgra bo'i srog la rol: zab gter rgya mtsho'i bka' yi bstan pa srungs: dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: dus 'khrug nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma'am bsang mchod dus dang bstun: gter srung sde bzhi'i gsol mchod gcig tu dril ba'o: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // ni) ༈ kī la ya che mchog khro rgyal las: gnod sbyin shan pa spu gri gsum gyi gsol mchod bzhugs pa lags so: de nas bka' srung shan pa spun gsum gyi gtor sgrub kyi cha lag phran bu ni: rin chen snod gtsang nang du dkar gtor 'dab can g.yas su bdud gtor g.yon gcus: g.yon du btsan gtor g.yas gcus dang bcas mtshams su mtheb skyus bskor bar bshams la: hūm̐: lha yi dge bsnyen drag po rtsal: bka' skyong lha yi dmag dpon ni: zhi ba'i cha lugs shrī ṭaḥ las kyi sde dpon dar mdung bsnams: ngang dkar rnga sngon chibs su chib: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri bsnams: lha dmag bswo sgra di ri ri:

dge bsnyen dmag dpon nyi li li: ma g.yel las mdzod bka' skyong rje: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sgrub mchog bka' dang bstan pa srungs: phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: du las skyes pa'i srog bdud ngam gyi rjes: hu lu'i sgra sgrogs dregs pa'i yang rje bo: char sprin mdog can dgra satwa lcags kyu bsnams: khrab rmog phub la rnga zhol nag pos brgyan: bdud rta rlung gshog 'dzam gling skad cig nyul: drag rtsal myur mgyogs bdud po skra dkar gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud po srog bdud nag po'i dus la bab: ra tsa du ru ka lang sha la bh+yoḥ phrin las nam mkha'i gzi brjid thog ltar rgyugs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: tsa tri las mkhan shan pa srog bdag ni: me dpung mdog can bse khrab rmog zhu gsol: stag ral gzig shubs btsan mdung zhags pa 'khyug: ma rungs snying 'byin mche bas ma mchu mnan: bdud rta dmar zhur skad cig las la nyul: hur thum srog bdag shan pa dmar po'i tshogs: tha ma'i srog bdag ma lus 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: hur thum nad kyi mtha' dmag srog dbugs sdud: las byed dmar po ma g.yel dgra srog chod: drag rtsal dus la bab bo sa ma ya: oṃ dhe wa a du tsa tri mā ra ya tri ka ta dmigs bya'i sha khrag rnam lnga la kha kha khā hi khā hi: gtor ma zur gsum g.yas gcus g.yon gcus pad gtor gsum dang gang 'os phyogs su 'bul: rgya rgya rgya: hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis phag zla ba'i yar mar tshes kyi nyin phyed la rin chen 'od 'bar gser gling nas gdan drangs pa'o// // pi) ༈ mtshon srung rdo rje'i go khrab mi shigs pa'i pha lam bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: dregs pa yang gsang spu gri 'di: las tshogs rdo rje'i go khrab yin: pad+ma bdag gis bstan par bya: gsaun cig jo mo mtsho rgyal ma:

ma 'ongs sum cu kha dar dus: mtha' dmag dbus dar sa steng gang : mtshon cha sna tshogs bstan pa dar: las su dmag dang 'khrug pa byed: gdon du rgyal po 'dre srin dar: mtshon du du ru rdzas sbyor 'phen: gri btsan sha mgo rlung ltar 'tshub: mi phyed de yis hab sha byed: de la srung ba'i rim pa bstan: mi 'jigs rdo rje'i pha lam 'di: mtsho rgyal khyod kyis yi ger thob: ma 'ongs sems can don du sbos: mang du ma spel sa ma ya: war+dheṃ: de la bri thabs rnam pa gsum: dug gi shog bu ngar ldan la: gnam lcags rtsibs kyi ri mo bris: lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma bri: de steng hūm̐ yig mthing nag bri: mdun du rim bzhin: la si dhi na ka ka: de'i phyi rim la: hai dza dza hūm̐ hūm̐ mda' mtshon gyi gnod pas mi tshugs par srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa: badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes bri: de'i phyi rim la: ṭaṭaṭa: nā ga bā su ka ma ma sid+dhi: ṭaṭaṭaṭa: hūm̐ṭa: 'chang ba po la srungs shig: rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra ma ma rak+ṣi ṇa ha ri ni sa dzaḥ om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la badz+ra ṇi rak+ṣa: gu ru hūm̐ hūm̐: de'i phyi rim la: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na zhes bri: mdun du rdo rje ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ: 'khor lo gri gug me dpung phur pa: mda' bcas bri/ rdzas ni rnam pa gri khrag gri lcags: pha lam gyi rdo: nag po dgu sbyor ri sna dgu'i sa rdo chu: mgar ba'i khrag dang skra: glang chen gyi rus pa: rgya rtsi dug lo: rin po che sna lnga dang : dar sna lnga: nas 'bru nag po bdun la: ṭaṭa ṇi mtshon gyis mi tshugs par srungs shig rak+ṣa: zhes khri tsho gcig sngags: rab gnas bya la dar dmar gyis dril zhing zangs lcags kyi gwa'u nang du bcug la mgul du 'chang : wa se sgo mo bud med la 'dzem pa gces: pad+ma bdag gi snying bcud yin: mtshon la rdo rje'i go khrab yin: dgra la rdo rje'i go khrab yin: rin chen gter gyi nor bu yin: mang du ma spel sa ma ya: hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis gser gl̥ng nas gdan drangs pa'o//

// phi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs: ngan sngags dug gi par bu'i srung bzlog gi 'khor lo bzhugs so: bla ma drag po khrag 'thung sku la 'dud: de nas bsrung ba'i dpe'u ris 'god pa ste: thog mar srung ba la: dri bzang gis byugs pa'i shog bur 'bri ba'i lag len khol du phyung ba: thog mar lte ba rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbus su hūm̐: de nas mu khyud la rtsa sngags bskor ba'i sham bur: bdag sgrub pa po la pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha gang gis kyang mi tshugs par srungs shig rak+ṣa: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: oṃ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ rat+na kā+-i la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ pad+ma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ karma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐: de 'og phyogs bzhir rigs 'gres bshangs: de'i phyi rol rtsibs lnga ru: go cha'i sngags bri: rtsibs mchan ging lnga'i sngags bri: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bcu ru: khro bo bcu'i sngags bri: rtsibs mchan la sde dpon bcu'i sngags bri: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po'i mthar srung ba'i 'dod gsol kha bsgyur bris: de'i phyi rol me ri'i dkyil du rdo rje rgya gram bzhi: lcags sdig bzhi: khyung bzhi bcas bri: rdzas ni rin chen sna lnga'i phye ma: khyad par gri lcags phye ma: thog lcags kyi phye ma: mchod rten dkar po'i sa sna bcas rdzas su byug: spru nag: bong nga : shing kun: ga pur rnams kyis ngar gdab: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rab tu gnas par bya: de'ang sprin chen 'khor lo lta bur 'bub pa'am: lus la 'chang ba skabs dang bstun: sa ma ya: de nas bya khyung 'khor lo ni: lte ba'i dbus

khroṃḥ rtsibs bzhir: trig khroṃ bh+yoḥ rtsibs mchan la: ma ni mā ra bh+yoḥ de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: mā ra ya du zlog zlog: pho rgyud khro bo mo rgyud khro mo'i drag sngags thun sngags dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: de'i phyi rol rtsibs drug tu: du na du na zlog: rtsibs mchan la: du shan du shan zlog: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: he phu lu ni zlog: ṇi phu lu ṇi zlog: ban bon sngags pa'i zor kha yi dam lha yis bka' chad chos skyong 'khu ba'i gdug rtsub sde brgyad byad kha dam sri gdug pa'i dmod pa dang bcas pa thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: gh+ri ha na ku ru gnod byed bhig nan rbad chod mā ra ya zlog: phyi rol khyung gi sku 'khor bris: bya khyung gi 'dra 'bag bzo na 'khor lo me ris bskor ba zhig bya khyung gi rgyab tu 'dzugs: rdzas ni dug dang khrag khyung lnga sman chen bcas kyis ngar btab ste byad bzlog zor mda' dug gi par bu zhes so: sa ma ya: de nas zlog 'khor 'bring po ni: lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum bya: dbus su hūm̐: g.yas g.yon mdun nas 'di ltar 'god: khroṃ raṃ bh+yoḥ de'i phyi rol mu khyud du: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur: pha rol gyi dgra bo lha srung ban bon srung gur thams cad bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog sarba yaṃ gi a dhi bha ba tu lo ka du na zlog zlog: de'i phyi rol rtsibs lnga ru: go cha lha lnga'i snying po: rtsibs mchan la ging chen lnga'i sngags: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro ta kro ti ya he raṃ ma tri shug rtse ging ka ra he laṃ bhi shu bha na tri tri he truṃ myag ka ra bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog pha rol byad ma gnod byed bī sha mā ra ya dam sri pur thum trig myog mtha' 'khob gdug pa'i dmag dpung chum chum zlog zlog: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bcu la khro bcu'i sngags bris: rtsibs mchan la:

ka li ka li ta bh+yoḥ ka dza bhur wa ti bh+yoḥ u raṃ ta bh+yoḥ gha tri a ni bh+yoḥ shu na ra ga ra bh+yoḥ shu na tsa du bh+yoḥ a mu ka bh+yoḥ ha he shaṃ bh+yoḥ na ga shu bh+yoḥ tri du tri bh+yoḥ de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ ma hā dhe wa u ma dhe ya sha phu byā+e sha a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya shan+ḍa shaṃ mo bzlog rak+sha ma ti zlog: e ka tsa ra zlog: e ka ya ma zlog: bhe tu bhe na zlog: lha srin sde brgyad kyis byad du bcug pa khram la btab pa rlung la bskur ba chu la gtad pa sa la sbas pa me la bsregs pa zor kha 'debs pa thams cad sarba bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: pha rol dgra bo byad ma'i steng du zlog zlog: de'i phyi rol tu mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi rtse phyi la bstan pa'i phreng ba me ris bskor: mi rta khyi gsum gyi khrag: bya gcan ri dwags thams cad kyi khrag: 'brong dang rkyang gi snying khrag: gtsod khrag bcas la glang chen smyon pa'i dug khrag rnams kyis ngar blud pa'i rdzas byug: zlog sngags lok+t+ri pā las rab tu gnas: bzlog pa'i rtse'am rgyan du 'dzugs: bzlog pa 'phang ba'i tshe gal che na me hom du gtor chen bcas bsreg: dmigs pa ni rang nyid drag po kī la ya gsal ba'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i rigs bzhi'i go cha khro bcu rnams kyis sra ba'i go gyon: rno ba'i mtshon thogs te gnam lcags kyi thog dang spu gri sogs mtshon cha grangs med srid pa las kyi sgyogs ltar 'phros: dgra bo'i yul khams thams cad brlag cing bcom ste thal ba rlung gis g.yeng ba ltar gtor bar bsgom: 'di nyid bsad pa spu gri reg chod kyi gzhung nas so: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o// // bi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las rdzas sngags bla gnas srung bzlog mnan gsum dmigs rim bcas pa ni ha ra ta sma:

bla ma thod phreng bdud 'dul las: snying po'i yang gsang spu gri bstan: sgrub gnas phyi nang sde brgyad dang : dregs pa rang srog bstan pa'i phyir: pad+ma bdag gis yi ger bkod: me yi spu gri dug gi par bu ni: snyigs dus tha ma'i srung bzlog bsad gsum ste: spu gri skor la rnam pa gsum du bstan: phyi pa mu stegs bzlog pa'i sde brgyad ni: dbang po brgya byin: dri za: thag bzang : klu rgyal: gza' bdud bya rog mgo: tshangs pa sde lnga: grul bum 'dzin bcu drug: bdud ha la rmu rmu btsan: de ni tha mi rang log gi skor ro: gsang ba sngags kyi srung ma: rang gnas su sdod pa: bstan pa srung ba: rang gnas su yul grur 'khor ba: nā ga ra tsa sog ma me: tsa mu tri: ya mān+ta ka: rak+ta du pra ma: gza' ha ra: bdud mo gser mig: ma hā dhe wa: sman btsun 'brug grags: las la bskul drag rtsal can: ma rdzas kyi skor gcig bsdus: kha rta ge na dz+wa la: me'i spu gri rtsa tri nag po dug gi par bu mā ra ya b+ba: du pra ma shu la ra nā ga ra tsa: rak+sha kriṣ+ṭa: e ka dzā ṭi: ya mān+ta ka: dharma rā dzaḥ rā hu la: ma hā dhe wa: gzugs su 'khor ba bla gnas chags pa spu gri'i skor ro: mi mthong ba rang rgyud bsreg pa'i las bskul du 'os pa rang rgyud nas spros pa: ha ling ka: mu kha le: rak+ṣa kriṣ+ṇa: byi na ya ka: ma mo las byed ma: klu btsan myur mgyogs rol pa rtsal: ya mān+ta ka: ha la yak+ṣa du pra mo bya rog mgo brtsigs spros pa las la chas pa yang gsang gi skor ro: phyi nang gsang gsum sngags la gnas pa: bla gzugs la chags pa: 'khor lo la gnas pa: yul gru bsrung ba ni: dam can rdo rje legs pa: gnam thel dkar po: yam shud dmar po: btsan snying drung : yul lha sa srung : shrī ma hā kā la kriṣ+ṇa rdo rje rab khros: bdud bye ba gug ring : ma mo srog gcod snang srid bdag mo: dge bsnyen sbrul mgo can ni: rgyug lam 'phrog pa las la bskul ba'i bka' gnyan gyi skor ro:

las la dbang zhing gnas pa: thang lha: mkhar nag: tshangs pa: spom ra: rong lha sa bstan gyi skor ro: tsakra tsa tri paṃ mā ra ya: de'i skor las rdzas kyi rim pa ni: pha wang long rdo la sre mong khrag gi tri'u dzaḥ dar dmar po la pra ti dzaḥ rā hu la dzaḥ bya mtshal lu'i khrag gis bris: zangs khab sor bzhi tshon skud kyi a chings rgya: ༈ dar mthing la mtshal gyis du dza lcung ka'i snying du bcug: chu shing phur pa tshon skud: dar dkar du kha la sna mun dzaḥ phug ron snying lcags kyi phur pa sor bzhi tshon skud: ༈ dar dmar po la tsa ra ra tsa skyer phur bzhi dar dmar gyis dril la tshon skud: ༈ dar dmar po la ra tsa shig ḍa dza bya dkar khrag gis bris shing shel rdo byi li snying tshon skud: ༈ dar dkar la/ a dhe wa tsakra dzaḥgayag dkar po'i khrag snying tshon skud: ༈ bya nag gi gsob dar nag la: ma ma ru lu ru lu ma bh+yo dzaḥ bya ma nag mo'i khrag snying sing ldeng gi phur bu sor bzhi tshon skud: pha wang long bu la ra khrag gis: tra shu du sham ku ru dzaḥ pha wang mgo tshon skud tsa ra rog po'i snying : ༈ sbrul nya lpags/ nya khrag gis phu nā ga ra tsa dza hūm̐ dzaḥ nya mgo rla ba phur ba sor bzhi tshon skud sna lnga'i rgya chings rgyab cing rang gzugs kyi ma ne bo dho ya sga ṭa ya da sha an+ḍa: dregs pa rang gnas rang yul brla rten man ngag zhib mo'ang yang gsang gab rgya: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug don slad du: bkod cing las sbyor man ngag 'di: par bu sde dpung sum cu yi: yang gsang 'di na yin no gud du sbas: pad+ma bdag gis legs par bshad: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: mtha' ma tshang pa 'dra'o/ mi) ༈ ling khrus gnad gyi man ngag bsdus pa ni: sa yi phye ma la: lam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: sngags lngas sbyangs shing*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi dra dri 'bag btsog thams cad 'byung ba sa yis phyi'o: me long ngag chus bkrus la/ bam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā:

rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi dra dri 'bag btsog thams cad 'byung ba chu yis bkru'o/ dug gsum rdzas me bcas/ ram̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi dra dri 'bag btsog thams cad 'byung ba me yis bsreg go / rlung la phyar zhing*/ yam̐ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi dra dri 'bag btsog thams cad 'byung ba rlung gis gtor ro/ / nam mkha' la g.yug cing*/ e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dra dri 'bag btsog thams cad byang bar gyur cig /e yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ lam̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: zhes dang*/ bskyed bya bzas po de'i tshe bsod mnga' thang 'byor ba longs spyod bkrag mdangs gzi brjid mthu stobs nus rtsal sogs rang la thim pas tshe bsod longs spyod bkrag mdangs rgyas te kun gyis 'gran zla bral bar bsam/ āḥ rkyang nyer gcig dbugs thengs gcig bsgrags te chus bkrus la rang gis btung bar bya'o/ de'i tshe pha rol gyi srog khrag snying khrag dpal chen pos gsol bar bsam: ྀatsha: mnan pa'i las mtha' man ngag zur pa ni/ snal tshon sna lnga'i sngags ni ser po la/ badz+ra ti ri bi ri phung : dmar po la/ kha la rak+ṣa rbad: sngon po la/ rak+ta rbad su rbad: dkar po la/ shi ga kha du 'byung ba tig nan: nag po la/ zla shri pra sod: ces tshon skud re la brgya re btab ste/ sde brgyad byad thag tu bsam/ sde brgyad byad gzhug sngags dang bskrad chog kun spyi dril la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po mgo 'jug ldog la sngags de bsog man ngag go : sa tshon sna lnga'i sngags ni ser po la/ badz+ra ta ti baṃ phaṭḥ dmar po la/ ma hā pa te na ga hūm̐: sngon po la/ pad te pad shig pad hūm̐: dkar po la/ me shi kha rak+ṣa rbad: nag po la/ du pa ti tham na 'byung ba hūm̐: rim bzhin du btab pas sa rim pa bdun gyis mnan par bsam/ re thag gi ya khebs la/

nag khrid mā ra ya sod: dur g.yam la steng du 'byung ba rim brtsegs 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bris la/ ru mug thim dzaḥ stag phur zur gsum la thā gsum bris pa mnan sngags kyis gdab cing phur pa brdeg go /mnan pa brub khung 'bru ba'i man ngag bka' gtad sogs mang du gab kyang 'dir de tsam mo/ /zab rgy-i atsha: sri 'gugs sngags ni: om̐ sarba dza tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ su tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ na tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sha tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ ka tri ni hūm̐ dzaḥ chaig mo gum gum thul ril trig nan dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgra sri'i 'gugs sngags ni/ om̐ kro ta la hūm̐ ka bigh+nān ta kri dgra bo byad ma'i rnam shes la dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga ra tsa sog ma me rtsa mun tri ta dgra bo'i srog la dza dzaḥ om̐ ya mān+ta ka ha ra ha ra tri ha ra dgra bo'i dbugs la dza dzaḥ om̐ kha ṭa ge na du ru tsit+ta dgra bo'i dbang po la dza dzaḥ om̐ hab ti shag ru lu dgra bo mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la dza dzaḥ lha dbye ni: om̐ ha ra ya dgra bo shag phyes: a mu ka dgra bo shag phyes: ru tra tshin+dha dgra bo shag phyes: om̐ bhi bur mu ru mu ru dgra bo shag phyes: ha la dun+ti nag po dgra bo shag phyes: trag ru tra trag ru tra kha thaṃ dza shag phyes: bsad sngags ni/ om̐ ha la ka la yam rtse nag po ru ṭa nan: ru tra nṛ tri rbad: gzer thum gzer thum sbur thum sbur thum myog rak+ta myog rak+ta: gtub kha la gtub kha la ru ṭa ka wa tsi gzer gzer rbad rbad: mnan sngags ni/ om̐ trig trig kha la yaṃ rtse nag po ru tra nan: dgra sri nan nan: dam sri nan nan: god sri nan nan: gri sri nan nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: mā ra ya nan nan: ha la ha la yak+sha kro ta snying la rbad bh+yo nan: byad thag la/ ā aṃḥ ā+au oḥ ā+ai eḥ l̥̄ l̥ḥ ṝ ṛḥ u uḥ ā+-i iḥ ā aḥ k+ṣa ha sa ṣa sha wa la ra ya: ma bha ba pha pa: na dha da tha ta: ṇa ḍha ḍa ṭha ṭa: nya dzña dza tsha tsa: nga gha ga kha ka: hā swā ye na ma shrā hā ma dī bā waṃ e dha ro ni:

yo tsa ṣan te: t+ya wa h+ya: to ga thā ta ṣan+te tun he: wā bha pra tu he rmādha ye om̐: lan dgu bzlas de sogs gzhung nas gsungs so/ /de ltar bla ma drag po kī la ya'i/ /drag po zor gyi las rim bklag chog tu/ /drag po nyer bdun thun mtshams dag tu bris/ /drag po'i dmod pa 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rong smyon pas bgyis// // tsi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las g.yul bzlog dregs pa'i dmag bskul rngam ring thog mda' nag po bzhugs so: bdag 'dra pad+ma gar dbang gis: mtha' bzhi'i g.yul dpung gzhom pa'i phyir: dmag bskul dregs pa rngams ring gis: mu stegs bdud dpung snying 'byin bstan: de'ang bskul ring gnam lcags thog mda' dregs pa'i snying 'byin nag po reg chod ya ma snying gzir gyi rgyud las byung ba 'di: mtshon 'khrug dgra rkun bzlog pa dang : khyad par dgra yul du dmag sna 'dren pa sogs: dgos ched che ba'i dus ma gtogs gar thod du gtong mi rung : bka' shin tu gnyan pas tshod shes par bya: 'di ni ye shes dang 'jig rten phyogs mtshams kyi cha ma lus bskul ba yin pas: 'di yis mi bzlog gang yang med: 'di dang bzlog pa'i gzer 'phyong rnams sbrel na: gnam lcags kyi thog rgod dang mtshungs te snang srid kyi bdud rigs thams cad skad cig la 'joms par gdon mi za bas snying la chongs shig: bstan 'gro'i don du spyod cig: sgrubs shig: spel cig: 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa srungs shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas zor gtor ling ro dang sman raka gis sbran: gtor chung dmar chen la sogs pa bsham: rnga rdung dung 'bud dar nag gis g.yab cing bstan dgra sgrol ba'i nga rgyal gyis rngam stabs drag po'i skur bzhengs te thog mar gtso bor bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas:

rngam brjid stobs ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ snang srid dregs pa 'dul ba'i las la bzhengs: dregs pa khros pa'i zil gnon kī la che: snang srid bran du bskol phyir bzhengs pa'i tshe: ri rab 'jigs shing gling bzhi nyi li li: khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i rba klong lhabs se lhab: nyi zla gza' skar thog mda' sha ra ra: cho 'phrul snang stong 'brug sgra di ri ri: tsha grang gnam lcags ser ba hri li li: nad sprin smug nag bu yug thibs se thib: las kyi rlung dmar shwa kha 'u ru ru: gzugs can gzugs med 'o dod lhangs se lhang : las byed shan pa gri thogs rongs se rong : bdud kyi dgra 'dzin zhags pa khyugs se khyug: btsan gyi jag rgyug shwa kha tha ra ra: sgrol ging dkar nag gri thogs zings se zing : ma mo'i nad yams bu yug thibs se thib: klu bdud dug gi zor mda' lams se lam: gcan spyang sha gzan mdur rgyug chems se chem: srid pa'i dmag tshogs brgyud 'dzin lhabs se lhab: bka' yi las byed bswo sgra di ri ri: las la bzhengs shig rngam brjid kī la ya: do nub drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor:

go cha'i rgyan bskul ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdud 'dul khros pa'i khro rgyal ngang nyid las: rta zhal mthing nag rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: dbu skra dmar por bsigs pas stong gsum g.yo: thod skam dbyings nas khro bcu'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: sbrul chun g.yos pas klu brgyad bran du khol: smin ma me 'bar rgyal 'gong dam sri bsreg: ljags dmar glog 'khyug srid gsum g.yo zhing mgul: mche gtsigs shangs nas dug rlangs bgegs dpung 'joms: sku yi phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: dpral bar sku yi dmag tshogs 'jam dpal 'gyed: yang sprul gshin rjes stong gsum 'jig rten khengs: nyi khri bdun stong nag po lcags khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: nag po gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: om̐ ya mān+ta ka dgra bo byad ma sha trun a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: ljang dmar srid gsum bar snang tshwa tshwa khol: mche gtsigs drag po'i dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: zhal nas hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu las: hūm̐ dgu phaṭ dgu raṃ dgus mtha' dmag zlog: g.yon pa'i snang srid khro rgyal phur pa las: bh+yo dgu rbad dgu zlog dgus byad ma sgrol: gsung gi phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod phrin las drag po'i dus la bab: hūm̐: mgrin par gsung gi dmag tshogs rta mgrin 'gyed: yang sprul dbang phyug nyi shus stong gsum gang : nyi khri bdun stong dmar po zangs khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: dmar mo dbang phyug dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa dgra bo byad ma sha trun a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad:

hūm̐: glang ko zhing lpags gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms: dur khrod rus rgyan dregs pa las la bskul: spu gri'i sgro gshog brdebs pas snang srid 'khrug: thugs rje'i phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: thugs kar thugs kyi dmag tshogs phyag rdor 'gyed: yang sprul khro bo stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong sngon po g.yu khrab can: gnam lcags thog mda' mtshon cha dgra la ya: mthing nag rang 'dra'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi dgra bo byad ma sha trun a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: spyan mig stong nas drag po'i dmag tshogs bskul: rdo rje'i go khrab srid gsum g.yul las rgyal: yon tan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: hūm̐: lte bar yon tan dmag tshogs khro bo 'gyed: yang sprul sha zas stong gsum 'jig rten gang : sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ kro ti shwa ri dgra bo byad ma sha trun a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: dregs pa tshar gcod stag sham 'bar bas brgyan: srog la rngam byed chu srin khro zhal bgrad: dug sbrul kha rgyan klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul: gnam lcags dbal ldan bstan pa'i ru tra sgrol: stobs ldan phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: gsang bar phrin las dmag tshogs yak+sha 'gyed: yang sprul pho nyas stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong smug po mchong khrab can: gnam lcags mtshon cha thog mda' dgra la chos: smug nag pho nya'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog:

oṃ yak+sha ka la dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas yum gyi bskul ba ni: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ chos dbyings skye med rang byung klong yangs dbus: srid gsum bdag mo srog bdag dpal 'bar ma: snang srid las dbang mnga' bsgyur mthu stobs can: bdud 'dul khro mo'i tshul gyis skur bzhengs shig: snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i dus la bab: dbang sdud u ma'i tshul gyis skur ston tshe: mthing nag chos nyid tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: shar grol drag po'i dmag tshogs thibs se thib: gsal stong gdug pa'i mtshon cha si li li: drag stong ngan sngags 'brug sgra di ri ri: snang stong sgrol ba'i thog rgod sha ra ra: dran stong dug lnga yongs sgrol lhangs se lhang : tshor stong las mkhan pho nya sprengs se spreng : las la bskul lo snang srid ma mo che: bdud 'dul ye shes chas dgus brgyan pa'i tshe: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad: dbu skra bsig cing phag skad drag po sgraug: zil rngog me 'bar rigs bdag mkha' la shar: bdud 'dul khro mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya: hūm̐: sku sprul rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: zhe sdang dgra bo snying rjes bsgral bar bskul: snang stong dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: me long ye shes lhun grub phrin las mdzod: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī ye dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: snyan cha dbu rgyan cod pan dbyings la bskyod: sgra snyan gsung dbyangs drug cu phyogs bcur sgrog: lnga ldan tshom bus brgyan cing lha srin 'dul: bdud 'dul khro mo'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya: hūm̐: gsung sprul pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: 'dod chags dgra bo snying rjes bsgral bar bskul: grags stong dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

sor rtogs ye shes lhun grub phrin las mdzod: oṃ pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī ye dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: glang ko zhing lpags bdud dpung thal bar brlag: phyag g.yas gri gug 'khor ba rtsad nas gcod: phyag g.yon rtogs med nyon mongs snying khrag 'thung : bdud 'dul khro mo'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya: hūm̐: thugs sprul sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: gti mug dgra bo snying rjes bsgral bar bskul: gsal stong dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: chos dbyings ye shes lhun grub phrin las mdzod: oṃ bud+dha ḍāk+ki nī ye dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: rus rgyan kha ṭ+wāṃ dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: me long mgo phreng gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog: spyan stong gtams pas phra men dmag tshogs 'gyed: bdud 'dul khro mo'i yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya: hūm̐: yon tan rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: nga rgyal dgra bo snying rjes bsgral bar bskul: tshor stong dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mnyam nyid ye shes lhun grub phrin las mdzod: oṃ rat+na ḍāk+ki nī ye dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: gdug pa'i stag sham sbrul chun klu bdud 'dul: brkyang bskum byad ma'i snying khar rngam zhing brjid: dmar nag me dpung dbus bzhugs stong gsum sreg: bdud 'dul khro mo'i phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo sa ma ya: hūm̐: phrin las karma mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: phrag dog dgra bo snying rjes bsgral bar bskul: bde stong dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bya grub ye shes lhun grub phrin las mdzod: oṃ karma ḍāk+ki nī ye dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad:

hūm̐: thugs dam bskul lo ma mo phra men dang : sgo skyong gnas nyul srid pa ma mo'i tshogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra gnod byed gdug pa'i g.yul ngo rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ bi shwa ḍāk+ki nī ye dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas rigs bdag gi bskul ba ni: hūm̐: rigs bdag rab khros dregs pa zil gnon rtsal: mthu stobs dbang phyug bdud 'dul sngags pa'i chas: rdo rje phur pa bsgril zhing bstan dgra sgrol: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod phrin las drag po'i dus la bab: hūm̐: ral pa'i khrod nas rig 'dzin dmag dpung 'gyed: yang sprul rjes 'brang stong gsum 'jig rten gang : nyi khri bdun stong bdud 'dul sngags chas can: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: drag sngags rig 'dzin dmag tshogs las la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ ma hā gu ru thod phreng rtsal dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas bya khyung gi bskul ba ni: hūm̐: thugs las sprul pa'i gnam lcags ga ru ṭasaḥ krang kring sgra sgrogs bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: me gshog brdeb cing mche sder dgra snying rol: rigs bdag phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: spyi bor sprul pa'i bya khyung dmag tshogs 'gyed: yang sprul khyung gis stong gsum 'jig rten khengs: nyi khri bdun stong sha khrag srog la rngam: gnam lcags mtshon cha'i thog mda' dgra la ya: stobs ldan bya khyung dmag tshogs dgra la chos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal ba rdul du rlog: oṃ khrom ga ru ṭa phe k+ṣeṃ dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad:

de nas kī la ya rigs bzhi'i bskul ba ni: hūm̐: g.yas su dkar nag gru gsum e yi klong : tshangs pa pho mo bsnol ba'i dal dbus su: 'jigs byed chen po badz+ra kī la ya: khrag 'thung khros pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs sgrol: rdo rje thod phreng sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: zhe sdang lha bu'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: kha 'jam bslu brid tshul gyis sgrol bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: rgyab tu ser nag gru gsum e yi klong : gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i dal dbus su: 'jigs byed chen po rat+na kī la ya: khrag 'thung khros pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs sgrol: rat+na thod phreng sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: nga rgyal phung po'i bdud dmag dgra la chos: ngar 'dzin 'gong sems tshul gyis sgrol bar gyis: oṃ rat+na kī li kī la ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: g.yon du dmar nag gru gsum e yi klong : bdud nag pho mo bsnol ba'i dal dbus su: 'jigs byed chen po pad+ma kī la ya: khrag 'thung khros pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs sgrol: pad+ma thod phreng sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: nyon mongs las kyi bdud dmag dgra la chos: nye 'brel 'khrul ba'i tshul gyi sgrol bar gyis: oṃ pad+ma kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: mdun du mthing nag gru gsum e yi klong : mu stegs pho mo bsnol ba'i dal dbus su: 'jigs byed chen po karma kī la ya: khrag 'thung khros pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs sgrol: karma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: 'chi bdag bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la chos:

rnam rtog 'byung 'khrug tshul gyis sgrol bar gyis: om̐ karma kī li kī la ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas ging chen sde lnga'i bskul ba ni: hūm̐: zhe sdang sku yi ging chen ni: keng rus drag tu khros pa'i gzugs: phyag gnyis spu gri lcags kyu 'dzin: sa khams sha rus gnas nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ging chen dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ dam nyams sdig chen byad ma rnams: lcags kyus zungs la spu gris sgrol: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: oṃ badz+ra ging ka ra dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: 'dod chags gsung gi ging chen ni: khrag mdog me yi tsha zer can: phyag gnyis lcags sgrog spu gri 'dzin: chu khams khrag gi gnas nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ging chen dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ dam nyams sdig chen byad ma rnams: lcags sgrog sdoms la spu gris sgrol: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: oṃ pad+ma ging ka ra dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: gti mug thugs kyi ging chen ni: ram ram rung rung mun pa'i gzugs: phyag gnyis spu gri rgya gram 'dzin: nam mkha' mun pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ging chen dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ dam nyams sdig can byad ma rnams: rgya gram bsnun la spu gris sgrol: byad ma'i lha srung rten dang phrol: oṃ bud+dha ging ka ra dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: nga rgyal yon tan ging chen ni: ser nag ral pa kham nag can: phyag gnyis spu gri zhags pa 'dzin: g.yogs byed pags pa'i klong nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ging chen dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ

dam nyams sdig can byad ma rnams: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: oṃ rat+na ging ka ra ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: phrag dog phrin las ging chen ni: kham nag bu yug 'khrigs pa'i gzugs: phyag gnyis spu gri ral gri 'dzin: khyab byed rtsa rlung klong nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ging chen dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yoḥ dam nyams sdig can byad ma rnams: dril bus myos la spu gris sgrol: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: oṃ karma ging ka ra ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces mtshams rnams su dmar chen bya zhing gtor ma 'bul: de nas phyi 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad las la bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: srid pa lha rgyal las la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag dpung dgra la drongs: dkar po lha dmag nyi khri stong : shel khrab dkar po si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: āḥdhe wa ra tsa dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: lho phyogs dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: ya ma gshin rje dmag la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: las gshin dmag tshogs nyi khri stong : khro chu'i go khrab si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab:

gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: yaḥm ra tsa dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: nub phyogs dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: srog len ma mo las la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: dmar nad bdag mo nyi khri stong : gser khrab ser po si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: maḥm mo ru lu ru lu dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: byang phyogs dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: bdud nag 'jigs byed dmag la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: nag po bdud dmag nyi khri stong : lcags khrab sngon po si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob:

'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: duḥpra ma rak+sha dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: shar lho'i dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: shel ging srog bdag dmag la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: dkar nag rgyal 'gong nyi khri stong : dkar gsal dung khrab si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: ruḥshu la ra dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: lho nub dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: srog gzan btsan rgod dmag la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: dmar po btsan dmag nyi khri stong : zangs khrab dmar po si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog:
