bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: tsaḥr tsa ging ka ra dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: nub byang dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: yak+sha gnod sbyin dmag la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: smug nag gnod sbyin nyi khri stong : mchong khrab smug po si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: shaḥyak+sha ka la dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: byang shar dregs pa'i dmag dpon che: nā ga klu bdud dmag la bzhengs: drongs shig dmag sna dgra la drongs: mthing nag klu dmag nyi khri stong : g.yu khrab sngon po si li li: rmog phor ldem 'phru tshubs se tshub: ru dar ba dan lhabs se lhab: gnam lcags thog mda' sha ra ra: zhal nas bswo sgra lhangs se lhang : mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug brangs se brang : dgra bo byad ma'i g.yul ngo 'di: da lta nyid du cham la phob: 'gras ya rtsod pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: sngags la gnod pa'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: bskul lo sde brgyad mthu ma chung : rbad do dregs pa rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: nāḥnā ga rak+sha dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad:

de nas sgo skyong bzhi'i bskul ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo skyong bskul ba ni: stag gdong dkar mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na lcags kyu phur pa bsnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs dgra bgegs myur du khug: bkug nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dzaḥbadz+ra aṅku sha ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo skyong bskul ba ni: 'ug gdong ser mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na zhags pa phur pa bsnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs dgra bgegs myur du chings: bcings nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ rat+na pā sha ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo skyong bskul ba ni: dmar mo khwa gdong bye ba 'bum: phyag na lca sgrog phur pa bsnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs dgra bgegs myur du sdoms: bsdams nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: baṃ pad+ma s+pho ṭa ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo skyong bskul ba ni: spyang gdong sngon mo bye ba 'bum: phyag na dril bu phur pa bsnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: myos nas bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ho karma ghaṇ+ḍe ya dgra bo byad ma sha truṃ a mu ka hur thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: de nas yang 'khor pho nya'i bskul ba ni: hūm̐: yang 'khor sha za bye ba 'bum: srog gcod dbugs len dmag tshogs 'gyed: go cha stong sde si l̥ li: mtshon zhabs dgra la rubs se rub: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol la shog: byad ma'i rnam shes rten dang phrol: drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra sa dhu ma mo rak+mo yak+mo kā la du tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad:

ces mtshams rnams dmar chen sbreng zhing gtor ma 'bul: de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad drag po mngon spyod kyi las la chas te nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad yongs su gang nas dgra bo'i yul du mtshon char drag po'i char phab ste: ming shul med par brlags: kho'i sha khrag dbang po rnams las mkhan dregs byed gdug pa can rnams kyis lhag ma med par dpa' zas su rol te: slar yang mi ldang ba'i bro brdungs pas dgra bo'i yul zhing nor zas bcas kyang las kyi rlung gis bskyod pas: srid pa'i ri rab yang mgo mjug ldog nas zhing rdul dang dgra bo rlung gis nye bas sprin gtor ba ltar mos so: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug la: g.yul bzlog gnam lcags thog mda' yi: bskul ring bdud dpung snying 'byin 'di: gnubs ban dzñā na'i skyes mtha' mchog: drag po hūm̐ gi ming 'dzin pa'i: mthu chen de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas khrom gter du bgyis te spyan drangs pa'o// // tshi) ༈ bskul thung dregs pa dbang sdud ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum kun 'dus thod phreng skur bzhengs shig: dus ngan sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: du ru ra tsa bzlog pa'i dus la bab: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mu stegs dmag g.yos bzlog pa'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gnyan nad smyo 'bog bzlog pa'i dus la bab: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: sngon gyi dam bca' nyams par mi 'gyur bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo'i steng : gnas pa'i sde brgyad dmag dpung rnams:

sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges te: rang rtags rgyan dang phyag mtshan rdzogs: mi bzad bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: rngam brjid ha ha'i gad mo sgrog: rdzu 'phrul ri rab thal bar rlog: las la chas pa'i mthu bo che: srog la rngam pa'i 'jig rten lha: myur du rgyugs pa'i drag rtsal can: bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub mdzad pa: sde brgyad mngon spyod las la bskul: khyed rnams gang bcol phrin las rnams: dam tshig bka' las ma 'da' bar: sangs rgyas bstan la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can las la chos: mtha' 'khob dmag tshogs bzlog pa dang : dus 'khrug nad yams bzlog pa sogs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya hūm̐: zhes bskul zhing gtor ma 'bul: de nas gser skyems gtong : dzi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: smad las bsad pa reg phung dug mda' nag po bzhugs so: bdud 'dul drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: de'ang ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su steng 'og bar gsum 'khrug pas nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal pa dar: de'i tshe dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rim pa bsad pa reg phung dug mda' nag por 'jug pa ni: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum ldan pa'i sngags 'chang gis: bstan dgra sgrol ba'i sems bskyed go gyon te: mngon spyod dmod pa drag po'i chas su zhugs: mdun du gnam lcags las grub hom khung nang : ma rungs byad ma bdud sde dpung tshogs dang : rgyab rten bla dwags mi rus ldan pa'am: zor las dmod pa'i zhal bstab brtsam pa ni: zan ling khrag gi sbrus pa zhig la 'thus: dar nag re nag mun pa nag pos dgab: mtha' skor phur yungs la sogs thun rdzas dang : bya 'ug sgro sogs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas: bsgral phur las phur sgrol gri gtun tho sogs: mngon spyod drag po'i thun rdzas ma lus bsags: lta ba rgyab rten gnyen po ye shes lha: sprul pa las byed lha yi go cha ni:

rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog kī la ya sku mdog mthing nag zhal gdangs shing rno dbal gyi mche ba zur gsum gtsigs pa: spyan gsum khrag ltar g.yo zhing gyen mthur du 'khyil ba: smin ma dang sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba: phyag g.yas pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkhar gdengs shing : g.yon pas khro rgyal las kyi phur pas dgra bgegs kyi snying khar gzir ba: dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa: sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum las mtshon cha'i dbal zer 'phro ba: sku'i cha las las byed sprul pa'i shan pa bye ba sa ya 'phro ba: ye shes kyi me dpung tshwa tshwa drag tu khol ba'i dbus su gsal bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ drag sngags bzla zhing gzi byin dpal stobs bskyed: rtsa gsum dregs pa'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phud 'dren gser skyems gzu dpang gsol ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs klong nas bzhengs: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: drag po mthu yi gzi byin bskyed du gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir ma nyes gzu dang dpang po mdzod: bstan pa'i srog shing rdo rje theg pa la: mu stegs log lta bdud kyis brnyas btsugs so: rgyu drang bka' btsan man ngag don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rgya bod mkhas grub rig 'dzin pad 'byung la: bdud blon bsam ngan can gyis brnyas btsugs so: 'ja' lus skye 'chi spangs pa don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgongs brgyud slob dpon gzu dang dpang po mdzod: mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag rdzogs chen a ti la: nyan thos grub mtha' can gyis brnyas btsugs so: chos nyid mngon sum ston pa don ma chung :

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma sring mkha' 'gro kun gyis gzu dpang mdzod: rig 'dzin rjes 'jug rgyal tshab rnal 'byor la: bdud rigs dam sri ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas bsgrubs pa don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma nyes snod ldan bdag cag sgrub pa por: dam nyams dgra bo 'di yis brnyas btsugs so: rbad bskul pho nya mngags pa don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gter srung mthu ldan gzu dang dpang po mdzod: bdag gis ma nyes sdig can dgra yis nyes: phyi rgyud lha dang srung ma thams cad kun: deng 'dir drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: dgra bo kho rang lha srung gshed du phob: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems 'thor: brub khung du dmigs bya bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du e las gnam lcags las grub pa'i btson khang nag po mun pa dgu rim gyi rang bzhin nag la 'thug pa tsha la rtsub pa dmar la rngam pa: steng na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: 'og na 'dod chags kyi chu khol ba: bar na nga rgyal gyi thog ser 'bebs pa: logs na phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs pa: las kyi gshin rje'i bsha' ra: bdud kyi bsad ra: srog gcod nag po'i btson khang : snang srid srog bdag nag po'i brub khung : zin nas thar pa med pa de'i nang du: nṛ tri dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo byad ma de nyid lus nyams sngo la ham pa srog chad la khad: dbugs bral la khad: lag pa gnyis kyis skra 'bal zhing brang brdungs pa: bu ga dgu nas nad rlangs dang khrag 'dzag pa: mgo bo lho nub mtshams su bstan cing : rkang pa byang du bsgrogs pa: dmyal srung las mkhan nag pos zhags pas drag tu bsdams pa:

las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bskor nas bros dbang med pa zhig tu gyur: bka'i bden stobs kyis 'gugs shing dmigs pa'i rten la dbab pa ni: na moḥ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang : sku 'jam dpal gsung rta mgrin thugs phyag rdor: yon tan mkha' 'gro: phrin las yak+sha me dbal: sprul pa'i bya khyung dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du bdud 'dul che mchog kī la ya rigs lnga: ye shes khro mo lnga: sprul pa'i khro bo yab yum bcu: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: sgo ma bzhi: dregs pa'i sde tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan dgra: dkon mchog gi sgos dgra: bla ma'i sku dgra rnal 'byor gyi zur dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyod la mthu med zer ba: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: lam gyi mgron po bcom pa: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' las 'gal zhing dam las log pa: bslab pa'i slob bu dam log: bzhag pa'i bran 'khor snying ring : rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa sos log: shag rogs mna' gzan: mdza' rogs snying ngan: yon bdag gzhungs ngan: bka' bcag pa: dam bkral ba: kha 'o ma las 'jam zhing : snying tsher ma las rtsub pa: bsam ngan sbyor log 'chang ba'i dgra bo spyi dang : khyad par du bstan 'gro'i bde skyid bcom pa'i mtha' bzhi'i dmag 'khrug g.yo zhing mtshon rtse ston pa'i dam sri bdud rigs log par 'dren pa rgyab rten dang bcas pa 'di nyid mgo 'khor bar gyis: yid 'khrugs par gyis: smyo zhing 'bog par gyis: las mkhan pho nya rnams kyis lcags kyus snying nas zung : zhags pas ske nas chings:

lcags sgrog gis yan lag sdoms: dril bus myos su chug: las rlung drag po'i rta la bskyon: mun nag 'jigs pas mdun nas bsus: steng nas gnam gyi 'ju thag chod: 'og nas sa yi rten phur phud la: rang dbang med par byi'u chung khras khyer ba bzhin du gzugs liṅga dkar byang dmar byang nag byang btab pa 'di la khug cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes rol mo drag rdung dang bcas nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: lha btsan drag po mthu bo che: shar phyogs dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs: lha zhags dkar pos bcings nas kyang : sbur ma rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin: mtshan byang liṅga 'di la phob: bla 'gugs jag pa las la 'gyed: srod la bla srog bcud bsdus la: nam phyed dgra bo gzer thum thongs: tho rangs srog chod snying khrag 'thung : sha rtsas gri bo ded pa bzhin: nyes can dgra bo khug la shog: lha btsan dmag tshogs dus la bab: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: a dhe wa tsa shu dgra bo nṛ tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: srog gzan bdud nag mthu bo che: lho phyogs dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs: bdud zhags nag pos bcings nas kyang : ra lug gcan gyis ded pa bzhin: ming rus liṅga 'di la phob: bla 'gugs jag pa las la 'gyed: srod la bla srog bcud bsdus la: nam phyed dgra bo gzer thum thongs: tho rangs srog chod snying khrag 'thung : rngon pas ri dwags ded pa bzhin: nyes can dgra bo khug la shog: srog bdud dmag tshogs dus la bab: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: du pra ma rak+sha dgra bo nṛ tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: btsan rgod hur thum mthu bo che: nub phyogs dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs: btsan zhags dmar pos bcings nas kyang : nya mo sram gyis ded pa bzhin: bla dwags liṅga 'di la phob: bla 'gugs jag pa las la 'gyed:

srod la bla srog bcud bsdus la: nam phyed dgra bo gzer thum thongs: tho rangs srog chod snying khrag 'thung : nyes can btson du khrid pa bzhin: nyes can dgra bo khug la shog: btsan rgod dmag tshogs dus la bab: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: ru shu la tsa tri dgra bo nṛ tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: kha la rak+sha mthu bo che: byang phyogs dgra bgegs byad ma'i tshogs: sbrul zhags ljang khus bcings nas kyang : byi'u khra yis khyer ba bzhin: dmigs rten liṅga 'di la khug: bla 'gugs jag pa las la 'gyed: srod la bla srog bcud bsdus la: nam phyed dgra bo gzer thum thongs: tho rangs srog chod snying khrag 'thung : sgra gcan nyi zla bzung ba bzhin: nyes can dgra bo khug la shog: klu bdud dmag tshogs dus la bab: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: nā ga kha la rak+sha dgra bo nṛ tri dza dzaḥ zhes rol mo 'ur rdung dang bcas te khug rtags ma byung bar 'gugs: bsad las chen mo'i skabs su bla 'gugs kyi sngags kyang sbyar: sngags dang phyag rgya bzhi'i gnad la dbab: khug rtags rdzogs nas lha dang dbye ba ni: gser skyems mchod cing ma nyes yus bshags gdab: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: ma nyes ma len gzu dpang dkon mchog bzhugs: drang shan phye ba'i sde brgyad dmag tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams log 'dren byad ma 'di nyid kyi: drag sngags rdo rje phur pa'i thun 'debs pa: ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: mngon spyod bka' yi chad pa drag po ni: de ring dam nyams log 'dren 'di la phob: las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya:

zhes las sbyor skabs su dbye rdzas rten du bskyed cing dbye sngags kyi nus pa rdzas la bstim: phyogs gzhan zhig tu sngags bzhin du bsreg: dbye sngags ting 'dzin dmod pas gnad la gdab: bzlog zor las kyi skabs su ni: gu gul yungs dkar thang phrom sha chen bsreg: bya 'ug dang rus dbye sprad cing sngags rgya bya: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dregs byed stag gdong dkar mo'i dus la bab: dam sri log par blta ba'i dgra bo 'di: mgon skyabs ban bon lha srin thams cad kun: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog brgyab ltar: bya spu rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du gtor: zhes dbye thun cung zad brdeg: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ 'joms byed 'ug gdong ser po'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma sdig can 'di: pha lha ma lha dgra lha zhang lha phyes: srog lha yul lha skyes lha srung ma phyes: tha ma dug chu'i bshal ba bzhin du gtor: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ za byed khwa gdong dmar mo'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan sdig can 'di: 'chi bdag gshin rjer gtad cing byad du chug: lag dmar bdud la sprod cing khram la thob: sprin nag rlung gis gtor ba bzhin du thongs: om̐ ha ra ya dgra bo shag phyes: a mu ka dgra bo shag phyes: ru tra tshin+dha tshin+dha ya dgra bo shag phyes: a bhi bur mu ru mu ru dgra bo shag phyes: ha la dun ti nag po dgra bo shag phyes: trag ru tra kha ru tra kha thi dza shag phyes: zhes ting nge 'dzin dang bcas gang nus bzla zhing du ba bdug: byad thag gis bcings shing sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya dang bcas: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ srog gcod spyang gdong nag po'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bgegs las ngan sdig can 'di: 'gugs shing sdom myos mnan bskrad rings par gyis: srog la dbang zhing srog dbugs sdud par gyis: bskal mes 'byung rdul bsregs pa bzhin du thongs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad myog: las sbyor skabs su bsad pa'i ting 'dzin gyis:

bsad pa'i sngags byang gud du bskol zhing bzla: gong du bsgrubs pa'i thun gyi gzir zhing brdeg: hūm̐: bzlog med khro bo'i nyungs dkar thun: dmar nag dmar po khrag gi thun: tshe thun gshin rjes dmod pa'i rdzas: dug thun 'chi bdag bu yug 'tshubs: mtshon thun tshwa tshwa si li li: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: me thun dbal kha lhabs se lhab: skam thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: rlon thun dug rlangs chi li li: dmod pa'i drag sngags 'u ru ru: bzlog med drag po'i thun rdzas gyis: char chen dam nyams dgra la phob: byad ma thal ba rdul du rlog: bh+yo bh+yo dun tshi de ya byad ma trig trig bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes thun brdeg: sa ma ya: spro na sde brgyad thun zor sbyar: de nas dregs pa'i zor rdzas sna dgu brdeg: srid pa lha'i kong zor ni: ri nyil g.yul 'khrug tshab mo che: ri sul sha rbud sde phung shul: mdze mo'i nyal shul sreg pa rnga mong shi: phung sa dgu las byas pa yi: kong zor ro sol gri khrag gi: dmar nag rtsang gis brgyan pa thogs: hūm̐: dur khrod phung shul dgu las grub pa'i sa: ngan sngags gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag 'di: srid pa'i lha gnyan chen pos zor sna drongs: dgra bgegs byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: a dhe wa ra tsa dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khram zor ni: skyer byang ngos la phung rdzas dgus: 'chi bdag nag po'i dza khram gdab: hūm̐: tsha ngar gdug pa'i shing las byung ba yi: phung bshig rdzas kyis thig nag gtab pa 'di: las gshin ya ma ra tsas zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: ya ma ra tsa dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: srog bdag ma mo'i dug zor ni: btsan dug ra dug bong dug dang : thar nu thang phrom re lcag sogs: dug rdzas sna dgu lkugs chur sbyor: phung sa'i kong bur blugs pa thogs: hūm̐: dug chu sna dgu'i rdzas kyis ngar btags pa: yams nad sna dgu me ltar 'bar ba 'dis:

srog bdag ma mo chen mos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: ma mo ru lu ru lu dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: srog bdud shan pa'i rdo zor ni: gnam lcags thog bshig brag ri'am: rbab rgod mi bsad zur gsum rdor: dug khrag rbad bh+yo bris pa thogs: hūm̐: khro chu khol ma las grub drag po'i rdo: zur gsum rno ngar thog ltar 'bebs pa 'di: srog bdud shan pa lag dmar zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: du pra ma rak+sha dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: srog bdag shel ging nyungs zor ni: brag nag byang bstan dur khrod dam: rtsub 'gyur tshal du skyes pa yi: nyungs dkar khro zhal ldan pa thogs: hūm̐: srid gsum sgrol byed nyungs dkar khro bo'i rdzas: zur bzhi log brgyad gnam lcags 'khor lo 'di: srog bdag shel ging dkar pos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: ru ra tsa ging ka ra dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: btsan rgod 'bar ba'i snying zor ni: dam nyams bsgral ba'i tsit+ta 'am: ngar phye dug khrag sbyar ba yi: tsit+ta zur brgyad ngos logs su: dmar nag rtsang gis brgyan pa thogs: hūm̐: ru tra dregs pa bsgral ba'i tsit+ta la: drag sngags gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'phro ba 'di: btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rjes zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: tsa shu la raṃ dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: gnod sbyin nag po'i thod zor ni: dam sri pho mo bsnol ba'i bu: gdug rtsub 'chang ba'i thod pa ru: phung rdzas sna dgu brub pa la: rtsang gis brgyan nam ngar zan la: thog mde'u dbyibs la rtsang btsugs te: thod dung nang du bcug pa thogs: hūm̐: dam sri pho mo sbyor ba'i thod zor la: spu gri mtshon cha gzengs pa'i ngar ldan 'di: yak+sha hur thum nag pos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: sha yak+sha kā la dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad:

klu bdud nag po'i khrag zor ni: bud med gcig la yugs sa dgu: pho 'gam yugs sa dgu dag gi: mngal khrag kong bur blugs pa thogs: hūm̐: yugs sa dgu yi gzhang nas thon pa'i khrag: ma rungs khrag sbyor nad rlangs 'thibs pa 'di: klu bdud kha la rak+shas zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: nā ga kha la rak+sha dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: ging chen dkar nag phur bu'i zor: sked pa rgya mdud rtsang rtse dbal: dug shing sbyar ba'i phur bu la: bsad pa spu gri'i sngags rgod dang : dug khrag rdzas kyis ngar blud thogs: hūm̐: snang srid stong khams bshig pa'i phur pa la: gza' rgod shan pa bskul ba'i rgya rtags 'di: las byed ging chen dkar nag zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: ging ka ra rak+sha kī la ya dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: ma gza' rdor legs mda' yi zor: gri rgod rtsib gzhu gri rgyus bring : dug shing skyer mda' srin bya 'ug: pho rog sgros brgyan gri lcags mde'u: reg phung dug gis ngar btab pa: g.yas g.yon sbrel zhing pho nya 'gyed: hūm̐: thabs mchog gzhu mo rdo rje legs: gzhu breng e ka dzā ṭi ma: gnyis med sras mchog rā hu la: gnam lcags 'khyugs pa ji bzhin du: las la thogs med ki kang rje: thabs shes yab yum khro bcu yis: rbad cing las la mngag pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: om̐ badz+ra sa dhu ru lu rak+mo e ka dzā ṭi rā hu la du pra ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: 'di la drang srong rgyu thebs dang bstun te: rgyu phyogs gdong gtad chu tshod ma 'chug par: drag sngags bzla zhing rgyu tshe brdeg par bya: byad ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba the tshom med: bsad las chen mo'i skabs su sbyar shes par bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas tshe khrus dgongs pas bsgral ba ni: tshe khrus dgongs pa mi ldan ngan sngags mkhan: gnas spor cho ga mi shes shan pa 'dra:

de phyir tshad med snying rjes bsgral 'dren bya: bdag nyid lha ru ma gsal rang la log: phur pa sras mchog ma gsal las la rdugs: gzas po mngon sum ma gsal gzhan du 'byams: de phyir gsal ba gsum kyi ting 'dzin gces: tshad med snying rje'i phur pa 'khor bar gdab: thugs rje'i sprul pa'i phur pa ru trar gdab: mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa liṅgar gdab: kun kyang rang rig ye shes phur bu'i ngang : bdag nyid chos sku'i phur pa longs spyod rdzogs: drag po rgyal sras sprul sku'i ngo bor sbyangs: bdag phur 'ben gsum sku gsum ro gcig pa: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum lta bas zin pa na: hom khung la brten sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i lam: rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs der ldan pas: las phur thal sbyar bar du bzung byas nas: hūm̐ hūm̐ ham̐'u: bdag nyid che mchog kī la ya: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis nyi zla'i dal: khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum gyi: sbyor mtshams mkha' gsang nas spros pa'i: drag rtsal sprul pa'i las mkhan ni: sras mchog rdo rje phur pa che: tshwa rngam khro chung si li li: drag sngags tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : bla ma yi dam sprin ltar gtibs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong las la bskul: sku smad chu srin klu bdud gnas: dam can gter bdag glog ltar 'khyug: dbal zur mtshon cha char ltar 'bebs: las mkhan srog len khyugs se khyug: bsgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum g.yo: gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs sngangs: btab pas ri rab thal bar brlag: 'gran zla med do kī la ya: zhes nga rgyal bskyed cing phur bskor dang bcas gnas rnams su gdab: hūm̐: rab 'jigs dpal chen rig sngags thogs: bsrung phyir spyi bor lan gsum bskor: bdag gzhan srung 'khor mi shigs 'bar: bzlog phyir sked par lan gsum bskor: pha rol byad zor rang gshed dbab: bsgral phyir mdun du lan gsum bsgril: 'joms byed chen po dpa' zhing ngar: gdab phyir drag por lan gsum bsgril:

mu stegs dam sri rdul du brlag: dmod pas 'khor ba rtsad gcod phyir: dgra bgegs lto bar kī la ya: srid rtsa me rlung drungs nas phyungs: klad rgya'i mgo la kī la ya: gzugs phung srid pa'i rtse nas shigs: blta byed mig la kī la ya: gzugs su zhen pa'i ru tra chom: nyan byed rna bar kī la ya: sgra la zhen pa'i ru tra chom: tshor byed sna la kī la ya: dri la zhen pa'i ru tra chom: myong byed lce la kī la ya: ro la zhen pa'i ru tra chom: snyob byed lag par kī la ya: 'khums shing chad pa'i dus la bab: 'gro byed rkang par kī la ya: zha zhing rengs pa'i dus la bab: don snying lnga la kī la ya: dug lnga gzhom pa'i dus la bab: dbang po drug la kī la ya: tshogs drug yal ba'i dus la bab: rnam shes sgo dgur kī la ya: khams gsum rigs drug snang ba shigs: zhe sdang pho la kī la ya: rigs rgyud rdzas skam dus la bab: 'dod chags mo la kī la ya: mngal nad khrag skyug dus la bab: gti mug rigs rgyud kī la ya: phung thal sna dgu'i dus la bab: yul mkhar khyim la kī la ya: rjes med brlag pa'i dus la bab: nor rdzas phyugs la kī la ya: ltog 'gong bar chad dus la bab: dgra bgegs sgrol cig kī la ya: srid gsum rigs rgyud thal bar rlog: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya nṛ tri sha trun bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ: khrus lung ni: hūm̐: snang srid phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: gnas gsum sbyor byed āḥdakar las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams: āḥdakar rnam pa spyan drangs nas: bdag nyid la thim sdig ltung sbyangs: gsal stong 'od kyi sku ru gyur: gnas gsum āḥlas grangs med āḥ khams gsum rigs drug sgrib sbyangs nas: dpal chen sku ru lam gyis gyur: gnas gsum āḥlas 'od zer āḥ grangs med char ltar dbab pa las: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i sgrib sbyangs nas: dbyings su sgrol ba'i skal ldan gyur:

a a āḥ zhes dmigs pa gsal zhing bzla: rol mo dang bcas phur bu phyogs bcur gdeng : 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i 'dun pa bskyed: tshe lung dang ni gnas lung dgongs pa ni: zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs dam nyams kyi: snying dbus dmar gsal thig le'i rten: srog rlung ljang gu nṛ yig mtshan: 'gugs byed mtshan mar rnam shes la: btab bo badz+ra kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs longs 'dus byas shig: 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma nṛ yi rnam: tshe bsod bkrag mdangs 'dus pa'i gzugs: kun gzhi'i shes pa āḥdakar bcas: phur bu'i khong gseng nas brgyud de: rgya mdud nas thon thugs kar thim: tshe dang bsod nams gzi byin rgyas: phur pa klad la bskor ba yi: snang srid phur pa'i sku ru gyur: 'od zer 'phro bsdus bdag la thim: hūm̐ zhes phur pa gyen bstan pas: bdag gi thugs las thugs rje'i 'od: zer thag rnal 'byor rlung sems kyi: rnam shes āḥdakar bskyon te phaṭḥ dpag chen mda' ltar 'phang ba yis: 'og min kun bzang sbyor mtshams su: dmigs med chos sku'i mkha' la thim: zhes mos la: hūm̐: mtshan 'dzin phung po bsgral ba'i rnam shes de: āḥyig phur pa'i khong brgyud 'og min zhing : sku gsum bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med gyur: slar yang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig badz+ra kī li kī la ya byad ma nṛ tri trig nan ban+dha ya myog myog thum dril rbad ya bh+yo ya mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces phur bu snying khar nub par btab cing gnas spor: de nas mtshon gyis gtub pa ni: pho'i bla g.yas brtsam ste: pus mo long bu tshigs gsum gtub: g.yas skor tshul gyis lag pa gcod: lag g.yon dang rkang g.yon pa nas dum bu gsum re gtub par bya: mo'i bla g.yon nas brtsam ste: g.yon skor tshul gyis gtub par bya zhing : de ltar gnad don shes byas nas: dang po gshin rje'i ral gri thogs: hūm̐: bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed:

ral gri drag po glog ltar 'khyugs: byad ma bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar thongs: gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: om̐ ya mān+ta ka dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad rbad: pho rgyud min pa'i dbang byas te: rkang g.yas lag g.yas dum bur gtub: rta mchog gsung gi dgra satwa thogs: hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag 'jigs byed sku: gcod byed dgra satwa thog ltar 'bebs: byad ma bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar thongs: gtubs shig dgra satwa 'bar ba'i mtshon: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad rbad: ske bcad lag g.yon rkang g.yon gtub: gsang bdag thugs kyi rdo rje thogs: hūm̐: nga ni gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: ye shes sprul pa'i rdo rje 'dis: rdungs shig rdo rje thog ltar 'bebs: byad ma bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar thongs: gtubs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon: om̐ badz+ra pā ṇi dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad rbad: snying khar rdo rjes brdeg: phrin las me dbal phur pa thogs: hūm̐: nga ni me dbal khro bo'i sku: phur thun drag po ser ltar 'bebs: byad ma bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar thongs: shig cig badz+ra kī la ya: om̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kro ta gha ru ṭa daṇ+ṭa kī la ya phaṭḥ dgra bo snying rtsa la bh+yo bh+yoḥ la ti tha ba ni rak+sha du tra dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: baṃ ril snying rtsa la chum chum: dun+ti sha rbad bh+yo hur hur snying rtsa bh+yo bh+yoḥ

phur bu gzir zhing dgra satwa yis: lus gzhung gshags shing sked par gtub: ji ltar bos pa'i dum bu bsar: de nas gtun du brdung ba ni: gtun snod khrag sbyar lag tu thogs: hūm̐: nga ni rigs lnga khro mo'i sku: thar med hom gyi gtun khung du: rdungs shig rak+ta'i char pa phob: byad ma bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar thongs: choms shig brub khung khrag tu bskyil: om̐ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa dgra bgegs kyi ka wa tsi rbad rbad: pad+ma a kro ta ya kha tham kha tham kha tham: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas brdung : ling ro phye mar bgos te zhal bstab bya: phyed cha bzlog pa'i skabs su 'bul rgyu bzhag: tshogs lhag la'ang cung zad blug: zhal bstab zor gtor dregs par bgos la 'bul: sman raka bran zhing bdud rtsi sbar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: che mchog drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: gnam sa 'dzam gling dgyes pa'i rngam zhal phyes: srid gsum 'od 'bar glog dmar ljags rkyongs shig: gangs dkar ri rab lta bu'i sgrol tshems gtsigs: dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'di: phung po khams dang skye mched rnam shes bcas: hom yangs bde chen 'bar ba'i zhal du bzhes: zung 'jug bde chen rgyas pa'i mgrin par skyil: dug lnga rang grol skye med klong du thim: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li badz+ra kī li kī la ya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya mañdzu shrī h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi ḍāk+ki ha ri ṇi sa yak+sha kā la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta keṃ ni ri ta la kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes 'bul lhag med bzhes shing thugs dam bskang : ye shes 'jig rten sha khrag mchod pas tshim: dam nyams dgra bgegs gzhi dbyings grol bas tshim: bdag nyid bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs tshim:

tshim pa rnam gsum mngon spyod khyad chos so: e maḥ yang zab spu gri'i chos skor las tshogs 'di: kho bo rgya gar mkhas pa dag gis bris: phyi rabs skal ldan dbang lung zab khrid nod: lag len sdeb sbyor 'khrugs bsdebs shes par gyis: dug phreng nag po'i las tshogs dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs shing 'khrugs bsdebs bklag chog mar shog ser las phab pa'o// // wi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: gdab las dug phreng nag po bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal gyi sku la 'dud: de nas 'phang ba'i dus la bab pa'i tsheḥ zor gtor 'og gi liṅga sbyin sreg bya: zor gtor mtha' yi ling chung dmar gtor bsgral bstab kyi: bdud 'dul dregs pa'i dpung tshogs las la bskul: dpa' ba'i go gyon rno ba'i mtshon thogs nas: hūm̐ phaṭ bh+yo zlog drag sngags 'brug ltar ldir: srid gsum log 'dren za ba'i las la rngam: bdud 'joms las la rings ba'i tshul du bskul: sha chen spos bsreg thod rnga rkang gling dang : rngam pa'i rol mo drag po'i nga ro yis: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar rab 'bar 'khrugs pa'i klong : snang srid lha srin sde brgyad khri steng du: g.yul las rnam rgyal gtum chen mthu bo che: che btsan khros pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: khyod ni dus ngan snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon mchog: bdag gis rtse gcig gus pas bsten sgrub tshe: thugs bskyed smon lam thugs rjes dus 'di ru: rtse bas dgongs shig rgyal ba rig 'dzin tshogs: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i rtsal shugs bskyed du gsol: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la:

sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: dam nyams 'di yi mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes bskul liṅga sha dum bcas: tshig mtshams so sor bsgral bstab bya: dmar sbreng drag po'i gtor tshogs bya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mth-ing nag gru gsum e yi dal dbus su: mi bzad stobs ldan pad+ma he ru kaḥ che mchog bdud 'dul kī la skur bzhengs shig: drag po'i mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i tshe: stong khams mtshon cha tshwa tshwa si li li: dug gi ser 'bebs bskal me lhabs se lhab: pho rgyud mo rgyud las byed sha ra ra: dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs nyi li li: sha za khrag 'thung rkan sgra thags se thag: dregs pa srog la dbang bas phrin las mdzod: mthing nag drag po kī la mthu bo che: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril glog dmar me dpung g.yo: spyan bgrad rta skad drag po phyogs bcur sgrog: gnam lcags rdo rje'i ri rab bshig cing nyil: snang srid phur pas bstan dgra ma rungs brlag: rdzu 'phrul 'dab gshog bar snang rlabs kyis gcod: dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: chu srin rngam zhal bstan bshig snying khrag 'thung : gnam lcags phur gsham byad ma'i srog rtsa gcod: khro rgyal stobs 'dus drag po'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan la dgrar sdang byad ma rnams: ring por ma thogs gzugs ling 'di la khug: bsgral zhing bstab bo badz+ra kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma hur thum rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams dgra la zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa dang : than ltas sna dgus dgra yul phung thal thongs: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos 'byung dmar nag rab rgyas dkyil 'khor nas: drag mo bdud 'dul nag mo skur bzhengs shig: dam nyams sdig can sgrol ba'i dus la bab:

sangs rgyas sogs? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: smug nag klong yangs mtha' bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas: dregs pa dbang sdud nag po skur bzhengs shig: mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan l hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: srid pa'i ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: khyung nag srog gzan nag po skur bzhengs shig: gza' klu rgyal nad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan l hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ser nag ral gri brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal gshin rje kī la skur bzhengs shig: rgya nad rgyu gzer bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dmar nag spu gri brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas: dbang gi rgyal po kī la skur bzhengs shig: btsan gyi rta nad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag chu srin brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: gtum po phyag rdor kī la skur bzhengs shig: smyo 'bog srog rlung bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sngo nag gsal shing brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: drag byed khro mo rigs lnga skur bzhengs shig: ma yams sun ma bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ljang nag rlung gri brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: stobs ldan yak+sha kī la skur bzhengs shig: byad kha gtad mnan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: shar phyogs me long sprul pa'i dur khrod nas: drag rtsal badz+ra kī la skur bzhengs shig: shar phyogs dmag g.yos bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs mnyam nyid sprul pa'i dur khrod nas: drag rtsal rat+na kī la skur bzhengs shig: lho phyogs dmag g.yos bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nub phyogs sor rtogs sprul pa'i dur khrod nas: drag rtsal pad+ma kī la skur bzhengs shig: nub phyogs dmag g.yos bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan la dgrar sdang byad ma rnams:

ring por ma thogs gzugs ling 'di la khug: bsgral zhing bstab bo badz+ra kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma hur thum rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams dgra la zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa dang : than ltas sna dgus dgra yul phung thal thongs: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byang phyogs bya grub sprul pa'i dur khrod nas: drag rtsal karma kī la skur bzhengs shig: byang phyogs dmag g.yos bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? de nas 'khor gyi sde brgyad bskul zhing mngag pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: srid pa'i shar phyogs sku mkhar nas: lha yi rgyal po skur bzhengs shig: bka' chad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs gshin rje'i lcags mkhar nas: ya ma ra tsa skur bzhengs shig: khrims kha bzlog pa'i dus la babs: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nub phyogs dbyings kyi sku mkhar nas: las kyi ma mo skur bzhengs shig: gshin bdud bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya:

nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byang phyogs mun gling sku mkhar nas: srog bdag nag po skur bzhengs shig: gshin bdud bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: shar lho'i srid rtse'i sku mkhar nas: shel ging srog bdag skur bzhengs shig: smyo 'bog bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas? hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho nub khra tshwa'i sku mkhar nas: 'bar ba btsan rgod skur bzhengs shig: jag sna bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nub byang dregs 'dul sku mkhar nas: yak+sha kī la skur bzhengs shig: rbod stong bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byang shar rgya mtsho'i mkha' klong nas: kha la rak+ṣa skur bzhengs shig: klu nad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: shar phyogs dung mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma stag gdong skur bzhengs shig: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs gser mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma 'ug gdong skur bzhengs shig: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nub phyogs zangs mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma khwa gdong skur bzhengs shig: mos bzhi dbang sdud dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog:

than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: byang phyogs lcags mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma spyang gdong skur bzhengs shig: dgra bgegs tshar gcod dus la bab: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bskul lo bskul lo thugs dam rgyud bskul cig: mdzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dam tshig thugs dam dus las ma 'da' bar: bstan dgra dam nyams ma rungs sems ldan rnams: myur du khug la bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces liṅga dang gtor chung rdzogs rjes su: rak+tas bran cing dmigs bsal dgra bo yin na ming bcug: lha srin sde brgyad dmag tshogs dgra bo yul du chas nas byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa rdul du brlags par bsam mo: sa ma ya: e ma rno myur zab pa'i ti la ka: thog mda' reg chod nag lam bzlog med kyi: las 'jug g.yul 'joms las la chas pa'i tshe: dregs pa'i dmag ston gdab las dmar la ste: pha rol dpung 'joms bzlog pa'i lde kha'o:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // zhi) ༈ sangs rgyas bstan la dgrar sdang byad ma rnams: ring por ma thogs gzugs ling 'di la khug: bsgral zhing bstab bo badz+ra kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma hur thum rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams dgra la zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa dang : than ltas sna dgus dgra yul phung thal thongs: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zi) ༄/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di: ring por ma thogs myur du khug: bsgral zhing gtub bo kī la ya: nṛ tri dgra bo byad ma rbad: dug gsum sha khrag rus pa bzhes: bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: snang srid lha srin dal yams zlog: gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul ngo zlog: than ltas sna dgu dgra la thongs: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: zhes sde brgyad kyi rgyug byang ngo*// // 'i) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: rtsang bzlog dmod pa snying gzir nag po zhes bzhugs so: rtsang bzlog srid gsum sgrol byed bdud 'joms snying gzir nag po bya ba ni: rtsang rnams ye shes kyi pho nya las byed dregs pa'i dmag dpung tsha zhing ngar ba rno zhing myur ba stong gsum thams cad gang bas mtha' dmag nad mtshon rims dal 'byung ba bzhi'i g.yo 'khrug la sogs pa brlag cing dmigs med chen por bsgom la: rtsang rnams la dmar sbreng zhing rol mo rngam brjid dang bcas pas: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang mthing nag e yi klong : pho nya las mkhan tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir: che mchog khros pa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: las mkhan srog gcod lha tshogs gshegs su gsol:

shan pa gri thogs dmag tshogs gshegs nas kyang : myur mgyogs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: khrag zhag rba klong mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas rtsang khungs byung ba ni: hūm̐: myur mgyogs pho nya tshogs pa'i rten: dmar nag drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: dang po the'u rang yul nas byung : slob dpon rdo rje drag rtsal gyis: mu stegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir: mgar nag bka' yis bskul ba las: gri lcags sna dgu'i satwa re brdungs: dug sbyor dgu yi ngar btab pas: reg chod satwa re de nas byung : de nas rtsang byung gang nas byung : rtsang byung gshin rje'i yul nas byung : las gshin shan pa dmar nag gis: las mkhan gcer bu pho nyar rbad: gshin rje gdug pa'i dmag sna drangs: dug mda' gzer bu de las byung : de nas rtsang byung gang nas byung : rtsang byung srin po'i yul nas byung : gdug pa'i shing la lha min tshogs: gshin rje'i mtshon gyis dbal btab pas: lha min shing bcad yo zhing 'gyel: shar du yo dang lho ru 'gyel: nub tu gas shing byang du chag: dum bu dgu ru gyur pa las: rdzas ngan sna dgu'i rtsang phur byung : rtsang phur btsan gyi yul nas byung : btsan rje kha bzhi gdong brgyad des: bcad gtub rtsang phur bcos pa las: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi ru grub: rdzas ngan dug dang khrag ngar btab: srin po klu yi kha chus bran: gdug pa bdud kyis byin rlabs byas: ma mos rims nad par bur bsgyur: gza' rgod thog mda'i rdzas su dmod: slob dpon phyag tu phul ba las: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gzhi bkod: dug khrag gshin rje'i pho brang bris: gdug pa'i dpal gtor zor rdzas bshams: chu srin srin mo pho nya dang : spu gri drwa ba gtams pa yi: phrin las bzhi ldan rtsang phur btsugs: ngan sngags bden pa'i dmod bor bas: mu stegs khrag bskyugs brgyal bas gum: de ltar sngon tshe rtags mngon bzhin:

do nub pho nya las la bskul: gzir mda' rtsang phur zur gsum 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la thob: byad ma rang gshed rang la phob: pha rol bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: bskul lo rtsang phur mthu ma chung : rbad do bskul lo bang ma bul: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la thob: khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de rgyab sprul pa'i pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mo dbyings kyis mkha' la bslebs: mar gyi rtse mos ngan song gnas su brjid: sked pa rgya mdud sku lnga lhun gyis grub: yar rtse rig 'dzin lha tshogs spungs se spung : mar rtse 'gro drug thar lam sha ra ra: rgya mdud gnyis med gsal stong khro lo lo: dug lnga sgrol ba'i chos nyid rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: rnam rtog mtshan 'dzin dgra bgegs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mo srid gsum 'jig rten g.yo: mar gyi rtse mo gshin yul sa 'og 'joms: sked pa rgya mdud snang srid gzhal yas khang : yar gyi rtse la lha dang lha min 'thab: mar gyi rtse la gshin rje klu bdud 'thab: rgya mdud lha srin dmag tshogs dgra la 'gyed: srog gcod pho nya gdug pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i dal kha rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mo tshangs pa'i gnas gzhir bsnyegs: mar gyi rtse mo sa bdag klu gnyan gzir: skad pa rgya mdud mun gling 'khrug cing 'bar: las kyi gshin rje rngam pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: snang srid las kyi g.yo 'khrug rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur yar gyi rtse mo la: bya khyung dmag tshogs gshog sgra 'u ru ru: gdug pa'i rtsang phur mar gyi rtse mo nas:

dug sbrul nag po'i 'khyug 'greng khyugs se khyug: rgya mdud chu srin rkan sgra thags se thag: dgra bgegs byad ma klu yi lag tu gtad: klu bdud mdze nad sna dgu dgra la thongs: dgra bo byad ma lha srung rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur yar gyi rtse mo la: btsan dmag 'bum gyi sho kha tha ra ra: gdug pa'i rtsang phur mar gyi rtse mo la: shan pa dmar nag 'o dod lhangs se lhang : rgya mdud the'u rang bu yug chi li li: dgra bgegs byad ma btsan gyi lag tu gtad: btsan gyi jag sna snying gzer dgra la thongs: dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur yar gyi rtse mo la: 'chi bdag bdud nag zhags pa na ra ra: gdug pa'i rtsang phur mar gyi rtse mo la: mi nag gcer bus 'o dod lhangs se lhang : rgya mdud 'dre mo'i srog len zhungs se zhung : dgra bgegs byad ma bdud kyi lag tu gtad: smyo 'bog rengs shing dgra srog dmar po chod: bdud bzhi 'chi bdag sna dgu rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur yar gyi rtse mo la: lha dmag nyi khris bswo sgra di ri ri: gdug pa'i rtsang phur mar gyi rtse mo la: lha min gdug rtsub ngar mtshon spungs se spung : rgya mdud gnod sbyin snying bskur 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs yul 'dre 'byung po'i lag tu gtad: 'gong po 'byung 'dre'i ltas ngan dgra la phob: lha srin sde dpon g.yo 'khrug rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur gar stabs 'gros su btsugs: las mkhan pho nya'i gar stabs lings se ling : srog gcod rtsang phur srin mo'i 'gros su btsugs: khrag mdog srin mos sha za ljibs se ljib: mnan gtad rtsang phur chu srin 'gros su btsugs: ngag mnan chu srin gre ba thams se tham: sgrol 'debs rtsang phur phur bu 'gros su btsugs: las mkhan mtshon cha tshwa tshwa si li li: bzlog pa'i rtsang phur dmag g.yos tshul du btsugs: lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung nyi li li:

srung ba'i rtsang phur mig mang drwa bar btsugs: rang 'dra'i khro bos drag sngags di ri ri: rtsang phur pho nya dmod pa las kyi lha: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ rtsang phur sha za ljibs se ljib: rtsang phur khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rtsang phur rus mur krums se krum: rtsang phur zlog sngags sha ra ra: rtsang phur dug rlangs chi li li: rtsang phur rbad bskul sha ra ra: bzlog cig byad zor phur kha zlog: sgrol cig brnag pa'i byad ma sgrol: rtsang gi lha de rtsang la btsugs: khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: mtha' 'khob dmag dpung rtsang gis zlog: nad 'khrug cho 'phrul rtsang gis zlog: byad ma gdug pa'i dmag tshogs rnams: do nub dmar nag rtsang gis zlog: bzlog cig bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog mā ra ya: byad ma g.yul gshom lha srung dang bcas pa thums shig ha la ha la: dun dun yam shig rbad: ces khrag mchod phul zhing : rtsang la gnas pa'i pho nya rnams go gyon cing mtshon thogs nas bzlog bsad byed par bsam: g.yul bzlog gnam lcags thog mda'i gzer bu'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o// // yi) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: bzlog 'phyong gshin rje myos byed dug mda' nag po bzhugs so: dpal chen khro rgyal he ru ka pa yi: drag rtsal bzlog 'phyong dug mda' nag po bstan: phyi rabs rten 'brel chos bdag bu la sprod: shan pa sde bzhi gsang ba'i a thaṃ rgya: de'ang bzlog pa'i bskul ring las bzhi rdzogs nas: zlog byed khro bo nag po'i dmag tshogs thams cad zhal phyir gzigs nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi bu yug 'bebs shing mtha' bzhi'i g.yul dang chag che nyam nga thams cad gnod byed pha rol gyi steng du bzlog par bsams la:

rnga rdung dung 'bud rak+tas bran la 'di skad do: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mthing nag gru gsum zla gam khrag mtsho'i klong : snang srid dregs chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: che btsan khros pa'i dkyil 'khor khro bo'i tshogs: bzhengs shig dur khrod chen po'i gnas nas bzhengs: do nub zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: dam las ma 'da' bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas bzlog pa'i byung khungs bshad cing gyer ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: lha dbang gzhon nu stobs rgyal gyis: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gi: lha min dmag tshogs rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring rig sngags drag pos bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po dang : mu stegs sde bzhi rtsod pa'i tshe: chos rgyal shrī gha dha yis: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gis: mu stegs dmag tshogs rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring rig sngags drag pos bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi:

chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : slob dpon seṅge sgra sgrogs dang : mu stegs ma hor nag po gnyis: bden gnyis dam chos rtsod pa'i tshe: slob dpon kī la drag rtsal gyis: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gis: mu stegs dmag tshogs rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring rig sngags drag pos bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : mtha' bzhi'i g.yul ngo rtsod pa'i tshe: khrag 'thung badz+ra gro lod kyis: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gis: mtha' bzhi'i dmag tshogs rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring drag sngags drag pos bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang : bod kyi lha srin 'thab pa'i tshe:

slob dpon badz+ra kī la yas: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gis: mu stegs dmag tshogs rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring rig sngags drag po bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal gyis: drag sngags zab gter spyan drangs tshe: lta log grub mthas 'tshe zhing brnyas: rgyal bstan bdud kyis bcom pa'i tshe: zil gnon bdud 'dul kī la yas: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gi: dam sri bdud rigs rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring rig sngags drag pos bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis: chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : phyi rabs rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: mu stegs dmag tshogs 'joms pa dang : rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: zhe sdang drag po'i snod du bzhag: gtum rngam drag po rtsang gis brgyan: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs:

drag sngags zor mda' sna dgus brgyan: bdud 'dul ngan sngags btab pa'i tshe: bden pas dmod pa'i rtags byung gis: rkyen ngan bar chad rdul du brlags: sngon byung dngos rtags de bzhin du: de ring rig sngags drag pos bskul: mtha' dmag gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dang : rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: chag che nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab:

ces khyung nag gi bzlog byang ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: che mchog badz+ra kī la mthu bo che: dmod pa'i zlog sgyur phrin las dus la bab: pha tshogs yab kyi drag sngags dgra la zlog: ma tshogs yum gyi drag sngags dgra la zlog: 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: lha yis bka' chad babs pa dgra la zlog: lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa dgra la zlog: lha 'dre'-i za kha ston pa dgra la zlog: ma mo'i nad yams 'khrug rtsod dgra la zlog: gshin rje dregs pa'i khram kha dgra la zlog: bdud kyi sho rdel babs pa dgra la zlog: btsan gyi jag pa rgyug pa dgra la zlog: gnod sbyin srog lus rku ba dgra la zlog: klu bdud gtad khram nag po dgra la zlog: drang srong gza' yi gdug rtsub dgra la zlog: the'u rang 'gong po'i phung shig dgra la zlog: ki kang nag po'i dug zor dgra la zlog: shel ging rgyal po'i smyo 'bog dgra la zlog: grong rgyun 'dre mos 'o dod dgra la zlog: shi 'dre bse rag za kha dgra la zlog: shel gyi mi dkar rgyang glu dgra la zlog: rgya gar chos kyi dmod zor dgra la zlog: rgya nag bsgyur gto gtong ba dgra la zlog: zhang zhung bon gyi mthu sgrub dgra la zlog: sum pa'i dug glang zor mda' dgra la zlog: li yi spar kha gdan bgos dgra la zlog: za hor me yi zor mda' dgra la zlog: stag gzig dbal gyi ngar kha dgra la zlog: me nyag sog mo 'debs pa dgra la zlog: sngags nag gtor ham sbar ba dgra la zlog: skyes pa'i bswo 'gran mda' gri dgra la zlog: bud med dmod pa'i thal zor dgra la zlog: byis pa'i dgu thog rbab 'dre dgra la zlog: ban de ngan pa'i dmod kha dgra la zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ gnam nas bdud kyis 'bod pa dgra la zlog: sa nas dug mda' langs pa dgra la zlog: bar nas gri btsan rgyug pa dgra la zlog: rims yams me 'bar gnyan nad dgra la zlog: spar kha'i gzhi legs sde 'khrugs dgra la zlog:

gza' skar dus babs gtong ba dgra la zlog: rlung rta'i rgya ma chag pa dgra la zlog: dbang thang za kha thung ba dgra la zlog: rten phur 'ju thag chad pa dgra la zlog: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams pa dgra la zlog: shi 'dres mi bla 'phrog pa dgra la zlog: gshed bzhi'i rgya dur 'phrad pa dgra la zlog: mi kha phung shig ngan smra dgra la zlog: gtam ngan mi kha 'bu shu dgra la zlog: gnam 'khrug ri ltar nyil ba dgra la zlog: sa 'khrug chu ltar 'brub pa dgra la zlog: bar 'khrug rlung ltar 'tshubs pa dgra la zlog: yul 'khrug 'bras ltar bsigs pa dgra la zlog: dus 'khrug mtshon gyi dbal kha dgra la zlog: klu 'khrug mdze nad lhog rgod dgra la zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: glo bur nyi khri chig stong dgra la zlog: bgegs rig stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la zlog: gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad dgra la zlog: skag chen sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: mi mthun rkyen ngan dgra bo'i steng du zlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ pho bdud dal kha g.yas su zlog: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du zlog: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la zlog: chung bdud dal kha phyogs bcur zlog: ma rungs sna dgu'i than ltas rnams: dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma'i steng du bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog rbad rbad bsgyur ya: zhes rtsa sngags dang zlog sngags kyis bskrad la thun gyis brab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o// // ri) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: khyung bzlog srid gsum brlag byed khro chu'i zhun khol bzhugs so: khyung bzlog srid gsum brlag byed ni: dbang gi rigs bdag khros pa'i dbyings: srid pa las kyi ga ru ṭasaḥ sprul pa yang sprul dpag med 'gyed:

sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i khyon: yom yom shig shig krang kring sgrog: snang srid khams kun g.yo zhing ldeg: za byed khro chu'i zhun ltar khol: 'khor 'das rig sngags dmod par byed: nad dal mtshon 'khrug cho 'phrul than: srid gsum g.yo 'khrug ma lus pa: nus stobs rtsal gyis brlags par bsam: dmar sbreng gsur chen dud sprin gtibs: rngam brjid rol mo'i dpa' stobs dang : srid gsum g.yo ba'i nga ro yis: hūm̐: srid pa'i ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: bde gshegs thugs sprul mkha' lding ga ru ṭaḥ mthing nag rngam pa krang kring sgra sgrogs che'i: sprul pa yang sprul srid pa bya khyung 'bum: thugs dam bskul zhing zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dbu skra dmar ser sprin ltar g.yo ba yi: srid pa las kyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: gnam lcags khro chu'i rwa gnyis gzengs pa yis: ma mo'i dal kha yams nad bzlog tu gsol: snang mtha' yid bzhin nor bus brgyan pa yis: yi dam bka' chad 'bebs pa bzlog tu gsol: gser mig tshwa tshwa drag tu khol ba yis: zhe sdang lha srin sde 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje'i zhal gdangs dbal mche gtsigs pa yis: rgyal 'gong srin po'i gnod pa bzlog tu gsol: ljags dmar drag po glog ltar 'khyugs pa yis: mo nad wa ril lhog yams bzlog tu gsol: dug sbrul pho mo zhal du gsol ba yis: klu nad gnyan gzer dug mda' bzlog tu gsol: phyag gnyis lcags sder bgrad cing gzir ba yis: sa bdag dmu chu zha grum bzlog tu gsol: ral gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: khro bo khro mo'i zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: spu gri'i sgro thur me zer 'phro ba yis: bar snang lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod rus rgyan sgra ldan 'khrol ba yis: tshogs drug dug lnga'i dmag tshogs bzlog tu gsol: lte ba gnyan po mig gis brgyan pa yis: ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags bzlog tu gsol:

zangs sder gdol pa pho mo 'dzin pa yis: gdug pa'i lha srin g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: ye shes me dpung dmar nag 'khrigs pa yis: snang srid las kyi bka' chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bskul lo bya khyung rgyal po mthu ma chung : rbad do yang sprul dmag tshogs rtsal ma zhan: bzlog cig byad ma lha srung dmag tshogs rnams: dmigs rten bya rgod sha la rol ba bzhin: 'gugs 'ching sdom pa'i myos sdig sha la rol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dmag tshogs cham la phob: sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod: om̐ khrom raṃ ga ru ṭa ka la pa k+ṣeṃ dgra bo byad ma bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces zlog sgyur bya: e maḥ bzlog pas mi bzlog yang bzlog che: khyung bzlog srid gsum brlag byed 'di: g.yul bzlog dregs pa'i cha lag go: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // li) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: than bzlog stong thun nag po ngan dgu'i sgyur chog bzhugs so: bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru rtsal la 'dud: ma 'ongs sems can dug lnga'i stobs rgyas pas: mi dge bcu spyod dge bcu khyad gsod brnyas: bstan gnyis zung 'jug ya ma zung du 'gro: gcig gis gcig gsod tha ma gnyis phung 'gyur: de yi rkyen gyis gnam sa bar gsum 'khrug: bstan 'dzin nyung zhing bstan bshig bdud rigs dar: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i than ltas cho 'phrul lang : 'jig rten khams gsum mtshon 'khrug nad mug g.yo: chos byed skyes bu re tsam byung na yang : bdud rigs bar gcod don gnyis mtha' mi gsal: mu stegs nag po'i dmag tshogs bod du lhags: snying po'i bstan bsnub bstan 'dzin srog la rgol: chos byed nyam dma' sdig spyod mnga' thang rgyas: de yi stobs 'joms bdud 'dul kī la ya:

gzhung dang las tshogs kha tshang don dril ba: bzlog pa'i kha tshar stong thun nag po bcas: ma 'ongs bstan pa srung ba'i mtshon char bzhag: mthu chen hūm̐ gi ming dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: than dang byad ltas bzlog pa'i rim pa ni: rnga rdung dar nag rdeb cing ting nge 'dzin: 'ur 'jam rngam pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di ltar gyer: hūm̐: sngon tshe ye med stong pa la: snang ba 'khrul ba'i sgong bu srid: de la bya khyung dkar po srid: dpag bsam shing la tshang yang bcas: shing la srin bya gshog can byung : de gnyis 'tshogs pa'i ltas ngan la: 'dab chags mche can ltas ngan byung : de yi ltas ngan gtor mas bzlog: sgong bu nag po skyes pa la: sa yi byi nag lag drug byung : ri rab zom la tshang bcas chags: sa la sa khyi sbrul 'jug byung : de gnyis srid par 'jug pa la: gcan gzan sder chags ltas ngan byung : de yi ltas ngan gtor mas bzlog: sgong bu ser po skyes pa la: spra ser mi min can yin byung : brag nag bya skyibs tshang bcas pas: brag la bud med srin gzugs byung : de gnyis 'dod srid log pa las: ming sring 'khrig pa'i ltas ngan byung : de yi brda than gtor mas bzlog: nyi zla'i 'od nyams stong sgra 'byin: srid pa 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: 'byung ba 'khrug cing mtshon kha g.yo: yi dam lha yis bka' chad yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: bya nag gshog rdeb sder mchu brdar: pho rgyud 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: bong zhon dril zhon rlung dmar g.yo: mo rgyud 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: stong chem sgra sgrogs ri rnams ngur: sde brgyad 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: thog ser g.yo zhing mun nag 'thib: gza' rgod bka' chad ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog:

gnam la tshan than sprin dmar mched: gzhi bdag 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mkha' la bun nag sngo dmar 'tshub: ma yams 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: nyi ma log zer dum bu 'byung : mtho 'bebs mkhar 'bebs ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: yul gru 'jag skya shing skam phyug: rma g.yang nyams pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: dbyar dgun go log rlung dmar g.yo: dus 'khrug 'byung ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sa g.yo 'bir ldir khol chen g.yo: chos srid 'bebs pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sde dpon nang 'khrug blo ngan spyod: rgyal srid stong ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: ban bon sngags btsun g.yul ngo 'dren: dam sri 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mchod khang tshag cing stong sgra mang : pe har 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: tog dang rnga thug sing sgra 'byung : zhig ral 'byung ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: ka cha mchod cha 'khrol zhing chag: 'gong pos 'tshe ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sgo khyi'i sgo them slog pa de: kha yog 'byung ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: khang pa'i ka gdung chag pa de: rkyen kha glo bur ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sbra gur chon thag rgyug pa de: shor rgod 'ong ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: rta drel rnga rngog 'cha' ba de: pho lha nyams pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sbra la skya thig bya sbal de: god kha sdang ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: khang khyim byi bas skad ngan 'don: bse rag zhugs pa'i ltas ngan yin:

brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mi skra gcod cing gos lag breg: glo bur na'am 'chi ba'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: tho rangs mdzo pho ldang zhing ngur: bdud kyis mi bla 'gugs pa'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: nam phyed rta pho 'tsher ba de: gnod sbyin phung thal ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: srod 'phros khyi nag ngu zug snang : grong du 'dre mo'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: rlung nag khang khyim g.yogs pa de: shi bla gson la 'gyu ba'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: shi mig gson la blta ba de: za 'dre gshin rta rgyug pa'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: pha spun nang 'thab rgyag pa de: dgra lha mi 'og shor ba'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: ming sring khyim thab bzung ba de: mi kha phung gyod srid pa'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: chung mas khyo gyod btsal ba de: mtha' 'khon bye bral yong ba'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: bu sring kha lce mang ba de: ming po'i ltag pa phung ba'i ltas: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: chu gnas 'khrug cing 'thab pa de: klu bdud khros pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sbrul dang sbal nag 'thab pa de: sa bdag 'khrug pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sre mong byi ro khyer ba de: chung sri ldang ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: thad du gcan gzan 'thab pa de: gri rgod 'byung ba'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: wa mos sgo bskor ku 'debs de: srin mo bong zhon ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: shwa phos ru 'dzing 'thab pa de: gri btsan g.yos pa'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog:

mgo rdum sha thed rnyed pa de: 'chi bdag zhags pa thebs pa'i rtags: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: stag gis mi ro khyer mthong de: phung rngam nag po'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: dur byas bshugs glu sgrog pa de: dur sri nag po'i ltas ngan yin: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: dud 'gro gang zhig la la'i rigs: mgo gcig mig dgu gza' yi than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: lto sbyor nag po gshin rje'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: rgyu bshal dmar po btsan 'gong than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: chu yi gtsug phud dbu yi than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mgo chad phrag ral byad kha'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: lus gcig mgo gsum ma mo'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: bya mchu kha sho 'gong po'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: zo lag brang brdungs gnod sbyin than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: dud 'gro mi gzugs rgyal po'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: lus gnyis sgal 'byar srin po'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: lus gnyis mgo gcig sha za'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: lus gcig mgo gnyis 'dre mo'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: yas 'gem mas 'gem bse rag than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: tshigs la lhag chad the'u rang than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: ya mchu med pa pho lha'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mgo bo med pa gre bo'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: bu ga med pa rabs chad than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: rgyab tu lag 'byar za 'dre'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mig med mche can ma mo'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: gru gu zlum po dmu yi than:

brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: don snying med pa 'chi bdag than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: rgyu ma med pa 'byung po'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mdzo nag gnyis 'brel bdud kyi than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: ma kha med pa za 'dre'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sbrul gyi mjug can sde brgyad than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: mgo mjug sprad pa bka' chad than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: 'dab chags gzugs can yul lha'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: gcan gzan gzugs can sde brgyad than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: sha mis rgal 'phru 'dre mo'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: ltag pa'i kha mig gnod sbyin than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: dbang po'i chad lhag log pa'i than: brda than bsgyur ro ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu gya gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: rbad 'dre byur kha mi kha zlog: dgra gyod phung sri ltas ngan zlog: yul 'dre dam sri rgyal 'khyams zlog: mi nad nor nad yams nad zlog: mi srid srid pa'i ltas ngan zlog: pho rgyud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo rgyud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: chung bdud dal kha thad du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: byad ma rang gshed rang la phob: bzlog cig sgyur cig phrin las mdzod: pho bh+yo g.yas su bh+yoḥ mo bh+yo g.yon du bh+yoḥ za ba'i 'dre la bh+yoḥ phung ba'i sri la bh+yoḥ gyod dang byur la bh+yoḥ ban byad ban la bh+yoḥ bon byad bon la bh+yoḥ rang gshed rang la phob: thal ba rdul du rlog: kun rdzob cho 'phrul rnams: dmigs med klong du zlog: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog bzlog: gnod byed sarba mā ra ya rbad rbad:

ces zlog sngags dang bcas nas ltas ngan gang byung ba la dmigs te bzlog pa bya: sa ma ya: g.yul bzlog gzhung dang ma 'brel par than bzlog kyang byed na: lcags snod du drag po'i dmar gtor lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: tshe yungs rtsang dmar sha dum gyis brgyan la bsham: las gzhung bsrang : zor rdzas byin rlabs byas nas: zlog sngags kyis bsgrub: spro na gdab las zhal bstab bya: bskul ba dang bcas dgra phyogs su 'phang : e ma zab pa'i mthar thug pa: than bzlog ltas ngan tshar gcod 'di: gnam lcags gcod pa'i ral gri'i mtshon: phung thal bshig pa'i mtshon char shog: ltas ngan yul sdig ci byung yang : lan gcig bstab pas myur du zhi: gdab las btab na lta ci smos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // shi)༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: zor rdzas byin rlabs dug mtshon reg chod bzhugs so: g.yul bzlog dreg dpung gnam lcags thog mda' yi: mtha' skor dmod pa drag po'i zor rdzas ni: phung sa'i kong bu tshe yungs dmar nag rtsang : dug khrag rbab rgod dang ni tsit+ta'i zor: skyer phur thod zor dug mda' gshin rje'i khram: ke tshe shang tshe kong bu'i kha khyer la: byad thag sna lngas dkris la zor du bsham: dug khrag sbreng zhing gnam lcags thog ltar bsgom: oṃ badz+ra kro ta kī la ya mā ra ya swā hā: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bh+yoḥ drag po khros pa'i ngang las bzhengs pa'i mtshon: srid pa las kyi drag rdzas zor thun la: mtshon 'khrug yams nad 'phro ba'i rang bzhin can: bsam chod reg chod gdong chod dregs pa'i mtshon: gang la gdab kyang thogs med sgrub rdzas 'di: rig 'dzin grub thob bla ma rgya mtsho dang : yi dam drag po thod phreng bdud 'dul bcas: chos skyong dregs pa'i dmag tshogs sde dpon gyis:

zor rdzas gdug pa'i mtshon char byin gyis rlobs: do nub drag po'i zor rdzas bsgral chas 'di: gang la phog kyang myur du sgrol mdzad pa'i: dgra bgegs srog gi spu gri 'byung gyur cig: ces brjod bzlog bsad sngags kyi byin brlabs shing : nus rtsal stobs shugs bsgyur stim yang yang bya: zor gyi rdzas la zlog sngags btab cing 'phang : rgyas pa ltar na drag po'i dmar 'gyed kyi: rbad sngags 'khor lo'i sngags rnams gong du bskyil: gang tshe skyes bu g.yul du zhugs pa'i tshe: go mtshon drag po'i zor ltar byin brlabs nas: skyes bu bdud 'dul kī lar dbang bskur te: mtshon cha dregs pa'i dpung bskyed bran du gtad: mtshon srung g.yul bzlog sku 'khor lus la 'chang : dpal chen mnga' gsol rab gnas bkra shis bcas: gser skyems dgra lha mchod cing dregs sde bskul: g.yul gshom bdud dpung 'joms par the tshom med: gzhan yang dmag dpon re dang dregs pa dang : sbrags te dregs pa'i 'du shes bskyed: ngar ngar bswo sgras drag po'i dmag sna 'dren: mtshon srung rdo rje'i go khrab 'chang bar gces: 'di yang bdud dpung gzhom pa'i zhal gdams yin: e ma zor rdzas rno myur gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog: ma rungs bdud dpung 'joms pa'i mtshon gcig pu: ngan sngags dug gi par bu'i sde ba ste: ma 'ongs bstan pa srung ba'i mtshon char bzhag: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // si)༈ bla ma drag po rtsal gyi 'phen pa zor gyi lhan thabs dgra bgegs dpung 'joms bzhugs so: rig sngags dmod pa drag po'i lha la 'dud: phyi nang gi sgo dbye: glud za lam: zor rdzas byin brlab sogs grub nas ji ltar bab pa'i sar phyin pa dang :

gser skyems btang ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs klong nas bzhengs: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: drag po mthu yi gzi byin bskyed du gsol: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir ma nyes gzu dang dpang po mdzod: bstan pa'i srog ni rdo rje theg pa la: mu stegs log lta can gyis brnyas btsugs so: rgyu drang bka' btsan man ngag don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rgya bod mkhas grub rig 'dzin pad 'byung la: bdud blon bsam ngan can gyis brnyas btsugs so: 'ja' lus skye 'chi bral ba don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgongs brgyud slob dpon gzu dang dpang po mdzod: mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag rdzogs chen a ti la: nyan thos grub mtha' can gyis brnyas btsugs so: chos nyid mngon sum ston pa don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: ma sring mkha' 'gro kun gyis gzu dpang mdzod: rig 'dzin rjes 'jug rgyal tshab rnal 'byor la: bdud rigs dam sri ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas bsgrubs pa don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: ma nyes snod ldan bdag cag sgrub pa por: dam nyams dgra bo 'di yis brnyas btsugs so: rbad bskul pho nyar mngags pa don ma chung : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gter srung mthu ldan gzu dang dpang po mdzod: bdag ni ma nyes dam nyams dgra bo nyes: phyi rgyud lha dang srung ma thams cad kun: de ring drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams ru tra'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: dgra bo kho rang lha srung gshed du phob:

mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems 'thor: dmigs bya bskyed cing 'gugs gzhug lan gsum byas la: thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bzhengs shig skye med chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: dgongs shig rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgongs: ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog gnyan po bzhugs: slob dpon rgyud srung gnyan po'i rgyab rten mdzod: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dmag dpung skyed: dam can bka' srung gter bdag zor sna drongs: snang srid lha srin gzhi bdag zor lam phyes: nyes can dgra bo ma gtogs sku bzur cig: dbu chum zhabs skums g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzhud: gal te nyes na le lan dgra la phob: nyes med rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag la: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'dis: byas med srog rgol chags med bu lon bsnyags: dkar po khyad du gsod pa'i dgra bo 'di: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces bskul la: de nas lha'i kong zor thogs te: hūm̐: dur khrod phung shul dgu las grub pa'i sa: ngan sngags gdug pa'i kong zor dmar nag 'di: srid pa'i lha gnyan chen pos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: āḥdhe wa ra tsa dgra bau nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: gshin rje'i dza khram thogs la: hūm̐: tsha ngar gdug pa'i shing las byung ba yi: phung bshig rdzas kyis thig nag gtab pa 'di: las gshin ya ma ra tsas zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: yaḥm ra tsa dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: ma mo'i dug zor thogs la: hūm̐: dug chu sna dgu rdzas kyis ngar btab pa: yams nad sna dgu me ltar 'bar ba 'di: srog bdag ma mo chen mos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: maḥm mo ru lu dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya rbad rbad: srog bdud nag po'i rdo zur thogs la: hūm̐: khro chu khol ma las grub drag po'i rdo:
