zur gsum rno ngar thog ltar 'bebs pa 'di: srog bdud shan pa lag dmar zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: duḥpra ma rak+sha dgra bo nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad: shel ging dkar po'i zor thogs la: hūm̐: srid gsum sgrol byed yungs dkar khro bau'i rdzas: zur bzhi log brgyad gnam lcags 'khor lo 'di: srog bdag shel ging dkar pos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: ruḥr tsa ging ka ra dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya rbad rbad: btsan rgod mtshon zor thogs la: hūm̐: ru tra drag po bsgral ba'i tsit+ta la: drag sngags gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'phro ba 'di: btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rjes zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: tsaḥshu la raṃ dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya rbad rbad: gnod sbyin nag po'i thod zor thogs la: hūm̐: dam sri pho mo sbyor ba'i thod zor la: spu gri mtshon cha gzengs pa'i ngar ldan 'di: yak+sha hur thum nag pos zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: shaḥyak+sha ka la dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya rbad rbad: klu bdud nag po'i khrag zor thogs la: hūm̐: yugs sa dgu yi gzhang nas thon pa'i khrag: ma rungs khrag sbyor nad rlung 'thibs pa 'di: klu bdud kha la rak+shas zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: nā ga kha la rak+sha dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya rbad rbad: ging chen dkar nag phur zor thogs la: hūm̐: snang srid stong khams bshig pa'i phur bu la: gza' rgod shan pa bskul ba'i rgya rtags 'di: las byed ging chen dkar nag zor sna drongs: dgra bo byad ma'i srog la mā ra ya: ging ka ra rak+sha kī la dgra bo nṛ mā ra ya rbad rbad: ma gza' rdor gsum mda' zor thogs la: hūm̐: thabs mchog gzhu mo rdo rje legs: gzhu breng e ka dzā ṭi ma: gnyis med sras mchog rā hu la: gnam lcags 'khyugs pa ji bzhin du: las la thogs med ki kang rje'i: thabs shes yab yum khro bcu yis:

rbad cing las la mngag pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya: oṃ badz+ra sa dhu ru lu rak+mo e ka dzā ṭi rā hu la du pra ma rak+sha dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: dgongs gsol dmod pa drag po'i zor chen 'phen pa ni: bh+yoḥ dgongs shig mi mngon rab 'byams phyogs bcu nas: kun bzang snang mtha' byang sems rig pa 'dzin: mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dgongs su gsol: longs sku zhi khro gar dbang thugs kyi klong : pad 'byung thod phreng drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha: bka' srung dam can gter bdag dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan bshig bla mar zhe nas smod: dkon mchog gsum la blo log rgyab gtad cing : rig 'dzin sngags la do bsdo 'gras 'tshol zhing : mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: dam chos sgrub la gegs sems gnod 'tshe bskyar: bka' gsang rdo rje theg pa'i dam chos gshe: chos skyong mthu med zer ba'i dgra bo 'di: lo dang zla ba zhag dus ma bzhag par: pho rgyud skam shing chag pa lta bur thongs: mo rgyud mi rabs bdun rgyud mngal nas skoms: chung rgyud ram bu ser bas gtor ba bzhin: rigs rgyud srid pa'i tha ram rlung la bskur: sgo nor zhing khang phyug rdzas phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i mnga' thang 'ju thag rtsad nas chod: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi myur du gtor: mgyogs pa chings la yan lag dum bur thongs: go cha shus la mtshon cha phye mar rdungs: mi rta phyes la nang tshan 'du ba dkrugs: byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo kun bsdus nas: srog chod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed gtor: byad ma lha srung yul dang bcas pa rnams: rang dbang med par bkug cing bsdams nas kyang : che mchog ma hā gu ru kī la ya: bdud 'dul khros pa'i yang gsang lha tshogs kyi: hom khung snang srid rgyal ba'i zhal gdangs nas: chu srin khro phur ngar ldan mche ba gtsigs: reg chod spu gri rlung gi ljags rkyongs la:

skad cig da lta nyid du zhal bzhes shig: ces zlog sngags bcas pas 'phang ngo : gom pa dgu sgrol ba'i mtshams su tho brtsegs la: hūm̐ khroṃḥ tho ni khyung nag me dbal kha gdangs pas: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams khor yug khengs: rngam mche gtsigs shing sder gshog brgyangs pa yis: sgab 'dre 'byung po rgyu ba'i lam chod cig: khroṃ raṃ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: bshal chus brtan ma sgo drung du bskyang la: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: lhab lhub sil snyan sgra dang bcas: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma bzhes: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du: gsang sngags grogs kyi mel tshe mdzod: oṃ du pra mo yak+ṣa kau rī an+ḍi ting ting sarba kha kha khā hi: gtor snod sbub ste dmigs bya 'gugs la rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: drag po dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje rngam klong bro brdungs pas: dug lnga'i bag chags dbyings su gtor: pho brang yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: chos skyong pho nyas bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang ru tra thabs kyis bsgral: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes lnga ldan bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i mtshan ma bshig: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang 'khor ba yongs grol gar: gsang sngags rdo rje'i khro bo yis: rgyas gdab ru tra ma ldang cig: oṃ nan: ā nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: gtor snod kha yar bzed la bkra shis bya ba ni: hoḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yi dam lha tshogs la: dpag med sprul pa'i mchod pa dpag yas 'bul: rten 'brel chos bzhin smon lam shugs phyung nas: sku bzhi'i dpal 'byor yar rgyas bkra shis shog: ces dang*/ hūm̐: chos sku dri med rol rtsal drag po'i lhas: las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: rten 'brel dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog:

ces brjod cing mched lcam gyis phye mar skyems chang la rol zhing ha ha'i gad mo dang bcas nang du log: gtang rag mchod bstod dngos grub len pa bzod gsol shis brjod gshegs bsdu rnams bya ba ni: hūm̐: srung 'khor lha rnams mi dmigs hūm̐ gi nang : hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu ha khog mgo rked dang : zla tshes nā da mi dmigs 'ja' yal bzhin: 'dzin bral zang thal gsal stong ngang du bzhag: hūm̐: a a āḥ zhes pas rang rtsal rang dbyings klong du bsdu: drag po mngon spyod kyi las rjes mi mngon par bsdu bar bya zhing bsngo smon gzhung ltar bya bas mtha' brgyan no: rnal 'byor mched lcam rnams kyis tshe sgrub dang tshe gzungs la gang 'bad bsgrubs pas rang nyid kyi tshe dpal snyan grags stobs 'byor gong nas gong du 'phel// // hi) drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: srin mo'i za lam mkha' 'gro'i sun zlog bzhugs so: mdos dang zor gyi sgo 'byed pa: za lam srin mo'i zlog sgyur bstan: bsgral bstab sgo dbye gser skyems mchod: zor dpag glud bsngo gzu dpang gis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskul: phyir bzlog las su chas la khad: srin mos zor lam dbye bar bya: lcags sam gang rung snod dag tu: ngar zan nam ni sa spyin la: srin gzugs nu 'phyangs mtshan ma bsgrad: mthing nag skra gzengs g.yas g.yon du: dmar gtor zor gyi kong bu thogs: mtha' bskor phyogs mtshams khrag kong brgyad: yang na dmar gtor gtso 'khor brgyad: tshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa la: dmar sbreng dpal 'bar btsugs pa bshams la:

bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ srin mo'i za lam gom pa bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol nas: khrag dang zhag rlangs g.yo ba'i me rlung dbus: na bun dug char 'bebs pa'i tshwa khrod nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro dmar nag bzhugs pa ni: 'jig rten 'das kyang las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ye shes grub kyang srin gzugs pho nya ba: sa lam thob kyang 'jig rten ma mo'i gzugs: snying rje'i dbang gis sha za mkha' 'gro'i gtso: dmar nag ral par khrag gi bu yug can: stong khams dmod pas las kyi mtshon zor thogs: ba spur nad rlangs dug mtshon char du 'bebs: 'byung bzhi'i dus bdag nad kyi ma mo'i tshogs: bzhengs shig skyod cig drag po'i mthu rtsal skyed: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ye shes 'jig rten las kyi sun ma zlog: ming po snang srid lha 'dre'i kha bsgyur la: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus zhal du 'bul: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzhin bzang kyus legs yid 'ong 'grus bzang mas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po dri za'i skag bzlog za 'dre sgyur: shar phyogs mdos zor drag po'i sna drongs la: shar phyogs dgra bgegs ma mo'i zhal du 'bul: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo klog phreng gshin rje'i lcam gcig mas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po gshin rje'i bka' bzlog khram kha sgyur: lho phyogs mdos chen drag po'i zor sna drongs: lho phyogs dgra bgegs ma mo'i zhal du 'bul: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ 'od ldan ma mo nag mo drel zhon mas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po klu yi bka' bzlog gtad khram sgyur: nub phyogs mdos chen drag po'i zor sna drongs:

nub phyogs dgra bgegs ma mo'i zhal du bstab: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ thal bzlog nag mo dug gi mche ba can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po gnod sbyin bka' bzlog za kha sgyur: byang phyogs mdos chen drag po'i zor sna drongs: byang phyogs dgra bgegs ma mo'i zhal du bstab: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ mtshams bzhir ma mo srin mo khrag mdog bzhis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mtshams bzhi'i sha za mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: me rlung srin po dbang ldan dri zar sgyur: mtshams bzhir mdos chen drag po'i zor sna drongs: mtshams bzhi'i dgra bgegs ma mo'i zhal du bstab: bh+yo bh+yo ma mos zlog sgyur phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad thams cad kyi: srid pa pho mo'i g.yo 'khrug khram kha rnams: byad ma rbod gtong dgra bgegs steng du bh+yoḥ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: snang srid ma mo dgra bo steng du chos: sha zo khrag 'thung bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo rak+mo ma tri shwa na bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces bskul zor gyi sna ru rdzongs: zor sna srin mos khrid par bsgom: sa ma ya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o// // i) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: g.yul bzlog thog mda' reg chod kyi sgo dbye dang lam bstan zor gyi rim pa bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: g.yul bzlog zor gyi las brtsam dus: sgo dbye pho nya bskul ba ni:

zor gtor mdun nas sgrub khang sgor: 'phang ba'i phyogs su dkar lam 'then: gser dngul rin chen pad snod du: gser skyems g.yu chab gtsang ma bsham: gtum chen rngam dbyangs rol mo bcas: hūm̐: shar phyogs dung mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo skyong dkar mo stag gdong mas: lcags kyus mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: thabs kyi sgo dbye sha ra ra: shes rab g.yer kha si li li: drag po'i dmag tshogs spungs se spung : sgo dbye 'phrang sol dmag tshogs bskyed: de ring bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho phyogs gser mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma ser mo 'ug gdong mas: zhags pas mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: thabs kyi sgo dbye sha ra ra: shes rab g.yer kha si li li: drag po'i dmag tshogs spungs se spung : sgo dbye 'phrang sol dmag tshogs bskyed: de ring bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub phyogs zangs mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma dmar mo khwa gdong mas: lcags sgrog mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: thabs kyi sgo dbye sha ra ra: shes rab g.yer kha si li li: drag po'i dmag tshogs spungs se spung : sgo dbye 'phrang sol dmag tshogs bskyed: de ring bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang phyogs lcags mkhar ldem pa nas: sgo ma sngon mo spyang gdong mas: dril bus mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: thabs kyi sgo dbye sha ra ra: shes rab g.yer kha si li li: drag po'i dmag tshogs spungs se spung : sgo dbye 'phrang sol dmag tshogs bskyed: de ring bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang sgo phyes dmag tshogs sdud: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: rdzu 'phrul las la dbang bar mdzod: thogs med bstan dgra rdul du rlog: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub mdzod:

ces brjod gser skyems phyogs bzhir gtor: dmar rlon g.yang gzhi bting ba'i khar: sgo der dkar gtor za lam dang : de rgyab dmar chen gtor ma dang : glud dang drag po'i zor rdzas bsham: sngags 'chang dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: srid pa'i spyi zhwa ser nag bklub: lto zhal rak+sha mgo phreng dang : rus rgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur: gdong la dug khrag ro sol byug: thun dang rdzas su ga shal brgyan: drag po khros pa'i stangs stabs kyis: zhing chen gdan la rol stabs 'khod: g.yas g.yon rdo rje'i sngags 'chang rnams: rnga gling rol mo sna tshogs bcas: gzhan yang zor gyi rgyas chos su: ban de thal rdeb bon po gshang : skyes pa mtshon thogs yugs sa ni: dur 'debs byis pa 'ur thogs sogs: srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams: ban bon rig sngags dmod pa'i byed: snang srid g.yo 'khrug cho 'phrul than: bzlog phyir rten 'brel stabs chas su: bka' yi tha tshig chad mdo bsgrag: gtor ma 'bul zhing gser skyems mchod: srin po'i zor lam dbye bar bya: dmar chen zor lam dpal 'bar gzugs: gser skyems dmar sbreng yus 'dren zhing : ma nyes dpang gzugs thugs dam bskul: gsung dbyangs yi chad dang bcas nas: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: ma nyes dpang pos bzhugs mdzod thugs dam can: bdag ni zob med don gyi rnal 'byor pa: thar lam sgrub pa'i gegs byed dgra bo 'dis: rnal 'byor bdag la sgrub tu ma ster bas: byang chub lam rgyud mthong ba don ma chung : rtsa brgyud bla mas gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: skye 'gro'i sgron me snang byed dkar dmar la: sgrib byed lho sprin nag pos brnyas btsugs so: gling bzhi 'od kyis 'geng ba don ma chung : gza' rgod rgyu skar gzu dang dpang po mdzod:

rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: dbyings la gnas pa'i dkar phyogs sgra gcan la: ltas ngan zin phung nag pos brnyas btsugs so: thogs med mkha' la rgyu ba don ma chung : dbyings kyi mkhyen ldan gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag gsang ba'i zab lam la: chags sdang grub mtha' can gyis brnyas gtsugs so: rdo rje'i 'ja' lus grub pa don ma chung : zab gter bka' srung gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: 'gran gyi zla bral slob dpon pad 'byung la: mu stegs log spyod ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: thogs med mthu stobs ldan pa don ma chung : rig 'dzin brda brgyud gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: bstan pa'i sgron me gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin lam: mtha' 'khob skye bo ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: smon lam bden stobs sbyor ba don ma chung : chos skyong dam can gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyen po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin rig 'dzin sngags 'chang la: dam nyams slob ma ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: bskyed rdzogs lam rgyud sbyangs pa don ma chung : shan pa dmar nag gzu dang dpang po mdzod: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i las la bskul: don gnyis mthar thug rdzogs chen a ti la: nyan thos dge bshes ngan pas brnyas btsugs so: chos nyid mngon sum ston pa don ma chung : 'od gsal rdo rje snying pos gzu dang dpang : rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la:

dgra bgegs g.yul ngo bzlog phyir las la bskul: hūm̐: srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : gdong la gnas pa'i dregs can rnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: sku bzur g.yas g.yon phyogs su dor: sgrub pa'i lha srung gnyan po rnams: rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: de ring drag po'i zor sna 'di: nyes can dgra bo steng du drongs: zor zor rdugs su ma spyod cig: zor zor logs su ma spyod cig: zor zor 'byams su ma spyod cig: pho nyas rgyug log ma byed cig: chos skyong mthu med mi srid kyi: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gseng : gling bar lcags ri mun pa sogs: ban bon skyabs 'og gang 'dug kyang : da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i phrin las mdzod: ces bskul zor rnams rim par 'degs: dregs sde ma lus bran du bskol: rngam sgras srid gsum 'jig rten g.yo: snang srid thog rang mtshon char 'khrigs: las byed pho nya dregs pa can: dgra bo'i sha khrag srog la rngam: drag po khros pa'i stangs stabs kyis: sngags rgod bzla zhing rdo thun brdeg: dar nag g.yab cing rnga gling sogs: ngar chen bskyed pa'i rol mo bsgrag: go mtshon phyar dar bswo sgra sgrog: 'phang ba'i sa ru rings par 'gro: thathaḥ hūm̐ḥ snang srid shan pa mtshon char dkyil: sdang dgra yul mkhar ma lus pa: byer shor gab khung med par bsgom: rim bzhin zor 'phang dgra bo brlag: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bzhengs shig skye med chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs: dgongs shig rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgongs: ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog gnyan po bzhugs: slob dpon rgyud srung gnyan po'i rgyab rten mdzod: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dmag dpung bskyed: dam can bka' srung gter bdag zor sna drongs: snang srid lha srin gzhi bdag zor lam phyes:

nyes can dgra bo ma gtogs sku bzur cig: dbu chum zhabs skums g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzhud: dbal zer 'phros na sku la reg srid kyi: bdag ni ma nyes ma lan smra ba'i tshig: gal te nyes na le lan dgra la phob: nyes med rnal 'byor rig 'dzin bdag cag la: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams sdig can 'dis: byas med srog rgol chags med bu lon bsnyags: dkar po khyad du gsod pa'i dgra bo 'dir: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad par: da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces bskul kong zor nas brtsam rim pa ltar: zor rdzas sna dgu bsad pa ltar du 'phang : hom sbar dmigs bya gsal zhing gtor chen 'degs: dgongs gsol dmod pa drag pos 'phang ba ni: hoḥ dgongs shig mi mngon rab 'byams phyogs bcu nas: kun bzang snang mtha' dbyer med rig pa 'dzin: mchog gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma dgongs su gsol: longs sku zhi khro gar dbang thugs kyi klong : pad 'byung thod phreng drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha: bka' srung dam can gter bdag dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan bshigs bla mar zhe nas smod: dkon mchog gsum la blo log rgyab gtad cing : rig 'dzin sngags la do bsdo 'gras 'tshol zhing : mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: dam chos sgrub la gegs sems gnod 'tshe byas: bka' gsang rdo rje theg pa'i zab chos gshe: chos skyong mthu med zer ba'i dgra bo 'di: lo dang zla ba zhag tu ma bzhag par: pho rgyud skam shing chag pa lta bur thongs: mo rgyud mi rabs bdun rgyud mngal nas skoms: chung rgyud ram bu ser bas gtor ba bzhin: rigs rgyud srid pa'i thal ba rlung la bskur: sgo nor zhing khang phyug rdzas phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i mnga' thang 'ju thag rtsad nas chod: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi myur du gtor: mgyogs pa chings la yan lag dum bur thongs: go cha shus la mtshon cha phye mar rdungs:

mi rta phyes la nang tshan 'du ba dkrugs: byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul ngo kun bsdus nas: srog chod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed gtor: byad ma lha srung g.yul dang bcas pa rnams: rang dbang med par bkug cing bsdams nas kyang : che mchog ma hā gu ru kī la ya: bdud 'dul khros pa'i gsang bdag lha tshogs kyis: hom khung snang srid rgyal ba'i zhal gdangs nas: chu srin khro phur ngar ldan mche ba gtsigs: reg chod spu gri rlung gi ljags rkyongs la: skad cig da lta nyid du zhal bzhes shig: ces brjod zlog sngags bzlas shing gtor zor 'phang : zor chen 'khor 'das stobs 'dus mtshon cha thogs: srid pa phur bu'i dbal dang khro chu'i khol: srid pa'i mtshon cha dug rlangs bu yug 'tshubs: ldog med gnam lcags thog ltar 'phangs pa 'di: mtha' dmag nad mtshon byung dang skag rkyen rnams: rdul du brlag cing dbang po sha khrag rus: las byed pho nyas hub sgra dir dir rol: slar yang ldog med rig sngags dmod pa 'debs: pho nya'i dmag tshogs dgra la za lam bstan: dar nag gdab cing mtshon thogs bswo sgra 'debs: ban des thal rdeb bon pos dzo zor 'phen: yugs sas dur 'debs byis pas 'ur rdo 'phen: ma nyes shag 'debs yus dang la sogs brda: dmag bzlog la sogs dgos gnad che ba na: sku 'khor sdeb cing dregs sde gnad la dbab: gnod byed kun 'joms bya ra g.yul ngo bzlog:

gom dgu bgrod mtshams tho brtsegs bya khyung bskyed: hūm̐ khroṃḥ tho ni khyung nag me 'bar gsal ba las: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams 'khor yug khengs: rngam mche gtsigs shing sgro gshog brgyangs pa yis: sgab 'dre 'byung po rgyu ba'i lam chod cig: khrom̐ raṃ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes pas khyung nag me 'bar sgab 'dre gcod: de nas sgo drung bshal chus brtan ma bskyang : gtor gzhong kha sbub dmigs bya 'gugs bstim bya: ldang med khro rgyal stobs 'dus dgra bo gzir: mched lcam mthe'u chung sbrel zhing bro ra ni: mngon spyod drag po'i zur gsum g.yon du bskor: hūm̐: drag po dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje'i rngam klong bro brdungs pas: dug lnga bag chags dbyings su gtor: pho brang yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du: chos skyong pho nyas bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang ru tra thabs kyis bsgral: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes lnga ldan bro brdungs pas: bdag tu lta ba'i mtshan ma bshig: bro yang ye shes chen po'i bro: glu yang ye shes chen po'i glu: gar yang 'khor ba yongs grol gar: gsang sngags rdo rje'i khro bo yi: rgyas gdab ru tra ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong kha gzed nas 'bru blugs: hoḥ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yi dam lha tshogs la: zag med sprul pa'i mchod pa dpag yas 'bul: rten 'brel chos bzhin smon lam shugs phyung nas: sku bzhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: ces dang*/ hūm̐ḥ chos sku dri med rol rtsal drag po'i lhas: las sgrib rkyen ngan ma rig 'khrul gzugs rnams: rten 'brel dmod pa zab mos tshar bcad nas: rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod la mched lcam rnams phye mar dang skyems chang la rol zhing ha ha'-i gad mo dang bcas nang du log: gtang rag mchod bstod dngos grub len pa bzod gsol bsngo smon sogs las gzhung ltar bya zhing :

dkyil 'khor bsdu chog ni: hūm̐: srung 'khor lha rnams mi dmigs hūm̐ gi ngang : hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu ha khog mgo rked dang : zla tshes nā da mi dmigs 'ja' yal bzhin: 'dzin bral zang thal stong pa'i ngang du bzhag: hūm̐ a a āḥ zhes pas rang rtsal rang dbyings klong du bzhugs: las rjes mi mngon legs par bsdu bya zhing : bdag gzhan rgyu sbyor tshe dpal gong 'phel zhing : mngon spyod dbal gyis bla tshe'i zer nyams pa: gso phyir tshe chog g.yang len ci 'grub bya: mngon spyod las 'grub stobs rtsal snyan grags rgyas: snyigs dus dug lnga'i rang rgyud 'grub pa'i rtsal: phyi nang dgra 'dre byur dang than ltas mang : mtshan 'dzin 'khrul ngor snang ba'i 'gal rkyen rigs: gdul dka' 'dul ngor thugs rje'i skur shar ba: bdag nyid khro rgyal stobs 'dus kī la yas: 'bar ba'i gar gyis srid gsum bdud dpung brlag: smon lam dbang gi mthu stobs nus rtsal myur: log 'dren bgegs 'dul dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol: de phyir nga yi rjes 'jug skyes bu rnams: sgyid lug bag med dbang du ma song bar: bstan dang 'gro phan sems bskyed go gyon te: rten 'brel sna tshogs rgyu rkyen gang 'byor bsags: thugs rje'i dpung bskyed rdo rje'i mtshon cha yis: gsang sngags dmod pas bdud dpung phye mar brlag: mtha' dmag nad mtshon 'byung pos 'tshe byed na: lha srin dpang du btsugs la bzlog pa bskyil: snang srid bdud dpung ming med brlag par bya: theg chen a ti'i bstan mchog bzung bar gyis: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'o// // ki) ༈ bla ma drag po kī la ya'i dmod bcol gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// // hoḥ

dgongs su gsol lo/ /mi mngon dbyings nas bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum/ rtsa gsum zhi khro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig /bcom ldan 'das 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi sprul pa'i khro chen bzhi/ yum chen sgo ba ging dang bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag tu 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs dam pa srung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'i srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ khyad par du'ang dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ ma ning nag po/ gdong bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa/ bram ze'i gzugs can/ las kyi mgon po/ srog bdud nag po/ bya rog gdong can/ zhing skyong seng gdong yab yum/ sprul pa bam ro pho mo/ ma gcig 'dod khams dbyings phyug khyab mjug chen po rā hu la/ btsan rgod rol pa bco brgyad/ gter sgro las kyi sman mo/ sprul pa'i rgyal chen sku lnga/ blon po tsi'u dmar po/ skyes bu klu yi dge bsnyen/ yang sprul dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang bcas pa gzhan yang bka' gter zab mo'i srung ma mthu bo che thams cad gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi shar phyogs sbas yul dkar po'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhi bdag thams cad gsan du gsol/ dkar po'i chos khrims kyis bde bar skyong zhing rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar spel bar mdzad pa'i dkon mchog gi mchod yon gyi bstan pa la gnod cing*/ sku tshe mdzad pa dang phrin las la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri gdug can gyi yid bsgyur ba'i mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung kha lud pa/

lkog tu bsam ngan gyi dug mtsho g.yo ba/ dngos su dmag dang 'khrug pa gshom pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'joms pa/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba/ lta ba log par spel ba/ grub mtha' ngan pas yid bsgyur ba/ khyad par du'ang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dang de 'dzin la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa/ skye 'gro sems can gyi bde skyid 'joms shing las 'bras khyad du gsod pa/ tshe srog la rngam zhing yams nad byur sna 'dren pa/ nor rdzas rku ba/ 'khor 'bangs dang sde rigs 'phrog pa/ mkhar rdzong dang yul zhing 'joms pa/ dmag sna jag sna 'khrid pa/ phu'i rngu ba la bsdo ba/ mda' yi zhing la gnod pa/ bar gyi mi nor rdzas gsum la 'tshe ba/ mdor na bsam pa ngan pa yid la 'chang zhing*/ sbyor ba rtsub mo dngos su gshom par byed pa'i log par 'dren pa'i gdon bgegs spyi dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum/ khyim sgo lam srang*/ gzhi byis lam gsum la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs/ dam sri bdud rigs log par 'dren pa thams cad mtho srid pa'i rtse mo nas/ dma' na raka dmyal khams yan chod du gar 'gro gar gnas kyang*/ sprul pa glog stong 'khyug pa'i las byed pho nya dregs pa stong gsum gang ba rnams kyis skad cig gis thengs gcig yud tsam zhig la/ las kyi rlung mun gyis thems su bcug ste gzugs dang liṅga 'di la khug cig /nṛ tri a mu ka aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes drag rol g.yab dar gyi tshwa rngam drag tu bya/ ho/ dpal chen po bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru drag po'i sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho/ las byed pho nya dregs pa can rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa'i rtsal phyungs la/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo bdun rgyud dang bcas pa'i srog gi ljon shing sgyel cig

/gnam gyi 'ju thag chod cig /sa'i rten phur phyungs shig /chags pa'i yul dang phrol cig /dbang thang gi ra ba gtor cig /rlung rta'i rgyal mtshan sgyel cig /sgo nor phyug zhing phyags mas thob cig /skyob byed kyi lha dang phrol cig /srog rtsa dmar po chod cig /snying khrag zhal du drongs shig /don snying spar gyis longs shig /klad khrag zho ltar dkrugs shig khong khrag thang la 'phos shig /pho rgyud rtsad nas chod cig /mo rgyud mngal nas skoms shig /nye gzhi rtsa lag chod cig /bdun rgyud drungs nas phyungs la/ sgo dang lam srang ma nor/ ming 'dra dang rus 'dra ma nor/ khyim mtshes dang dgra gnyen ngo shes par gyis la/ mi tshe ring po la dus ma 'debs/ nam mkha' stong pa la tshad ma 'dzugs/ las kyi dbang mo che la gnyer ma 'dog /skye rga na 'chi gsum la khungs ma 'byin par/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo pha tshan nye 'brel bdun rgyud dang bcas pa lo dang zla bar ma bzhag /zhag dang za mar ma 'gyang bar da lta nyid du dpal chen dbang drag 'bar ba'i zhal du bstab bo/ bzhes shig /rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes nas rol mo drag tu bdun rdung byas la/ hūm̐/ bskal pa dus mtha'i me dpung ltar/ /rab 'bar ye shes me hom nang*/ /dbang drag 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la/ /gangs ri lta bu'i mche ba gtsigs/ /glog dmar lta bu'i ljags rkyongs shig /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag dang*/ /snga 'gyur bstan bshig dgra bo dang*/ /dam sri bdud rigs lnga phung gzugs/ /skad cig yud kyis 'dir khug la/ /gzugs phung zhal du dz+wa la raṃ/ /tshe srog zhal du dz+wa la raṃ/ /rten mkhar zhal du dz+wa la raṃ/ /skyob byed zhal du dz+wa la raṃ/ /lhag med zhal du dz+wa la raṃ/ rtsa sngags me dpung dgu bsgril mthar/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ sha truṃ rū pa tsit+ta ag+ni dz+wa la raṃ khā hi/ zhes 'khor ling bsreg go /smras pa/ dug sbrul nag po bzhin du mthong nas kyang*/

/sngangs skrag 'dar bar 'gyur ba'i gnubs lo zhes/ /rlung ltar rab grags mthu mkhan de yi tshe/ /gnam lcags rdo rje zhes bya smyon pa las/ /sngags snying phrin las rab 'byams mi mkhas kyang*/ /mngon spyod las byed rang byas tshud pa tsam/ /de phyir rab khros drag sngags dmod pa 'di/ /drag po'i phrin las sgrub pa'i dus su'o/ /thog ma'i rtsom yig rong smyon rtsal gyis bgyis/ /chos smyon bla ma drag po kī la ya'i/ /klong smyon rdzogs chen 'khor 'das rang grol nyid/ /gter smyon dam pa nyid kyis spyan drangs tshe/ /gnas smyon brag nag bdud rdzong zhes pa ru/ /bdud smyon dam sri lta log 'dul ba'i ched/ /slob smyon thugs mchog ming gis zhus pa'i tshe/ /mtha' bzhi'i mgo can dmag rnams bzlog phyir du/ /thugs smyon drag po hūm̐ gi shog ser las/ /phab ste gdan smyon khrom gzigs dag tu spel/ /rjes 'jug smyon pa bde ba'i rdo rje yis/ /'dzin 'chang spel ba'i nus pa mi mnga' yang*/ /rang re'i yid kyis nor 'dzin 'di kho nas/ /gzhan rigs su ma mgu yang zhe blo bde/ /phung 'tshengs nus pa dug sbrul nor bu ltar/ /the tshom dwang du blang la nyams su longs/ /de phyir phyi rabs sngags 'chang rjes 'jug rnams/ /som nyi spongs la 'di phyi'i chos sgrubs shig /bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bo rmang nas phyungs/ /'gal med sgrub byed rig pa'i ral gri zhig /gdengs pas log rtog dgra bo 'dar ba'i me/ /'gyed nus yod na dpung bcas ru mtshon phyor/ /de la bdag kyang shin tu spro ba skye/ zhes rong smyon dā ri dras yid 'ong sngags nag grong nag tu 'grim zhing sems can rnams ris mi snyoms pa des kun la smras so// // khu) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu'i skor las: glud rabs lha mi'i yid 'phrog bzhugs so: drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: bdag 'dra jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis:

bdud 'dul las kyi kha skong du: glud rabs lha ma'i yid 'phrog bstan: bzlog bsad drag po'i las brtsams kyang : sngon las stobs kyi dgra yin na: phar la mi thebs rang la sdig: lan chags sbyang ba'i cho ga yis: bu lon sha 'khon sbyang bar gces: lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ro: chos nyid bden pa'i mthu ldan zhing : rten 'brel mtshams sbyor shes pa yis: 'di la mi ltos thog dang 'dra: ji ltar brtsam pa'i mod la 'grub: 'on kyang tshogs gnyis rgyun yin phyir: yas chung khyad du gsod mi bya: chos kun bden gnyis zung du 'jug: de ltar dgongs par mi ldan zhing : drod rtags med par las sbyor rtsom: snyigs mtha'i sngags gzugs de lta bu'i: bab col rtsing spyod ma song bar: lhag bsam sems bskyed go gyon te: rten 'brel dmigs rdzas gang 'byor bsags: ting 'dzin sngags rgyas mkho rgur brlab: bden pa'i stobs kyis yongs su bsngo: tshim zhing bu lon sha 'khon sbyang : mthu dang nus pa shugs kyis 'byung : de phyir 'di la brtson par bya: sa ma ya: rten 'brel rdzas kyi rim pa ni: mi nor phyugs kyi ngar glud dang : chang zan changs bu brgya rtsa'i grangs: ting lo mar me kyu gu dang : 'bru sna zas sna dar sna sman: ras sna gos sna sbags pa'i rigs: dkar gsum mngar gsum rin chen rigs: sha chang zas sna tshang bar bsags: sbang ma ja lo thal zan sogs: mi kha'i yas sna sna tshogs pa: ji ltar 'byor ba glud la 'bungs: bsang chus bran zhing sngags kyis sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i khang bzang yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su nṛ las bskyed pa'i rin chen sna lnga'i mi'i dbang po'i khams dang skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa mtshar sdug gi rgyan du mas spras pa: bzhad gad lhang lhang 'byin pa: yid du 'ong ba'i 'khor du mas gtams pa: mtha' bskor du gnag phyugs rta drel ra lug rkang 'gros du mas rtse mchong 'khrab pa:

steng 'og phyi nang thams cad nas: dri zhim gyi spos dang : snyan pa'i gling bu: pi waṃ gi sgra snyan gyi lha mos gar bsgyur ba: mdor na 'jig rten srid pa'i khams na mngon par mtho zhing dpal brjid pa: ye shes kyi 'od zer 'jam la 'khyug pa: khyab cing brdal ba reg na mi bzod pa'i bde ba 'bar ba: myong grol ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zag med kyis bar snang gang ba: zag bral nges legs kyi dpal la spyod pa'i thugs rje'i 'dod rgu zad mi shes pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig: na maḥsarba ta thā ga bh+yo bi shwa mu ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te sa s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab par bya: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po gsal ba'i mdun: k+ṣa las bi na bgegs kyi rgyal: bran g.yog sde dpung ma lus pa: mtshan tshang dbang po rdzogs par gyur: ces brjod la bden stobs kyis 'gugs pa ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya sngags: rigs 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas mthus: lan chags bgegs rigs gang yin pa: skad cig nyid la gzugs 'dir mchis: sarba bhu ta dza dzaḥ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ bde gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang : 'jam klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki

sogs? bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi: tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar: lan chags bu lon sha 'khon dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen gang yin pa: sbyang phyir mchod sbyin rgya mtsho 'bul: bsngos pas dge zhing tshims gyur nas: tshe thung phyugs dbul na tsha mang : bsad bcad rdung rdeg gcog gsum dang : rku 'phrog gshe skur mi kha sogs: khyod kyis lan chags dag byas nas: mi kha'i yas stags 'di khyer la: khyod kyi za kha dgra la ston: de nas kha phyir bsgyur la: kyaiḥ mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan ldan: rin chen sna lnga'i sku lus la: 'ja' 'od dar tshon na bza' gsol: tshogs drug 'gogs pa'i rgyan chas spras: sgyu ma mkhan gyi sprul bsgyur 'dis: pho rgyud rgyal po tshim gyur cig: mo rgyud 'dre mo tshim gyur cig: spyi bdud sde brgyad tshim gyur cig: rgyan chas snang srid tshim gyur cig: dkar po lha yi tshogs la 'bul: pham ltung sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: ser po lha min tshogs la 'bul: 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: dmar po mi yi tshogs la 'bul: skye rga'i sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: sngo nag byol song tshogs la 'bul: klen lkugs sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: duḥkha yi dwags tshogs la 'bul: bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: nag po dmyal ba'i tshogs la 'bul: tsha grang sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du 'bul: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas thob par shog: ces pas snang zhing srid pa'i mgron: thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar: lan chags bu lon ma 'jal ba'i: 'byung po'i rigs gyur kun la bsngo: kun kyang gtan bde'i lam zhugs nas: bla med sa la gnas par bsam: yas glud zor gyi rgyab tu dpag: drag sngags thun gyis brab par bsam: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang karma las 'brel gling pas brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'o//

// ge)༈ dbang drag che mchog kī la ya'i drag po hom gyi lhan thabs dgyes rdzas bcu las/ dang po ling chung brgya la rtsa sngags brgya/ ru tra'i rus pa la kha kha khā hi/ de bzhin du sha dum brgya la/ ru tra'i māṃ sa la kha kha khā hi: rak+ta brgya la/ ru tra'i rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: 'bru brgya la/ ru tra'i tsit+ta la kha kha khā hi: tshil zhun brgya la/ ru tra'i rkang tshil zhag la kha kha khā hi: dar zab brgya la: ru tra'i mthun rdzas kyi yo byad la kha kha khā hi: chang phud brgya la: dpa' bo dgyes rdzas kyi myos byed la kha kha khā hi: khrag phud brgya la/ mkha' 'gro dgyes rdzas kyi rak+ta la kha kha khā hi: zas mchog brgya la/ mthu stobs bskyed rdzas kyi zhal zas la kha kha khā hi: gtor ma brgya la/ brten rdzas bskang rdzas kyi bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes zhal tu bstab pa dang bskul ba sogs 'os mtshams su sbyar shes par bya'o/ /mchod bstod sogs gzhung nas brtsam ste mthar bsdu rim bar du phyag len 'khrul med ltar bya ba yin no/ gter ston dngos nyid kyi bka' gnang bzhin gter mthun gyi kha sab dge'o// // ngo) ༈ bsad pa dug gi ral gri'i sbyin sreg dgra bo'i srog gcod bzhugs so: ma hā gu ru bdud 'dul rtsal la 'dud: las mtha' sbyin sreg bya ba ni: phung gsum shul sa la stegs bu brtseg: dug khrag ro sol chag gdab pa'i: nag po gru gsum dbyibs can bya: de la ma traṃ sa gzhi bri: lte bar lcags sdig mgo dgu bri: dug shing sna dgu'i me haum brtseg: khrag mchod 'od zer 'bar ba dang : til mar yam shing rdzas rnams bsags: liṅga brgya'am dgu byas rung : 'bru nag zan gyi dpal gtor bsham: hom gzar la sogs tshang byas nas: rang nyid zhwa gos nag po gyon: gdong la khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan: gshin rje'i phyogs la kha bltas nas: rol stabs khrag 'thung tshul gyis sdod: sngon du las byang sngags la bskyal: dang po rang nyid lha bskyed ni: hoḥ

bdag nyid che mchog ma hā gu ru rab tu khros pa'i ngo bo bdud 'dul kī la ya khro rgyal sku mdog mthing nag: zhal dgu phyag bco brgyad zhabs kyis gling bzhir 'gengs shing bgrad pa: rtsa zhal gsum po mthing la rngam pas byad ma gdug pa'i sha la dgyes pa: g.yas zhal gsum po dkar la brjid pas pha rol gdug pa'i tshe bsod 'joms pa: g.yon zhal gsum po dmar la gtum pas: dgra bo byad ma'i snying khrag la rol pa: dbu skra dmar ser 'og min gyi mkha' la bskyod cing thod skam gyi phreng ba dang gdug pa'i bya khyung 'phro ba: rtog med ye shes kyi rta dbu gsum gyis rta skad nam mkha' la sgrog pa: phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug: gnyis pas na rdo rje: gsum pas ral gri: bzhi pas gsal shing : lnga pas rgyu zhags: drug pas gsang rnga: bdun pas thong bshol: brgyad pas tshangs mgo: dgu pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o: phyag g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag: gnyis pas kha ṭ+wāṃ: gsum pas lcags sdig: bzhi pas spu gri: lnga pas mdung thung : drug pas me zhags: bdun pas tsit+ta: brgyad pas klu mgo: dgu pas gsod byed las kyi phur bu 'dril ba: sku stod la zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang sbrul rigs lngas lhu tshigs brgyan pa: snyan g.yas par khyung chen: g.yon par seṅge dang sku yi cha la dar nag gi cod pan 'phur ba: khrag gi thig le: zhag gi zo ris: thal chen gyi tshom bu: chu srin gyi stod g.yogs: sdig sdom gyi rgyan 'phyangs: rdo rje'i go khrab la rus sbal gyi sku rags bcing zhing : spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs pas rgyal bsen dam sri brlag cing 'joms pa: thod rlon gyi ga shal: zhing lpags kyi rked dkris: stag lpags kyi sham thabs rus pa'i rgyan la sogs pa dur khrod kyi chas du mas brgyan pa: de'i pang du yum tsa ti ma dmar mo me 'od kyi gdong pa can zhal gsum phyag drug pa shin tu rngam pa: g.yas zhal dkar ba: g.yon zhal sngo ba:

dbus zhal mthing ba: spyan dgus sdang mig gis bgegs la gzir ba: dbu skra dmar ser mkha' la bskyod pa'i gseb nas phag zhal ngur ba: thod skam gyis brgyan cing dar nag 'phur ba: phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag: bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang nad rkyal: tha ma gnyis kyis be con dang rgyu zhags 'dzin pa'o: zhing lpags dang stag lpags rus ba'i rgyan 'phyang gis mdzes pa: thod rlon gyi ga shal 'phyang zhing : zhabs gnyis kyis yab la 'khril ba: thugs kyi kī la sras bzhis bskul ba: yab yum rnams kyang me ri smug nag 'khrigs pa'i klong du bzhugs pa: shar du ging chen bzhi: lho ru srog bdag bzhi: nub tu ma mo bzhi: byang du shan pa bzhi: de rnams kyang phyogs kyi sgo chas dang snying zhags 'dzin pa rngam zhing gtum pa gshin rje'i las byed kyi rnam pa can du gsal bar gyur: om̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa he ru ka baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti ka li badz+ra kī li kī la ya a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya ging ka ra ging ka ra yak+sha hu lu: yak+sha hu lu: ru lu ru lu: ma ru rtse ma ru rtse: ru tra nṛ tri hu lu hu lu mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa gcig bzlas pas gzi byin bskyed: de nas mdun du lcags snod nang du liṅga bzhag la dmigs bya bskyed: rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: phaṭḥ mdun du 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po'i bsad khang du: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo'i lus mya ngan gyi phyag rgya dgu dang ldan pa: sdug bsngal gyi smre sngags dang 'o dod tser ba bu ga dgu nas khrag dang nad rlangs 'phro ba zhig tu gyur: de nas 'gugs pa ni: spro na gdab las ltar gyi 'gugs gzhug byas kyang legs: hūm̐: na moḥ bla ma mchog gsum rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gyi: mthu dang nus pa myur mgyogs bden tshig gis: spyi dgra sgos dgra zur dgra myur du khug:

rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po'i snying rtsa sdud: gson 'dre pho gdon mo gdon rnams sgrol: sgab 'dre dam sri yul 'dre rmang nas phyungs: bse rag chung sri rmang 'dre rtsad nas chod: bdag la sdang ba'i pha rol byad ma dang : bsam ngan log sbyor 'tshe ba'i ban bon rigs: mnan gtad sbyin sreg gzhan mthus bskul ba sogs: dmag sna 'khrugs pa'i sna 'dren mi kha sdang : kha yog skur 'debs ngos bstod lkog nas smad: ka cha dkor nor 'phrog cing srog la sdang : byas med srog 'tshe chags med bu lon bsnyags: lam nas sgug cing dgra gshom gnon byed rigs: da lta nyid du gzugs ling 'di la khug: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i dus la bab: srog bdag gnod sbyin mched bzhi'i dus la bab: las bdag ma mo rnam bzhi'i dus la bab: shan pa btsan rgod rigs bzhi'i dus la bab: yang 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad dus la bab: pho nya las kyi dmag tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: las byed khyod la bcol zhing gnyer ba'i las: pha rol byad ma dam nyams sdig can 'di: shwa ltar bros na khyi ltar ded la shog: lug ltar bros na spyang ltar ded la shog: nya ltar bros na sram ltar ded la shog: byi'u ltar bros na khra ltar ded la shog: sha rtsas lag dmar ded pa ci bzhin du: gzugs kyi liṅga 'di la myur du khug: gcer bu shan pa'i dmag tshogs mthu ma chung : da lta nyid du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+yo bh+yo ging ma mo rak+sha hu lu duṣ+ṭāṃ ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes yang yang dgug cing drag sngags rgyud ltar mthu bsgrub na 'gugs sngags bzla: rtags rdzogs nas thun gyis brab: las mtha' phran bu ltar na brgya phrag tsam: skabs su thun gyis brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: ldog med khro bo nyungs dkar thun: dmar nag ma mo khrag gi thun: tshe thun gshin rjes dmod pa'i rdzas: dug thun 'chi bdag bu yug 'tshubs: mtshon thun tshwa tshwa si li li: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra:

me thun dbal kha lams se lam: skam thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: rlon thun dug rlangs chi li li: dmod pa'i drag sngags 'u ru ru: ldog med drag po'i thun rdzas kyis: chag che dam nyams dgra la phob: byad ma thal ba rdul du rlog: thun sngags bzla zhing dus drug tu thun gyis brab: mthu sgrub pa ma yin na: bsgral rjes su thun gyis brdeg: de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: sras mchog las kyi phur bu 'di'i: mgo bo rgya mdud gzhal yas khang : 'chang bzung sde brgyad 'gyu ba'i yul: chu srin pho nya 'tshogs pa'i gnas: zur gsum shan pa rgyug pa'i lam: ldog med yin no mthu ma chung : bsrung phyir spyi bor lan gsum bskor: bzlog phyir rked par lan gsum bskor: bsgral phyir mdun du lan gsum bskor: gdab phyir drag por lan gsum bsgril: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: dbang po lnga la kī la ya: byad ma lha srung rten dang phrol: myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gdab sngags bzlas shing myur du bsgral bar bya: de nas ral gris gtub pa ni: hūm̐: 'chi bdag nag pos ral gri thogs: byad ma gtubs shig gnyen po che: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di nyid kyi: mgo snying nang rol phrol bar gyis: byad ma rdul phran bzhin du shigs: om̐ ya mān+ta ka dgra bo'i srog la hur thum rbad ya: zhes bzlas shing dum bur gtub: de nas zhal bstab me hom du byed pa la: mdun du dug hom de nyid 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rjer bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du 'chi bdag las kyi pho brang dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba: de'i dbus su srog bdag had po nag po shin tu khros pa'i ngo bo: gnam lcags me'i sdig pa dmar po kha dgu mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa lus thams cad kha dang mig gis gang ba gshin rje khram thogs kyi bu yug 'tshubs pa: dug gi rlangs pas dpag tshad bcu drug tu khyab pa: bskal pa'i me dmar nag tu 'bar ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs pa:

de'i lte bar kha thun gyi klu bdud nag po chu srin gyi mgo bo can la rus sbal gyi gzugs yod pa: mdze nad nag po'i tsha zer 'phro ba: de'i lto bar dgra bo'i rnam shes dbang po 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur: de nas bskul zhing bsreg pa ni: hūm̐: las mkhan 'chi bdag khros pa'i sku: pho nya lcags sdig mthu bo che: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa la: nad yams dug rlangs chi li li: mun thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: me zer mtshon cha wa la la: sha khrag srog la rngam pa po: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: 'chi bdag khyod kyi zhal du gtad: byad ma ban bon sngags pa rnams: bstan la sdang zhing gdug pa'i tshogs: rgyal bsen dam sri 'dre rgod rnams: 'chi bdag lcags sdig zhal du thob: srog bdag klu bdud zhal du thob: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol: zhes rtsa sngags dang bcas pas bsreg: de nas liṅga bri thabs ni: dug shog gam ni ro ras la: dug sna dgu dang gri khrag gis: liṅga dbang po tshang ba la: spyi bor nan dang rna bar 'on: mig la long dang kha la lkugs: yan lag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes: tshigs su chag dang mngal du skam: snying khar ming dang lte bar rus: gsang bar lo shing spar me dang : las kyi dug sprul dkar nag gnyis: gsang gnas nas thon spyi bor zhugs: snying gi dkyil du 'khril bar bya: sbrul gyi khog par sngags 'di bri: nā ga kha thun nag po dgra bo hu lu ya khug dzaḥ snying khar sngags 'di bri: phyi rol dza khram sbrul gyis bcing : yang na yugs sa'i skra yis bcing : la cha'i bum pa'i nang du gzhug: yang na rdza yi rus sbal shes: 'byung ba lnga ni gang gtad kyang : dus tshod 'gyu ldog dag dang bstun: de nas liṅga bsregs pa'i thal me cha gsum du bgos te: cha gcig lam rgya gram du mnan: cha gcig sgo'i them pa'i 'og tu mnan: cha gcig lha 'dre drag po rgyu gsang du mnan: de rnams glang gi rwa g.yas pa mdzo rwa dang :

gcan gzan gyi thod par bsreg: thal blugs re bas kha gcod: snar ma dgu bsgril gyis bsdam par bya: mnan pa'i sa mi mthong bar bya: sgo them 'og tu mnan nas: hūm̐: gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyan gyi bdag: srog bdag dpe dkar rgyal po khyod: ma thogs gnas 'dir myur du byon: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: snying rlung smyo 'bog sna tshogs thongs: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' ma bcag: da lta sngags 'chang dam ma bkral: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: ging ra tsa dgra bo ka wa tsi satwaṃ bha ya nan: dza rbad dzaḥ zhes sngags shing gtad: sa ma ya: de nas klu la gtad pa ni: hūm̐: rgya mtsho mer ba'i nang shed nas: 'chi bdag nā ga kha thun khyod: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma dam nyams sdig can 'di: nag po klu bdud khyod la gtad: mdze nad sna dgus 'joms par gyis: 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa po: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' bzhin du: dgra bo ma shor sa ma ya: nā ga kha thun nag po dgra bo hu lu ya ka wa tsi nan dza rbad dzaḥ zhes sngags shing gtad: sa ma ya:

de nas lam rgya gram du lha 'dre drag po rgyu ba'i sar gnon pa ni: sa bdag gam gang rung du gshin rje dang yul bdag 'dogs: hūm̐: rim pa dgu yi mnga' bdag po: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la: lha srin yul 'dre'i 'khor gyis bskor: klu gnyan sa bdag bran dang bcas: ma thogs gnas 'dir myur du byon: sha khrag gsur mchod 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: 'chi bdag lha srin gshin rjer gtad: smyon pa lag ring dus la bab: sa bdag mig dgu'i dus la bab: gshin rje smyo byed dus la bab: 'dre rgod the'u brang dus la bab: sprul pa yang sprul dus la bab: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' bzhin du: dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: ya mān+ta ka dun+ti na dgra bo hu lu ya nan dza rbad dzaḥ zhes sngags shing rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog kī la ya'i: bdud 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhengs: dam nyams mnan pa'i bro ra la: khrag 'thung bro rdung khrigs se khrig: drag sngags rgyas 'debs sha ra ra: sde brgyad dmag dpung khrigs se khrig: brdung ngo rol pa'i rta bro rdung : g.yas pas khro bo'i rngam bro rdung : g.yon pas khro mo'i chem bro rdung : dam sri dam nyams mnan pa'i bro: rdungs shig ru tra'i steng du rdung : mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: zhes sngags bzlas shing rdo rje'i rgya gram la: phur bus mnan: de nas las gzhung gi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o: dgra bo lha dang dbye ba ni: bya rog 'ug sgro thogs nas: hūm̐: myos byed ser mo'i dus la bab: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : phyag na gtor byed spu gri 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: mgon skyabs lha dang myur du phyes: srog gcod bdud dang myur du sprod: hūm̐: 'joms byed nag po'i dus la bab: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : phyag na gcod byed ral gri 'dzin:

dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: skyob byed ban bon lha srung phyes: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i lag tu sprod: dus la bab bo mthu ma chung : pha lha ma lha zhang lha phyes: dgra lha yul lha skyes lha phyes: byad ma'i mgon skyabs lha srung rnams: bshig cing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces dud pa bdug cing thun gyis brab: dgra bo lha dbye'i rim pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: las kyi pho nya mthu bo che: khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra: dgos su bdag la 'tshe ba rnams: myur du sgrol ba'i dus la bab: mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas 'di bzhes la: deng nas bzung ste ji srid bar: sgab 'dre chod la dam sri sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ya mān+ta ka bi ru pa ru tri sha khrag la kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma sogs 'bul zhing dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug las: las mtha' bzlog med gu h+ya rgya: ma 'ongs nyi shu kha dar la: gnubs ban dzñā na'i skye ba mchog: pad+ma gter bdag gling pa la: sprod cig lha klu btsan bdud rgya: bstan pa srung ba'i mel tshe ru: byad ma sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis gser gling nas gdan drangs shing sbas yul pad+ma bkod du shog ser las zhal bshus so// // ci) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshogs dug gi par bu+u'i skor las: drag sngags dug mda' nag po bzhugs so: them med skor sa ma ya: bdud 'dul ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal la 'dud: las mtha' rim pa rnam bzhi bstan: 'gugs shing bsgral dang mnan bsad 'phang : dang po liṅga 'bri ba ni: dug shog gam ni ro ras la: dug sna dgu dang gri khrag gis: liṅga dbang po tshang ba la: spyi bor nan dang rna bar 'on: mig la long dang kha la lkugs: yan lag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes:

tshigs su chag dang mngal du skem: snying khar ming dang lte bar rus: gsang bar lo shing spar sme dang : las kyi dug sbrul dkar nag gnyis: gsang gnas nas thon spyi bor zhugs: lcags sdig dang bcas 'khril bar bri: sbrul gyi khog par sngags 'di'o: nā ga kha thun nag po dgra bo nṛ tri hu lu ya khug dzaḥ sdig pa'i khog par sngags 'di bris: ti pa ra tsa dgra bo'i tsit+ta myog myog mā ra ya nan: snying khar tri'i mtha' bskor gzer dang 'phrog byed gru bzhi bris pa'i mthar: trag rak+sha ru tra nṛ tri dza dzaḥ tri tri sha tri dgra bo khag tham ru lu ru lu du na du na thun thun shig shig rbad dgra bo'i snying la rbad rbad khug khug: dza dza myog myog yaṃ yaṃ hur thum rbad: ces dgod: phyi rol mnan gtad sngags dang ni: bsreg par me sngags bri bya zh-ing : gang yang dzaḥkhram sbrul gyis bcing : ling khrus 'byung ba lngas sbyangs nas: dgra yi rkang rjes g.yas pa'i sa: de dag skyer pa lcang ma shing : byang bu gnyis kyi bar du bzhag: brub khung gzugs la 'gugs gzhug bya: dang po dgra bo 'gugs sngags ni: om̐ kro ta la he ru ka bin nan ta kri: chaig mo'i rnam shes la dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga ra tsa sog ma me tsa mun tri ta dgra bo'i srog la dza dzaḥ om̐ ya mān+ta ka ha ra ha ra tri har khug dza dzaḥ om̐ lags ge na du tu tsit+ta dgra bo'i dbang po la dza dzaḥ om̐ hag ti sha ru lu dgra bo'i mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la dza dzaḥ zhes 'gugs pa'i sngags bzla shing : khug rtags rdzogs nas gu gul dang thang khrom kyi dud pas dgra bo myos shing lha dang dbye: lha dbye'i sngags ni: oṃ ha ra ya dgra bo shag phyes: a mu ka dgra bo shag phyes: ru tra tshin+dha tshin+dha ya dgra bo shag phyes: om̐ bhir bur mu ru mu ru dgra bo shag phyes: ha la dun ti nag po dgra bo shag phyes: trag tu tra trag tu tra kha tham dza shag phyes: bsad pa spu gri'i sngags rgod ni: om̐ ha la ka la trig trig nan:

ru tra nṛ tri rbad: gzer thum gzer thum sbur thum sbur thum: myog rak+ta myog rak+ta gtub kha la gtub kha la: ru tra ka wa tsi gzer gzer rbad rbad: ces bzlas spu gri'i 'khor lo bskor bar bsam: bdud bzhi rang gshed 'bab pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom: skabs su thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: ldog med khro bo nyungs dkar thun: tshe thun gshin rje dmod pa'i rdzas: dug thun 'chi bdag bu yug 'tshub: mtshon thun tshwa tshwa si li li: rdo thun rbab rgod sha ra ra: me thun dbal kha lhabs se lhab: skam thun bu yug tshubs se tshub: rlon thun dug rlangs chi li li: dmod pa drag sngags sha ra ra: ldog med drag po'i thun rdzas kyis: chag che nyam nga dgra la phob: byad ma thal ba rdul du rlog: bh+yo bh+yoḥ dunitsha de ya byad ma trig trig: bh+yo bh+yoḥ zhes nyin mtshan dus drug tu thun gyis brab: thun gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: bsad par nges pa'i rtags rdzogs shing gdab las kyi rigs gzhung bzhin ni: dmigs pa gsal zhing sngags 'di bgrang : om̐ āḥhūm̐: ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kro dha bha ru ṭa duṇ+ṭa kī la ya phaṭḥ dgra bo'i snying rtsa la bh+yo bh+yoḥ la ti tha ba ni rak+sha ru tra dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: baṃ ril snying rtsa la chum chum dun+ti sha rbad bh+yoḥ hur hur snying rtsa la bh+yo bh+yoḥ bsreg par byed na dug lnga rang grol bzhin du bya: mnan gtad bya na sngags ni: om̐ trig trig kha la yam rtse nag po ru tra nan: dgra sri nan nan: dam sri nan nan: god sri nan nan: gri sri nan: satwam bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan nan: ha la ha la yak+sha kro ta snying la rbad bh+yo nan: ces bzlas shing dmod pa byas nas thun gyis brdeg ling lteb bya zhing yugs sa'i skras bcing: la cha'i bum pa'i nang du gzhug: yang na rdza yi rus sbal shes: 'khor lo 'byung ba lnga yis gar gtad kyang : dus tshod 'gyur ldog dag dang bstun: de nas mnan pa'i tshul dag ni:

chos 'khor gtsug lag rgya sgo chen po'i: them 'og tu mnan na gnyer gtad pa ni: hūm̐: gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyer gyi bdag: srog bdag dpe dkar rgyal po khyod: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod: snying rlung smyo 'bog sna tshogs thongs: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' ma bcag: da lta gsang sngags dam ma bkral: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: ging ka ra tsa dgra bo ka wa tsi satwaṃ bha ya nan dza rbad dzaḥ zhes dang sngags bzla zhing gtad: sa ma ya: de nas lam rgya gram drag po rgyu ba'i sar mnan pa sogs gang rung du gshin rje dang yul bdag la gtad pa ni: hūm̐: rim pa dgu yi mnga' bdag pa: sogs sbyin sreg ltar ro: zhes dang mnan sngags kyis gtad: sa ma ya: gang gi tshe na'ang dur rdo la stong kham bris pas kha bcad cing rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog kī la ya: sogs sbyin sreg ltar ro: spros na gzhung gi rta bro bya: gom pa dgu tsam bgrod mtshams su tho zhig byas la: khyung nag sgab 'dre bcad par gnyer gtad: srung 'khor rten 'brel dang bcas log: las gzhung bzhin du las rjes bsdu: zab pa'i mthar thug sa ma ya: 'gugs pa pho nya lag dmar skor: bskrad pa gshin rje spu gri'i skor: gzir ba dug mda' srog gzir skor: dbye na 'chi bdag phung 'debs skor: sreg pa stong thun me dpung skor: bri ba 'chor med zhags pa'i skor: gdab pa bla rdzas bzlog med skor: las rgyud dug mda' reg phung ste: par bu man ngag dgu pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma kho bo rgya gar pad 'byung ngas: drag sngags kun gyi yang rtse 'di: gnubs ban dzñā na khyod la gtad: yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: khyod nyid zhe sdang lo 'dzin tshe: gdams ngag 'di dang 'phrad par shog: sprod cig lha bdud btsan klu rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya:

gsang rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis brag nag bdud rdzong nas spyan drangs te sbas yul pad+ma bkod du shog ser las phab pa'o// // chu) ༈ dbang drag pad+ma drag po rtsal gyi mnan pa'i phrin las kyi bsad las thun bskul bdud dgra tshar gcod bzhugs so: ye shes thugs rje'i pho nya ni: sbyong byed rang rang gnyen por shar: bsad cing gzir ba ma yin te: dug lnga'i las stobs tshar bcad nas: phung khams rnam shes rdo rjer bstim: des ni srid rtsa 'khrul 'dzin gzhom: khyad par ma rungs bdud sde'i rigs: zhi rgyas dbang gis 'dul dka' bas: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: thugs rje'i ngar dang bcas pas sgrol: de yang dgra bgegs gang yang rung : 'gugs 'ching sdom myos byed du gzhug: bsad sngags bzla zhing thun la sngags: thun bskul dmod pa'i ngar dbyangs bcas: dmigs yul bdud la gzir zhing brdeg: bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig las la bzhengs: reg phung dug mda' thun gyi lha: rngam brjid khro gtum pho nya'i tshogs: zhal rlangs dud sprin chi li li: rig sngags dmod pa 'brug ltar ldir: gdug pa'i dbal dang glog ltar 'khyugs: drag po'i sngags rgod ser ltar 'dril: reg phung dug mda' thog ltar 'bebs: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog: bh+yoḥ gnam lcags thun gyi dbal zor gyis: bdud dgra'i phung po reg tsam gyis: 'byung lnga'i pho nya gshed du bskul: rang byas rnam smin rang la rdeg: phung po'i snang ba bshig cing gtor: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: bh+yoḥ 'dod chags chu ltar 'khrugs pa yis: brnab sems dkon mchog dkor nor 'joms: nyes med skye 'gro'i 'dzin nor 'phrog: bstan 'gro'i dpal la 'tshe byas pa'i: rnam smin skad cig dus 'dir bskul: khrag dang chu khams ma lus pa: dmar nag sdig rgod grang ngad can: shig shig yom yom drag tu 'khrugs:

lcags dang rus la mched pa yi: dgra khams thal ba rdul du rlog: bgegs dpung dmigs med dbyings su gtor: bh+yoḥ zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba yis: gnod sems dmag dang 'khrug pa gzhom: sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed pa'i: rnam smin skad cig dus 'dir bskul: drod dang rus khams mes sdig pa: dmar nag me yi tshwa tshwa can: shig shig yom yom drag tu 'khrugs: lcags dang rus la mched pa yi: dgra khams thal ba rdul du rlog: bgegs dpung dmigs med dbyings su gtor: bh+yoḥ nga rgyal ri ltar gzengs pa yis: bdag bstod gzhan smod grub mtha' gshe: mi kha dmod tshig phra ma dbyen: dkar po'i las la bar chad pa'i: rnam smin skad cig dus 'dir bskul: sha khams sa sdig lci zhing 'thas: ser nag mtshon cha'i zer 'od can: shig shig yom yom drag tu 'khrugs: rlung khams tho las mched pa yi: dgra khams thal ba rdul du rlog: bgegs dpung dmigs med dbyings su gtor: bh+yoḥ phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa yi: 'byung 'jug rtog tshogs snang ba'i rtsal: legs sub nyes sgrub ngag sems kyis: bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'joms byas pa'i: rnam smin skad cig dus 'dir bskul: dbugs khams rlung sdig stobs shugs drag: ljang nag spu gri'i 'dab ma can: shig shig yom yom drag tu 'khrugs: rlung dang phrag dog las mched pa'i: dgra khams thal ba rdul du rlog: bgegs dpung dmigs med dbyings su gtor: bh+yoḥ gti mug mun ltar gtibs pa yis: dkar nag bzang ngan shan ma phye: mchog gsum rgyab bor 'gong tshogs bsten: bdud dang dam sri'i las byas pa'i: rnam smin skad cig dus 'dir bskul: mkha' khams lcags sdig mun pa'i mdog: reg chod gtor byed 'khor lo can: shig shig yom yom drag tu 'khrugs: mkha' khams gti mug las mched pa'i: dgra khams thal ba rdul du rlog: bgegs dpung dmigs med dbyings su gtor: bh+yoḥ ye shes pho nya'i dbal zor gyis:

dug lnga'i rang mdangs 'byung lnga'i stobs: dgra bgegs phung khams snang ba kun: ye shes lnga yi rang zer can: sdig rgod yom yom shig shig g.yo: shugs drag bskal pa'i rlung ltar du: 'ur 'ur chems chems drag tu 'khrugs: dgra dpung shigs la bgegs dpung chom: bag chags snang sems thum thum nub: dran med brgyal 'thom bag la nyal: dpal chen thugs sprul sdig rgod tshogs: rngam drag gtum pa'i mthu dpung skyed: srid gsum yom yom shig shig gang : sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bh+yoḥ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥ phung bar byed pa'i sri la bh+yoḥ ltas ngan cho 'phrul steng du bh+yoḥ mtha' dmag rgyal 'gong steng du bh+yoḥ log rtog the tshom steng du bh+yoḥ byang chub bar chod steng du bh+yoḥ thar med 'khor ba'i dpung la bh+yoḥ dngos 'dzin thal ba rdul du rlog: ces ye shes lnga'i sdig rgod rab tu 'khrugs pas dmigs bya dgra bgegs kyi phung khams thams cad dmigs med du bzlog /de las rim par mched pas srid pa gsum gyi khams thams cad kyang ye shes kyi snod lnga'i sdig rgod rab tu 'bar ba yom yom shig shig gang ste/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dmigs med du brlag cing 'byung lnga so sor klong du thim pas/ slad nas nyon mongs dug lnga'i stobs gzhom pa'i gnyen por ye khyab tu gnas pas nam yang ldang med du bsam/ 'di ni dgra bgegs spyi 'gro'i mnan sreg la sogs pa'i thun bskul du bya ba yin la/ dmigs gsal dgra bo bsad pa'i las sbyor la ni bdud bzhi rang gshed dbab pa pho nya dregs sde dang sbyar zhing bgegs la yak+sha me dbal sogs rang rang gi gshed mthun sbyar na legs par mngon no/ /de ltar bsad pa'i thun bskul 'di'ang 7 sngags btsun kun dga' blo gros gyis bskul ngor/ mngon spyod drag po'i rig sngags 'chang ba skyid grong smyon pas mnan gzir dmod pa'i las sbyor gyi tshe gang shar du bkod pa'o//

je) ༈ dbang drag pad+ma drag po che mchog bdud 'dul kī la ya'i mnan pa'i las mtha' chu srin kha 'tham zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rab khros sgaig dang dpa' dang rab 'jigs brjid/ /rab rngam snying rje rab zhi dgod dang gshe/ /rab 'bar gtum drag srid gsum sa dgu g.yo/ /gar dgus khams gsum gnon la gus phyag 'tshal/ /ma rungs log 'dren gdug pa gzhoms pa dang*/ /dam sri 'dul phyir las mtha' 'dir bkod pa'i/ /rtsa gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ /chos skyong gter bdag tshogs kyis gnang ba stsol/ de'ang bca' gzhi lag len gzhung bzhin las/ /'dir sa 'dul mnan pa'i las rim ji ltar gong ma'i phyag len ma nor bar sa gnad sogs man ngag zur du gsal bzhin pa las: mnan bru+ub rdzas sogs gzhung nas 'chad pa bzhin bsags nas: mnan sgrub sngon du song la mnan sar phyin pa dang*/ hūm̐: rang nyid dbang drag che mchog gsal ba yi/ /phyag gis gnam lcags phur pa sa la btab/ /sa gzhi gas te rgya mtsho sngo mer gsal/ /de dbus gnam lcags khang pa sgo med nang*/ /'chi bdag gshin rje nag po 'jigs rung pa/ /lag g.yas dbyug to g.yon pas zhags pa thogs/ /mi sdug dri 'thul ma he nag po zhon/ /gshin rje'i 'khor tshogs rngam pa'i tshul gyis bskor/ /mngon sum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur/ sa mā ya dza/ sa ma ya hūm̐ gis rang nyid yi dam du bsgoms nas/ dmar gtor la bka' yi bden stobs kyi dmigs bya lan gsum du bkug la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlab/ oṃ triṣ+ṇa khaḍ+ga hūm̐/ triṣ+ṇa dza mā ra ya rbad/ triṣ+ṇa dz+wa la raṃ/ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa tsit+ta rak+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ti ghṛ ha na khā hi sa bsngos la/ hūm̐/ rim pa dgu yi mnga' bdag po/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje la/ /lha srin yul 'dre'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /klu gnyan sa bdag bran dang bcas/ /ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di/

/'chi bdag lha srin gshin rjer gtad/ /smyon pa lag ring dus la bab/ /sa bdag mig dgu'i dus la bab/ /gshin rje smyo byed dus la bab/ /'dre rgod the'u brang dus la bab/ /sprul pa yang sprul dus la bab/ /sngon tshe slob dpon bka' bzhin du/ /dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di/ /'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor bcas la/ /gtad do ma shor phrin las mdzod/ /ya mān+ta ka dun+ti na dgra bo hu lu ya nan dza rbad dzaḥ zhes pas dmar gtor 'bul/ lha khang dang mchod rten la gtad nas/ hūm̐/ gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyan gyi bdag? drag gtad dug mda' nag po ltar byas la/ klu gtad sogs kyang zur gsal ltar ro/ /de nas liṅga thogs la/ hūm̐: phung sri bya ba'i las ngan 'dis: rdo rje slob dpon sku la bsdos: rdo rje'i mched la bar chad byas: rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe byed cing : rgyal khams yongs la gnod pa byas: sbyor sgrol mang po'i sgo yang bkag: bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di: nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig: 'jigs rung gshin rje'i kha nang chug: mi 'gyur yangs pa'i mgrin par drongs: thar med las kyi lto bar chug: gtad do 'chi bdag khyod la gtad: 'chi bdag nag po dam tshig can: gal te byang chub sems ldan bar: sri ngan gtad kyi slar ma gtong : zhes pas dong nang bsgyur te dmod mo'ang bya'o: lo rgyal por dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: zla ba blon por dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: zhag dmag mir dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dus tshod mtshon char dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: snga dgra lag gis brdar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: phyi dgra zhe la 'chang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: da dgra thad du langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra mgo thog tu babs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra zur babs kyi slob pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: shar shing khams pa'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub:

lho me khams pa'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: nub lcags khams pa'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: byang chu khams pa'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: mtshams bzhi sa khams pa'i dgra bo thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: g.yas nas bsam pa ngan pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: g.yon nas sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: mdun nas rtsang bzhin 'dzugs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: rgyab nas khyi bzhin 'brang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: lkog nas 'bu bzhin 'bug pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: phyogs nas dmag chen g.yo ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: lam 'phrang gi 'gag tu sgug pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: rkun sna jag sna dug sna ston pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dgra sgo dang gyod sgo bye ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: che sri dang chung sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dar sri dang dur sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: pho sri dang mo sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: na sri dang god sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dus sri dang mtshon sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: gzhi sri dang byes sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: phung sri dang gdon sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dme sri dang 'khon sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: rgyal sri dang blon sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: yul sri dang grong sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: lo zla zhag dus kyi skag sri langs pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: dam sri dang 'gong pos 'tshe ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: sde brgyad kyi za kha ston pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: mi kha dang kha mchu ldang ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub: nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra 'dre byur gsum thams cad mā ra ya brub rbad nan sod cig: du ka la kha tra nan ru tra nan/ chaig mo nan/ mā ra ya rbad nan nan/

zhes thal mo brdab cing mi kha'i rdzas sogs blugs la/ ri rab dang rgya gram bris pas dur rdo dang ran 'thag gis dgab/ de steng sa rim pa dgus bkab cing*/ dmigs bya khar chud gshin rje zhal bsdams te/ /mnan pa'i las sbyar dam nyams dgra bo rnams/ /bskal pa ma stong bar du mi thar par/ /mun nag rum gyi nang nas rgya mtsho'i gting*/ /rim dgu sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sogs/ me chu go ldog gis rgya bsubs te: nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab 'og: mnan pa yin gyis ldang bar ma byed cig: sangs rgyas don yod grub pas rgyas gdab bo: dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su sa ma dhi: oṃ sum+bha ni? sogs nas/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sha truṃ sarba satwaṃ bha ya nan: bskal pa ma stong bar du ma ldang zhig / ces dang rgyas gdab cing : hūm̐: gcig ni chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi ni tshad med bzhi yi rgya: lnga ni ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug ni pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun ni yan lag bdun gyi rgya: brgyad ni rnam thar brgyad kyi rgya: dgu ni theg pa rim dgu'i rgya: don dang brda sbyar rtags kyi rgya: gnyis su med par rgyas gdab bo: oṃ laṃ: ā laṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: satwaṃ bha ya nan: dharma dhā tu a āḥ gong gnon gyi gtor ma bsreg la: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog badz+ra kī la ya: bdud 'dul bla ma drag po skur bzhengs shig: ma hā kā la rta gdong skur bzhengs shig: yum mchog phag gdong nag mo skur bzhengs shig: 'jigs byed khro bcu'i lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: ye shes dbyings nas khro bo skur bzhengs te: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bdag la dgyes pa'i phyir: dam rdzas gtsang ma'i gser skyems 'di bzhes la: de ring mnan pa'i phrin las dus la bab: khyad par dmod pa'i las la bsngags pa'i lha: che btsan stobs ldan khyed kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis:

rig sngags stobs kyis snang srid skye 'gro bkums: mthu rtsal shugs kyis khro bcu'i dmag tshogs 'gyed: yang sprul ba spu'i bu ga re re nas: khro chung gnam lcags thog ser char du 'bebs: spu gri 'khor lo'i mtshon cha rlung ltar 'tshubs: byad ma 'dre rgod dam sri bdud kyi rigs: log par 'dren pa'i 'byung po thams cad dang : bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bo thams cad la: gnam lcags ri rab phur thun ser ba phob: chu 'dzin nag por drag po'i rlung bskyod bzhin: gling dgu'i ri rab sa dgu'i 'og tu bsnyol: bskal pa'i mun nag 'khrigs pa'i lhums su bskyal: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i gdan la phob: 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum dus la bab: dgra bgegs byad ma las ngan sdig can 'di: bskal pa ma stong bar du ma gtong zhig: byang chub sems ldan bar du phrin las mdzod: dmigs pa ni bdag nyid srid pa las kyi khro bo'i thugs ka nas yi ge thā nag po ri rab dang mnyam pa grangs med 'phros pas/ bzas po'i steng gi bar nang du slebs tsam gyis gnam lcags kyi mchod rten nag po grangs med thog sgyogs ltar phab ste/ byad ma sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu mnan par bsam/ mchod rten gyi 'og tu rtsibs ldan gnam lcags 'khor lo so 'thab de rlung spu gri reg chod kyis bskor bas/ dgra bgegs byad ma rnams dum bur 'thag pa'i sha khrag rnams las byed pho nya rnams dang gshin rje nyi khri dgu 'bum gyis gsol bar bsam/ kho'i bla rten tshe rten rnams gshin yul lcags mkhar nag po sgo med kyi nang du khrid nas/ nam yang mi shor bar bsams shing rgyas gdab ste rta bro bya ba ni mched lcam rnams srin mdzub sbrel te gru gsum zla gam gru bzhi zlum po sogs las bzhi'i tshul du byas la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal che mchog kī la ya: bdud 'dul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhengs: dam nyams mnan pa'i bro ra la: khrag 'thung bro rdung khrigs se khrigs:

drag sngags rgyas 'debs sha ra ra: sde brgyad dmag dpung shigs se shig: brdung ngo rol pa'i rta bro rdung : g.yas pas khro bo'i rngam bro rdung : g.yon pas khro mo'i chem bro rdung : dam sri dam nyams mnan pa'i bro: rdungs shig ru tra'i steng du rdung : mnan no nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ nan: a nan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: spro na gzhung gi rta bro yang bya'o/ /gom pa dgu la sa rim pa dgu byas te lo dgu rlung dgu chu dgu me dgu'i chad par bsam zhing tho brtsegs la/ khrom̐: tho ni khyung nag me dbal kha gdangs pas: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams 'khor yug khengs: rngam mche gtsigs shing sgro gshog brgyangs pa yis: sgab 'dre 'byung po rgyu ba'i lam chod cig: khroṃ raṃ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: tho khyung nag mngon du gsal la sgab 'dre 'byung po rgyu ba'i lam bcad do/ /smras pa/ rig sngags 'chang ba ral pa'i cod pan can/ /ma rungs bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam rgyal ba/ /gar dgu'i stangs stabs srid gsum gnon mdzad pas/ /smras 'di bstan dgra sgrol ba'i cha rkyen shog /rig 'dzin hūm̐ gi rjes su bzung ba'i bus/ /sngags gling e waṃ mi 'gyur gnas mchog tu/ /gu ru drag po rtsal gyis bsnyen sgrub tshe/ /zla nag nyi nag thun mtshams dag tu spel/ /gang zhig srid mtshor 'khyams pa'i skal ngan kun/ /myur du mngon 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur gyur te/ /sa mchog bde chen zhing du rab mngon nas/ /srid 'dir yid can gtsug na mdzes gyur cig /dag bcos cung zad gu h+yas bgyis so// // nyo) ༈ thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum zhi khro rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du'ang bdud 'dul drag po rtsal gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthus/ dgra bgegs 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dmar chen thun gyi rdzas 'di la khug cig /nṛ tri dza dzaḥ lan gsum/ sman raka gis bran cing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐

gis spel/ hūm̐/ dur khrod rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /stobs ldan che mchog bla ma drag po rtsal/ /go cha ging chen bka' sdod sde bzhi bcas/ /thugs dam bskul lo mngon spyod las la bzhengs/ /bstan dgra bdud rigs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /srid pa'i khyon ltar brdal ba 'dod rgu'i sprin/ /thogs med drag sngags dmod pa'i lhar 'bul na/ /rngam brjid gtum pa'i gar gyis bzhes nas kyang*/ /dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs bla gzugs ming rus bcas/ /dkar nag dmar byang khram la gtab pa 'dis/ /bla rten srog khug smyo 'bog reng du chug /dmar nag las kyi mtshon cha drag po yis/ /srog gcod dbugs longs tshe yi 'du byed bkums/ /bag chags gzugs phung lhag med zhal du bstab/ /dam nyams dgra bgegs rang gshed rang la phob/ /skag sri rkyen ngan mi mthun dgra la sgyur/ /bsad rtags dmar po mngon sum gtan la phob/ /tshe dpal dbang thang 'byor pa srog gi rten/ /lus ngag yid gsum mthu rtsal nus stobs rnams/ /ldang med mnan cing dmod pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ces bla ma drag po kī la ya'i dgra mnan gyi skabs su thun gtor 'bul ba'i rim pa 'di sngags 'chang skyid grong smyon pas sbyar ba'o// // ti) ༈ drag po kī la ya'i las tshog dug gi par bu'i skor las: drag gtad sūr+ya'i tsakra'i drag sngags bzhugs so: them med skor ro: che mchog pad+ma khrag 'thung 'dud: ma 'ongs yang mtha' sum cu la: glo bur bar chad bdud kyis sdang : chos byed dmangs kyis khol bur 'bebs: dgra rkun jag chom dar ba'i tshe: ting 'dzin sgom brtson bar chad sdang : ban sngags nang rgyas mthu sgrub byed: che btsan rnams kyang dug gis gsod: ma 'ongs yang snyigs de yi dus: bstan dgra las ni sgos kyi dgra: de dag glo bur gsod pa'i thabs: drag gtad sūr+ya'i tsakra bstan: drag sngags kho bo pad 'byung ngas: snying rje'i sa bon ma dor zhing :

rjes 'jug bu la phan phyir bzhag: las can ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal mas: brda bzhi'i shog ser logs su bris: spu gri rigs gtso 'khor lo'i sdom: mi shigs brag gi dkyil du sbos: sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: de la dang po 'gugs pa: gnyis pa bskrad pa: gsum pa gzir ba: bzhi pa gtad pa dang bzhi las: dang po 'gugs pa ni: dug shog gam ni gang rung la: gri khrag: dme khrag: yugs sa'i mngal khrag: mdze khrag: khyi khrag: rta khrag: ban de bka' log pa'i khrag: rgya khrag: gtsod khrag: dug khrag: ra khrag: phag khrag:gcan gzan sna dgu'i khrag: gza' brgyad kyi sman: dug sna dgu sbal sbrul gyi sha: de rnams zhib tu 'thag pa'i khu bas bris pa'i liṅga dbang po tshang ba la yan lag lnga nas sbrul gyis za ba: de'i phyi rol du sdig pas bskor ba du yod grangs las mang bar bya: bris thur lcags smyug gam skyer shing gis bri: yang na rdo nag gis g.ya' ma la bris pas tshur mi ldog: shog dgra yin na: sbal pa'i nang dug sna'i dkyil du bzhag: la chas kha bkag ste shin tu gnyan pa'i mtsho'am chu mig tu sba: sa ma ya: gnyis pa bskrad pa ni: grib ma mi 'phog pa'i phug pa'am khang par bri: gu gul bdug cing ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyang : gsum pa gzir ba ni: dgra bo'i gos dri ma can nam: skra sen zag rdzas rjes sa la sogs pa de: lcags snod du bsags te liṅga dang sbrags: pho mo gnyis kyi liṅga yin na kha sbyor te snal mas dkris: dug khrag gi rlan bcos par bya'o: sa ma ya: bzhi pa gtad pa ni: sngags bzlas pas 'gugs pa'i rtags la mi nag mang pos cho nge'i sgra dang : mi dmar mang pos gzhan gyi mgo snying nang khrol khyer nas byung ba: gcan gzan gyis byol song bsad pa: ling pas ri dwags bsad pa: bud med mang pos dmar mchod 'gyed pa: sgrub pa pos gzhan gyi lus la mtshon btab pa: brag bshig pa: chu dkrug pa: ri nyil ba: mi'i snying dang sha khrag la dgyes pa: ban bon dang lha khang bcom pa:

gcan gzan gyi ngu sgra sgrog pa sogs rmis na khug pa'i rtags: yang rang dang gzhan gnyis rtsod pas rang pham pa: gcan gzan dang dmag gis ded pa sa rdo rbab dang ser ba byung zhing : gzhan gyis rang la kha yog 'gel ba sogs rmis na pha rol gyi lha rgod cing ma khug pa'i rtags yin pas: chos skyong drag po las la bskul zhing dgra bor lha dbye mang du bya: 'gugs pa'i dus ni nam phyed nyin phyed srod 'phros tho rangs nyi nub sogs dus skabs su 'gugs: chos skyong bzhengs bskul mdos bzlog dang sbrags: dgra 'gugs pa'i yul ni hom khung nag po rtsang gis brgyan pa steng du ri rab bang rim dgu yis mnan pa: de'i steng du gnam lcags gyi phur bu gzugs phyogs sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan chos skyong tsakli gri mtshon gyi g.yab mo dang thun rdzas bshams: ngag bsdam zhing smra ba mi bya: sha khrag dang chang la 'dzem: phyi rol du legs nyes kyi bya ba gang yang la mig gis longs spyod spang : dbang po'i dwangs ma lnga mi nyams: lar rtsub pa'i nyams ci byung yang rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang mi 'bral bar bya'o: khug pa'i rtags byung nas gtad pa ni: nyi ldog gam gza' rgyu phyogs nyi ma nub mtshams su lha 'dre rgyu ba'i dus yin pas gtad par bya'o: de'ang chos skyong gi gtor 'bul dang g.yab pa'i dar mnan pa'i ri bo sogs shes par bya'o: gtad pa'i klu ni thebs pa'i dus dang bstun na myur: mi log mi sdug mi 'byams par lan gsum gtad: rjes su khyung gi tho bya: yang gnad can la bskyar yang rung : sngags pa nang rgyas bzlog pa dang sbrags na myur: kho'i rigs rgyud kyi mgo rnyed na rab: ma rnyed na gcan gzan thod pa myur: tha mar rwa rtse: rang la mi log par byed khrol gyi srung ba 'dogs: rgyun du chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul: de nas dgra bo rtsal rdzogs nas yul de'i klu la gtad dkrol gyi 'khor lo phul khrus bya zhing gtang rag gtong :
sa ma ya: sngags ni:

nag po phe sha phe lam dgra bo la yaṃ yaṃ rmug rmug myog myog thum thum ril ril: nā ga sog la me kha thun nag po dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa phyung phyung : dgra bo 'di la mdze gri thongs: gri gri thongs: satwa gri thongs: baṃ gri thongs: chu gri thongs: me gri thongs: lceb gri thongs: thog gri thongs: mdze nad thongs: snying gzer thongs: khrag skyug thongs: dmar nad thongs: steng grib thongs: lhog yams thongs: gzer thum thongs: smyo 'bog thongs: rims yams thongs: sbos 'gas thongs: glang thab thongs: rigs rgyud thongs: klu'i dug mda' nag pos dgra bo'i sha khrag longs: ha la du ru dgra bo'i don snod lnga la rbad: dgra bo nṛ tri gzer thum: thun thun shig shig dza dza rbad: ces sngags rnams lto bar bri'am sbrul gyi khong du bri: 'khor lo bskor na gnam sa gru gsum du shing tsher ma can gyis byang bus: liṅga bskor: de ltar na rbad bsad kyi sngags dang ming rus sbyar nas bskor: yang na chos skyong gi sngags kyi sham bur dgra bo'i ming dang bsad sngags bskor: yul la bskor na yul ming dang yul de'i sa sna chu sna dgra bo'i zhing khang nor rdzas sogs blang zhing bskol bas yul phung du 'gro: yang dgra bo 'gugs par byed na sngags 'di sbyar: dgra bo'i lus chings shig: ka ya a ru sa satwaṃ bha ya: ngag chings: khag thum satwaṃ bha ya yid chings shig: tsit+ta thum ril satwaṃ bha ya: dun dun dgra bo kha la yaṃ tse nan: zhes sham bu bri: bskor na yugs mo'i skras bcing : de nas khug rtags byung nas me sdig la gtad kyang rung : sa ma ya: e maḥ drag sngags pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: gdug pa'i srog gi spu gri 'di: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu la bzhag: gsang sngags bstan la dgra dar na: tsakra bzlog med gzer thig rgya: snying gi bu mchog ma gtogs par: 'khor lo dpe'u ris ma ston cig: don med sngags pa zhe sdang can: dug sbrul 'dra der ma ston cig:

las mtha' par bu nag po 'di: ma 'ongs nyi shu shar ba'i dus: pad 'byung nga yi thugs kyi sras: gnubs ston dzñā na'i skyes mtha' mchog: drag sngags pad+ma gter bdag gling : las can skyes bu de nyid dang : yang zab 'di dang 'phrad par shog: lha bdud btsan klu dge bsnyen rnams: dam chos 'di yi bya ra mdzod: bdag 'dra sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal gyis gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod nas gdan drangs shing sbas yul pad+ma'i tshal du shog ser las zhal bshus so// // thu) bdud 'dul che mchog kī la ya'i zin bris brjed tho bzhugs so// dang po bca' tshogs kyi yar gzhi klu dbang gi phyogs su cung zad mtho ba'i khar/ g.yas su zhi ba la/ gdan gor mo gsum gyi khar gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab zlum 'gyed bzhis spras pa bsham/ dbus su gdan gru bzhi bang rim gsum gyi khar/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng du rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng du dpal gyi gtor ma brjid chags pad 'dab bzhis spras pa mtshams bzhir mtheb skyu bzhi ril bu bzhi bya/ drag po'i gtor ma/ g.yon du yum gtor la gdan chos 'byung bsnol ma'i khar snying bshos brjid chags thod skam gyi pad 'dab bzhi yod par bya/ g.yas g.yon du sman dang rak+ta bum pa sku rten rnams bsham/ de 'og tu bzlog pa bcas la/ rang gzhung las/ phung sa'i stegs bu gru bzhi la: ro sol dug khrag chag chag gdab: gnam lcags 'khor lo ma traṃ gyis: thig btab rab ni pho brang brtsig: ces gsungs/ rab sa stegs la dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs bri ba'am/ tha ma ma traṃ sogs ci 'grub spyi mthun ltar gyi khar/ rang gzhung las/ de dbus gru gsum liṅga bzhag: rgyas pa lha grangs lta bu la: bris ling steng du zan ling bzhag: dar nag re ba nag pos gcod: ces dang*/ lcags ri'i nang du dgra ling ni: khrag gis sbags la gang mang bzhag: thun mtshams 'gugs gzhug thun gyis brab: ces gsungs/ lcags kyi hom khung dkar byang shog ling mnan rdzas dang dbye 'gugs bya ba grub pa'ang*/
