gal chung na zan ling dmar byang bzhag pa'i khar/ rang gzhung las/ de steng drag po'i gtor ma ni: lcags sam shing gi li khram steng : rab ni lcags snod drag po'i rdzas: ma rnyed gang rung snod gtsang du: ngar phye khrag chang dag gis sbrus: dregs pa rngam 'dra khro zhal btod: dmar nag me ri zur gsum brgyan: rtse mor khyung chen 'bar bar gzugs: go cha lnga la dpal gtor re: kī la rigs bzhir dpal gtor bzhi: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad sde brgyad la: rang rang 'os pa'i bshos bu bzhag: sgo ma bzhi yang de bzhin grangs: lha grangs ltar gyi khrag kong brgyan: zhes gsungs pas/ lcags snod sogs kyi nang du 'bru nag phye khrag gis sbags pa la dmar gtor khro zhal dang me ris brgyan pa'i rtse mor srung bzlog 'khor lo dang bya khyung 'dzugs/ de'i phyi rol tu dmar gtor lnga/ de'i phyi rol tu bzhi/ de'i phyi rol tu brgyad/ de'i phyi rol tu ba liṃ khrag kong de'i grangs ldan bya/ rang gzhung las/ phyag rtsang drug cu re bzhi ni: ring thung khru re'i tshad du bya: phyi rtsang brgya dang rtsa lnga ste: ring thung mtho re'i tshad du bya: shan pa srin mo'i 'gros su btsugs: bha su ta'i zhags pas bsdam: rtse mo sha dang liṅgas brgyan: dar nag gur phub tsit+ta dang : zlog 'khor me long dar snas brgyan: ma 'byor snal ma'i gdugs rtsibs dbus: zhes gsungs pa de ltar/ rang gzhung las/ phyogs bzhi dur 'jim kong zor la: mda' dang dregs pa'i zor rdzas dang : dmar chen yon chab la sogs pa'i: drag po nyer spyod rnams kyang bzhag: ces gsungs pa dang*/ rang gzhung las/ srid pa lha yi kong zor ni: ri nyil g.yul 'khrug tshab mo che: ri sul sha rbud sde phung shul: mdze mo nya shul sreg pa rnga mong shi: phung sa dgu las byas pa yi: kong zor ro sol gri khrag gi: dmar nag rtsang gis brgyan pa thogs: zhes gsungs pa ltar kong zor rtsang gis brgyan pa dang*/ rang gzhung las/

'chi bdag gshin rje'i khram zor ni: skyer byang ngos la phung rdzas dgus: 'chi bdag nag po'i dza khram gdab: ces gsungs pas/ zor gyi nang du skyer pa gong gi rdzas bsres pa'i khrag gi khram ris btod de rtsang gis brgyan/ yang rang gzhung las/ srog bdag ma mo'i dug zor ni: btsan dug ra dug bong dug dang : thar nu thang phrom re lcag sogs: dug rdzas sna dgu lkugs chur sbyor: phung sa'i kong bur blugs pa thogs: zhes gsungs pas/ gong gi phung sa dgus bzos pa'i zor gyi nang du gong du smos pa'i dug rdzas blugs te rtsang gis brgyan/ rang gzhung las/ srog bdag shan pa'i rdo zor ni: gnam lcags thog bshig brag ri'am: rbab rgod mi bsad zur gsum rdor: dug khrag rbad bh+yo bris pa thogs: zhes gsungs pas/ phung sa las byas pa'i zor nang du gong nas 'byung ba'i rdo la dug khrag gi yi ge bris pa bzhag ste rtsang 'dzugs/ yang rang gzhung las/ srog bdag shel ging nyungs zor ni: brag nag byang bstan dur khrod dam: rtsub 'gyur tshal du skyes pa yi: nyungs dkar khro zhal ldan pa thogs: zhes gsungs pas/ gong ltar zor gyi nang du nyungs dkar btsugs te rtsang gis brgyan/ btsan rgod 'bar ba'i snying zor ni: dam nyams bsgral ba'i tsit+ta 'am: ngar phye dug khrag sbyar ba yi: tsit+ta zur brgyad ngos logs su: dmar nag rtsang gis brgyan pa thogs: zhes gsungs pas gong du smaus pa'i ngar phye dang*/ khrag gis sbags pa'i snying zor rtsang gis brgyan/ yang rang gzhung las/ gnod sbyin nag po'i thod zor ni: dam sri pho mau bsnol ba'i bus: gdug rtsub 'chang ba'i thod pa ru: phung rdzas sna dgu brub pa la: rtsang gis brgyan nam ngar zan la: thog mde'u'i dbyibs la rtsang btsugs pa: thod pa'i nang du bcug pa thogs: zhes gsungs pas/ gong du smos pa'i thod pa'i steng du zan gyi thog mde'u bzhag ste rtsang 'dzugs pa'am thod pa bcas la rtsang 'dzugs/ rang gzhung las/

klu bdud nag po'i khrag zor ni: bud med gcig la yugs sa dgu: pho 'gam yugs sa dgu dag gi: mngal khrag kong bur blugs pa thogs: zhes gsungs pas/ zor gyi nang du khrag kong bzhag ste rtsang 'dzugs/ rang gzhung las/ ging chen dkar nag phur bu'i zor: sked pa rgya mdud rtsang rtse dbal: dug shing skyer pa'i phur bu la: bsad pa spu gri'i khrag rgod dang : dug khrag rdzas kyis ngar blud do: zhes gsungs pa bzhin zor gyi nang du gong ltar gy-i phur bu 'dzugs te rtsang gis brgyan/ rang gzhung las/ ma gza' rdor legs mda' yi zor: gri rgod rtsib gzhu gri rgyus bring : dug shing skyer mda' srin bya 'ug: bya rog sgros brgyan gri lcags mde'u: reg phung dug gis ngar btab pa: g.yas g.yon sbrel zhing pho nya 'gyed: ces gsungs pas/ rab gong du smras pa nyid dang tha ma skyer pa'i mda' gzhu dang rtsang rnams 'dzugs pa'i zor bya/ de mthar g.yon bskor du khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang lnga'i me tog /tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ tsit+ta'i zhal zas/ rkang gling dang thod rnga'i rol mo bsham/ shar du phyi mchod kyi pañtsa spyi ltar dang*/ lhor stag lpags sogs kyi steng du tshogs sha/ tshogs chang*/ tshogs tshes zan/ gzhan yang tshogs rdzas rnams phun sum tshogs par bsham/ byang du bka' srung gi rigs bsham dgos pas/ dang po dam can gyi gtor ma ni/ rang gzhung las/ 'bru nag gam mam gang rung zan: ra mgos mtshan pa'i dpal gtor gzugs: ra yi sha khrag gsur btang zhing : zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ dmu bdud klu gsum gyi gtor ma rang gzhung las/ dmu bdud klu gsum gtor ma ni: dmu la zur gsum rtse mo nor bus mtshan: bdud la gtor nag zur gsum mi mgos mtshan: klu la nor bu sbrul dkris pad+mas mtshan: zhes gsungs pa de ltar dang dge bsnyen sde bzhi ni/ rang gzhung las/ bse phor zangs snod gang rung du: dpal bshos bzhi bshams dkar dmar brgyan:

skyems phud mchod pa ci 'byor bsham: zhes gsungs pa de ltar bya/ gnod sbyin shan pa spun gsum ni/ rang gzhung las/ rin chen snod gtsang nang du dkar gtor pad 'dab can gyi g.yas su bdud gtor g.yon gcus/ g.yon du btsan gtor g.yas gcus/ mtshams su mtheb skyus bskor ba bsham: zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ rang lugs spyi ltar chad mdo brtan ma gzhan yang chos skyong gang 'os kyi gtor ma bsham/ gzhan yang myur mgyogs sde bzhi'i gtor ma/ gzhung nas nges par ma gsungs kyang rang gi blos dpag ste bsham mo/ /lho nub srin po'i phyogs su zhing lpags sogs kyi steng du/ rang gzhung las/ zor las dmod pa'i zhal btab brtsam pa ni: zan ling khrag gis sbrus pa zhig gis 'thus: dar nag re nag mun pa nag pos dgab: mtha' bskor phur yungs la sogs thun rdzas dang : bya 'ug sgro sogs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas: gdab phur las phur sgrol gri gtun tho sogs: mngon spyod drag po'i thun rdzas ma lus bsag: ces gsungs pa de ltar bsags pa'i gong du smras pa'i shog ling dang gnyis ka dgra dpung tshan la bstun pas kyang chog: gzhan yang bskul gyi skabs su 'bul gtor sum cu so bdun bya ste mtha' gang bder bsham mo/ gzhan yang mtha' btegs dma' sar phung ras sam zhing lpags sogs kyi steng du glud ni/ rang gzhung las/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi rim pa ni: mi nor phyugs kyi ngar glud dang : zan chang changs bu brgya rtsa'i grangs: ting lo mar me kyu gu dang : 'bru sna zas sna dar sna sman: ras sna gos sna pags pa'i rigs: dkar gsum mngar gsum rin chen rigs: sha chang zas sna tshang bar bsags: sbang ma ja lo thal zan sogs: mi kha'i yas stags sna tshogs dang : ji ltar 'byor ba glud la 'bungs: zhes gsungs pa dang*/ srin mo'i za lam ni/ rang gzhung las/ lcags sam gang rung snod dag tu: ngar zan nam ni sa spyin la/ srin gzugs nu 'phyangs mtshan ma bsgrad: mthing nag skra gzengs g.yas g.yon du:

dmar gtor zor gyi kong bu thogs: mtha' bskor phyogs mtshams khrag kong brgyad: yang na dmar gtor gtso 'khor brgyad: tshe nyungs rtsang gis brgyan pa la: dmar sbreng dpal 'bar btsugs pa bsham: zhes gsungs pa de ltar bya ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun sar nas gzeb gdab phur dar sna'i g.yab mo'ang bsham mo/ ༈ dang po dngos gzhi'i don la 'jug pa ni/ rang gzhung las/ rdzong 'phrang srog gsum ldan pa'i sngags 'chang gis: bstan dgra bsgral ba'i sems bskyed go gyon te: mngon spyod dmod pa drag po'i chas su zhugs: zhes gsungs pas/ bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gong gi yo byad bsags te/ dang po brgyud 'debs ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: ye shes rang gsal lhun grub dkyil 'khor dbus: sogs kyi gsol 'debs mu tig rtsal kud 'don/ de nas zhi ba'i sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: sogs kyi skyabs sems dang*/ de nas dkar gtor snang ba'i 'dod yon gyis 'bul/ de nas zhi ba'i las byang gi hūm̐: bdag nyid bdud 'dul khro rgyal gyi: sogs nas dkyus ltar bgegs 'gugs bskrad kyis bgegs gtor dor: hūm̐: steng 'og sogs/ hūm̐: bla med kun bzang nas a hūm̐ bar/ hūm̐: pad 'byung rig 'dzin sogs/ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ bar/ hūm̐: snang srid pad 'byung zil gnon lha sogs nas tsit+ta hūm̐ bar/ hūm̐: nam mkha'i dbyings nas stong gsal ru: sogs nas dkyus ltar dzap bar 'don/ bsnyen pa ci nus mthar dngos grub bskul/ de nas drag po'i gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ gsol 'debs rgyas pa bdud dpung g.yul 'joms kyi/ e ma hoḥ chos dbyings mtha' bral yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas sogs nas khyab brdal chen po'i a la la/ bar brjod/ na mo: sangs rgyas kun 'dus rje btsun thod phreng rtsal: sogs nas phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: bar 'don/ srung bzlog gi de'ang rang nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la

sogs nas 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur: bar bya rang gzhung las/ sgrub pa rtsa sngags kyi gzhi tshugs: go cha zhi ba: rigs bzhi rgyas pa: khro bcu dbang : las sngags drag sgrub sde brgyad byed gzhug: sde gsum mtha' sdud sogs rim pa ltar le lo rnam g.yeng mi tshig gis bar ma chod par rtags rdzogs su bzla'o: oṃ ā hūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig sogs bsnyen pa ci nus mthar/ hūm̐ sgrub bya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: dur khrod chos 'byung me dpung 'bar ba'i klong : sogs nas ma hā sarba pū dza la khā hi bar brjod/ 'di'i mtshams nas/ dam can/ dmu bdud klu gsum/ dge bsnyen sde bzhi/ srung ma nyer bsdus/ shan pa spun gsum/ 'bar ba mched bzhi dang gzhan yang bka' srung gang 'os thams cad 'di'i mtshams su 'don/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi/ om̐ e shud+dhe nas dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bar dang srung bzlog gi mdun bskyed kyi pho brang 'og tu dgra bo'i bsad khang nang nas ming shul tsam yang med par bya bar 'don/ las byang rtsa sngags me dpung 'khor lo ltar/ om̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig hūm̐

sogs kyi bzlas pa bya/ rang gzhung las/ las bzhi'i skabs su sham bu kha bsgyur ni/ dang po go cha lus dang srog nyams par gyur cig mā ra ya bzlog bzlog nan nan/ de nas kun la 'gres zhes gsungs pas/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo byad ma'i lha srung dang mgon skyabs thams cad nyams par gyur cig /mā ra ya bzlog nan/ om̐ ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa badz+ra pā ṇi sarba ḍāk+ki yak+ṣa kā la hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo'i lus dang srog thams cad? om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bo'i zla ba dang lus? om̐ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra ya bi dza ya ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li nī la dan+ḍa a tsa le a pa rā dzi ta trai lokya bi dza ya ma hā bā la kro ta kro ti hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i zhag dang dbang thang? om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru artsig nirtsig badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo'i dus tshes dang rlung rt om̐ hri tri ka la a ya ma du ru tsa sha n sogs kyi shog byang ltar bzla bar bya/ lo rgyal po la dgra dar ba mā ra ya rbad nan: zla ba blon po la dgra dar b sogs dang*/ lag rdeb kyis/ hūm̐ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu gsal ba yi? sogs a ā bar brjod/ de nas bzlog pa'i gong rang gzhung las zlog dmigs dang brab dmigs 'grub nas mnan dmigs dmigs pa bya zhes gsungs pas/ rang gzhung las rlung ri rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba hūm̐ yig gi nang du dgra bo mngon sum du dmigs pa'i snying khar sku smad gnam lcags kyi dbal btab pa ni/ dbal zur nas las mkhan shan pa 'phros pas kho'i nus pa 'joms/ mya ngan gyi skad tser kyi hud 'debs pa de'i las mkhan rnams kyis rgyob sod kyi sgra 'brug ltar ldir bas/ sku'i cha nas khro chu'i tshwa tshwa gnam lcags kyi zi ra thog char bu yug 'tshubs te bskrad cing bcom nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsgom/

khyad par du snang srid thams cad khro bo'i me dpung sa gzhi thams cad khro chu khol ma'i rba rlabs zi ra khol ma'i rang bzhin can du bsgom/ de'i snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam sri 'byung po'i bar chad ma rungs bdud kyi cho 'phrul ban bon sngags pa'i rgyob zor rnams skad cig la brlag nus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ lag rdeb kyis/ om̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma kā ra sogs nas byad ma rbod gtong thams cad zlog zlog bar bya ba legs/ de ltar dang*/ 'di mtshams do gal che na spu gri'i mngon rtogs hūm̐ sgrub bya ba'ang legs so/ /de nas thun mtshams gtor 'bul ni/ spu gri las/ hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog badz+ra kī la ya: sogs nas ha la ha la hūm̐ bh+yo zlog zlog bar byas te gtor ma 'bul/ de nas rjes chog gi tshogs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po'i thugs ka nas: sogs om̐ a hūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ bar bya/ de nas bskang bsdus kyi/ hūm̐ gdod nas dag pa chos sku zhi khro'i klong : nas rang sa zin gyur cig: bar bya/ de nas bla ma'i zhal rgyun las/ dkyil 'khor gcig la gdab las gnyis mi bya zhes gsungs pas/ bsgral las gzhung la 'jug pa ni gong du bshad pa ltar bsgral chas gzhung ltar 'grigs nas/ dmag bskul gtong ba ni/ rang gzhung las/ zor gtor ling ro sman raka gis bran: gtor chung dmar chen la sogs bsham: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gtor chung sum cu so gcig dang sha dum de grangs bshams te bar mtshams su 'bul/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sogs nas/ rak+mo yak+mo ka la du tri dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: bar brjod/ de nas smad las kyi rang nyid skad cig gis che mchog kī la ya nas dkyus ltar/ las mkhan dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bar brjod/ thun gtor bshams te/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang sogs/

ldang med mnan cing dmod pa'i phrin las mdzod: bar bya ste gtor ma 'bul/ hūm̐: dregs byed stag gdong dkar po'i dus la bab: nas bh+yo dun+ti de wa byad ma trig trig bh+yo bh+yo bar bya/ thun bskul ni/ bh+yo: bzhengs shig sogs? nas dngos 'dzin thal ba rdul du rlog bar bya/ hūm̐: dur khrod phung shul dag las grub pa'i sa: nas/ keṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi: bar brjod/ de las dug phreng nag po la 'jug pa ni/ rang gzhung las/ bskul zhing liṅga dum bu bcas: tshig gi mtshams so sor bsgral bstab bya: dmar sbreng drag po'i gtor rdzongs bya: zhes gsungs pas ling ro dum bu nyer lnga dang sha dum gtor chung de mtshungs tshig mtshams su phul te/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar rab 'bar 'khrugs pa'i klong : sogs nas myur du khug la bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: bar bya/ de nas rtsang bzlog khyung bzlog /bzlog 'phyong gshin rje myos byed ltar dang*/ than bzlog rnams bya/ zor rnams rak+tas bran zhing gdan steng du bshams nas zor rdzas byin rlabs rnams/ nyin re bzhin 'don/ de nas glud dang za lam rnams lam bstan yan 'don/ de nas lhag ma bsngau'o/ de nas las byang gi bskul gtong*/ de nas chos skyong rnams kyi gtor 'bul/ chad mdo 'bul/ brtan ma skyong*/ rta bro bya/ bzod gsol bya/ de nas 'di mtshams su rang gzhung las/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa ni: dgong thun bzhag pa'i tshe srod thun nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la: ting 'dzin mi g.yo bar gsal gdab pa'i ngang nas: zhes gsungs pas/ hoḥ skad cig gis bdag mdun mi dmigs pa'i ngang las e chos 'byung sogs nas/ 'gran zla bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur bar bya: bla ma thod phreng rtsal gyi nas 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: bar bya/ rang gzhung las/ nub mo nyal khang srung 'khor dgu rim sgom zhing srung sngags bzla: rmi ltas log dang cho 'phrul sogs byung na:

gnyid sad skabs sham bu 'di bzla: zhes gsungs pas/ om̐ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭ nas satwaṃ bha ya nan bar bya/ de nas bsngo smon dang bkra shis sogs bya/ nyin tha mar babs tshe/ lhag ma yan gong dang 'dra la/ lhag ma nas/ sgo dbye bya ba ni/ dkar gtor gser skyems bsham la/ hūm̐: shar phyogs dung mkhar ldem pa nas bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bar bya/ sgo gtsang dang mdos thig dkrol/ de nas rang gzhung las/ dmar rlon g.yang gzhi bting ba'i khar: sna der dkar gtor za lam dang : de rgyab dmar chen gtor ma dang : glud dang drag po'i zor rdzas bsham: sngags 'chang dmod pa'i chas su zhugs: srid pa'i spyi zhwa ser nag bklubs: lto zhal rak+sha mgo phreng dang : rus rgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur: gdong la ro sol dug khrag byug: thun dang rdzas ru ga shal brgyan: drag po khros pa'i stang stabs kyis: zhing chen gdan la rol stabs 'khod: g.yas g.yon rdo rje sngags 'chang rnams: rnga gling rol mo sna tshogs bcas: zhes gsungs pas de ltar bsham tshul dang chas gos rnams bshad ma thag ltar bya ste: mdos lam du dpag /de nas 'grig na/ rang gzhung las/ gzhan yang zor gyi rgyab chos su: ban de thal rdeb bon po gshang : skyes pa mtshon thogs yugs sa ni: dur 'daibs byis sba 'ur thogs sogs: srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams: ban bon rig sngags dmod par byed: snang srid g.yo 'khrug cho 'phrul than: bzlog phyir rten 'brel rtags su 'chang : bka' yi tha tshig chad mdo bsgrag: gtor ma 'bul zhing gser skyems mchod: srin mos zor lam dbye bar bya: dmar chen zor la dpal 'bar 'dzugs: gser skyems dmar sbreng yus 'dren cing : ma nyes gzu dpang thugs dam bskul: chad mdo dang bka' srung rnams 'don/ gzhung gi bskul ba bya/ za lam dang glud sogs lam bstan 'don/ de nas gser skyems btang ste/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha:

nas de ring drag po'i phrin las mdzod: bar bya/ rang gzhung las/ de nas zor rnams rim par 'degs: dregs sde ma lus bran du bskol: rngam sgras srid gsum 'jig rten g.yo: snang srid thog dang mtshon char 'khrigs: las byed pho nya dregs pa can: dgra bo'i sha khrag srog la rngam: sngags rgod bzla zhing rdo thun brdeg: dar nag g.yab cing rnga gling sogs: ngar chen bskyed pa'i rol mo bsgrag: go mtshon phyar dar bswo sgra sgrog: 'phang ba'i sa ru ring bar 'gro: zhes gsungs pas bzhengs bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bzhengs shig skye med klong nas bzhengs: nas da lta nyid du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: bar du bya ste lam du zhugs/ rang gzhung las/ zor rdzas dgu bsad ltar du 'phang : zhes gsungs pa de ltar bya dgos so/ /de nas rang gzhung las/ hom sbar dmigs bya gtor chen bsreg: ces gsungs pas/ hoḥ dgongs shig mi mngon phyogs bcu rab 'byams nas: nas skad cig da lta nyid du zhal bzhes shig: bar brjod te 'phang*/ rang gzhung las/ zlog sngags bzla zhing gtor zor 'chang : zor chen 'khor 'das stobs 'dus mtshon cha thogs: srid pa phur bu'i ngar bsad khro chu khol: srid pa'i mtshon cha dug rlangs bu yug 'tshubs: ldog med gnam lcags thog ltar 'phang ba yis: mtha' dmag nad mtshon byur dang skag rkyen rigs: rdul du brlag pa'i dbang po sha khrag rus: las byed pho nyas hub sgra dir dir rol: slar yang ldog med rig sngags dmod pas 'debs: dar nag g.yab cing mtshon thogs bswo sgra 'debs: zhes gsungs pas/ zlog sngags bzlas shing dar nag g.yab: rang gzhung las/ ban de'i thal rdeb bon po'i dzo zor 'phang : yugs sa dur 'debs byis pa'i 'ur rdo 'phang : ma nyes shag 'debs yus dang la sogs brdar: dmag bzlog la sogs dgos gnad che ba dang : sku 'khor bsdeb cing dregs sde las la dbab: gnod byed kun 'joms bya ra g.yul ngo bzlog:

ces gsungs pa de ltar bya/ rang gzhung las/ gom dgu bgrod mtshams tho brtsig bya khyung bsgom: zhes gsungs pas/ hūm̐: tho ni khyung nag 'bar ba kha gdangs nas khrom̐ raṃ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐: bar bya ste tho bya/ rang gzhung las: de nas sgo drung bshal chus brtan ma bskyang : zhes gsungs pas sgo drung khang thog tu brtan ma 'bul: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs: kyis phul/ rang gzhung las/ gtor gzhong kha sbub dmigs bya 'gugs bstim bya: ldang med khro rgyal stobs 'dus dgra bo gzir: mched lcam mthe'u chung sbrel zhing bro ra ni: mngon spyod drag po'i zur gsum g.yon du bskor: zhes gsungs pas/ sgo 'gag tu gtor gzhong sbub la sgab 'dre bkug cing rta bro bya ba ni/ hūm̐: drag po dpal gyi dkyil 'khor du: nas mā ra ya nan: bar bya/ rang gzhung las de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bzed la nas 'bru blugs: zhes gsungs pas/ de bzhin/ hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yi dam lha tshogs la: nas rgyal khams phyogs med bde ba'i bkra shis shog: bar bya/ rang gzhung las/ mched lcam rnams kyis phye mar skyems chang la rol zhing ha ha'i gad mo dang bcas nang du log: ces gsungs pas/ nang du log la tshe 'gugs dang dngos grub len chog la rol te/ hūm̐: zab dbyings bde chen mkha' spyod klong yangs nas: nas/ ma hā mu ṭa sarba sid+dhi hrī bar 'don/ de nas sngar ltar srung 'khor bsgom/ lag rdeb bya ste/ rdzogs rim nyer bsdu dang bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' legs par bya'o/ 'dir smras pa/ pad 'byung rab khros snyigs dus la dmigs pa/ /pad+ma'i zab gter bdud 'dul kī la ya/ /pad+ma'i brgyud 'dzin rno ba'i mtshon cha 'di/ /pad+ma ge sar bdag yid rmad byung bkod/ ces rten 'brel brda 'byin dang bcas zin bris phra zhib tu bkod pa 'di/ rang gzhung bslad med 'bru 'grel bab col du bzhag pa dang dkyil 'khor gzhan dang khog dbubs su/

o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa rin po che'i zhabs rdul gtsug gi rgyan du byed po bag med dkor 'gam btsun chung ar+yā dh+wa dzas bris so// // de) ༈ gu ru drag po kī la ya'i bla ma'i gtor ma/ gdan gru bzhi'i steng du bla ma'i gtor ma pad 'dab bzhi yis brgyan cing mtshams su mtheb skyu 'jog /yi dam gtor ma gdan gru bzhi'i steng du/ rtsibs brgyad/ de'i steng du rtsibs bzhi/ de'i steng du bla ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du bla ma bra gzugs/ zur gsum thod skam gyis brgyan/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma gdan gru bzhi'i steng du*/ chos 'byung bsnol ma/ de'i steng du dpal gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa/ dkar dmar gyis brgyan cing mdzes par bya/ gtor zlog /gtor ma khro zhal byung na rab/ ma byung na dmar gtor khru gang zhig la yum gtor phyed cha/ 'khor sras bzhi yum/ go cha lha lnga/ sde brgyad/ sgo ma bzhi/ mtheb skyu/ a ku lha grangs g.yas su rtsang bzlog dmar gtor mtho gang zhig la 'khor bzhi/ g.yon phyogs than bzlog dmar gtor mtho gang la 'khor nyer cig /bka' gter srung ma/ chad brtan spyi 'gro/ de ltar spu bo gtor ma'i bca' gshom gsar 'gyur lags// //
